papers.title: Non-Invertible Symmetries on Tensor-Product Hilbert Spaces and Quantum Cellular Automata
papers.abstract: We investigate realizations of (1+1)-dimensional fusion category symmetries on tensor-product Hilbert spaces, allowing for mixing with quantum cellular automata (QCAs). It was argued recently that any such realizable symmetry must be weakly integral. We develop a systematic analysis of QCA-refined realizations of fusion categories and prove two statements. First, we show that, under certain physical assumptions on defects, any QCA-refined realization has QCA and symmetry-operator indices determined by the categorical data, up to the freedom of redefining the symmetry operators. Second, we construct a lattice model that provides a QCA-refined realization for any weakly integral fusion category symmetry on a tensor product Hilbert space. We also compute indices of the QCAs in our lattice model and show agreement with the first result. As an application of the general construction, we give an explicit QCA-refined realization of general Tambara-Yamagami categorical symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fusion category symmetries, quantum cellular automata, lattice model construction。；研究对象：(1+1)维张量积希尔伯特空间上的融合范畴对称性，以及其与量子胞自动机（QCA）的混合实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在特定物理假设下，任何QCA修正的融合范畴对称性实现中，QCA和对称性算子的指标由范畴数据唯一确定（允许重新定义对称性算子的自由度）；并构造了一个格点模型，为任意弱整融合范畴对称性提供了QCA修正的实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在特定物理假设下，任何QCA修正的融合范畴对称性实现中，QCA和对称性算子的指标由范畴数据唯一确定（允许重新定义对称性算子的自由度）；并构造了一个格点模型，为任意弱整融合范畴对称性提供了QCA修正的实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于缺陷的物理假设，对QCA修正的融合范畴实现进行系统性分析；格点模型构造：为弱整融合范畴对称性显式构建张量积希尔伯特空间上的模型，并计算其中QCA的指标。具体应用：对一般Tambara-Yamagami范畴对称性给出显式QCA修正实现。

papers.title: From Coffee Rings to Self-Driven Assembly: Active Matter Enabled Design of Drying Droplets
papers.abstract: Evaporating colloidal droplets have long been used as model systems to understand capillarity, interfacial transport, and particle assembly, most prominently through the coffee ring effect. In classical descriptions, suspended particles are treated as passive tracers carried by evaporation-driven capillary flow, with additional influence from Marangoni stresses, wettability, and contact line pinning. More recent studies, however, show that this picture changes significantly when the particles themselves are active. Systems containing motile microorganisms, chemically active colloids, or externally driven particles can continuously inject energy or generate gradients within the droplet, leading to self-driven flows, modified interfacial stresses, and dynamic contact line behavior. In this Perspective, we bring together these developments, identify the key mechanisms governing active droplets, highlight the role of bubble-mediated flows, and outline strategies for controlled deposition and functional interface design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述型（Perspective）。关键词：Perspective、identify key mechanisms、outline strategies。；研究对象：蒸发液滴中的活性物质（如运动微生物、化学活性胶体、外部驱动颗粒）及其引发的自驱动组装行为，特别是与经典“咖啡环效应”的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当悬浮颗粒具有活性（如自驱动或注入能量）时，经典蒸发液滴中的被动输运图像被彻底改变，活性颗粒可产生自驱动流、改变界面应力和接触线行为，从而调控沉积图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当悬浮颗粒具有活性（如自驱动或注入能量）时，经典蒸发液滴中的被动输运图像被彻底改变，活性颗粒可产生自驱动流、改变界面应力和接触线行为，从而调控沉积图案。；创新点：系统整合了活性物质与蒸发液滴交叉领域的最新进展，首次从“活性液滴”视角提出控制沉积和功能界面设计的策略，并强调了气泡介导流的作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于文献综述与理论机制分析，识别活性液滴的关键物理机制（如气泡介导流、自驱动流、界面应力修正），未涉及具体实验或计算手段。

papers.title: Multiscale order, flocking and phenotypic hysteresis in the cellular Potts model of epithelia
papers.abstract: In epithelia, how do collective cell migration and tissue spatial organization feedback on each other? We address this question through large-scale numerical simulations of the cellular Potts model. By accounting for both cell morphology and cytoskeletal activity, we uncover a remarkably rich phase diagram featuring multiple types of orientational order, either as distinct phases or coexisting across length scales. We identify a specific pathway in parameter space along which a gradual increase in the actin polymerization rate drives a phase transition into a long-range flocking state. Simultaneously, quasi-long-range nematic order emerges at length scales much larger than the cell size due to the combined effects of directed motion and lateral cell-cell interactions. At length scales comparible to cell size, however, cells adopt an approximatively hexagonal morphology, resulting in hexanematic order, similar to that observed in reconstituted Madin-Darby Canine Kidney (MDCK) cell monolayers. With further increases in actin polymerization, nematic order becomes fully long-range, while hexatic order remains quasi-long-range and confined to short length scales, but independent of cytoskeletal activity. When noise is sufficiently low to allow crystallization at finite actin polymerization rate, cycling the cell-monolayer across the melting transition yields an example of phenotypical hysteresis, reminiscent of that observed across the epithelial-mesenchymal transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：large-scale numerical simulations、cellular Potts model。；研究对象：上皮组织中的集体细胞迁移与空间组织之间的相互反馈，具体为细胞形态与细胞骨架活动对多尺度有序相变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在细胞Potts模型中，随着肌动蛋白聚合速率增加，系统经历从无序到长程定向 flocking 态的相变，同时在不同尺度上出现准长程向列序、六角向列序等共存的多类型取向有序，并观察到类似上皮-间充质转变的表型滞后现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在细胞Potts模型中，随着肌动蛋白聚合速率增加，系统经历从无序到长程定向 flocking 态的相变，同时在不同尺度上出现准长程向列序、六角向列序等共存的多类型取向有序，并观察到类似上皮-间充质转变的表型滞后现象。；创新点：揭示了上皮组织中多尺度取向有序（包括长程 flocking、准长程向列序、短程六角向列序）的共存与竞争，并首次在细胞Potts模型中通过循环跨过熔化转变实现了表型滞后，与上皮-间充质转变中的滞后现象类比。摘要未突出说明与具体实验数据的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模数值模拟，基于细胞Potts模型（cellular Potts model），同时考虑细胞形态和细胞骨架活动（如肌动蛋白聚合速率）作为控制参数。

papers.title: Duality Between Chemical Potential Dynamics and Reaction-Diffusion Systems
papers.abstract: Pattern formation in soft, active, and biological matter is described by two ostensibly distinct continuum frameworks: phase-field theories driven by chemical-potential gradients, and mass-conserving reaction-diffusion (McRD) dynamics governed by local interconversion kinetics. Here we establish a constructive, equation-level duality valid in the nonlinear, far-from-equilibrium regime. McRD is the broader class: every chemical-potential theory with conserved order parameters embeds as the slow dynamics on an attracting manifold of an McRD system; conversely, every McRD with attractive nullcline admits an exact chemical-potential representation in the fast-interconversion limit, with the constitutive relation set by the nullcline. The construction resolves the generic non-invertibility of the chemical-potential as a function of density in phase-separating regimes by embedding it as an attracting manifold in an extended two-field description with conserved total density. Gradient stiffness maps faithfully onto an intrinsic reaction-diffusion length set by the auxiliary field, yielding a diagonal-diffusion normal form whose interface profile matches the original Cahn-Hilliard model by construction. The duality yields an explicit dictionary for phase coexistence: the Maxwell equal-area construction is exactly equivalent to the reactive turnover-balance condition. It extends to weakly nonconservative dynamics, unifying reaction-arrested coarsening and mesa splitting, and to multicomponent theories with broken Maxwell symmetry. As a concrete payoff, the dual sharp-interface picture yields a closed-form velocity law for traveling waves in nonreciprocal Cahn-Hilliard dynamics, in quantitative agreement with simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：duality（对偶性）、equation-level（方程层面）、constructive（构造性）。；研究对象：软物质、活性物质和生物物质中的图案形成（pattern formation），具体涉及化学势梯度驱动的相场理论（phase-field theories）与质量守恒反应-扩散（McRD）动力学之间的对偶关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了化学势动力学与质量守恒反应-扩散系统在非线性、远离平衡态下的方程级对偶性：McRD系统是更广泛的框架，而化学势理论可嵌入为其吸引流形上的慢动力学；反之，具有吸引零倾线的McRD系统在快互转换极限下可精确表示为化学势理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了化学势动力学与质量守恒反应-扩散系统在非线性、远离平衡态下的方程级对偶性：McRD系统是更广泛的框架，而化学势理论可嵌入为其吸引流形上的慢动力学；反之，具有吸引零倾线的McRD系统在快互转换极限下可精确表示为化学势理论。；创新点：首次在非线性、远离平衡态下建立了化学势动力学与McRD系统之间的精确方程级对偶性，并给出了显式的对偶词典（如相共存条件、界面速度律），解决了相分离区域中化学势作为密度函数的非可逆性问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与构造性证明。通过将化学势理论嵌入扩展的双场描述（含守恒总密度），利用吸引流形、零倾线、快互转换极限等概念，建立对偶映射，并导出对角扩散规范形式、界面轮廓匹配、麦克斯韦等面积法则与反应周转平衡条件的等价性。

papers.title: Limitations of Debye-Waller lattice temperature extraction under electronic excitation
papers.abstract: Ultrafast diffraction is the cutting-edge technique to extract the atomic temperature at femtosecond timescales, and further related quantities - in particular, electron-phonon coupling strength at elevated electronic temperatures. The present work demonstrates limitations of such an analysis, emphasizing the importance of careful evaluation of the evolution of the Debye temperature. It is shown that, due to the sensitivity of the Debye-Waller analysis to this parameter, neglecting its changes under electronic excitation may lead to significant deviations of the atomic temperature extracted from its true values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/分析文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“demonstrates limitations”、“emphasizing the importance of careful evaluation”、“it is shown that”，属于对现有分析方法的理论局限性进行论证。；研究对象：超快衍射实验中，在电子激发条件下，利用Debye-Waller因子提取晶格温度的过程，以及与之相关的电子-声子耦合强度提取。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电子激发下，若忽略Debye温度的变化，基于Debye-Waller分析提取的晶格温度会显著偏离真实值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电子激发下，若忽略Debye温度的变化，基于Debye-Waller分析提取的晶格温度会显著偏离真实值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对Debye-Waller分析方法的理论敏感性进行分析，重点考察Debye温度参数在电子激发下的演化对温度提取结果的影响。

papers.title: Oscillatory photoresistance on the high field side of the cyclotron resonance
papers.abstract: We consider the displacement contribution to photoresistance in overlapping Landau levels at radiation frequencies much smaller than the cyclotron frequency. We show that in the limit of short-range disorder and high radiation power, this contribution leads to a new class of magneto-resistance oscillations. These oscillations, which we call radiowave-induced resistance oscillations (RIROs), are distinct from the well known microwave-induced resistance oscillations in the following aspects: (i) their amplitude is independent of power, (ii) their period is controlled by the radiation electric field, rather than by the radiation frequency, and (iii) they can be either $1/B$ or $1/B^2$-periodic, depending on $B$, with the crossover point linked to the width of the cyclotron resonance absorption curve. We also show that RIROs should be readily observed in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“We consider”“We show”“We also show”，全文为理论推导与分析，无实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：在回旋共振高频侧（辐射频率远小于回旋频率）的二维电子气中，重叠朗道能级下的光致电阻（photoresistance）现象，具体为位移贡献（displacement contribution）导致的磁阻振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短程无序和高辐射功率极限下，位移贡献导致一种新型磁阻振荡——无线电波诱导电阻振荡（RIROs）。其振幅与功率无关，周期由辐射电场而非辐射频率控制，且随磁场B可呈现1/B或1/B²周期性，交叉点与回旋共振吸收曲线宽度相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短程无序和高辐射功率极限下，位移贡献导致一种新型磁阻振荡——无线电波诱导电阻振荡（RIROs）。其振幅与功率无关，周期由辐射电场而非辐射频率控制，且随磁场B可呈现1/B或1/B²周期性，交叉点与回旋共振吸收曲线宽度相关。；创新点：首次提出并系统描述了无线电波诱导电阻振荡（RIROs），该振荡与已知的微波诱导电阻振荡（MIROs）在振幅、周期控制参数及周期性上均有本质区别。摘要未突出说明与实验对比或具体材料体系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于重叠朗道能级模型，考虑短程无序散射，计算辐射场对电子位移的贡献，推导出光致电阻的振荡行为，并分析其周期、振幅及磁场依赖关系。

papers.title: The Emergence of Photonic Crystalline Order and Time-Series Dynamics in NaCl Droplet Deposition
papers.abstract: Crystallization during droplet evaporation gives rise to complex, self-organized structures, yet the mechanisms underlying the emergence of ordered functional phases remain poorly understood. In this study, we present a comprehensive, multi-scale investigation into the crystallization dynamics of NaCl during droplet evaporation on a germanium (001) substrate, relevant for its IR applications. Through systematic microscopic characterization, we identify the formation of diverse microstructures, including 1D photonic crystal nanostructures formed within hybrid crystal-glass photonic system. To enable quantitative comparison across experimental conditions, we introduce the NaCl equivalent height as a unified metric to describe and classify the evolution of crystalline morphology. Our results reveal that diffusion anisotropy, rather than growth kinetics, primarily governs the maximal attainable structure size. Quantitative thin film interference analysis demonstrates the presence of discrete thickness layers in the film. Controlled evaporation experiments yield homogeneous crystallization patterns across the entire droplet area, facilitating the emergence of ordered photonic structures. Time-series dynamics analysis of height profiles uncovered the spatiotemporal evolution of the crystallization front, providing insights into the details of underlying physical mechanisms. Together, these results establish a robust experimental framework for understanding and predicting crystallization behavior in evaporating droplets, with potential applications in materials synthesis, photonics, and microscale pattern formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：microscopic characterization, controlled evaporation experiments, quantitative thin film interference analysis, time-series dynamics analysis。；研究对象：NaCl液滴在锗(001)衬底上蒸发过程中的结晶动力学，以及由此形成的微结构，特别是光子晶体有序结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了NaCl液滴蒸发过程中可形成一维光子晶体纳米结构，并揭示扩散各向异性（而非生长动力学）是决定最大结构尺寸的主要因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了NaCl液滴蒸发过程中可形成一维光子晶体纳米结构，并揭示扩散各向异性（而非生长动力学）是决定最大结构尺寸的主要因素。；创新点：首次在NaCl液滴蒸发体系中观察到混合晶体-玻璃光子系统中一维光子晶体纳米结构的形成，并建立了基于扩散各向异性的结构尺寸控制机制。
papers.method_zh: 系统微观表征（具体手段摘要未明确说明）、定量薄膜干涉分析、受控蒸发实验、高度轮廓时间序列动力学分析。引入“NaCl等效高度”作为统一度量描述晶体形貌演化。

papers.title: Dynamical scaling near the pseudogap quantum critical point of the two-dimensional Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We study dynamical scaling in the quantum-critical fan of the pseudogap-metal to Fermi-liquid transition of the two-dimensional Hubbard model. Using a four-patch dynamical cluster approximation with the numerical renormalization group as a cluster impurity solver, we access real-frequency dynamics over several decades at arbitrary temperatures. Close to the critical doping, the local spin and cluster-current susceptibility spectra exhibit $x=ω/T$ scaling of the form $χ''(ω,T)\sim \tanh(x/2)$, and the cluster contribution to the optical conductivity obeys $Tσ'_{\mathrm{cl}}(ω,T) \sim \tanh(x/2)/x$, implying a $1/T$ cluster dc conductivity. In the scaling regime, the vertex contribution to the cluster optical response is much larger than the bubble contribution. We further find evidence for a marginal-Fermi-liquid nodal self-energy. This, together with the $1/T$ vertex contribution to the conductivity, implies strange-metal optical transport in the quantum critical region. Our results describe several qualitative aspects of several experimental observations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：dynamical cluster approximation（动力学团簇近似）、numerical renormalization group（数值重整化群）。；研究对象：二维Hubbard模型中赝能隙金属到费米液体转变的量子临界区，具体关注其动力学标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界掺杂附近，局域自旋和团簇电流的谱函数呈现ω/T标度行为，且团簇光导的顶点贡献远大于气泡贡献，结合节点自能的边缘费米液体行为，表明量子临界区存在奇异金属光输运特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界掺杂附近，局域自旋和团簇电流的谱函数呈现ω/T标度行为，且团簇光导的顶点贡献远大于气泡贡献，结合节点自能的边缘费米液体行为，表明量子临界区存在奇异金属光输运特性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用四贴片动力学团簇近似（four-patch DCA），并以数值重整化群（NRG）作为团簇杂质求解器，从而在任意温度下获取多个数量级的实频动力学信息。

papers.title: Quantum criticality in the two-dimensional Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We study the normal-state, doping-driven phase diagram of the square-lattice Hubbard model using the dynamical cluster approximation combined with the numerical renormalization group as a cluster solver, which gives direct access to real-frequency dynamics at essentially zero temperature. In a parameter regime relevant for cuprates, $U=7t$ and $t'=-0.3t$, we find a critical doping $p^{\ast}$ that marks a continuous quantum phase transition between a pseudogap metal and a normal Fermi liquid. The transition is identified by a continuous collapse, from both sides, of the Fermi-liquid scale extracted from charge, spin, and $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave pairing susceptibilities. This collapse produces a non-Fermi-liquid regime at intermediate energy scales, which appears to extend to arbitrarily low scales at $p^{\ast}$. As $p^{\ast}$ is crossed from the normal Fermi liquid at $p>p^{\ast}$ into the pseudogap metal at $p<p^{\ast}$, the coherent low-energy spectral weight in the antinodal region is lost and replaced by a narrow, metallic pseudogap, while the nodal region evolves smoothly and remains comparatively coherent. This gives rise to Fermi arcs in the pseudogap metal at $p<p^{\ast}$, since the zero-frequency spectral weight remains large in the nodal region but is strongly suppressed in the antinodal region.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：dynamical cluster approximation、numerical renormalization group、cluster solver。；研究对象：二维正方晶格Hubbard模型在铜氧化物超导体相关参数下的掺杂驱动量子相变，具体关注正常态下的赝能隙金属与费米液体之间的量子临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在掺杂浓度 \( p = p^{\ast} \) 处存在一个连续的量子相变，连接赝能隙金属相和正常费米液体相；在临界点附近，从电荷、自旋和 \( d_{x^2-y^2} \) 波配对磁化率中提取的费米液体标度连续坍缩，形成中间能量尺度的非费米液体行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在掺杂浓度 \( p = p^{\ast} \) 处存在一个连续的量子相变，连接赝能隙金属相和正常费米液体相；在临界点附近，从电荷、自旋和 \( d_{x^2-y^2} \) 波配对磁化率中提取的费米液体标度连续坍缩，形成中间能量尺度的非费米液体行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学团簇近似（DCA）结合数值重整化群（NRG）作为团簇求解器，在接近零温下直接获取实频动力学信息。

papers.title: Impurity-induced geometric correlations and fractional quantization in quantum Hall systems
papers.abstract: We propose a geometric mechanism for fractional quantum Hall states based on impurity-induced correlations within a Landau level. A correlated distribution of ionized impurities partially modifies the Landau-level degeneracy through coherent coupling between cyclotron orbits, generating fractional energy sublevels. The odd-denominator hierarchy emerges naturally from the intrinsic guiding-center quantization and the correlated cyclotron motion. The resulting spectrum reproduces the principal experimentally observed fractional sequences and predicts a strong dependence of fractional-state stability on impurity geometry and layer separation. The absence of an incompressible Hall plateau at filling factor 1/2 follows from cancellation of the geometric correlations responsible for odd-denominator states. These results suggest that impurity-induced geometry may constitute an additional organizing principle in quantum Hall systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“提出几何机制”、“产生于内在的引导中心量子化”、“预测”等理论推导和模型构建的词汇。；研究对象：量子霍尔系统中的分数量子霍尔态。具体研究了由杂质诱导的关联效应如何产生分数量子化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于朗道能级内杂质诱导关联的几何机制，该机制可以自然地产生奇数分母的分数量子霍尔态序列，并解释了1/2填充因子处不可压缩霍尔平台的缺失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于朗道能级内杂质诱导关联的几何机制，该机制可以自然地产生奇数分母的分数量子霍尔态序列，并解释了1/2填充因子处不可压缩霍尔平台的缺失。；创新点：提出了杂质诱导的几何关联作为量子霍尔系统中除传统相互作用之外的一个新的组织原则，并以此机制解释了分数量子霍尔态的稳定性对杂质几何结构和层间距的强烈依赖性，以及1/2态缺失的原因。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架为：通过电离杂质的关联分布与回旋轨道之间的相干耦合，部分修改朗道能级的简并度，从而产生分数量子化子能级。利用内在的引导中心量子化和关联回旋运动推导出奇数分母层级结构。

papers.title: Larkin-Ovchinnikov-Fulde-Ferrell state of spin polarized atomic Fermi superfluid on a spherical surface
papers.abstract: By implementing the Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) formalism of population-imbalanced atomic Fermi gases with pairing interactions in a thin spherical shell, we characterize the Larkin-Ovchinnikov-Fulde-Ferrell (LOFF) state in such a compact geometry. We first construct a phase diagram showing where uniform solutions of spin-polarized Fermi superfluid from the BdG equation cease to exist due to the vanishing order parameter. Near the boundary, various LOFF states with spatially modulating order parameters and density profiles can survive as convergent solutions to the BdG equation. When both uniform and LOFF solutions are present, we compare their grand potentials to determine the energetically favorable state and find that the LOFF states with multiple nodes in the order parameter become more stable at higher spin polarization. However, the LOFF state only survives close to the phase boundary where the uniform solutions vanish, indicating fragility of the LOFF state on a spherical surface. We also briefly discuss possible implications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) formalism”进行理论建模和计算，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：自旋极化的原子费米超流在薄球壳几何结构中的Larkin-Ovchinnikov-Fulde-Ferrell (LOFF)态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在球面上，LOFF态仅在均匀解消失的相边界附近存在，且在高自旋极化下具有多个节点的LOFF态更稳定，但整体上LOFF态在球面上是脆弱的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在球面上，LOFF态仅在均匀解消失的相边界附近存在，且在高自旋极化下具有多个节点的LOFF态更稳定，但整体上LOFF态在球面上是脆弱的。；创新点：首次在紧凑的球面几何中系统表征了LOFF态，构建了相图，并揭示了该几何下LOFF态仅存在于相边界附近的脆弱特性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG)形式，对薄球壳中具有配对相互作用的粒子数不平衡原子费米气体进行自洽计算，通过比较均匀解和LOFF解的巨势来确定能量有利态。

papers.title: Current induced magneto-optical Kerr effect as a probe of Dirac carriers in Bi$_{1-x}$Sb$_x$ alloy
papers.abstract: We study the current-induced magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) in Bi$_{1-x}$Sb$_x$ semi-metalic alloys. The MOKE signal is found to be the largest in pure Bi ($x=0$), exceeding that of transition metals by nearly four orders of magnitude, and decreases monotonically with increasing Sb concentration. We find the MOKE signal scales with the resistivity ($ρ$) as $ρ^{1.7 \pm 0.6}$ and with the mobility ($μ_\mathrm{c}$) as $μ_\mathrm{c}^{2.0 \pm 0.2}$. Model calculations show that such exponent can be accounted for if the Dirac electrons are responsible for the generation of spin current. This is in contrast to the $ρ^{2}$ and $μ_\mathrm{c}^{-2}$ scaling of the MOKE signal induced by the free electrons in parabolic band. The scaling of the MOKE amplitude with the resistivity also partly accounts for the order of magnitude differences of the signal observed between metals, semimetals, and semiconductors. These results demonstrate that current induced MOKE serves as an effective means to characterize the nature of spin current in materials with diverse electronic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：study, MOKE signal, model calculations）；研究对象：Bi₁₋ₓSbₓ半金属合金中的电流诱导磁光克尔效应（MOKE）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纯Bi（x=0）的电流诱导MOKE信号比过渡金属大近四个数量级，且信号强度随电阻率ρ按ρ^{1.7±0.6}标度，随迁移率μ_c按μ_c^{2.0±0.2}标度，表明狄拉克电子是自旋电流的主要来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纯Bi（x=0）的电流诱导MOKE信号比过渡金属大近四个数量级，且信号强度随电阻率ρ按ρ^{1.7±0.6}标度，随迁移率μ_c按μ_c^{2.0±0.2}标度，表明狄拉克电子是自旋电流的主要来源。；创新点：揭示了狄拉克电子与抛物带自由电子在电流诱导MOKE信号标度行为上的本质差异（狄拉克电子对应ρ^{1.7}和μ_c^{2.0}，而抛物带电子对应ρ²和μ_c^{-2}），并指出该效应可有效表征不同电子结构材料中自旋电流的性质。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量电流诱导磁光克尔效应（MOKE），并结合模型计算分析标度指数。

papers.title: On the Symmetries of Anisotropic Spin Interaction Models
papers.abstract: We show that anisotropic spin interactions do not merely break spin-space group (SSG) symmetries, but instead twist them through cohomology invariants, yielding symmetry classes beyond subgroups of $O(3)\times \operatorname{Isom}(\mathbb{R}^3) $. This requires redefining the spin-only group $S_0$ in terms of proper spin rotations. Based on this unitary $S_0$, we formulate a twisted SSG (tSSG) theory that captures the complete set of spin-space symmetries. We then study a spin-1 model with tSSG symmetry using linear flavor wave theory and find topological quadrupolar excitations defined on a spin Brillouin Klein-bottle rather than the conventional torus. Specifically, the bosonic BdG Hamiltonian satisfies a glide reflection sewing relation, the ribbon spectrum exhibits Möbius boundary states. These topological excitations are classified by $ \mathbb{Z}_2 $, enforced by the nonorientability of the Klein-bottle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, formulate, theory, classify。；研究对象：各向异性自旋相互作用模型中的对称性，特别是自旋-空间群（SSG）对称性的扭曲及其导致的拓扑激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 各向异性自旋相互作用并非简单地破坏自旋-空间群对称性，而是通过上同调不变量将其扭曲，产生超出 $O(3)\times \operatorname{Isom}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 子群的对称性类；基于此提出的扭曲自旋-空间群（tSSG）理论预言了定义在自旋布里渊区克莱因瓶（而非传统环面）上的拓扑四极激发，其玻色子BdG哈密顿量满足滑移反射缝合关系，能带谱呈现莫比乌斯边界态，并由 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 拓扑数分类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：各向异性自旋相互作用并非简单地破坏自旋-空间群对称性，而是通过上同调不变量将其扭曲，产生超出 $O(3)\times \operatorname{Isom}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 子群的对称性类；基于此提出的扭曲自旋-空间群（tSSG）理论预言了定义在自旋布里渊区克莱因瓶（而非传统环面）上的拓扑四极激发，其玻色子BdG哈密顿量满足滑移反射缝合关系，能带谱呈现莫比乌斯边界态，并由 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 拓扑数分类。；创新点：揭示了各向异性自旋相互作用通过上同调不变量扭曲对称性而非简单破缺的机制，并首次在自旋模型中预言了由非可定向克莱因瓶布里渊区导致的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 拓扑四极激发和莫比乌斯边界态。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：重新定义基于纯自旋旋转的自旋群 $S_0$，并以此构建扭曲自旋-空间群（tSSG）理论；数值计算：对具有tSSG对称性的自旋-1模型应用线性味道波理论（linear flavor wave theory）进行分析。

papers.title: Image Force Effects on Tunneling Currents in an STM -- I `Point charge in the Barrier Region' - Model
papers.abstract: In a Scanning Tunneling Microscope (STM), when a tunneling electron treated as a point charge enters the barrier region between the tip and the sample, it induces image charges on the conducting surfaces, which modifies the shape of the potential barrier it sees. In this paper, the effect of the modification in the barrier potential due to these induced charges on the tunneling current density and currents in an STM,is studied as a function of the tip-sample distance $d$ and the Bias Potential $eV_b$. The image potential is found to reduce the height and the effective width of the potential barrier, leading to a huge increase in the tunneling current densities. This huge increase (by several order of magnitudes) is however unreasonable, prompting a revisit of the assumption that the electron in the barrier region is a point particle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“model”、“treated as”、“studied as a function of”等理论建模与分析表述，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：扫描隧道显微镜（STM）中隧穿电子在针尖与样品之间的势垒区域所受到的镜像力效应，以及该效应对隧穿电流密度和电流的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 镜像势会降低势垒的高度和有效宽度，导致隧穿电流密度出现数量级上的巨大增加（几个数量级），但这种不合理的大幅增加表明将隧穿电子视为点粒子的假设需要重新审视。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：镜像势会降低势垒的高度和有效宽度，导致隧穿电流密度出现数量级上的巨大增加（几个数量级），但这种不合理的大幅增加表明将隧穿电子视为点粒子的假设需要重新审视。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用“点电荷在势垒区域”的理论模型，通过引入镜像电荷修正势垒形状，并基于该修正后的势垒计算隧穿电流密度和电流随针尖-样品距离 \(d\) 及偏压 \(eV_b\) 的变化关系。

papers.title: Resonant optical cooling of nuclear spins in case of strong Knight field of photoexcited electrons
papers.abstract: Resonant cooling of the nuclear spin system of a semiconductor by spin-polarized charge carriers under pumping with helicity-modulated polarized light is considered theoretically. It is shown that in the case of strong Knight field of charge carriers, exceeding local fields of the dipole-dipole interaction of nuclear spins, the Overhauser field arising as a result of resonant cooling can considerably modify the overall shape of magnetic-field dependences of charge carrier spin polarization, experimentally observed as the Hanle effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：considered theoretically。；研究对象：半导体中核自旋系统的共振冷却，以及光激发电子的强Knight场对核自旋极化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光激发电子的Knight场超过核自旋偶极-偶极相互作用局域场的情况下，共振冷却产生的Overhauser场会显著改变载流子自旋极化随磁场变化的整体形状（即Hanle效应）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光激发电子的Knight场超过核自旋偶极-偶极相互作用局域场的情况下，共振冷却产生的Overhauser场会显著改变载流子自旋极化随磁场变化的整体形状（即Hanle效应）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于自旋极化载流子与核自旋在螺旋度调制偏振光泵浦下的相互作用模型。

papers.title: From Chaos to Synchrony in Recurrent Excitatory-Inhibitory Networks with Target-Specific Inhibition
papers.abstract: Biological neural networks can operate in qualitatively distinct dynamical regimes, and transitions between these regimes are thought to underlie changes in computation and behavior. The seminal work of Sompolinsky, Crisanti, and Sommers (SCS) showed that random recurrent networks undergo a transition from quiescence to asynchronous chaos, establishing a paradigmatic link between random connectivity, dynamical instability, and internally generated fluctuations in neural circuits. Here, we extend this framework to two-population firing-rate networks with segregated excitatory and inhibitory neurons and target-specific inhibitory couplings that break excitation--inhibition balance. Using dynamical mean-field theory, we derive self-consistent equations for the macroscopic mean activities and autocorrelations, together with stability criteria distinguishing mean-driven and fluctuation-driven instabilities. We show that target-specific inhibition organizes the phase diagram into three qualitative classes: inhibition-dominated or strictly balanced networks display only quiescent activity and asynchronous chaos; excitation-dominated networks display persistent activity together with either synchronous chaos with non-vanishing mean activity or coherent oscillations, depending on the stability-matrix eigenvalues. Crucially, coherent oscillations do not coexist with chaotic fluctuations around the periodic mean trajectory; rather, their onset suppresses the chaotic component, reminiscent of input-induced suppression of chaos. These results generalize SCS theory to recurrent networks with explicit excitatory--inhibitory structure and identify target-specific inhibition as a key control parameter for large-scale neural dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory（动力学平均场理论）、self-consistent equations（自洽方程）、stability criteria（稳定性判据）。；研究对象：具有靶向特异性抑制的兴奋-抑制双群发放率神经网络，具体研究其从混沌到同步的动力学相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 靶向特异性抑制可将网络相图组织为三类定性不同的动力学区域：抑制主导或严格平衡网络仅出现静息态和异步混沌；兴奋主导网络则出现持续活动，并伴随同步混沌或相干振荡，且相干振荡的出现会抑制混沌涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：靶向特异性抑制可将网络相图组织为三类定性不同的动力学区域：抑制主导或严格平衡网络仅出现静息态和异步混沌；兴奋主导网络则出现持续活动，并伴随同步混沌或相干振荡，且相干振荡的出现会抑制混沌涨落。；创新点：将Sompolinsky-Crisanti-Sommers（SCS）经典混沌理论推广至具有明确兴奋-抑制结构的两群网络，并识别出靶向特异性抑制作为调控大规模神经动力学的关键参数。摘要未突出说明与实验或生物数据的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学平均场理论推导宏观平均活动和自相关的自洽方程，并结合稳定性矩阵本征值区分平均驱动与涨落驱动的不稳定性。

papers.title: FKPP fronts in quenched random media
papers.abstract: We study numerically the evolution of one-dimensional FKPP fronts initiated from steep initial conditions in the presence of a quenched random growth rate. Compared to both the homogeneous case (with velocity $v_0$) and deterministic disorder, quenched randomness increases the average propagation speed. We show that the velocity shift relative to the homogeneous case scales linearly with the disorder variance $σ^2$, with a universal prefactor -- independent of the specific distribution of the disorder -- such that $v = v_0 + a σ^2$, with $a \approx 0.02432 \pm 0.00002$. Moreover, the front position exhibits diffusive fluctuations across disorder realizations. The corresponding effective diffusion coefficient scales quadratically with $σ$, $D = \frac{b^2 σ^2}{2}$, with $b \approx 0.223 \pm 0.002$. These results suggest a universal statistical response of FKPP fronts to quenched heterogeneity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerically study（数值研究）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：一维FKPP（Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov）方程在淬火随机介质中的传播前沿演化，具体为存在淬火随机生长率时的前沿动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 淬火随机性使FKPP前沿的平均传播速度相对于均匀介质增加，速度偏移与无序方差σ²呈线性关系，且具有普适性系数；前沿位置在不同无序实现间表现出扩散型涨落，有效扩散系数与σ²成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：淬火随机性使FKPP前沿的平均传播速度相对于均匀介质增加，速度偏移与无序方差σ²呈线性关系，且具有普适性系数；前沿位置在不同无序实现间表现出扩散型涨落，有效扩散系数与σ²成正比。；创新点：发现了淬火随机介质中FKPP前沿速度偏移的普适标度律（v = v₀ + aσ²，a ≈ 0.02432）以及扩散系数与σ²的二次方关系（D = b²σ²/2，b ≈ 0.223），且这些系数与无序的具体分布无关，揭示了淬火无序对FKPP前沿统计响应的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟：从陡峭初始条件出发，在淬火随机生长率下演化一维FKPP方程，通过统计不同无序实现的前沿速度与位置涨落，提取速度偏移和扩散系数。

papers.title: Revealing Hidden Correlations in a Fermi-Hubbard system via Interaction Ramps
papers.abstract: We observe an enhanced visibility of charge-density-wave correlations in a cold-atom realization of the attractive Hubbard model following a rapid boost of the interaction strength. The interaction boost associates nonlocal pairs into doublons which mark the center of mass of the original pairs. The enhancement is largest in the strongly correlated regime where pairing is nonlocal. We distinguish the unpaired Fermi liquid from the pseudogap phase of preformed pairs by analyzing atom-resolved spin-charge correlations after the ramp. The technique we establish here may facilitate the observation of exotic forms of pair order in spin-imbalanced systems, and of stripe order in the dual case of the doped repulsive Hubbard model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：cold-atom realization（冷原子实现）、observation（观测）、technique（技术）。；研究对象：吸引型费米-哈伯德模型（attractive Hubbard model）中的电荷密度波关联，以及通过相互作用强度快速提升（interaction ramp）揭示的隐藏关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过快速提升相互作用强度，将非局域配对关联转化为双占据（doublon），从而显著增强电荷密度波关联的可见性；在强关联预配对赝能隙相中增强效果最大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过快速提升相互作用强度，将非局域配对关联转化为双占据（doublon），从而显著增强电荷密度波关联的可见性；在强关联预配对赝能隙相中增强效果最大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 冷原子实验实现吸引型哈伯德模型，通过快速改变相互作用强度（interaction ramp）将非局域对转化为双占据，并利用原子分辨的自旋-电荷关联分析区分未配对费米液体与预配对赝能隙相。

papers.title: Generative reconstruction of 2D and 3D polycrystalline microstructures using symmetrized hyperspherical harmonics
papers.abstract: Establishing structure-property linkages in polycrystalline materials requires representative two- (2D) and three- (3D) dimensional microstructural inputs for full-field simulations. A core objective of microstructure characterization and reconstruction is the generative synthesis of 2D and 3D microstructures that reflect a target statistical ensemble using limited 2D data as a reference. This work introduces an orientation-based differentiable microstructure characterization and reconstruction framework, implemented in MCRpy, to perform reconstructions of voxelized images. Unit quaternions in combination with symmetrized hyperspherical harmonics are utilized to derive a continuous, symmetry-invariant representation of crystallographic orientations to overcome the numerical singularities and discontinuities associated with traditional Euler-based methods. The descriptor-based reconstructions are driven by a set combining two-point spatial correlations, a novel hybrid three-point variogram, and a mean variation regularizer to capture both global texture and local interfacial topology. The framework's efficiency is demonstrated by reconstructing 3D realizations from 2D orientation data of an aluminum alloy after thermo-mechanical processing, successfully recovering both morphological features and crystallographic distribution. Systematic benchmarking indicates that second-order gradient-based optimization, utilizing the L-BFGS-B algorithm, effectively navigates the complex loss landscape to generate high-fidelity realizations with minimal residuals. This methodology provides a versatile, open-source framework for the digital synthesis of polycrystalline representative volume elements to facilitate the rapid development of microstructure-informed materials design workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：generative reconstruction（生成式重建）、differentiable framework（可微框架）、optimization（优化）、open-source framework（开源框架）。；研究对象：多晶材料的微观结构，具体为2D和3D的体素化图像，并以热机械加工后的铝合金为例进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于取向的可微微观结构表征与重建框架，利用对称化超球谐函数克服了传统欧拉角方法的数值奇异性，能够从有限的2D取向数据成功重建出3D多晶微观结构，并恢复其形态特征和晶体学分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于取向的可微微观结构表征与重建框架，利用对称化超球谐函数克服了传统欧拉角方法的数值奇异性，能够从有限的2D取向数据成功重建出3D多晶微观结构，并恢复其形态特征和晶体学分布。；创新点：1. 引入对称化超球谐函数来表示晶体取向，解决了传统基于欧拉角方法在处理取向时的数值奇异性与不连续性问题。2. 提出了一种混合三点变差函数作为新的描述符，以更好地捕捉局部界面拓扑结构。3. 提供了一个通用的、开源的框架，用于从2D数据生成3D多晶代表性体积单元（RVE）。
papers.method_zh: 1. 使用单位四元数与对称化超球谐函数对晶体取向进行连续、对称不变的表示。2. 采用一组描述符驱动重建，包括两点空间相关性、一种新型混合三点变差函数以及平均变化正则化项。3. 使用基于二阶梯度的L-BFGS-B优化算法在复杂损失景观中导航，生成高保真度的微观结构实现。4. 该框架在开源软件MCRpy中实现。

papers.title: Lévy-like flights and fractal geometry of finite point sets
papers.abstract: We study Lévy-like and truncated Lévy-like flights with step probability distribution of the form $r^{-1+ν}$ for negative, positive, and zero $ν$, focusing on the appearance of fractal geometry characteristics in the generated point sets. Forming ensembles of such point sets with fixed multiplicity, we develop simulation techniques leading to the desired value of correlation dimension in a vast continuous interval of scales. In particular, we demonstrate the possibility to produce ensembles of data sets with a low number of points with the needed properties. Furthermore, we show that the positive $ν$ distributions, apart from a region near the upper scale limit, show fractal behaviour that extends to infinitesimally low scales. As an example, we apply our findings to producing simulations relevant to the search for critical fluctuations, related to QCD critical endpoint, in heavy-ion collision experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：simulation techniques（模拟技术）、study（理论研究）、demonstrate（理论论证）。；研究对象：论文研究的是具有特定步长概率分布（形式为 $r^{-1+ν}$）的 Lévy 飞行（Lévy-like flights）和截断 Lévy 飞行（truncated Lévy-like flights）所生成的点集，重点关注这些点集的**分形几何特征**。具体应用背景为**重离子碰撞实验中与QCD临界终点相关的临界涨落搜索**。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文证明了通过模拟技术，可以在一个很宽的连续尺度区间内，生成具有所需关联维数的有限点集（包括点数很少的集合）。此外，对于正ν值的分布，除了接近上限尺度的区域外，其分形行为可以延伸到无限小的尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文证明了通过模拟技术，可以在一个很宽的连续尺度区间内，生成具有所需关联维数的有限点集（包括点数很少的集合）。此外，对于正ν值的分布，除了接近上限尺度的区域外，其分形行为可以延伸到无限小的尺度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点可能在于：1）提出了一种能够精确控制有限点集在宽尺度范围内关联维数的模拟方法；2）揭示了正ν值分布下分形行为可延伸至无限小尺度的特性；3）将该方法应用于重离子碰撞物理中临界涨落的模拟，为实验数据分析提供了新的工具。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用了**数值模拟技术**。通过构建具有固定多重性（固定点数）的点集系综，并控制步长概率分布中的参数ν（可为负、正或零），来生成具有特定关联维数的点集。

papers.title: Transient superionic state in ultrafast-irradiated post-transition metal oxides
papers.abstract: Matter under irradiation may enter unusual transient states, outside of its equilibrium phase diagram. One of such states is a superionic-like state, in which one sublattice of a compound liquifies, whereas another one remains solid. Here, we study theoretically post-transition metal oxides under ultrafast excitation of its electronic system, identifying which compounds produce such a superionic state. It is shown that oxides with sufficiently sparce metallic sublattices (e.g. corundum structure) generally form transient superionic states via nonthermal phase transition. More closely packed lattices (such as the zinc-blend structure in ZnO and CdO) do not exhibit superionicity. Tl and Pb oxides only enter thermally-produced superionic states (induced by the atomic heating via electron-phonon coupling), but not nonthermal ones. Sn and Bi oxides demonstrate states that cannot be clearly classified, in which oxygen subsystem diffuses significantly more and faster than the metallic one, but the metallic one is not stable as it would be in a truly superionic state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study theoretically、nonthermal phase transition、electron-phonon coupling。；研究对象：后过渡金属氧化物（如Sn、Bi、Tl、Pb、Zn、Cd的氧化物）在超快电子激发下的瞬态超离子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 具有足够稀疏金属亚晶格的氧化物（如刚玉结构）可通过非热相变形成瞬态超离子态；而密堆积晶格（如ZnO和CdO的闪锌矿结构）则不表现超离子性。Tl和Pb氧化物仅通过电子-声子耦合加热产生热致超离子态，而非非热态；Sn和Bi氧化物则呈现难以明确分类的中间态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：具有足够稀疏金属亚晶格的氧化物（如刚玉结构）可通过非热相变形成瞬态超离子态；而密堆积晶格（如ZnO和CdO的闪锌矿结构）则不表现超离子性。Tl和Pb氧化物仅通过电子-声子耦合加热产生热致超离子态，而非非热态；Sn和Bi氧化物则呈现难以明确分类的中间态。；创新点：系统识别了哪些后过渡金属氧化物在超快辐照下能产生非热超离子态，并揭示了晶格堆积密度与超离子态形成之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于对超快电子激发后不同晶格结构（刚玉、闪锌矿等）中金属与氧亚晶格动力学行为的比较研究。

papers.title: T-E formulation-based modeling of thin HTS shell magnetization
papers.abstract: Numerical methods for modeling thin-film magnetization are primarily focused on computing the current density distribution. The highly nonlinear current-voltage characteristic of type-II superconductors significantly complicates the accurate computation of the electric field. The T-E formulation-based mixed finite element method, previously derived for flat superconducting films, enables the simultaneous, accurate determination of both variables. Another advantage of this method is that the computational domain is limited to the film itself: no meshing of the surrounding space is required. The thin-shell approximation reduces the problem to a two-dimensional one. This work extends the T-E formulation and numerical method to non-flat superconducting shells with a metal substrate. We validate the method with several test examples, including modeling the magnetization of a sphere. The method is then applied to a realistic model of a cylindrical magnetic dynamo pump, and the generated open-circuit voltage is computed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Numerical methods, modeling, T-E formulation-based mixed finite element method）；研究对象：薄型高温超导壳体的磁化过程，具体包括非平面超导壳体（如球体）以及圆柱形磁动力泵模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将基于T-E公式的混合有限元方法从平面超导薄膜成功扩展到非平面超导壳体，并验证了该方法在模拟复杂几何形状（如球体磁化）和实际器件（如磁动力泵开路电压）中的有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将基于T-E公式的混合有限元方法从平面超导薄膜成功扩展到非平面超导壳体，并验证了该方法在模拟复杂几何形状（如球体磁化）和实际器件（如磁动力泵开路电压）中的有效性。；创新点：将原本适用于平面超导薄膜的T-E公式数值方法扩展到了非平面超导壳体，并考虑了金属基底的影响，使其能够应用于更实际的几何构型（如圆柱形磁动力泵）。
papers.method_zh: 基于T-E公式的混合有限元方法，并采用薄壳近似将三维问题降维为二维问题。计算域仅限于超导壳体本身，无需对周围空间进行网格划分。

papers.title: Atomically resolved intrinsic superconducting gap in (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 films
papers.abstract: Ruddlesden-Popper bilayer nickelates provide an emerging platform for studying high-temperature superconductivity, yet the superconducting pairing symmetry remains under debate. Here, we use atomic-resolution scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy to investigate superconducting 1.5-unit-cell (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 films grown on SrLaAlO4. A cryogenic ultrahigh-vacuum (UHV) sample transfer preserves an ordered sqrt(2) * sqrt(2) surface and yields reproducible U-shaped spectra with two gap scales of ~14 and ~20 meV and extended flat zero-conductance bottoms. By contrast, samples exposed for a longer time in UHV without cooling during transfer show V-shaped spectra despite retaining the surface reconstruction and a transport superconducting transition onset above 40 K. Wide-energy-range spectra indicate that oxygen loss can mix density-wave-related spectral weight. Our measurements provide an atomic-scale observation of the intrinsic nodeless superconducting gap in bilayer nickelate ultrathin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学（scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy）等实验手段。；研究对象：(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中的高温超导配对对称性，具体为双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐超导薄膜的能隙结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子级分辨的扫描隧道谱，在(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中观测到约14 meV和20 meV两个能隙尺度，且具有平坦的零电导底部，表明其为无节点的本征超导能隙；而长时间暴露的样品则呈现V形谱，暗示氧缺失会混入密度波相关的谱权重。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子级分辨的扫描隧道谱，在(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中观测到约14 meV和20 meV两个能隙尺度，且具有平坦的零电导底部，表明其为无节点的本征超导能隙；而长时间暴露的样品则呈现V形谱，暗示氧缺失会混入密度波相关的谱权重。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上直接观测到双层镍酸盐超薄膜的本征无节点超导能隙，并通过对比不同暴露条件的样品，揭示了氧缺失对能隙形状（U形 vs V形）的影响。
papers.method_zh: 原子分辨扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学（STM/STS），结合低温超高真空（UHV）样品传输，在1.5个单胞厚的(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜（生长于SrLaAlO₄衬底）上进行测量。

papers.title: Melting Behavior and Phase Stability of CaO from Neural Network Potentials: a Molecular Dynamics Study
papers.abstract: We investigate the melting behavior of calcium oxide (CaO) under extreme conditions, a problem that remains poorly constrained due to experimental limitations despite its relevance for geophysical and technological applications. We develop a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP) for CaO with PANNA 2.0 and the LATTE descriptor, training it on a dataset of $\sim$12,000 configurations including solid, liquid, interfacial, and void-containing structures, extracted from ab-initio molecular dynamics data employing PBEsol exchange-correlation functional. We perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to compute the melting temperature at ambient pressure using both the void-nucleated melting (VNM) and two-phase coexistence (TPC) methods, obtaining $T_m=3055\pm11$ K and $T_m=2847\pm15$ K, respectively.\\ We calculate an enthalpy of fusion of $ΔH_f\sim73$ kJ/mol, in agreement with thermodynamic assessments and ab initio calculations. We also reproduce the thermal expansion and obtain a volume increase of $\sim$29% at Tm, consistent with the corresponding decrease in density extracted from spatially resolved number density profiles. Finally, we calculate the high-pressure melting curve of CaO up to 20 GPa, providing one of the very few computational determinations of this quantity to date. The results confirm that the overheating ratio $η$ is not constant under pressure, increasing from 17% at ambient pressure to 24% at 20 GPa, confirming previous findings and ruling out the assumption of a fixed overheating ratio. Our results establish MLIP-based simulations as a robust and efficient framework for investigating phase stability in ionic oxides and provide new insight into the melting behavior of CaO under extreme conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP)”、“molecular dynamics simulations”、“ab-initio molecular dynamics data”。；研究对象：氧化钙（CaO）在极端条件下的熔化行为与相稳定性，包括常压熔点、熔化焓、热膨胀以及高压（至20 GPa）下的熔化曲线。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用神经网络势进行分子动力学模拟，得到CaO在常压下的熔点为2847–3055 K（取决于方法），并发现过热比（overheating ratio）随压力增加而增大（从常压的17%升至20 GPa时的24%），否定了固定过热比的假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用神经网络势进行分子动力学模拟，得到CaO在常压下的熔点为2847–3055 K（取决于方法），并发现过热比（overheating ratio）随压力增加而增大（从常压的17%升至20 GPa时的24%），否定了固定过热比的假设。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用PANNA 2.0和LATTE描述符构建机器学习原子间势（MLIP），训练数据集来自约12,000个构型（包含固、液、界面及含空洞结构），数据源自采用PBEsol交换关联泛函的从头算分子动力学（AIMD）。随后进行大规模分子动力学模拟，使用空洞成核熔化法（VNM）和两相共存法（TPC）计算熔点，并计算高压熔化曲线。

papers.title: Thermal expansion of FeWO$_4$ (Ferberite) and FeWO$_4$:Fe$_2$WO$_6$ (7:1): a comparative X-ray and neutron diffraction study
papers.abstract: The thermal expansion of natural FeWO$_4$ (ferberite) and synthetic FeWO$_4$:Fe$_2$WO$_6$ (7:1) was investigated over the 2-1123 K temperature range combining single-crystal and powder X-ray diffraction together with neutron powder diffraction. High-precision lattice parameters were obtained for both samples. The temperature dependence of the unit-cell volume was analysed using physically based thermodynamic models, including the Kroll and Berman approaches as implemented in EoSFit7. All datasets are well reproduced within their respective temperature intervals. However, significant differences are observed between the behavior of ferberite and FeWO$_4$:Fe$_2$WO$_6$, which has a \~40% smaller thermal expansion coefficient and a reduced reference volume. Possible origins, including microstructural and phase-coexistence effects, are discussed. The results provide a comprehensive description of the thermal expansion behavior of FeWO$_4$ across a wide temperature range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：结合单晶与粉末X射线衍射、中子粉末衍射等实验手段进行对比研究。；研究对象：天然FeWO₄（铁钨矿，ferberite）与合成FeWO₄:Fe₂WO₆（7:1）复合材料的热膨胀行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种样品在2-1123 K宽温区内的热膨胀行为存在显著差异：FeWO₄:Fe₂WO₆（7:1）的热膨胀系数比天然FeWO₄小约40%，且参考体积更小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种样品在2-1123 K宽温区内的热膨胀行为存在显著差异：FeWO₄:Fe₂WO₆（7:1）的热膨胀系数比天然FeWO₄小约40%，且参考体积更小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射、粉末X射线衍射、中子粉末衍射；基于物理的热力学模型（Kroll模型和Berman方法，通过EoSFit7软件实现）分析晶胞体积的温度依赖性。

papers.title: Optimizing strong light-matter coupling of plasmonic lattices and monolayer semiconductors
papers.abstract: Exciton-polaritons provide a versatile platform for the study of a wide range of phenomena, including polariton lasers, topological polaritons, and bosonic condensation. Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers host excitons with large oscillator strength and binding energies constituting a robust matter constituent that forms polaritons from cryogenic to room temperature when embedded in optical microcavities. Plasmonic nanoparticles arranged in lattice geometries offer strong field-confinement and high quality factors. However, the high sensitivity of monolayer excitons to strain and dielectric disorder necessitates encapsulation in atomically flat hBN to ensure a high optical quality, rendering plasmonics more challenging. Here, we employ our recently developed fabrication method for embedding gold nanodisk arrays into van der Waals heterostructures and compare two samples with opposite layer order. We observe that strain and etching-induced surface contamination can reduce the exciton quality and thus the light-matter interaction strength significantly. Our fabrication approach reduces interfacial irregularities and enables homogeneous large-area polariton lattices for a wide range of applications, such as polarization-control or topological polaritonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“我们采用我们最近开发的制造方法”、“比较了两个样品”、“我们观察到”等实验操作和观测结果。；研究对象：等离激元晶格（金纳米盘阵列）与单层过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）半导体形成的强光-物质耦合体系（激子-极化激元）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 样品的层序（即金纳米盘阵列与单层半导体、六方氮化硼的相对位置）会显著影响激子质量。由应变和刻蚀引起的表面污染会严重削弱激子品质，从而降低光-物质相互作用强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：样品的层序（即金纳米盘阵列与单层半导体、六方氮化硼的相对位置）会显著影响激子质量。由应变和刻蚀引起的表面污染会严重削弱激子品质，从而降低光-物质相互作用强度。；创新点：通过将等离激元晶格嵌入范德华异质结中，减少了界面不平整性，从而能够制备出均匀的大面积极化激元晶格，克服了单层半导体对介电无序和应变敏感、难以与等离激元结构集成的挑战。摘要未明确说明该制造方法的具体细节相对于已有方法的独特之处。
papers.method_zh: 采用了一种将金纳米盘阵列嵌入范德华异质结的制造方法，并对比了两种具有相反层序的样品。通过实验观测激子光学质量的变化来评估光-物质相互作用强度。

papers.title: Functional and Density-Driven Errors in Density Functional Theory: Quantum Monte Carlo Benchmarks for Solids
papers.abstract: We introduce a systematic analysis of density functional approximation errors in solids by separating functional-driven from density-driven contributions using quantum Monte Carlo densities of silicon, sodium chloride, and copper as reference. Typically, functional errors dominate, but we identify important exceptions where density-driven errors exceed functional errors by factors of 2-3, notably for SOGGA11 and τ-HCTH in the semiconductor and the insulator. Material dependence is striking: 63% of functionals show error cancellation in silicon versus 18% in copper, and only five functionals surpass LDA accuracy for metallic copper even with exact densities. For silicon and sodium chloride, GILL or BECKE exchange combined with PBE, PW91, or P86 correlation achieves near-exact xc energies on QMC densities, while copper requires specialized functionals like PBEsol or PBELYP. High-quality densities consistently reduce density-driven errors across all systems. Historical analysis reveals that 1990s GGA functionals outperform many modern meta-GGAs, contradicting expectations of systematic improvement along Jacob's ladder. These results provide practical guidance for functional selection and highlight implications for machine learning potential development, where material-dependent error cancellation may compromise transferability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory”、“quantum Monte Carlo benchmarks”、“functional-driven and density-driven contributions”。；研究对象：固体材料中的密度泛函近似误差，具体以硅（半导体）、氯化钠（绝缘体）和铜（金属）为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通常泛函误差占主导，但存在重要例外：在半导体和绝缘体中，SOGGA11和τ-HCTH等泛函的密度驱动误差比泛函误差大2-3倍。此外，1990年代的GGA泛函在许多情况下优于现代meta-GGA泛函，违背了“Jacob天梯”系统性改进的预期。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通常泛函误差占主导，但存在重要例外：在半导体和绝缘体中，SOGGA11和τ-HCTH等泛函的密度驱动误差比泛函误差大2-3倍。此外，1990年代的GGA泛函在许多情况下优于现代meta-GGA泛函，违背了“Jacob天梯”系统性改进的预期。；创新点：首次在固体中系统分离并量化了密度泛函理论中泛函驱动误差与密度驱动误差的相对贡献，揭示了材料依赖性的误差抵消行为（63%的泛函在硅中显示误差抵消，而在铜中仅18%），并指出该现象可能影响机器学习势函数的可迁移性。
papers.method_zh: 使用量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法计算硅、氯化钠和铜的精确电子密度作为参考，将密度泛函近似误差分解为泛函驱动误差和密度驱动误差两部分进行系统分析。

papers.title: Anisotropic Surface Spin Waves as Signature of A-type Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets have attracted intense interest because they have the advantages of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. However, their experimental identification remains challenging, in particular for the A-type altermagnets that account for a large group of material candidates. Here, we discover a kind of anisotropic surface spin waves in A-type altermagnets, which is absent in ferromagnets and conventional antiferromagnets. The anisotropic surface spin waves arise directly from the nature of altermagnets, i.e., the spin-opposite sublattices cannot be related by translation or inversion, which breaks the combined spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetry, leading to the anisotropic surface spin waves with two properties, the chirality-dependent top-bottom positions and chiral split constant frequency contours. We further show that these two properties can be measured experimentally from the stray field and by resonance absorption spectrum, respectively. Our results provide a signature for detecting altermagnets and will inspire spin-based logic and information-storage devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验数据或计算模拟，主要基于理论推导和性质分析（如“发现”“源于”“导致”等理论论证词汇）。；研究对象：A型交变磁体（A-type altermagnets）中的各向异性表面自旋波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在A型交变磁体中发现了铁磁体和常规反铁磁体所不具备的各向异性表面自旋波，该自旋波具有手性依赖的上下表面位置差异和手性分裂的恒定频率轮廓，可作为识别A型交变磁体的特征信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在A型交变磁体中发现了铁磁体和常规反铁磁体所不具备的各向异性表面自旋波，该自旋波具有手性依赖的上下表面位置差异和手性分裂的恒定频率轮廓，可作为识别A型交变磁体的特征信号。；创新点：首次提出各向异性表面自旋波可作为A型交变磁体的实验识别特征，并指出其可通过杂散场和共振吸收谱分别测量，为交变磁体的检测提供了新方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架基于交变磁体的本质特性——自旋相反的子晶格不能通过平移或反演操作相关联，从而破坏了空间反演与时间反演的联合对称性，由此推导出各向异性表面自旋波的产生机制及其可观测性质。

papers.title: Telecom-Wavelength-Compatible Quantum Information Transcription Using Nitrogen-Vacancy Centers
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are a leading platform for solid-state quantum sensing and quantum information processing. While most optical studies rely on the visible fluorescence associated with the triplet transitions, the infrared singlet transition near $1042$ nm, which is typically considered dark within the singlet manifold of the NV optical cycle, provides an alternative optical channel. Here, we report wavelength-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) measurements of this infrared emission. We directly observe ODMR contrast in the $1042$ nm emission and analyze its dependence on the magnetic field. The field-dependent spectral dispersion of the ODMR signal demonstrates that the spin-state information encoded in the NV center is transcribed to the infrared singlet emission through the spin-selective intersystem crossing, in close analogy to the visible fluorescence readout. These results establish infrared ODMR as a high-fidelity optical readout pathway. Crucially, by extending spin-state transcription directly into the $1300-1600$ nm range, this work demonstrates a direct, conversion-free interface between diamond spin-qubits and standard telecommunication infrastructure, bypassing the efficiency bottlenecks of active frequency conversion and benefiting from the already well-developed technologies in this range of the electromagnetic spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：wavelength-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) measurements、directly observe、analyze。；研究对象：金刚石中的氮-空位（NV）色心，特别是其近红外单重态跃迁（约1042 nm）以及该发射与自旋态信息的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过波长分辨的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量，直接观察到NV色心在1042 nm红外发射中的ODMR对比度，证明自旋态信息通过自旋选择性的系间穿越被转录到红外单重态发射中，从而建立了红外ODMR作为高保真度光学读出路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过波长分辨的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量，直接观察到NV色心在1042 nm红外发射中的ODMR对比度，证明自旋态信息通过自旋选择性的系间穿越被转录到红外单重态发射中，从而建立了红外ODMR作为高保真度光学读出路径。；创新点：将NV色心的自旋态信息直接转录到1300-1600 nm电信波段范围内，实现了金刚石自旋量子比特与标准电信基础设施的直接、无频率转换的接口，避免了主动频率转换的效率瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 波长分辨的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量，分析1042 nm红外发射的ODMR信号及其随磁场的变化。

papers.title: Compositional and Magnetic Characterisation of Oblique Co and Fe Nanowire Structures Fabricated Using Focused Electron Beam Induced Deposition
papers.abstract: Focused electron beam induced deposition (FEBID) is an additive manufacturing technique uniquely suited for fabricating nanoscale 3D prototypes for a range of applications, including spintronic devices. However, the variation of growth dynamics associated with electron beam translation and sample interaction volumes results in structures with non-uniform composition when fabricating intricate 3D geometries. Herein, we measure changes in atomic composition and corresponding changes in magnetic induction in 3D ferromagnetic nanostructures with overhanging elements, e.g. bridges or arches. To investigate the effects of electron beam translation, we fabricated 41 Co and Fe nanowire (NW) structures with growth angle relative to the optic axis varying from 0° to 90°. The (scanning) transmission electron microscopy techniques of electron energy loss spectroscopy and off-axis electron holography were performed to map the NW elemental composition and magnetic induction as a function of NW growth angle. Comparison of the results reveals a reduction in metal content with increased oblique growth angle in FEBID NWs. The magnitude of metal content reduction can be tuned by controlling electron beam parameters, and ferromagnetic NWs with approximately equal metal content at growth angles from 0° to 60° were fabricated by using the lowest viable electron beam voltage and the highest viable beam current to reduce the interaction volume and increase the metal content, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：FEBID、TEM、EELS、离轴电子全息术。；研究对象：利用聚焦电子束诱导沉积（FEBID）技术制备的钴（Co）和铁（Fe）倾斜纳米线结构，重点研究其成分与磁感应随生长角度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FEBID纳米线的金属含量随倾斜生长角度的增大而降低；通过调节电子束参数（使用最低可行电压和最高可行电流），可在0°至60°生长角度范围内制备出金属含量近似相等的铁磁纳米线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FEBID纳米线的金属含量随倾斜生长角度的增大而降低；通过调节电子束参数（使用最低可行电压和最高可行电流），可在0°至60°生长角度范围内制备出金属含量近似相等的铁磁纳米线。；创新点：系统测量了FEBID三维铁磁纳米结构中因电子束平移导致的成分非均匀性及其对磁感应的影响，并提出了通过优化电子束参数（电压和电流）来补偿倾斜生长时金属含量下降的方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用聚焦电子束诱导沉积（FEBID）制备样品；利用（扫描）透射电子显微镜（STEM）中的电子能量损失谱（EELS）和离轴电子全息术，分别表征纳米线的元素成分和磁感应分布。

papers.title: Agentic Design of Compositional Descriptors via Autoresearch for Materials Science Applications
papers.abstract: Autoresearch offers a flexible paradigm for automating scientific tasks, in which an AI agent proposes, implements, evaluates, and refines candidate solutions against a quantitative objective. Here, we use composition-based materials-property prediction to test whether such agents can perform a task beyond model selection and hyperparameter optimization: the design of input descriptors. We introduce Automat, an autoresearch framework where a coding agent based on a large language model generates composition-only descriptors for chemical compounds and evaluates them using a random forest workflow. The agent is restricted to information derivable from chemical formulas and iteratively proposes, implements, and tests chemically motivated descriptor strategies. We apply Automat, with OpenAI Codex using GPT-5.5 as the coding agent, to the prediction of experimental band gaps in inorganic materials and Curie temperatures in ferromagnetic compounds. In both tasks, Automat improves over fractional-composition, Magpie, and combined fractional-composition/Magpie baselines, while producing descriptor families that are chemically interpretable. These results provide a demonstration that autoresearch agents can generate competitive, task-specific materials descriptors without manual feature engineering during the run. They also reveal current limitations, including descriptor redundancy, sensitivity to greedy feature expansion, and the need for explicit complexity control, descriptor pruning, and more sophisticated search strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“autoresearch framework”、“coding agent”、“random forest workflow”、“prediction”。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是材料的性质预测，具体包括无机材料的实验带隙（experimental band gaps）和铁磁化合物的居里温度（Curie temperatures）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型的自动研究（autoresearch）智能体能够自主设计出具有化学可解释性、且性能优于传统基线（如Magpie）的成分描述符，用于材料性质预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于大型语言模型的自动研究（autoresearch）智能体能够自主设计出具有化学可解释性、且性能优于传统基线（如Magpie）的成分描述符，用于材料性质预测。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于，证明了自动研究智能体不仅能够进行模型选择和超参数优化，还能自主完成更具挑战性的任务——即设计输入描述符（input descriptors），从而在运行过程中无需人工特征工程。
papers.method_zh: 采用了名为“Automat”的自动研究框架。该框架的核心是一个基于大型语言模型（具体为OpenAI Codex，使用GPT-5.5）的编码智能体。该智能体被限制仅使用从化学式中可推导的信息，通过迭代地提出、实现、评估和优化化学动机的描述符策略，并使用随机森林（random forest）工作流来评估描述符的性能。

papers.title: N-Graphdiyne as a Tunable Platform for Stabilizing Light Metals toward High-Capacity Reversible Hydrogen Storage
papers.abstract: Hydrogen (H2) is a promising carbon-neutral energy carrier. However, its deployment is limited by the lack of lightweight, reversible storage media that operate under practical conditions. Here, we establish nitrogen-doped graphdiyne (N-GDY) as a programmable two-dimensional platform for stabilizing dispersed light-metal dopants and enabling high-capacity physisorption of molecular H2. The computational package involves density functional theory (DFT) combined with ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) and Langmuir-based statistical thermodynamic modeling. The results revealed that N-sites of N-GDY bind up to five Li, Na, K, and Ca atoms per primitive cell with binding energies of -2.27, -1.57, -1.80, and -2.13 eV, respectively, exceeding their respective bulk cohesive energies. AIMD simulations at 400 K further confirm the structural robustness of the decorated frameworks and the absence of metal aggregation. The polarised metal centres activate reversible H2 adsorption through electrostatic and dispersion interactions, with average adsorption energies falling within the optimal window (-0.15 to -0.35 eV per H2). Sequential adsorption analysis reveals uptake of up to 25 H2 molecules per primitive cell, achieving intrinsic gravimetric capacities of 13.08, 10.82, 9.23, and 9.15 wt% for Li-, Na-, K-, and Ca-functionalized systems, respectively. Thermodynamic analysis indicates favorable adsorption-desorption behavior under near-ambient conditions, with Li- and Ca-functionalized systems exceeding the 6.5 wt% U.S. Department of Energy's ultimate system-level target when considering intrinsic material capacity. These results identify N-GDY as a chemically tunable scaffold for dispersing lightweight metals and provide a mechanistic design strategy for achieving high-capacity, reversible hydrogen storage in porous two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT、AIMD、Langmuir-based statistical thermodynamic modeling）；研究对象：氮掺杂石墨二炔（N-GDY）作为可调平台，用于稳定分散轻金属（Li, Na, K, Ca）并实现可逆储氢。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: N-GDY上的氮位点能稳定结合多达5个轻金属原子（Li, Na, K, Ca），其结合能超过金属自身的内聚能，从而防止金属团聚。这些功能化的金属中心通过静电和色散相互作用实现可逆的分子氢吸附，使Li-和Ca-功能化系统的本征重量储氢容量分别达到13.08 wt%和9.15 wt%，超过了美国能源部6.5 wt%的最终系统级目标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：N-GDY上的氮位点能稳定结合多达5个轻金属原子（Li, Na, K, Ca），其结合能超过金属自身的内聚能，从而防止金属团聚。这些功能化的金属中心通过静电和色散相互作用实现可逆的分子氢吸附，使Li-和Ca-功能化系统的本征重量储氢容量分别达到13.08 wt%和9.15 wt%，超过了美国能源部6.5 wt%的最终系统级目标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）以及基于Langmuir模型的统计热力学建模。

papers.title: Spin resolved spectral topology and re-entrant localization in a non Hermitian quasiperiodic SSH chain
papers.abstract: We investigate localization and spectral topology in a non Hermitian quasiperiodic Su Schrieffer Heeger lattice with Rashba spin orbit coupling and spin-dependent hopping. By analyzing the inverse participation ratio, complex energy spectrum, and spectral winding numbers, we demonstrate the emergence of a re-entrant transition from extended to localized and back to extended phases as the non-Hermitian parameter increases. The localization transition is accompanied by a simultaneous real-complex-real spectral transition in the complex-energy plane. In the absence of spin dependent hopping, the spectrum forms two nearly spin-degenerate loops characterized by winding numbers w = 2. Upon introducing finite spin-dependent hopping, each loop splits into two independent spin-resolved spectral branches, resulting in four disconnected spectral contours carrying distinct winding sectors. Our results reveal a direct correspondence between localization, spectral topology, and spin-resolved spectral splitting in non-Hermitian quasiperiodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analyzing、results reveal（理论分析与数值计算）。；研究对象：非厄米准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，包含Rashba自旋轨道耦合和自旋依赖跳跃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着非厄米参数增大，体系出现从扩展态到局域态再到扩展态的重入转变；该局域化转变伴随复能量平面上的实-复-实谱转变。自旋依赖跳跃导致能谱分裂为四个自旋分辨的独立谱分支，各自携带不同的绕数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着非厄米参数增大，体系出现从扩展态到局域态再到扩展态的重入转变；该局域化转变伴随复能量平面上的实-复-实谱转变。自旋依赖跳跃导致能谱分裂为四个自旋分辨的独立谱分支，各自携带不同的绕数。；创新点：揭示了非厄米准周期体系中局域化、谱拓扑与自旋分辨谱分裂之间的直接对应关系，并发现了重入局域化转变与实-复-实谱转变的同步性。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析逆参与率（inverse participation ratio）、复能量谱和谱绕数（spectral winding numbers）来表征局域化与拓扑性质。

papers.title: A DFT+DMFT study of the electronic structure of Samarium
papers.abstract: The electronic structure of Samarium (Sm) was calculated using the density functional theory combined with the single-site dynamical mean-field theory. In this work, we investigated the electronic properties of α, \b{eta} and γ phases at ambient pressure, including the band structures, density of states, self-energy functions and valence state histograms. Our results agree with the experimental data.The calculation shows that the 4f electrons in all these phases are well localized, the Kondo peaks are suppressed and the hybridization between the 4f electrons and conduction electrons are quite weak. Our results also show the strong correlation effect is significant in Sm metal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFT+DMFT study、calculated、investigated。；研究对象：金属钐（Samarium, Sm）的α、β和γ相在常压下的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钐中4f电子在所有相中均高度局域化，近藤峰被抑制，4f电子与传导电子的杂化很弱，且强关联效应显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钐中4f电子在所有相中均高度局域化，近藤峰被抑制，4f电子与传导电子的杂化很弱，且强关联效应显著。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合单站点动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）。

papers.title: Kinetic effects on the phase behavior and microstructural transitions of a thermoresponsive polymer solution
papers.abstract: The thermoresponsive behavior of Pluronic F127 solutions is governed by temperature-dependent micellization and complex self-assembly of these micelles. This study investigates the effect of thermal stimuli on the kinetics of phase transition of Pluronic systems during heating and cooling cycles. We employ Differential Scanning Calorimetry measurements to investigate the dependence of the micellization temperature on thermal stimuli, revealing that both the micellization temperature and the peak intensity vary systematically with the applied thermal ramp rate. Furthermore, we employ rheological characterization which reveals a sharp sol to soft-solid transition upon heating. Interestingly, we observe a novel multi-step transition during the cooling phase, indicating a more complex reorganization pathway with intermediate metastable states than typically assumed for reversible micellization. Our findings indicate that the characteristic multi-step cooling transition is transient, gradually weakening with successive thermal cycles. We also present a comprehensive mathematical model which accurately captures the kinetics and multiple step transition in viscoelastic parameters. Significantly, the distinct peaks in Small-Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS) measurements clearly reveal the evolution from a disordered unimers/micelles state at low temperatures to a highly ordered lattice with long-range spatial correlation at elevated temperatures. We also present a comprehensive phase diagram highlighting the critical role of thermal stimuli and pathways in defining the phase behavior of Pluronic system. This work, therefore, offers essential experimental and theoretical insights into the thermally driven self-assembly, transition kinetics, and microstructural evolution of thermoreversible Pluronic solution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有理论建模）。判断依据：Differential Scanning Calorimetry、rheological characterization、Small-Angle X-ray Scattering等实验手段，以及“comprehensive mathematical model”理论建模。；研究对象：热响应性聚合物Pluronic F127溶液的相行为与微观结构转变，特别是温度驱动的胶束化过程及其动力学效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 加热时体系发生尖锐的溶胶-软固体转变，而冷却时观察到新颖的多步转变（含亚稳态中间态），且该多步转变随热循环次数增加而逐渐减弱；SAXS证实了从低温无序单聚体/胶束态到高温长程有序晶格的微观结构演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：加热时体系发生尖锐的溶胶-软固体转变，而冷却时观察到新颖的多步转变（含亚稳态中间态），且该多步转变随热循环次数增加而逐渐减弱；SAXS证实了从低温无序单聚体/胶束态到高温长程有序晶格的微观结构演化。；创新点：揭示了冷却过程中多步转变的瞬态特性及其随热循环的衰减行为，并建立了能准确捕捉粘弹性参数中动力学与多步转变的数学模型，强调了热刺激路径对相行为的决定性作用。
papers.method_zh: 差示扫描量热法（DSC）测量胶束化温度对热刺激速率的依赖性；流变学表征溶胶-软固体转变；小角X射线散射（SAXS）探测微观有序结构；并建立描述动力学与多步转变的数学模型。

papers.title: Tunable Dual-Type Weyl Points in Dirac-Weyl Semimetal CaAgBi
papers.abstract: Dirac-Weyl semimetals host both Dirac and Weyl fermions and the exploration of material candidates with tunable topological properties is essential to realize topological spintronic devices. In this work, we propose CaAgBi as a Dirac-Weyl semimetal with tunable type-I and type-II Weyl points based on first-principle calculations. In addition to the three pairs of Dirac points located along the rotational axis as previously reported, our calculations reveal 18 additional pairs of dual-type Weyl points distributed across three distinct planes: type-I in the $k_z=0$ plane and type-II in the $k_z= \pm 0.0698\,\frac{2π}{c}$ planes. The topological features are further confirmed through chirality of the Weyl points as well as the existence of surface Fermi arcs. Moreover, we find that the position and annihilation of Dirac and Weyl points are tunable by the alloy engineering and external strains. The alloy engineering is employed to modulate the positions of Weyl points, revealing different annihilation concentrations for type-I and type-II Weyl points, potentially offering novel experimental strategies for Weyl point manipulation. Under tensile biaxial strain, the Weyl points in the $k_{z}=0$ plane annihilate along the $Γ$--$\mathrm{M}$ path at $2.1\%$ strain, whereas the Weyl points in the $k_{z}\neq 0$ planes remain robust within $6\%$ strain. This work provides a versatile platform for manipulating Dirac/Weyl interactions, with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) driven alloy control and strain-selective engineering opening avenues for topological electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principle calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：Dirac-Weyl半金属CaAgBi，具体研究其可调谐的I型和II型Weyl点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CaAgBi中发现了18对额外的双类型Weyl点（I型在k_z=0平面，II型在k_z=±0.0698·2π/c平面），并且这些Weyl点和Dirac点的位置与湮灭可通过合金工程和外加应变进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CaAgBi中发现了18对额外的双类型Weyl点（I型在k_z=0平面，II型在k_z=±0.0698·2π/c平面），并且这些Weyl点和Dirac点的位置与湮灭可通过合金工程和外加应变进行调控。；创新点：首次在CaAgBi中预测了除已知Dirac点之外的18对双类型Weyl点，并揭示了I型和II型Weyl点具有不同的合金湮灭浓度，以及应变选择性调控（k_z=0平面Weyl点在2.1%应变下湮灭，而k_z≠0平面Weyl点在6%应变内保持鲁棒）。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principle calculations），结合Weyl点手性分析及表面费米弧计算确认拓扑特征；通过合金工程（alloy engineering）和外加双轴应变（tensile biaxial strain）调控Weyl点位置与湮灭。

papers.title: Biquadratic exchange coupling effect on the magnetic properties of (Fe/Ti) multilayers
papers.abstract: This work explores the static and dynamic magnetic properties of weakly antiferromagnetically coupled Fe/Ti superlattices, emphasizing the link between magnetic behavior and structural characteristics. HRTEM and XRD analyses confirm alternating Fe and Ti layers with rough interfaces, especially in upper layers. Magnetic measurements reveal two-step hysteresis loops and a temperature and thickness-dependent interlayer exchange coupling (IEC). A macrospin model incorporating bilinear and biquadratic coupling reproduces the experimental data and supports a phase diagram analysis identifying non-collinear configurations. The results underscore the impact of structural imperfections and highlight the crucial role of biquadratic exchange in Fe/Ti/Fe multilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论建模）。判断依据：摘要提及HRTEM、XRD、磁性测量等实验手段，并结合宏自旋模型进行理论分析。；研究对象：弱反铁磁耦合的Fe/Ti超晶格多层膜，具体研究其静态与动态磁性质，以及层间交换耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe/Ti多层膜中双二次交换耦合（biquadratic exchange coupling）对磁性质起关键作用，导致非共线磁构型，且结构粗糙度显著影响层间交换耦合行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe/Ti多层膜中双二次交换耦合（biquadratic exchange coupling）对磁性质起关键作用，导致非共线磁构型，且结构粗糙度显著影响层间交换耦合行为。；创新点：明确揭示了双二次交换耦合在Fe/Ti/Fe多层膜中的主导作用，并建立了结构缺陷（粗糙界面）与磁行为（两步磁滞回线、温度/厚度依赖的层间耦合）之间的定量关联。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨透射电镜（HRTEM）和X射线衍射（XRD）分析结构；磁性测量（如磁滞回线）表征静态与动态磁性质；构建包含双线性与双二次耦合项的宏自旋模型（macrospin model）拟合实验数据，并基于相图分析识别非共线磁构型。

papers.title: Methane hydrate nucleation frustration and dimensional reduction of structural order under nanoconfinement
papers.abstract: Methane hydrate nucleation under nanoconfinement remains poorly understood due to the complex interplay between geometric restriction and molecular ordering. Here, we investigate the structural organization of water-methane systems confined between silica planar slit pores with widths ranging from 1 to 5 nm and temperatures between 250 and 295 K. Three-dimensional radial distribution functions reveal a clear suppression of hydrate-like ordering at strong confinement (below 2 nm), indicating frustrated nucleation. In contrast, projected two-dimensional correlations exhibit pronounced in-plane structural organization, evidencing a confinement-induced reduction in the dimensionality of molecular order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：investigate、radial distribution functions、projected two-dimensional correlations、confinement-induced reduction。；研究对象：甲烷水合物在纳米限域（二氧化硅平面狭缝孔，孔径1-5 nm）中的成核行为，以及水-甲烷体系的结构组织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强限域（孔径小于2 nm）下，甲烷水合物类有序结构被明显抑制，成核受阻；同时，限域导致分子有序的维度降低，表现为二维面内结构组织增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强限域（孔径小于2 nm）下，甲烷水合物类有序结构被明显抑制，成核受阻；同时，限域导致分子有序的维度降低，表现为二维面内结构组织增强。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子模拟或计算分析方法，具体包括三维径向分布函数（3D RDF）和投影二维关联函数（projected two-dimensional correlations），用于分析不同孔径（1-5 nm）和温度（250-295 K）下的结构有序性。

papers.title: Matrix-Product Belief Propagation for continuous-state-space variables
papers.abstract: Computation of observables in discrete stochastic, possibly conditioned, dynamics over large sparse networks is at the basis of a myriad of applications. The Matrix-Product Belief Propagation method allows a semi-analytical estimation of such observables with a controlled error that depends on the size of the employed matrices, called bond size. Its computational cost is linear in the time horizon and the network size for a large family of models with discrete degrees of freedom. Here, a generalization of this method to models with continuous or mixed continuous/discrete degrees of freedom is presented, using a tunable expansion in a Hilbert function basis. The computational cost of the method is linear in the network size with a prefactor that depends on the basis size and the bond size. The method's efficacy is demonstrated by employing a Fourier basis for a mixed continuous/discrete representation of the Kinetic Ising dynamics with real-valued random couplings, where intermediate ``local fields'' are treated as continuous. The accuracy of the method is verified via comparison with Monte-Carlo simulations. For this model, we calculate time auto-correlations, time evolution of energy and magnetization, and finally we estimate the large deviation function of the magnetization at a given future time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：提出并推广了一种名为“Matrix-Product Belief Propagation”的半解析计算方法，并进行了数值验证。；研究对象：连续状态空间变量（continuous-state-space variables）上的随机动力学系统，特别是具有连续/离散混合自由度的模型。具体演示了具有实值随机耦合的动力学伊辛模型（Kinetic Ising model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功将矩阵乘积置信传播（MP-BP）方法从离散自由度推广到连续或混合连续/离散自由度系统，并通过与蒙特卡洛模拟对比，验证了该方法在计算可观测量（如时间自关联、能量和磁化强度的时间演化、大偏差函数）时的准确性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功将矩阵乘积置信传播（MP-BP）方法从离散自由度推广到连续或混合连续/离散自由度系统，并通过与蒙特卡洛模拟对比，验证了该方法在计算可观测量（如时间自关联、能量和磁化强度的时间演化、大偏差函数）时的准确性。；创新点：将原本仅适用于离散自由度的MP-BP方法推广至连续或混合连续/离散自由度系统，并利用希尔伯特函数基展开（如傅里叶基）实现了这一推广，从而扩展了该方法的应用范围。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 矩阵乘积置信传播（Matrix-Product Belief Propagation, MP-BP）方法。该方法通过在一个希尔伯特函数基（如傅里叶基）中进行可调展开，将连续变量离散化，从而实现对连续状态空间变量的半解析估计。计算成本与网络规模成线性关系，但预因子依赖于基的大小和键尺寸（bond size）。

papers.title: A Brownian dynamics study of liquid-liquid phase separation in multi-scale chromatin networks
papers.abstract: In living cells, proteins involved in specialized biochemical functions are often spatially organized within biomolecular condensates. Increasing evidence suggests that some of these condensates, including DNA repair condensates, emerge through liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). In the nucleus, however, condensates form within a highly heterogeneous environment composed of chromatin fibers, RNA, and additional protein scaffolds such as PAR chains, all of which may interact with phase-separating proteins. Moreover, condensate formation is frequently associated with specific chromatin conformations; for instance, loop extrusion has been proposed as a mechanism promoting DNA repair condensates. Here, we investigate how the surrounding fibrous environment controls the morphology and spatial organization of phase-separated condensates. Using Brownian dynamics simulations of minimal models combining Lennard-Jones particles with fixed fibrous substrates, we examine the respective roles of local fiber geometry and large-scale network organization, reflecting the multiscale architecture of chromatin. We show that protein-fiber interactions strongly influence droplet positioning relative to the substrate, in a manner analogous to wetting transitions in soft condensed matter systems. Both local geometric constraints and global network organization markedly affect droplet size, morphology, and multiplicity. In addition, large-scale asymmetries in fiber organization can induce robust spatial localization of the dense phase. Our results thus highlight how multiscale structural heterogeneity of the nuclear environment can regulate the emergence and organization of biomolecular condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Brownian dynamics simulations、minimal models、Lennard-Jones particles）；研究对象：生物分子凝聚体在染色质多尺度纤维网络中的液-液相分离现象，具体涉及DNA修复凝聚体等核内凝聚体的形态与空间组织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蛋白质与纤维的相互作用可类比软凝聚态体系中的润湿转变，强烈影响液滴相对于纤维基底的定位；局部纤维几何与全局网络组织共同调控液滴尺寸、形态及多重性，且纤维组织的大尺度不对称性可诱导致密相的空间局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蛋白质与纤维的相互作用可类比软凝聚态体系中的润湿转变，强烈影响液滴相对于纤维基底的定位；局部纤维几何与全局网络组织共同调控液滴尺寸、形态及多重性，且纤维组织的大尺度不对称性可诱导致密相的空间局域化。；创新点：系统揭示了核环境的多尺度结构异质性（从局部纤维几何到全局网络不对称性）如何调控生物分子凝聚体的形成与组织，将软凝聚态物理中的润湿概念引入核内相分离研究。
papers.method_zh: 采用布朗动力学模拟，构建由Lennard-Jones粒子与固定纤维基底组成的简化模型，分别考察局部纤维几何与全局网络组织（反映染色质多尺度结构）的作用。

papers.title: Probing the Chirality of Trigonal Selenium and Tellurium by Spin and Orbital Hall Effects
papers.abstract: Chiral crystals exhibit enantiomer-dependent transport phenomena that generate pure spin or orbital currents, while the handedness sensitivity of spin and orbital Hall conductivities (SHC/OHC) remains insufficiently understood. Using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that trigonal selenium and tellurium -- prototypical chiral semiconductors -- exhibit opposite signs of the SHC/OHC tensor elements $σ_{yx}^{S_y}$ and $σ_{yx}^{L_y}$ between their left- and right-handed enantiomers. This behavior originates from the mirror operation relating the two structures, described by space groups $P3_221$ (left-handed) and $P3_121$ (right-handed). Although both enantiomers share identical band structures and four nonzero SHC/OHC tensor components, $σ_{yx}^{S_y}$ and $σ_{yx}^{L_y}$ reverse sign due to the antisymmetric transformation of the spin/orbital Berry curvature under the $M_{xy}$ mirror operation. More generally, for mirror-related enantiomorphic structures, selected SHC/OHC tensor components can exhibit symmetry-governed sign reversal. For trigonal Se and Te, the calculated signs of these components can be directly correlated with the left- and right-handed structures under the chosen coordinate convention. These results clarify the symmetry origin of handedness-dependent SHC/OHC and suggest a possible route for correlating measurable SHC/OHC signals with structural handedness in specific chiral materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：手性半导体材料：三方硒（trigonal selenium）和三方碲（trigonal tellurium），以及它们左右手性对映体中的自旋霍尔效应和轨道霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三方硒和碲的左右手性对映体之间，自旋霍尔电导率（SHC）和轨道霍尔电导率（OHC）的张量分量σ_{yx}^{S_y}和σ_{yx}^{L_y}符号相反。这一符号反转源于两种结构之间的镜面对称操作，并由自旋/轨道贝里曲率在镜面操作下的反对称变换所决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三方硒和碲的左右手性对映体之间，自旋霍尔电导率（SHC）和轨道霍尔电导率（OHC）的张量分量σ_{yx}^{S_y}和σ_{yx}^{L_y}符号相反。这一符号反转源于两种结构之间的镜面对称操作，并由自旋/轨道贝里曲率在镜面操作下的反对称变换所决定。；创新点：揭示了手性依赖的SHC/OHC的对称性起源，即镜面对称操作导致特定张量分量的符号反转，并指出可通过测量SHC/OHC信号来关联特定手性材料的结构手性。摘要未突出说明与以往计算工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体基于空间群P3₂21（左手）和P3₁21（右手）的晶体结构，计算了自旋/轨道贝里曲率及相应的霍尔电导率张量分量。

papers.title: Accurate computation of the electron-phonon interaction contribution to the total energy
papers.abstract: The standard Hamiltonian of a coupled electron-phonon system is based on second-order perturbation theory. The EPI contribution in the standard Hamiltonian consists of two terms, the EPI contribution to the band-structure energy and the partial-Fan-Migdal (FM)-occupied contribution. Within the non-adiabatic approximation, we derive a new expression for the partial-FM-occ contribution and show that it has the structure of a higher-order term, and not a second-order term. Along similar lines, we derive new expressions for the computation of the partial-FM-occ term. The new expressions for the partial-FM-occ term must be preferred over the standard expressions, in theoretical and computational studies, because they incorporate the complete physics underlying this term.
