Unlike the EPI contribution to individual eigenstates, the EPI contribution to the total energy must be computed in the non-adiabatic approximation for all materials, Infra-red (IR) active and IR-inactive. We report the computation of the standard Hamiltonian, for the first time, for Carbon polymorphs (diamond and hexagonal lonsdaleite) by including the EPI contribution to the total energy. This is the most accurate ab initio total energy reported till date. The present work also opens the way to compute the ab initio free-energy more accurately at finite temperatures by including the EPI contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：non-adiabatic approximation、derivation、ab initio total energy、computation。；研究对象：电子-声子相互作用（EPI）对总能量的贡献，具体应用于碳的同素异形体（金刚石和六方朗斯代尔石）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出电子-声子相互作用中部分Fan-Migdal占据贡献的新表达式，证明其本质上是高阶项而非二阶项；首次在碳同素异形体中实现了包含EPI贡献的总能量最精确的从头计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出电子-声子相互作用中部分Fan-Migdal占据贡献的新表达式，证明其本质上是高阶项而非二阶项；首次在碳同素异形体中实现了包含EPI贡献的总能量最精确的从头计算。；创新点：揭示了标准哈密顿量中部分Fan-Migdal占据项的高阶结构，并提出了更完整的物理表达式；首次在红外活性与非红外活性材料中均需采用非绝热近似计算EPI对总能量的贡献，并实现了对碳同素异形体的最精确总能量计算。
papers.method_zh: 基于非绝热近似，重新推导了部分Fan-Migdal占据项的解析表达式；采用标准哈密顿量框架，结合从头计算方法计算了金刚石和六方朗斯代尔石的总能量，包含EPI贡献。

papers.title: High-Pressure Crystal Structure Database
papers.abstract: High-pressure research is a productive route to new structures and emergent properties. However, crucial high-pressure structural information remains highly fragmented across individual publications and heterogeneous computational repositories. This fragmentation creates a major bottleneck for data-driven materials design. To bridge this gap, we introduce the High-Pressure Crystal Structure Database (HPCSD), a traceable, pressure-resolved repository that integrates experimental and theoretical high-pressure structures. HPCSD is constructed from two complementary data streams: elemental high-pressure phases and a searchable configuration space of stable and metastable phases generated via CALYPSO crystal structure prediction. To ensure rigorous comparability, all retained structures underwent re-optimization under a unified density functional theory (DFT) framework , with continuous enthalpy curves systematically generated specifically for the elemental phases across their stability fields. The initial release encompasses 77,346 consistently evaluated structural entries spanning 89 elements. An analysis reveals that pressure-induced polymorphism is ubiquitous and exhibits pronounced family-dependent trends. Structural diversity is strongly influenced by an element's electronic adaptability , with the greatest structural complexity emerging at intermediate rather than highest pressures. By providing standardized, reusable, and rigorously evaluated high-pressure structural data, HPCSD establishes a robust infrastructure to accelerate experimental phase identification, facilitate cross-study thermodynamic comparisons, and support the development of machine-learning interatomic potentials and generative models for high-pressure systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：CALYPSO晶体结构预测、密度泛函理论（DFT）重优化、计算数据库构建）；研究对象：高压下元素晶体的结构相变与多态性。具体研究对象为89种元素在高压下的实验与理论晶体结构数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力诱导的多态性在元素中普遍存在，并表现出明显的族依赖趋势。结构多样性受元素电子适应性的强烈影响，且最复杂的结构出现在中等压力而非最高压力下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力诱导的多态性在元素中普遍存在，并表现出明显的族依赖趋势。结构多样性受元素电子适应性的强烈影响，且最复杂的结构出现在中等压力而非最高压力下。；创新点：首次提供了一个标准化、可重复使用且经过严格评估的高压结构数据库，整合了分散在文献和异构计算库中的高压结构信息，为数据驱动的材料设计建立了基础架构。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个名为高压晶体结构数据库（HPCSD）的可追溯、压力分辨的数据库。数据来源包括：1）元素的高压实验相；2）通过CALYPSO晶体结构预测方法生成的稳定与亚稳态构型空间。所有收录的结构均在统一的密度泛函理论（DFT）框架下进行了重优化，并专门为元素相在其稳定场中生成了连续的焓曲线。

papers.title: Periodic Behavior of Topology in Graphene with Nanohole Array
papers.abstract: We derive a way to diagnose band topology for graphene with triangular and/or honeycomb array of nanoholes directly from the lattice constant of superstructure $m\sqrt{3}\times m\sqrt{3}$ with integer $m$. Taking into account the $C_{6v}$ crystalline symmetry respected by nanoholes and their array, we demonstrate that nontrivial topology appears periodically with $m$ with period two (six) for triangular (honeycomb) array. These behaviors are verified by Wyckoff positions of Wannier centers and parity index of valence bands at high-symmetry points in Brillouin zone. The results provide a convenient guide for material design of topological electronic states based on graphene derivatives.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“derive a way to diagnose”“demonstrate”“verified by Wyckoff positions and parity index”等理论推导和对称性分析关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有三角形或蜂窝状纳米孔阵列的石墨烯超结构（具体为 \( m\sqrt{3} \times m\sqrt{3} \) 超晶格，其中 \( m \) 为整数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持 \( C_{6v} \) 晶格对称性的纳米孔阵列中，石墨烯的能带拓扑性质随超晶格常数 \( m \) 呈周期性变化：对于三角形阵列，周期为2；对于蜂窝状阵列，周期为6。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持 \( C_{6v} \) 晶格对称性的纳米孔阵列中，石墨烯的能带拓扑性质随超晶格常数 \( m \) 呈周期性变化：对于三角形阵列，周期为2；对于蜂窝状阵列，周期为6。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析（\( C_{6v} \) 点群），利用Wannier中心的Wyckoff位置以及布里渊区高对称点处价带的宇称指标来诊断能带拓扑。

papers.title: Shaping Maximally Localized Wannier Functions via Discrete Adiabatic Transport
papers.abstract: Maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs) are conventionally constructed by iteratively minimizing a spread functional over a high-dimensional gauge landscape. In this work, we present a non-variational constructive algorithm that unifies gauge smoothing and the eigenvalue problem of the projected position operator into a single deterministic framework. We demonstrate that discrete adiabatic transport across band degeneracies emerges naturally as an integral part of the solution procedure for the position eigenvectors. In this transport-aligned gauge, the Bloch overlaps exhibit an approximately linear phase dependence, allowing the Wannier centers to be extracted via deterministic fixed-point iterations and self-consistent updates rather than spread-functional minimization. Benchmark calculations for one- and two-dimensional systems yield spreads and orbital shapes in good agreement with standard minimization schemes. Furthermore, this analytical approach transparently isolates the physical origin of the $\mathcal{O}(L)$ mesh-dependent spread scaling ($L$ being the boundary seam resolution) observed in graphene, demonstrating that it is an intrinsic geometric manifestation of non-commuting projected position operators forcing finite gauge defects to accumulate along a one-dimensional boundary seam.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：constructive algorithm、benchmark calculations、non-variational。；研究对象：最大化局域Wannier函数（MLWFs）的构造方法，具体应用于一维和二维系统（如石墨烯）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种非变分的确定性算法，通过离散绝热输运统一了规范平滑与投影位置算符的本征值问题，并揭示了石墨烯中O(L)网格依赖展宽的物理起源是投影位置算符非对易导致的边界几何缺陷累积。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种非变分的确定性算法，通过离散绝热输运统一了规范平滑与投影位置算符的本征值问题，并揭示了石墨烯中O(L)网格依赖展宽的物理起源是投影位置算符非对易导致的边界几何缺陷累积。；创新点：将规范平滑与投影位置算符本征值问题统一为单一确定性框架，避免了传统迭代最小化过程；透明地解析了石墨烯中展宽标度律的几何起源。
papers.method_zh: 基于离散绝热输运的确定性构造算法，通过固定点迭代和自洽更新提取Wannier中心，替代传统的展宽泛函最小化方法；在一维和二维系统中进行基准计算验证。

papers.title: Strain-Enhanced Hydrogen Evolution, Electrical, Optical, and Thermoelectric Properties of the Multifunctional 2D CrSi2N4 Monolayer
papers.abstract: First-principles density functional theory (DFT) is employed to evaluate the structural, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, and electrocatalytic properties of monolayer CrSi2N4. Its symmetric N-Si-N-Cr-N-Si-N septuple-layer structure exhibits dynamic, thermal (300 K), and mechanical stability, supported by a -8.76 eV/atom cohesive energy. PBE and HSE06 functionals reveal an indirect bandgap of 0.58 eV and 2.16 eV, respectively, driven by localized Cr-3d and N-2p states. The monolayer features 15.57 static dielectric constant and maximum absorption coefficients of 0.9 X 10^6 cm-1 (visible) and 1.4 X 10^6 cm-1 (deep-UV). Semiclassical Boltzmann calculations predict an outstanding room-temperature n-type thermoelectric power factor of 3.5 x mW/mK2. For hydrogen evolution (HER), the basal plane yields a baseline hydrogen adsorption free energy (ΔGH) of 1.05 eV at the N-site. Applying +5% expansive biaxial strain improves HER kinetics, reducing ΔGH to 0.46 eV. Thus, CrSi2N4 is a resilient, tuneable candidate for waste-heat recovery, photodetectors, and sustainable electrocatalysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“First-principles density functional theory (DFT)”、“Semiclassical Boltzmann calculations”。；研究对象：二维单层材料 CrSi2N4 的多种物理性质，包括结构、电子、光学、热电和电催化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层 CrSi2N4 是一种多功能、稳定的二维材料，具有优异的光吸收系数（可见光和深紫外区）和室温热电功率因子。通过施加+5%的双轴拉伸应变，可以显著改善其析氢反应（HER）催化活性，将氢吸附自由能从 1.05 eV 降低至 0.46 eV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层 CrSi2N4 是一种多功能、稳定的二维材料，具有优异的光吸收系数（可见光和深紫外区）和室温热电功率因子。通过施加+5%的双轴拉伸应变，可以显著改善其析氢反应（HER）催化活性，将氢吸附自由能从 1.05 eV 降低至 0.46 eV。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，使用了 PBE 和 HSE06 泛函评估电子结构；采用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论计算热电性质；通过计算氢吸附自由能（ΔGH）评估析氢反应（HER）性能。

papers.title: From spin splitting to projected mass in altermagnetic Chern matter
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic spin splitting alone does not define Chern matter. The relevant object is the exchange mass projected onto Hall-active surface, valley, orbital or interface sectors. We formulate this projected-mass criterion for compensated magnetic topology. The resulting two-channel $(C,\mathcal{A})$ diagnostic separates hidden compensated Hall responses from additive altermagnetic quantum anomalous Hall phases in a global insulating gap. It also guides interface, thickness and materials design strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“formulate”“diagnostic”“guides”等理论构建与设计策略的表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：交错磁（altermagnetic）陈绝缘体中的拓扑电子态，具体关注自旋劈裂与陈数（Chern number）之间的关系，以及隐藏的补偿霍尔响应与交错磁量子反常霍尔相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交错磁自旋劈裂本身不足以定义陈物质，关键在于交换质量（exchange mass）在霍尔活性表面、谷、轨道或界面等扇区上的投影。作者提出了这一投影质量判据，并建立了双通道 (C, 𝒜) 诊断方法，用于区分隐藏的补偿霍尔响应与可加性的交错磁量子反常霍尔相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交错磁自旋劈裂本身不足以定义陈物质，关键在于交换质量（exchange mass）在霍尔活性表面、谷、轨道或界面等扇区上的投影。作者提出了这一投影质量判据，并建立了双通道 (C, 𝒜) 诊断方法，用于区分隐藏的补偿霍尔响应与可加性的交错磁量子反常霍尔相。；创新点：提出了“投影质量”而非单纯自旋劈裂作为判断交错磁陈物质拓扑性质的核心判据，并建立了区分隐藏补偿霍尔效应与显式量子反常霍尔相的双通道诊断方法，为界面、厚度及材料设计提供了理论指导。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于投影质量判据（projected-mass criterion）对补偿磁拓扑进行形式化描述，并引入双通道 (C, 𝒜) 诊断分类。

papers.title: Chiroptical Ternary Entropy Harvesting from Self-Assembled Block Copolymer Nanopatterns
papers.abstract: Nanoscale fabrication inevitably produces local stochasticity that is commonly treated as a defect, but can instead be harnessed as a material resource for information security. Here we report a chiroptical platform for ternary entropy harvesting based on stochastic Au nanopatterns formed by block copolymer self-assembly. By transducing fabrication-induced stochastic microstates into handedness-dependent optical responses through chiroptical mapping, our platform enables native ternary digitization rather than conventional binary encoding, allowing physically harvested ternary random sequences to be used for key generation. This raises the information density to log2(3) = 1.585 bits per trit, approximately 58.5% higher than the binary limit, enabling more entropy to be harvested from a limited physical footprint. The harvested outputs exhibit near-balanced symbol populations, negligible spatial and inter-sample correlations, Shannon entropy approaching the ternary ideal, and resistance to statistical and machine-learning-based prediction. These results establish self-assembled chiroptical nanostructures as a scalable platform for cryptographic key generation, secure edge devices, and distributed Internet-of-Things platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：self-assembled block copolymer、stochastic Au nanopatterns、chiroptical mapping。；研究对象：基于嵌段共聚物自组装形成的随机金纳米图案，以及由此构建的手性光学三元熵采集平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将制备过程中的随机微观态转化为手性依赖的光学响应，实现了原生三元数字编码，使信息密度达到每三元1.585比特，比二进制极限高约58.5%，并可用于密钥生成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将制备过程中的随机微观态转化为手性依赖的光学响应，实现了原生三元数字编码，使信息密度达到每三元1.585比特，比二进制极限高约58.5%，并可用于密钥生成。；创新点：首次将自组装手性光学纳米结构用于三元熵采集，突破了传统二进制编码的信息密度限制，并展示了抗统计与机器学习预测的安全性。
papers.method_zh: 利用嵌段共聚物自组装形成随机金纳米图案，通过手性光学映射将随机微观态转化为手性依赖的光学响应，实现三元随机序列的物理采集与密钥生成。

papers.title: Quantum Criticality in Monolayer Amorphous Carbon
papers.abstract: Amorphous solids represent the extreme limit of broken translational symmetry, in which the absence of long-range order removes well-defined crystal momenta and invalidates the Bloch description of electronic states. Monolayer amorphous carbon (MAC) has emerged as a unique realization of a strictly two-dimensional (2D) amorphous lattice defined by a structurally contiguous but topologically disordered $sp^2$-bonded random network devoid of any defined long-range crystal symmetry. From atomic-resolution measurements of multifractal wavefunctions, we show that disorder in MAC effectively localizes the low-energy part of the electronic spectrum but retains an extended critical-like state near the band centre ($E\sim 0$). We conjecture that this state is protected from topological disorder by remnant chiral symmetry surviving within the continuous random network, described by a Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) topological term. Near criticality, we verify the multifractal scaling relation $η= -Δ_2$, providing quantitative agreement between independently measured spatial correlation decay and multifractal scaling exponents. Our results are confirmed by atomistic tight-binding calculations that closely mirror the multifractal scaling near $E\sim 0$. Our results establish MAC as the first strictly 2D amorphous electronic system to exhibit Anderson criticality driven purely by topological disorder
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“原子级分辨率测量”（实验手段）和“原子级紧束缚计算”（计算方法）。；研究对象：单层非晶碳（monolayer amorphous carbon, MAC），一种严格二维的无序sp²键合随机网络，研究其量子临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MAC中，无序有效局域化了低能电子态，但在能带中心（E~0）附近保留了一个扩展的临界态。该临界态受残余手征对称性保护，并由Wess-Zumino-Witten拓扑项描述，首次在严格二维非晶电子系统中实现了纯拓扑无序驱动的安德森临界性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MAC中，无序有效局域化了低能电子态，但在能带中心（E~0）附近保留了一个扩展的临界态。该临界态受残余手征对称性保护，并由Wess-Zumino-Witten拓扑项描述，首次在严格二维非晶电子系统中实现了纯拓扑无序驱动的安德森临界性。；创新点：首次在严格二维非晶电子系统中观察到纯由拓扑无序（而非化学无序或晶格畸变）驱动的安德森临界性，并建立了多分形标度关系η = -Δ₂的定量一致性。
papers.method_zh: 原子级分辨率测量（扫描隧道显微镜/谱）获取多分形波函数；原子级紧束缚计算（tight-binding calculations）验证多分形标度行为。

papers.title: Ward identities and orbital magnetization in current density functional theory
papers.abstract: We revisit the derivation of the orbital magnetization formula for periodic crystals in current density functional theory (CDFT)[1]. Our new derivation computes the linear response of the energy density to a periodic magnetic field in the long-wavelength limit. We unveil a Ward identity which connects the current vertex to the derivative of the Kohn-Sham self-energy. The result of Ref.[1] is confirmed: the orbital magnetization of the interacting solid can be computed exactly (in principle) from the self-consistent eigenfunctions and eigenvalues of the Kohn-Sham equation of CDFT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“推导”“线性响应”“Ward恒等式”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：周期性晶体在电流密度泛函理论（CDFT）中的轨道磁化（orbital magnetization）公式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过长波极限下对周期磁场的能量密度线性响应计算，揭示了连接电流顶点与Kohn-Sham自能导数的Ward恒等式，并确认了CDFT框架下相互作用固体的轨道磁化原则上可由CDFT的Kohn-Sham方程自洽本征函数与本征值精确计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过长波极限下对周期磁场的能量密度线性响应计算，揭示了连接电流顶点与Kohn-Sham自能导数的Ward恒等式，并确认了CDFT框架下相互作用固体的轨道磁化原则上可由CDFT的Kohn-Sham方程自洽本征函数与本征值精确计算。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于电流密度泛函理论（CDFT），采用长波极限下的线性响应方法，并运用Ward恒等式分析电流顶点与自能的关系。

papers.title: Depletion-mode N-polar AlN-based high electron mobility transistors with improved on/off ratios
papers.abstract: We report N-polar AlN-based high-electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) with a GaN channel thickness of 5.2 nm on N-polar AlN on sapphire. The threshold voltage is around -2.4 to -3.0 V with saturation currents over 240 mA/mm and on/off ratios as high as 10,000, much higher than previously reported N-polar AlN-based HEMTs. The high on/off ratio is attributed to the use of an abrupt AlN/GaN heterostructure with a dedicated AlN transition layer, together with improved gate leakage. The high frequency properties as well as the on-resistance of ~20 Ohm mm are all limited by the 2000 Ohm/square sheet resistance of the channel layer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“We report”、“measured”、“on/off ratios”、“gate leakage”等表明该工作为器件制备与电学性能测试。；研究对象：N极性AlN基高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMTs），具体为在蓝宝石衬底上生长的N极性AlN/GaN异质结，GaN沟道层厚度为5.2 nm。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了阈值电压约-2.4至-3.0 V、饱和电流超过240 mA/mm、开关比高达10,000的N极性AlN基HEMT，开关比显著高于此前报道的同类器件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了阈值电压约-2.4至-3.0 V、饱和电流超过240 mA/mm、开关比高达10,000的N极性AlN基HEMT，开关比显著高于此前报道的同类器件。；创新点：通过优化AlN/GaN异质结构（使用陡峭界面和专用AlN过渡层）有效抑制栅极漏电，使开关比提升至10,000，远高于此前报道的N极性AlN基HEMT。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）或金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）生长N极性AlN/GaN异质结构（摘要未明确说明具体生长技术），通过引入陡峭的AlN/GaN异质界面和专用的AlN过渡层来降低栅极漏电流，并测量了器件的直流输出特性、转移特性、开关比、高频性能及导通电阻。

papers.title: Unified definition of ferroelectricity
papers.abstract: Recent theoretical and experimental advances in quantum ferroelectrics suggest that ferroelectricity can also emerge in non-polar space group, highlighting the limitations of conventional polar space group criteria in identifying ferroelectric materials. Here, we introduce a unified definition based on switchable polarization differences between energetically equivalent states, which naturally encompasses conventional and quantum ferroelectrics. Guided by this principle, we implement a high-throughput screening strategy that systematically identifies both conventional and quantum ferroelectrics among experimentally synthesized materials. In particular, we identify a new type of quantum ferroelectric in which the quantized polarization arises from arbitrary ionic displacements, in contrast to previous quantum ferroelectrics (including both fractional and integer quantum ferroelectrics) where quantized polarization results from fractional or integer ionic displacements. Notably, we find that materials such as Ba3I6 and Cs2PdC2 exhibit low switching barriers and robust insulating behavior, highlighting their experimental viability. Our results reconcile conventional and quantum ferroelectrics, expand the accessible materials landscape, and provide a practical roadmap for discovering next-generation ferroelectrics with advanced switchable functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算筛选）。判断依据：提出统一理论定义（unified definition），并实施高通量筛选（high-throughput screening strategy）。；研究对象：铁电性（ferroelectricity）的统一定义，以及常规铁电体与量子铁电体（quantum ferroelectrics）的识别，具体材料包括 Ba₃I₆ 和 Cs₂PdC₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于可切换极化差（switchable polarization differences between energetically equivalent states）的铁电性统一定义，该定义自然涵盖常规铁电体和量子铁电体；并发现一种新型量子铁电体，其量子化极化源于任意离子位移，而非之前已知的分数量子铁电体或整数量子铁电体中的分数或整数离子位移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于可切换极化差（switchable polarization differences between energetically equivalent states）的铁电性统一定义，该定义自然涵盖常规铁电体和量子铁电体；并发现一种新型量子铁电体，其量子化极化源于任意离子位移，而非之前已知的分数量子铁电体或整数量子铁电体中的分数或整数离子位移。；创新点：首次提出一个统一框架，将常规铁电体与量子铁电体（包括分数、整数及新发现的任意位移型量子铁电体）纳入同一铁电性定义之下，并基于该定义实现了高通量材料筛选。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析提出统一定义；高通量筛选（high-throughput screening）对实验已合成材料进行系统识别；计算评估了 Ba₃I₆ 和 Cs₂PdC₂ 的切换势垒（switching barriers）和绝缘行为（insulating behavior）。

papers.title: Machine-learning-identified two-dimensional van der Waals multiferroics for four-state nonvolatile memory
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) multiferroics offer an attractive platform for four-state nonvolatile memory by combining switchable ferroelectric polarization and magnetization within a single material system. However, their development is hindered by the scarcity of synthesizable candidates and the lack of non-destructive readout schemes. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with first-principles calculations to explore the 2D vdW ABC$_2$X$_6$ family and identify a set of high-confidence multiferroic candidates. Among them, AuCrP$_2$S$_6$ monolayer emerges as a representative system with a ferromagnetic ground state, a sizable out-of-plane polarization of 7.46 pC/m, and a moderate ferroelectric switching barrier of $\sim$130 meV/f.u. Moreover, the nonlinear optical response mediated by the bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) in AuCrP$_2$S$_6$ provides a dual-channel probe of the ferroic orders, in which the polarization direction governs the photocurrent sign while the magnetic order selects the spin channel via robust exchange splitting. This intrinsic coupling enables the non-destructive readout of four logic states within a single atomic layer, thereby providing a practical blueprint for next-generation multistate optoelectronic memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning screening, first-principles calculations）；研究对象：二维范德华多铁材料家族ABC₂X₆，具体以AuCrP₂S₆单层为代表。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习筛选和第一性原理计算，在ABC₂X₆家族中识别出一系列高置信度的多铁候选材料，其中AuCrP₂S₆单层同时具有铁磁基态和面外铁电极化，其体光伏效应可实现四种逻辑状态的非破坏性读出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习筛选和第一性原理计算，在ABC₂X₆家族中识别出一系列高置信度的多铁候选材料，其中AuCrP₂S₆单层同时具有铁磁基态和面外铁电极化，其体光伏效应可实现四种逻辑状态的非破坏性读出。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习筛选结合第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如DFT+U等）。

papers.title: Shear-stress-constrained superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates
papers.abstract: Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates exhibit superconductivity under pressure in bulk crystals and under epitaxial constraint in thin films, while remaining highly sensitive to sample quality, oxygen content, defects, and stress conditions. We propose that the metastable RP lattice becomes superconducting only when the local constrained deformation of the Ni-O framework falls within a bounded shear-strain window. This deformation controls octahedral rotations, the interlayer Ni-O-Ni bond angle, and coupling between Ni dz2 and dx2-y2 orbitals. This shear-stress-constrained superconductivity scenario unifies the understanding of the pressure threshold, reversibility, spatial inhomogeneity, pressure-medium dependence, film-substrate sensitivity, and reproducibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“propose”（提出）、“unifies the understanding”（统一理解），未提及具体实验或计算手段。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）相镍氧化物（nickelates）中的超导电性，特别是其受剪切应力约束的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RP镍氧化物仅在Ni-O框架的局域约束变形处于一个有限的剪切应变窗口内时才会出现超导电性，该剪切应力约束机制统一解释了压力阈值、可逆性、空间不均匀性、压力介质依赖性、薄膜-衬底敏感性及可重复性等实验现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RP镍氧化物仅在Ni-O框架的局域约束变形处于一个有限的剪切应变窗口内时才会出现超导电性，该剪切应力约束机制统一解释了压力阈值、可逆性、空间不均匀性、压力介质依赖性、薄膜-衬底敏感性及可重复性等实验现象。；创新点：提出了“剪切应力约束超导电性”这一统一理论框架，将此前分散的实验现象（如压力阈值、薄膜衬底敏感性等）归因于一个共同的物理机制——局域剪切应变窗口。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体研究方法，仅基于理论分析提出物理图像（剪切应变窗口控制八面体旋转、层间Ni-O-Ni键角及Ni dz2与dx2-y2轨道耦合）。

papers.title: Open Quantum Theory of Shot Noise in Dissipative Chiral Transport
papers.abstract: We develop an open quantum theory for shot-noise dynamics in dissipative chiral transport. By mapping a system under consideration onto a quantum circuit, we show that current noise is governed by two competing factors: the average occupancy distribution and particle-number fluctuations. With energy fully relaxed, shot noise is strongly suppressed, reflecting the stacking of electrons into lower energy states due to dissipation. This process quenches the partition noise from partially occupied levels, and finally isolates the residual noise protected by strong $U(1)$ symmetry. Moreover, selectively heating the source against the bath uncovers the underlying competition between the noise contributions from the occupancy distribution and those from the particle-number fluctuations. It triggers a sign reversal in inter-channel correlation noise, a signature masked by seemingly identical single-channel thermal noises. We propose an inversion scheme to experimentally reconstruct the hidden occupancy distribution directly from measurable noise cumulants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：develop an open quantum theory、show、propose an inversion scheme。；研究对象：耗散手性输运中的散粒噪声动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电流噪声由平均占据分布和粒子数涨落两个竞争因素决定；能量完全弛豫时散粒噪声被强烈抑制，源于耗散导致电子堆积到低能态，从而淬灭部分占据能级的分割噪声，最终仅留下受强U(1)对称性保护的残余噪声。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电流噪声由平均占据分布和粒子数涨落两个竞争因素决定；能量完全弛豫时散粒噪声被强烈抑制，源于耗散导致电子堆积到低能态，从而淬灭部分占据能级的分割噪声，最终仅留下受强U(1)对称性保护的残余噪声。；创新点：揭示了占据分布与粒子数涨落对噪声贡献的竞争机制，并发现选择性加热源端可触发通道间关联噪声的符号反转，这一特征被看似相同的单通道热噪声所掩盖。摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 将所研究系统映射到量子电路上，建立开放量子理论框架；通过分析噪声累积量，提出从可测量的噪声累积量中反演隐藏占据分布的反演方案。

papers.title: Time Crystals in Coupled Exciton-Polariton Condensates
papers.abstract: In this paper, we show that time crystals can emerge in coupled exciton-polariton condensates without periodic external driving, enabled instead by incoherent gain and dissipation channels inherent to semiconductor microcavities. We present a full quantum description of these processes that recovers the established effective theory at the mean-field level. We analytically determine the mean-field phase diagram for the time-crystalline phase and find that its emergence requires the ratio of Kerr nonlinearity to nonlinear dissipation to exceed $\sqrt{5/4}$. Within this regime, the periodic oscillation of the particle numbers forms an attractor that is insensitive to the initial conditions. Numerical bifurcation diagrams reveal transitions between the time-crystalline phase and various steady phases, in excellent agreement with the analytical results. Using Bogoliubov perturbation theory, we evaluate the leading-order quantum corrections and find that, over a wide parameter range, these corrections remain periodic and much smaller than the mean-field background, thereby establishing the robustness of the time crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“full quantum description”、“mean-field level”、“analytically determine”、“Bogoliubov perturbation theory”等理论分析手段，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：耦合激子-极化激元凝聚体中的时间晶体（time crystals）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无周期性外部驱动的情况下，耦合激子-极化激元凝聚体可通过非相干增益和耗散通道自发形成时间晶体，其出现要求Kerr非线性与非线性耗散之比超过√(5/4)，且该时间晶体的周期性振荡对初始条件不敏感，形成吸引子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无周期性外部驱动的情况下，耦合激子-极化激元凝聚体可通过非相干增益和耗散通道自发形成时间晶体，其出现要求Kerr非线性与非线性耗散之比超过√(5/4)，且该时间晶体的周期性振荡对初始条件不敏感，形成吸引子。；创新点：首次在耦合激子-极化激元凝聚体中证明无需周期性外部驱动即可实现时间晶体，并揭示了Kerr非线性与非线性耗散比值的关键作用，同时通过量子修正分析证明了该时间晶体的鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 采用全量子描述，在平均场层面恢复已有有效理论；通过解析方法确定平均场相图；利用数值分岔图分析时间晶体相与稳态相之间的转变；运用Bogoliubov微扰理论评估量子修正的周期性及大小。

papers.title: Strong electron correlations and ligand hybridization for altermagnetism
papers.abstract: Spin-band splitting is a hallmark of altermagnetism, intrinsically linked to magnetic ordering driven by electron correlations. However, recent inconsistencies in the detection of altermagnetism in strongly correlated altermagnet candidates have cast doubt on the robustness of this phenomenon and its dependence on many-body effects. Here, using state-of-the-art quantum many-body frameworks, we dissect the electronic origins of altermagnetism in three prototypical candidates: MnF$_2$, MnTe, and RuO$_2$. In MnF$_2$, we identify pronounced local electron correlations within Mn-3$d$ states and uncover a distinct Mott gap in the visible range, rooted in nonlocal screening effects. The strong correlations markedly localize the Mn-3$d$ electrons, leading to a narrowing of the spin-resolved bandwidth and, consequently, a suppression of spin-band splitting. By contrast, MnTe provides an ideal platform for altermagnetism, exhibiting substantial local Mn-3$d$ magnetic moments due to the strong correlations and pronounced spin-band splitting, enabled by robust Mn 3$d$--Te-5$p$ orbital hybridization. RuO$_2$ manifests as a Pauli paramagnet with vanishing local moments, even in its antiferromagnetic phase. Nonetheless, it exhibits significant spin-band splitting, indicative of itinerant altermagnetic behavior. Our results reveal that both strong local electron correlations and judicious ligand selection to promote orbital hybridization are key prerequisites to realizing altermagnetism in strongly correlated systems. These insights pave the way for the rational design and discovery of novel altermagnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“state-of-the-art quantum many-body frameworks”等理论计算方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：三种典型的交变磁性候选材料：MnF₂、MnTe 和 RuO₂，以及交变磁性（altermagnetism）的电子起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强局域电子关联和配体杂化（如Mn 3d–Te 5p轨道杂化）是强关联体系中实现交变磁性的关键；MnF₂中强关联抑制了自旋带分裂，MnTe是理想的交变磁平台，RuO₂表现为巡游交变磁行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强局域电子关联和配体杂化（如Mn 3d–Te 5p轨道杂化）是强关联体系中实现交变磁性的关键；MnF₂中强关联抑制了自旋带分裂，MnTe是理想的交变磁平台，RuO₂表现为巡游交变磁行为。；创新点：揭示了强关联效应和配体选择（轨道杂化）对交变磁性的协同调控作用，为理性设计新型交变磁性材料提供了指导。
papers.method_zh: 采用先进的量子多体框架（quantum many-body frameworks）进行电子结构分析，具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否使用DFT+U、DMFT等）。

papers.title: Ultrafast decoupling of quasiparticles and spin fluctuations in superconducting cuprates
papers.abstract: Understanding how quasiparticles are generated following a rapid quench of superconductivity in high-Tc cuprates is a key unresolved problem in nonequilibrium superconductivity. Here we resolve these processes in optimally doped YBCO [YBa2Cu3Oy(y=6.94, Tc=92 K)] using broadband (0.16 -4.1 eV, ca. 100 fs) and nearly single-cycle (6 fs) transient reflectivity spectroscopy. We show that within a few femtosecond, enhanced electron-electron Umklapp scattering dominates, signaling a transient modulation of long-range Coulomb interactions on the eV scale. This regime is followed by a rapid suppression of the scattering rate of the mid-infrared absorption associated with carriers dressed by spin fluctuations. We attribute this observation to an ultrafast decoupling of quasiparticles from the spin-fluctuation background, occurring on a 90 fs timescale set by the inverse optical gap. These findings reveal the correlated many-body dynamics underlying quasiparticle generation in cuprates and provide further clues for unconventional pairing mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了“瞬态反射光谱学”（transient reflectivity spectroscopy）这一实验手段。；研究对象：高温超导铜氧化物（cuprates）中的非平衡态准粒子产生过程，具体材料为最佳掺杂的YBCO [YBa₂Cu₃O_y (y=6.94, Tc=92 K)]。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超导被快速猝灭后，准粒子与自旋涨落背景在约90飞秒的时间尺度上发生超快退耦合，揭示了准粒子产生的关联多体动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超导被快速猝灭后，准粒子与自旋涨落背景在约90飞秒的时间尺度上发生超快退耦合，揭示了准粒子产生的关联多体动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 宽带（0.16-4.1 eV，约100飞秒）和近单周期（6飞秒）瞬态反射光谱学。

papers.title: The thermopower properties of interacting systems
authors: Willdauany C. de Freitas da Silva
papers.abstract: The quest for efficient devices has fueled research in thermoelectric materials. In these materials, the goal is to maximize the Figure of Merit $ZT$. One of the components of this quantity is the Seebeck coefficient, which measures the voltage generated in response to a temperature gradient. Recent studies have revealed that strong electronic correlations can enhance the Seebeck coefficient, leading to anomalous behavior near half-filling. However, the impact of interactions beyond the on-site Hubbard remains mostly unexplored. In this work, we investigate the Seebeck coefficient considering attractive interactions, nearest-neighbor interactions, sublattice potentials and electron-phonon coupling. We find that additional interaction scales can enhance the Seebeck coefficient, while also leading to multiple anomalous changes of sign as a function of doping. We also show that the anomalous behavior is connected to a gap opening in the ground state. Moreover, electron-phonon coupling also lead to a Seebeck anomaly, even without on-site repulsion. We connect these changes of sign in the Seebeck coefficient with a restructuring of the Fermi surface and a change in its topology, an effect commonly seen in cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”“show”“connect”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：相互作用体系的热电性质，具体研究Seebeck系数（热电系数）在考虑吸引相互作用、最近邻相互作用、子晶格势和电子-声子耦合时的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 额外的相互作用尺度可以增强Seebeck系数，并导致其随掺杂出现多次反常变号；电子-声子耦合即使在没有在位排斥的情况下也能引起Seebeck反常。这些变号与费米面重构及其拓扑变化相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：额外的相互作用尺度可以增强Seebeck系数，并导致其随掺杂出现多次反常变号；电子-声子耦合即使在没有在位排斥的情况下也能引起Seebeck反常。这些变号与费米面重构及其拓扑变化相关。；创新点：系统研究了超越在位Hubbard相互作用的多种相互作用（吸引相互作用、最近邻相互作用、子晶格势、电子-声子耦合）对Seebeck系数的影响，并揭示了Seebeck系数变号与费米面拓扑变化的关联，这一效应常见于铜氧化物超导体。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体框架包括：考虑吸引相互作用、最近邻相互作用、子晶格势和电子-声子耦合的模型，通过分析基态能隙、费米面拓扑变化来理解Seebeck系数的行为。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如是否使用精确对角化、动力学平均场理论等）。

papers.title: Engineering Delocalization in Graphene Nanoribbons via Quasiperiodic Edges and Electronic Interactions
papers.abstract: We investigate localization effects in zigzag graphene nanoribbons with quasiperiodic Fibonacci-type edge extensions, accounting for electron-electron interactions. We employ a tight-binding model that includes first- and third-nearest-neighbor hoppings, in which electronic interactions are treated within a self-consistent mean-field Hubbard approximation. Charge transport properties are calculated using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism. Our results reveal that the combination of quasiperiodic geometry and electronic interactions gives rise to nontrivial transport phenomena. Specifically, the system exhibits three transport regimes: in the non-interacting case, we observe geometric localization. For weak interactions, the system shows a conductive regime with transmission oscillations, whose multiplicity increases with the Fibonacci generation order. In this regime, delocalization emerges from the interplay between geometry and interaction-induced correlations. Finally, for strong interactions, repulsion dominates, and the system returns to a localized state. Our results demonstrate that quasiperiodic edge engineering, combined with electronic interaction control, offers a promising path to modulate transport in graphene nanoribbons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“tight-binding model”、“self-consistent mean-field Hubbard approximation”、“Landauer-Büttiker formalism”。；研究对象：具有准周期斐波那契型边缘延伸的锯齿形石墨烯纳米带，并考虑电子-电子相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准周期几何结构与电子相互作用的结合可诱导三种输运机制：无相互作用时出现几何局域化；弱相互作用下出现导电态并伴随透射振荡，且振荡多重性随斐波那契代次增加；强相互作用下系统重新回到局域态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准周期几何结构与电子相互作用的结合可诱导三种输运机制：无相互作用时出现几何局域化；弱相互作用下出现导电态并伴随透射振荡，且振荡多重性随斐波那契代次增加；强相互作用下系统重新回到局域态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含第一近邻和第三近邻跃迁的紧束缚模型，电子相互作用通过自洽平均场Hubbard近似处理，电荷输运性质使用Landauer-Büttiker形式计算。

papers.title: Spin Hall effect in electronic Lévy glasses: Enhanced spin current generation in the superdiffusive regime
papers.abstract: In spintronics, both electronic charge and spin are used to process and store information. Generation, manipulation, and detection of spin currents are essential for the development of next-generation spintronic technologies. Here, we investigate the spin Hall effect in electronic Lévy glasses composed of graphene ribbons with randomly distributed circular regions of high spin-orbit coupling. These systems exhibit two transport regimes that can be tuned by adjusting the Fermi energy. The superdiffusive regime is characterized by low Fermi energy, low resistivity, and low magnetoresistivity, resulting in a long spin diffusion length, in contrast to the diffusive regime. Employing the Landauer-Büttiker approach in conjunction with numerically exact tight-binding simulations, we compute spin-resolved transmission coefficients to assess the spin Hall current and the spin Hall angle as functions of Fermi energy, spin-orbit coupling strength, and on-site electrostatic potential. Our findings reveal that, in the superdiffusive regime, a low charge current can be converted into a large spin Hall current, whereas in the diffusive regime, the same charge current generates a modest spin Hall current. Moreover, we observe that the spin Hall angle can reach 30% in the superdiffusive regime, whereas in the diffusive regime it is only 5%. These results demonstrate that electronic Lévy glasses provide a versatile platform for controlling spin transport and optimizing the spin Hall effect for spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要提到“Landauer-Büttiker approach in conjunction with numerically exact tight-binding simulations”，即采用数值精确的紧束缚模拟方法。；研究对象：电子Lévy玻璃中的自旋霍尔效应。具体体系为具有随机分布高自旋-轨道耦合圆形区域的石墨烯条带，研究其自旋输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超扩散输运区，低电荷电流可转化为大的自旋霍尔电流，自旋霍尔角可达30%；而在扩散区，相同电荷电流仅产生较小的自旋霍尔电流，自旋霍尔角仅为5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超扩散输运区，低电荷电流可转化为大的自旋霍尔电流，自旋霍尔角可达30%；而在扩散区，相同电荷电流仅产生较小的自旋霍尔电流，自旋霍尔角仅为5%。；创新点：首次在电子Lévy玻璃中揭示了超扩散输运区可显著增强自旋霍尔效应，为通过调控输运机制优化自旋电流生成提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用Landauer-Büttiker方法结合数值精确的紧束缚模拟，计算自旋分辨透射系数，进而评估自旋霍尔电流和自旋霍尔角随费米能量、自旋-轨道耦合强度及局域静电势的变化。

papers.title: A microcanonical approach to criticality in the mean-field $φ^4$ model: evidence of intrinsic microcanonical structure before the thermodynamic limit
papers.abstract: Collective critical behavior is often identified with thermodynamic nonanalyticities and divergences emerging only in the infinite-size limit. Here we adopt a complementary viewpoint: criticality is a structural property due to the rearrangement of the interactions among system's constituents that already exists at finite size and becomes singular only asymptotically. We show that the microcanonical entropy derivatives provide a natural finite-$N$ arena where such structure is encoded in intrinsic extremal/inflection morphologies, and that microcanonical inflection-point analysis (MIPA) turns these morphologies into a unique finite-size critical marker and a well-defined critical trajectory. Using the mean-field $φ^4$ model as a stringent benchmark, we reconstruct $β_N(\varepsilon)$ and $γ_N(\varepsilon)$ from microcanonical simulations, validate them against analytic results, and demonstrate that the MIPA trajectory converges to the exact thermodynamic critical point while simultaneously organizing the approach of other observables to their asymptotic behavior. Our results elevate finite-size criticality from a rounded remnant of the thermodynamic limit to a measurable and predictive object in its own right, with direct relevance to modern finite-system platforms and numerical studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：microcanonical approach、mean-field φ⁴ model、analytic results、microcanonical simulations）；研究对象：平均场φ⁴模型中的临界现象，特别是有限尺寸下的微正则结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微正则熵的导数在有限尺寸下已具有内在的极值/拐点形态，这些形态可通过微正则拐点分析（MIPA）转化为唯一的有限尺寸临界标记和明确定义的临界轨迹，该轨迹收敛到热力学极限下的精确临界点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微正则熵的导数在有限尺寸下已具有内在的极值/拐点形态，这些形态可通过微正则拐点分析（MIPA）转化为唯一的有限尺寸临界标记和明确定义的临界轨迹，该轨迹收敛到热力学极限下的精确临界点。；创新点：将有限尺寸临界性从热力学极限的“圆化残余”提升为本身可测量、可预测的对象，证明临界性作为系统组分间相互作用重排的结构性质在有限尺寸下已存在，而非仅由无限大极限下的奇异性定义。
papers.method_zh: 采用微正则模拟方法，重建β_N(ε)和γ_N(ε)函数，并与解析结果进行对比验证；核心分析框架为微正则拐点分析（MIPA）。

papers.title: Carrier-density dependence of magnetotransport in correlated Dirac semimetal CaIrO$_3$
papers.abstract: We report the carrier density dependence of the magnetotransport property in the correlated Dirac semimetal CaIrO$_3$. In the dilute carrier density region ($n_{\rm H}$ $\sim 2.2 \times 10^{16} \,$$\rm{cm}^{-3}$) at $2 \, \mathrm{K}$, the mobility exceeds $1.0 \times 10^{5} \,$$\rm{cm}^{2}/\rm{Vs}$ at $2 \, \mathrm{K}$, and the transverse magnetoresistance (MR) reaches $2,000 \,$\% at $12 \, \mathrm{T}$. The analysis of quantum oscillations and Hall conductivity shows that the Fermi velocity is nearly independent of the cross-sectional area of the Fermi surface, or equivalently the carrier density, supporting a $k$-linear dispersion of the Dirac node. The field dependence of magnetoresistivity is nearly $B$-linear in the moderate carrier density region ($n_\mathrm{H} \geq 4 \times 10^{16}\,$cm$^{-3}$), but scales with $B^α$ ($α> 2$) in the lower carrier density region. The variation of magnetoresistivity is likely affected by the enhanced long-range Coulomb interaction in the quantum limit, where Dirac electrons are subject to the magnetic confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了磁输运测量、量子振荡分析、霍尔电导分析等实验手段。；研究对象：关联狄拉克半金属 CaIrO₃ 中的磁输运性质，特别是其载流子密度依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低载流子密度区域，CaIrO₃ 的迁移率超过 1.0×10⁵ cm²/Vs，横向磁电阻在 12 T 下达到 2000%；费米速度几乎与费米面截面积（即载流子密度）无关，支持狄拉克节点的 k-线性色散；磁电阻率在中等载流子密度区域近似 B-线性，在更低载流子密度区域则呈 B^α（α>2）标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低载流子密度区域，CaIrO₃ 的迁移率超过 1.0×10⁵ cm²/Vs，横向磁电阻在 12 T 下达到 2000%；费米速度几乎与费米面截面积（即载流子密度）无关，支持狄拉克节点的 k-线性色散；磁电阻率在中等载流子密度区域近似 B-线性，在更低载流子密度区域则呈 B^α（α>2）标度关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过磁输运测量（包括横向磁电阻、霍尔效应）获取载流子密度和迁移率；利用量子振荡分析和霍尔电导分析提取费米速度；通过磁电阻率随磁场变化的标度分析研究不同载流子密度区域的输运行为。

papers.title: A Neural-Network Framework to Learn History-Dependent Constitutive Laws and Identifiability of Internal Variables
papers.abstract: The identification of constitutive laws is ubiquitous in engineering: in modeling of materials where experimental data are fitted to mathematical models or learning surrogate models to beat the FE\textsuperscript{2} computational cost of multiscale numerical simulations. However, these models of constitutive laws, unless equipped with a potential formulation, are not necessarily consistent with (a) the second law of thermodynamics; (b) stability of the material under extreme applied strain; and (c) the mathematical theory underpinning the existence of solutions of the governing equation. In this work, we present a causal and energetic formulation, consistent with aforementioned properties, of learning a history-dependent constitutive law. This characterization of the class of internal variables sheds light on the equivalence class of equivalent surrogate models for the constitutive law. We show that the internal variables that are learned from the data are unique up to a linear transform. The framework is deployed to learn the Taylor-averaged response of a polycrystalline magnesium unit cell. We achieve 2\% relative error in the prediction of the Taylor-averaged response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“neural-network framework”、“learning surrogate models”、“mathematical theory”等关键词，属于机器学习驱动的理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：历史依赖型本构定律（history-dependent constitutive laws）的机器学习建模，具体应用于多晶镁（polycrystalline magnesium）的Taylor平均响应预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种因果且符合热力学一致性的本构定律学习框架，并证明从数据中学到的内变量在唯一性上仅相差一个线性变换（即内变量可识别到线性变换等价类）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种因果且符合热力学一致性的本构定律学习框架，并证明从数据中学到的内变量在唯一性上仅相差一个线性变换（即内变量可识别到线性变换等价类）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统方法的具体对比，但明确指出了该框架相对于未配备势能公式的本构模型，首次同时保证了热力学一致性、材料稳定性与数学适定性，并揭示了内变量的可识别性（唯一到线性变换）。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经网络框架，结合因果性（causal）与能量（energetic）约束，确保模型满足热力学第二定律、极端应变下的材料稳定性以及控制方程解存在的数学理论。具体应用案例为多晶镁单胞的Taylor平均响应学习。

papers.title: Operator ordering as an emergent geometric background in Dirac systems with spatially varying mass
papers.abstract: We investigate the spectral consequences of the uniquely determined Hermitian ordering of the Dirac Hamiltonian with spatially varying mass. In contrast to the nonrelativistic case, where continuous families of admissible prescriptions exist, the relativistic Dirac operator admits a single consistent ordering compatible with probability-current conservation. This requirement generates an additional logarithmic-gradient term proportional to the spatial variation of the mass profile. We show that this contribution modifies the effective kinetic operator and induces a universal deformation of the spectral quantization condition. In compact geometry, an explicit analytic computation reveals a mode-dependent second-order spectral shift that becomes strongly enhanced near the mass-inversion threshold. These results demonstrate that the consistent relativistic ordering of the Dirac operator leads to observable modifications of discrete spectra in spatially inhomogeneous scalar backgrounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于哈密顿量的厄米排序、谱条件解析计算等理论推导，未提及实验或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：具有空间变化质量（spatially varying mass）的狄拉克系统，即狄拉克费米子在空间不均匀标量背景（mass profile）中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 狄拉克哈密顿量在空间变化质量下唯一确定的厄米排序会引入一个对数梯度项，该修正项有效改变动能算符，并导致谱量子化条件发生普适形变；在紧致几何中，该效应产生依赖于模式的二阶谱移，且在质量反转阈值附近显著增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：狄拉克哈密顿量在空间变化质量下唯一确定的厄米排序会引入一个对数梯度项，该修正项有效改变动能算符，并导致谱量子化条件发生普适形变；在紧致几何中，该效应产生依赖于模式的二阶谱移，且在质量反转阈值附近显著增强。；创新点：揭示了相对论性狄拉克算符（与非相对论情况不同）不存在连续可接受的排序族，其唯一排序导致的谱修正具有可观测的物理后果。摘要未突出说明与具体材料或实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于概率流守恒约束确定狄拉克算符的唯一厄米排序，通过解析计算推导谱量子化条件的修正，并在紧致几何中进行显式解析计算。

papers.title: The Role of Hydrogen Bridging Bonds in the Shear-Thickening and Jamming of Dense Suspensions
papers.abstract: Strong shear thickening and jamming in dense suspensions are driven by friction as particles are sheared into contact. Control over these frictional interactions can be achieved via particle shape and roughness, and also via the particles' surface chemistry and interactions with the surrounding solvent. We report on experiments with cornstarch suspensions where friction is enhanced by molecular bridging when hydrogen atoms at the ends of solvent molecules bond with hydroxyl groups on the surfaces of adjacent particles. We systematically vary the hydrogen bonding propensity by increasing the size of the backbone of the solvent molecule, from water to diols with up to 4 carbon atoms. For a fixed particle weight fraction, we find a sudden transition from strong shear thickening (in water and ethylene glycol) to shear thinning (in propanediol and butanediol). Combining data from rheology, density functional theory simulations, and fixed-rate pull tests, our results show how changes in the solvent's molecular structure affect both particle-solvent and solvent-solvent interactions, and how this can be used to tailor the shear thickening and jamming behavior of suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算与理论分析）。判断依据：关键词包括“experiments”、“rheology”、“density functional theory simulations”、“fixed-rate pull tests”。；研究对象：浓悬浮液（dense suspensions）中的剪切增稠（shear-thickening）与堵塞（jamming）行为，具体以玉米淀粉悬浮液为模型体系，研究溶剂分子中氢键桥接（hydrogen bridging bonds）对摩擦相互作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变溶剂分子主链长度（从水到含最多4个碳原子的二醇），可调控氢键倾向，从而在固定颗粒质量分数下实现从强剪切增稠（水和乙二醇中）到剪切变稀（丙二醇和丁二醇中）的突然转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变溶剂分子主链长度（从水到含最多4个碳原子的二醇），可调控氢键倾向，从而在固定颗粒质量分数下实现从强剪切增稠（水和乙二醇中）到剪切变稀（丙二醇和丁二醇中）的突然转变。；创新点：系统揭示了溶剂分子结构（主链大小）如何通过影响颗粒-溶剂和溶剂-溶剂相互作用来调控悬浮液的剪切增稠与堵塞行为，为通过分子尺度设计控制宏观流变响应提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 流变学实验（rheology）、密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟、定速拉拔测试（fixed-rate pull tests）。

papers.title: Observation of Switchable Chiral Magnons in an Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Chiral magnons, the quanta of handed spin waves, transport spin angular momentum without energy loss due to Joule heating. The recently discovered altermagnets were proposed to host chiral magnons arising from a non-relativistic exchange mechanism, similar to that in ferromagnets but without net magnetization, offering a stray-field-free platform for efficient magnon spin-current manipulation. In this work, we directly observed chiral magnons in the altermagnetic prototype MnTe using polarized inelastic neutron scattering. Furthermore, the magnon chirality was found to be reversibly switched by magnetic-field control, establishing a robust foundation for functional altermagnetic magnonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：directly observed、polarized inelastic neutron scattering。；研究对象：反铁磁体MnTe中的手性磁子（chiral magnons），具体为一种新型磁性材料——交变磁体（altermagnet）中的自旋波量子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交变磁体MnTe中直接观测到手性磁子，并发现其手性可通过外加磁场实现可逆切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交变磁体MnTe中直接观测到手性磁子，并发现其手性可通过外加磁场实现可逆切换。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观测到交变磁体中的手性磁子，并证实其手性可由磁场控制切换，为无杂散场的磁子自旋流操控提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 极化非弹性中子散射（polarized inelastic neutron scattering）。

papers.title: Switchable Surface Linear Photogalvanic Effect in the Magnetic Weyl Semimetal Co3Sn2S2
papers.abstract: We investigate the linear photogalvanic effect (LPGE) on the surface of the magnetic Weyl semimetal Co3Sn2S2 using a Green's-function and diagrammatic formalism. While the LPGE vanishes in the centrosymmetric bulk, it is symmetry-allowed on the surface where inversion symmetry is broken. We show that unitary crystal symmetries on the surface produce characteristic sign reversals of the total photocurrent at certain polarization angles upon flipping the magnetization. We further find that the intrinsic contribution to the LPGE is strongly constrained by an antiunitary mirror symmetry, which forces several nonlinear response tensor elements to vanish. In contrast, the extrinsic contribution is not subject to these constraints and displays a large magnitude which, we argue, is due to the enhanced density of states associated with Fermi-arc surface states. The current exhibits an approximately linear temperature dependence and a low-frequency power-law scaling, |jy| proportional to omega^-2.2, with weak temperature dependence of the scaling exponent. Our results identify Co3Sn2S2 as a promising platform for experimentally accessing symmetry-controlled nonlinear transport in realistic systems and for applications in magnetically controlled optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：Green's-function and diagrammatic formalism（格林函数与费曼图形式理论）、investigate（理论研究）、intrinsic/extrinsic contribution（本征/非本征贡献分析）。；研究对象：磁性Weyl半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂的表面线性光生伏特效应（LPGE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称的体相中LPGE为零，但在表面因反演对称性破缺而允许存在；表面反幺正镜面对称性强烈约束本征贡献（使多个非线性响应张量元为零），而非本征贡献不受此约束且幅度较大，该大贡献源于费米弧表面态增强的态密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称的体相中LPGE为零，但在表面因反演对称性破缺而允许存在；表面反幺正镜面对称性强烈约束本征贡献（使多个非线性响应张量元为零），而非本征贡献不受此约束且幅度较大，该大贡献源于费米弧表面态增强的态密度。；创新点：首次在磁性Weyl半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂表面理论预言了可通过磁化翻转实现符号反转的可开关线性光生伏特效应，并揭示了反幺正镜面对称性对本征/非本征贡献的不同约束机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数与费曼图形式理论，系统计算了表面LPGE的响应张量，分析了本征（intrinsic）与非本征（extrinsic）贡献，并研究了光电流随温度（近似线性）和频率（低频幂律标度|j_y| ∝ ω^{-2.2}）的依赖关系。

papers.title: Dual Shapiro steps and fundamental transconductance in dc driven Bloch transistor
papers.abstract: We propose a superconducting circuit based on the Bloch transistor, a quantum device consisting of two small-capacitance Josephson junctions connected in series and having a small island in between. This device is driven by two dc electrical sources controlling Josephson oscillations of frequency $f_J = 2e\overline{V_J}/h$, related to the average voltage $\overline{V_J}$ on the transistor, and Bloch oscillations of frequency $f_B = \overline{I_B}/2e$, related to the average current $\overline{I_B}$ injected into the transistor island. Due to the Bloch transistor properties, these two types of oscillations can mutually phase lock, i.e., $f_J = f_B$. This leads to formation of current steps on the current-voltage curve at $\overline{I}_B = 2ef_J$, which are similar to the dual Shapiro steps appearing at current $\overline{I}=2ef$ under microwave irradiation of frequency $f$. Moreover, transconductance $\overline{I_B}/\overline{V_J}$ takes the fundamental value of $1/R_Q$, where $R_Q = h/4e^2$ is the resistance quantum. The obtained results pave the way to the alternative quantum standard of resistance, based on the superconducting circuit and operating without applying strong magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、based on（基于）、due to（由于）、lead to（导致）、pave the way（铺平道路）。；研究对象：基于Bloch晶体管的超导电路，具体为两个小电容约瑟夫森结串联形成的量子器件，以及其中由直流驱动产生的约瑟夫森振荡与布洛赫振荡的相互锁相现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在直流驱动的Bloch晶体管中，约瑟夫森振荡频率与布洛赫振荡频率可相互锁相，从而在电流-电压曲线上形成类似双Shapiro台阶的电流台阶，且跨导达到基本值1/R_Q（R_Q = h/4e^2），为无需强磁场的替代量子电阻标准提供了新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在直流驱动的Bloch晶体管中，约瑟夫森振荡频率与布洛赫振荡频率可相互锁相，从而在电流-电压曲线上形成类似双Shapiro台阶的电流台阶，且跨导达到基本值1/R_Q（R_Q = h/4e^2），为无需强磁场的替代量子电阻标准提供了新途径。；创新点：提出了一种无需微波辐照、仅通过直流驱动即可实现类似双Shapiro台阶的电流台阶的方案，并发现跨导可达到量子电阻的倒数，为基于超导电路的无磁场量子电阻标准提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与推导。基于Bloch晶体管的量子特性，分析直流电压源和直流电流源分别驱动的约瑟夫森振荡（频率f_J = 2e\overline{V_J}/h）与布洛赫振荡（频率f_B = \overline{I_B}/2e）之间的锁相条件，并推导电流-电压特性及跨导值。

papers.title: Interference of dynamical arrest, thermodynamic instabilities and energy-scale competition in symmetric binary mixtures
papers.abstract: The equilibrium behavior of binary mixtures can be understood through the competition of energy scales, which classifies their corresponding phase diagrams into distinct topological regimes (Types I-IV). However, in many soft-matter mixtures, strong competing interactions and kinetic barriers often promote dynamical arrest, disrupting the formation of equilibrium and metastable states, and thus rendering conventional phase diagrams incomplete. Here we extend the description and classification of binary systems inside regions of thermodynamical instability. Specifically, we discuss how the interplay between two kind of instabilities and kinetic arrest generates a variety of amorphous states driven by different underlying mechanisms. For strong cross-attraction, for example, dynamical arrest suppresses demixing, whereas in competitive regimes, a mixture may display either condensation-driven or demixing-induced arrested states. The crossover between these regimes can be described by a structural order parameter $χ$, providing a unified non-equilibrium description that reconciles theoretical predictions with experimentally observed arrested states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：extend the description and classification、discuss how the interplay、provide a unified non-equilibrium description。；研究对象：对称二元混合物中动力学阻滞、热力学不稳定性与能量尺度竞争之间的相互作用，以及由此产生的非平衡非晶态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强交叉吸引下，动力学阻滞抑制相分离；而在竞争性区域中，混合物可能表现出由凝聚驱动或由相分离诱导的阻滞态。这些不同阻滞态之间的转变可通过结构序参量χ进行统一描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强交叉吸引下，动力学阻滞抑制相分离；而在竞争性区域中，混合物可能表现出由凝聚驱动或由相分离诱导的阻滞态。这些不同阻滞态之间的转变可通过结构序参量χ进行统一描述。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量尺度竞争对二元混合物相图拓扑分类（Type I-IV）的理论框架，进一步扩展至热力学不稳定区域，通过分析两种不稳定性与动力学阻滞的耦合机制，引入结构序参量χ建立非平衡描述。

papers.title: Finite-size scaling of hetero-associative retrieval in continuous-signal-driven Ising spin systems
papers.abstract: Real-world physical signals are continuous and high-dimensional, yet the statistical-mechanics machinery of associative memory operates on discrete Ising spins. We bridge this divide through a multilayer Ising framework that couples a geometry-preserving continuous-to-Ising encoder (PCA whitening composed with SimHash random-hyperplane projection) to Kanter-Sompolinsky pseudo-inverse memory couplings, embedded directly into the local-field equations of a tri-layer hetero-associative system. The pseudo-inverse correction renders the equal-weight mixture state thermodynamically unstable, so that thermal fluctuations break the cross-modal symmetry and select a single global winner. We further establish a dynamical duality: parallel (Little) updates are structurally required to ignite the cross-modal signal avalanche from a single cued layer, whereas sequential (Glauber) sweeps resolve symmetric superpositions. The operational storage capacity obeys the Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky finite-size correction $α_c(N)=α_c(\infty)-c\,N^{-1/2}$, extrapolating to an asymptotic operational limit $α_c(\infty)\approx 0.50$ under macroscopic-basin retrieval. Applied to multi-channel sleep polysomnography (PhysioNet Sleep-EDF), the architecture reconstructs the macroscopic sleep state on parietal EEG and EOG axes from a single noisy frontal-EEG cue, demonstrating cross-modal recall in the presence of quenched biological disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：关键词为“statistical-mechanics machinery”、“local-field equations”、“dynamical duality”、“finite-size correction”，并包含对实际数据的应用验证。；研究对象：论文研究的是连续信号驱动的伊辛自旋系统中的异联想记忆检索问题，具体物理现象为：如何将连续、高维的真实物理信号（如脑电图数据）映射到离散伊辛自旋系统，并实现跨模态（hetero-associative）的信息检索。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，通过伪逆修正的等权重混合态在热力学上是不稳定的，热涨落会打破交叉模态对称性并选出单一全局胜者。其操作存储容量遵循Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky有限尺寸修正，外推至宏观吸引域检索下的渐近极限约为0.50。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，通过伪逆修正的等权重混合态在热力学上是不稳定的，热涨落会打破交叉模态对称性并选出单一全局胜者。其操作存储容量遵循Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky有限尺寸修正，外推至宏观吸引域检索下的渐近极限约为0.50。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于：通过一个几何保持的编码器，在理论上弥合了真实世界连续信号与经典离散伊辛自旋联想记忆模型之间的鸿沟，并建立了一个可处理连续信号驱动的异联想检索的完整统计力学框架。摘要未突出说明与纯离散模型相比的具体性能提升细节。
papers.method_zh: 论文构建了一个多层伊辛框架，具体包括：

papers.title: Circularity in Perovskite-Based Tandem Photovoltaics for Terawatt-Scale Deployment
papers.abstract: As photovoltaics (PVs) scale from one to multiple terawatts over the next decade, ensuring sustainable deployment is urgently required. Crystalline silicon (c-Si) PVs, the current industry standard, will generate an estimated 160 million tonnes of waste by 2050, and there remains complex technoeconomic challenges associated with their recycling. Metal-halide perovskite (MHP)-based tandem PVs not only promise higher power conversion efficiencies than single-junction c-Si devices, but also offer intrinsic advantages for circularity, including simpler device architectures, low-temperature processing, and more accessible materials recovery routes. At this pivotal juncture when perovskite PVs begin to enter the market, this review examines the critical circularity challenges that must be addressed: substitution of scarce raw materials, scalable recycling protocols, cost-effective stack delamination, safe lead sequestration, and policy frameworks to encourage circularity across the device lifecycle with effective incentives. By integrating the materials, technoeconomic and policy dimensions that go beyond conventional lifecycle assessments, we outline actionable strategies to co-optimize device performance and sustainability. This review aims to guide researchers, policymakers, and industry stakeholders in steering perovskite-based tandem PVs towards a circular and responsible commercialization pathway within the global clean-energy transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“this review examines”“this review aims to guide”等表述，且未提及具体实验、计算或理论模型。；研究对象：基于金属卤化物钙钛矿（MHP）的串联光伏器件，重点关注其在大规模（太瓦级）部署场景下的循环性（circularity）问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钙钛矿基串联光伏在循环性方面具有内在优势（如更简单的器件结构、低温加工、更易回收材料），但实现可持续商业化仍需解决稀缺原材料替代、可扩展回收工艺、低成本叠层分离、铅安全封存及政策激励等关键挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钙钛矿基串联光伏在循环性方面具有内在优势（如更简单的器件结构、低温加工、更易回收材料），但实现可持续商业化仍需解决稀缺原材料替代、可扩展回收工艺、低成本叠层分离、铅安全封存及政策激励等关键挑战。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统综述的具体差异，但指出其创新在于将材料、技术经济与政策维度进行整合，并针对太瓦级部署场景提出超越常规LCA的循环性挑战分析。
papers.method_zh: 该综述整合了材料科学、技术经济学和政策分析三个维度，超越了传统生命周期评估（LCA）框架，提出协同优化器件性能与可持续性的行动策略。

papers.title: Engineering topological flat bands in $Γ$-valley moiré systems with Ising-type SOC: twisted 1T-ZrS$_2$ and 1T-SnSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Twisted moiré superlattices hosting topological flat bands provide a platform to explore the interplay between topology and correlations. Here we investigate topological band structures in $Γ$-valley moiré systems based on 1T-ZrS$_2$ and 1T-SnSe$_2$. Using large-scale ab initio calculations and continuum modelling, we demonstrate that both materials exhibit an approximate spin-$U(1)$ symmetry and host isolated topological moiré valence bands, including quantum spin Hall and high spin Chern states. By constructing a hierarchy of $Γ$-valley moiré continuum models, we show that isolated moiré bands carry a trivial $C_3$ symmetry indicator when the low-energy physics is described by a single effective orbital and a single layer-hybridized branch, either bonding or antibonding. Topological bands therefore arise from inter-branch and/or inter-orbital coupling. Moreover, we determine interaction-driven phase diagrams using Hartree--Fock and exact diagonalization, finding various phases tunable by twist angle, interaction strength, and displacement field. We identify specific conditions under which fractional Chern insulators are favored. Together with previous work showing that the moiré conduction bands of 1T-ZrS$_2$ and 1T-SnSe$_2$ realize $M$-valley twisting and host quasi-one-dimensional physics, our results establish these systems as ideal platforms for strongly correlated moiré physics and provide a systematic framework for understanding topological band structures in $Γ$-valley moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：ab initio calculations、continuum modelling、Hartree--Fock、exact diagonalization。；研究对象：基于1T-ZrS₂和1T-SnSe₂的Γ谷莫尔超晶格体系，具体研究其拓扑平带工程及强关联物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Γ谷莫尔体系中，孤立拓扑莫尔价带（包括量子自旋霍尔态和高自旋陈数态）源于带间和/或轨道间耦合，而非单有效轨道与单层杂化分支的C₃对称性指标；通过调控转角、相互作用强度和位移场，可得到包括分数量子陈绝缘体在内的多种可调相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Γ谷莫尔体系中，孤立拓扑莫尔价带（包括量子自旋霍尔态和高自旋陈数态）源于带间和/或轨道间耦合，而非单有效轨道与单层杂化分支的C₃对称性指标；通过调控转角、相互作用强度和位移场，可得到包括分数量子陈绝缘体在内的多种可调相。；创新点：建立了Γ谷莫尔材料的层级连续模型，揭示了拓扑能带形成的微观机制（带间/轨道间耦合），并系统给出了分数量子陈绝缘体出现的具体条件，将Γ谷莫尔体系确立为强关联莫尔物理的理想平台。
papers.method_zh: 大规模第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）、连续介质模型（continuum modelling）、Hartree-Fock方法、精确对角化（exact diagonalization）。

papers.title: Generalized Model Fractional Quantum Hall States on Lattices
papers.abstract: Model wave functions are essential for studying fractional quantum Hall phases, yet lattice model states have so far been limited to bosonic systems with on-site interactions. In this work, by combining analytical and numerical methods, we systematically construct lattice model states for the Laughlin, Moore--Read, and general $\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read--Rezayi series. Our lattice-specific states are characterized by their idealized energy and entanglement features and are distinguished from their continuum counterparts by a modified clustering behavior. Our theory advances the understanding of the stability of topologically ordered phases and illustrates the organizing principles of the conformal Hilbert space on lattices. Practically, this work paves the way for further studying lattice-specific excitations and offers a constructive route for engineering topological orders within density interactions, with potential immediate implications for cold-atom and synthetic flat-band platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合解析与数值方法，关键词：analytical and numerical methods、model wave functions、conformal Hilbert space）；研究对象：晶格上的分数量子霍尔态，具体包括Laughlin态、Moore-Read态以及一般$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统构建了晶格上的Laughlin、Moore-Read及$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列模型态，这些态具有理想化的能量和纠缠特征，并通过修正的聚集行为与连续体对应态相区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统构建了晶格上的Laughlin、Moore-Read及$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列模型态，这些态具有理想化的能量和纠缠特征，并通过修正的聚集行为与连续体对应态相区分。；创新点：此前晶格模型态仅限于具有在位相互作用的玻色子系统，本工作首次将晶格模型态推广到Laughlin、Moore-Read及一般$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列，并揭示了晶格特有的聚集行为修正。
papers.method_zh: 结合解析方法（共形场论、模型波函数构造）与数值方法（可能包括精确对角化或张量网络，摘要未明确说明具体数值技术）。

papers.title: Corner Charge Fluctuations in Higher Dimensions
papers.abstract: Measuring charge fluctuations within a subregion provides a powerful probe of quantum many-body systems. In two spatial dimensions, the shape dependence of the dimensionless corner contribution encodes universal data of quantum critical points and reveals observables of quantum geometry in various quantum phases. Here, we systematically extend this framework to higher dimensions. In three dimensions, we derive the universal angle dependence associated with trihedral corners of a generic parallelepiped and benchmark the predictions against Monte Carlo simulations of lattice models at the O(3) quantum critical point. We further identify a wedge-corner contribution that directly probes the quantum metric, supported by numerical results for a lattice Weyl semimetal model. More generally, we obtain angle functions for polyhedral corners of arbitrary parallelotopes in general dimensions and clarify the scaling of the corner contribution across phases of matter. While insulators and conformal critical points exhibit similar behavior across dimensions, metals display a characteristic even-odd dimensional effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算验证）。判断依据：推导通用角度依赖关系、标度分析等理论框架，并结合蒙特卡洛模拟和晶格模型数值结果进行验证。；研究对象：高维量子多体系统中子区域电荷涨落的角部贡献（corner contribution），特别是三维空间中的三面角（trihedral corner）和楔形角（wedge-corner）的普适行为，以及一般维度下平行多面体（parallelotope）角部的电荷涨落标度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维空间中，三面角贡献具有普适的角度依赖关系，并通过O(3)量子临界点的蒙特卡洛模拟验证；楔形角贡献可直接探测量子度量（quantum metric），并在外尔半金属模型中数值证实。此外，绝缘体和共形临界点在各个维度行为相似，而金属表现出特征性的奇偶维度效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维空间中，三面角贡献具有普适的角度依赖关系，并通过O(3)量子临界点的蒙特卡洛模拟验证；楔形角贡献可直接探测量子度量（quantum metric），并在外尔半金属模型中数值证实。此外，绝缘体和共形临界点在各个维度行为相似，而金属表现出特征性的奇偶维度效应。；创新点：将二维空间中的角部电荷涨落框架系统推广至三维及更高维度，首次推导出三维三面角贡献的普适角度函数，并识别出可直接探测量子度量的楔形角贡献。摘要未突出说明与已有二维工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用量子多体系统中子区域电荷涨落的形状依赖框架，推广至一般维度平行多面体角部；数值验证：对O(3)量子临界点晶格模型进行蒙特卡洛模拟，以及对晶格外尔半金属模型进行数值计算。

papers.title: Fermi Surface Geometry from Charge Fluctuations in Three-Dimensional Metals
papers.abstract: For three-dimensional non-interacting multi-band metals, we show that important information about the shape and the quantum geometry of Fermi surfaces is encoded in the subleading logarithmic term of bipartite charge fluctuations. This logarithmic term is related to the dimensionless $|\mathbf{q}|^3$-coefficient of the structure factor in momentum space, and both quantities can be expressed as Fermi surface integrals of the Fermi surface curvature tensor and the quantum metric tensor. When the real-space partition surface is a quadric (i.e., sphere or ellipsoid), the logarithmic coefficient satisfies a topological bound depending only on the Euler characteristic and the Chern number of the Fermi surface, illustrating a non-trivial interplay between topology and quantum topology in multi-band metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-interacting multi-band metals、Fermi surface integrals、topological bound。；研究对象：三维非相互作用多带金属中费米面的几何与拓扑性质，具体通过电荷涨落（bipartite charge fluctuations）来研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维多带金属中，二分电荷涨落的次主导对数项编码了费米面的形状与量子几何信息；该对数系数可表达为费米面曲率张量与量子度规张量的费米面积分，且在实空间分割面为二次曲面（球面或椭球面）时满足一个仅依赖于费米面欧拉示性数与陈数的拓扑下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维多带金属中，二分电荷涨落的次主导对数项编码了费米面的形状与量子几何信息；该对数系数可表达为费米面曲率张量与量子度规张量的费米面积分，且在实空间分割面为二次曲面（球面或椭球面）时满足一个仅依赖于费米面欧拉示性数与陈数的拓扑下界。；创新点：揭示了多带金属中费米面的拓扑（欧拉示性数）与量子拓扑（陈数）在电荷涨落对数系数中的非平凡相互作用，并建立了该系数的拓扑下界。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。通过分析动量空间结构因子的无量纲 \(|\mathbf{q}|^3\) 系数，将其与实空间电荷涨落的对数项关联，并利用费米面曲率张量与量子度规张量进行积分表达。

papers.title: Quantum Monte Carlo fermion spectroscopy of a non-compact CP$^1$ model
papers.abstract: We study a model describing electrons coupled to anti-ferromagnetic spin fluctuations, and consider the situation where hedgehog defects in the order parameter field are suppressed. Without hedgehogs, the bosonic sector of the theory can be taken to realize the physics of the non-compact CP$^1$ theory with a deconfined U$(1)$ gauge field. After strongly coupling the boson to fermion spins, we simulate the single-particle spectral properties of a hedgehog-suppressed electron-boson model defined on a bilayer square lattice with Quantum Monte Carlo, and interpret the results in terms of an effective theory with fractionalized spinon and chargon excitations. As one of our main results we show that the electron gap on top of the half-filled insulator with gapless photon fluctuations closely resembles the mean-field dispersion of an electron in an anti-ferromagnetic spin background, even though the system fully preserves both the translation and spin rotation symmetry. Finally, we discuss potential implications of our results for the high-temperature superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Quantum Monte Carlo（量子蒙特卡洛模拟）、effective theory（有效理论）、mean-field dispersion（平均场色散）。；研究对象：电子与反铁磁自旋涨落耦合的模型，具体为在双层正方晶格上定义的、抑制了序参量场中“hedgehog”（刺猬）缺陷的电子-玻色子模型，其玻色子部分实现非紧致CP¹理论（含退禁闭U(1)规范场）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半填充绝缘体中，即使系统完全保持平移和自旋旋转对称性，存在无能隙光子涨落时，电子能隙的行为与电子在反铁磁自旋背景中的平均场色散高度相似。该结果对高温超导体具有潜在启示意义。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半填充绝缘体中，即使系统完全保持平移和自旋旋转对称性，存在无能隙光子涨落时，电子能隙的行为与电子在反铁磁自旋背景中的平均场色散高度相似。该结果对高温超导体具有潜在启示意义。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用量子蒙特卡洛（Quantum Monte Carlo）方法模拟单粒子谱性质，并结合有效理论（含分数化自旋子与电荷子激发）进行解释。

papers.title: Rongzai agent: A Large Language Model-Based Autonomous Assistant for Rietveld Refinement of Neutron Diffraction Data
papers.abstract: Neutron diffraction (ND) is an indispensable technique for determining atomic positions (especially light elements) and thus serves as a critical probe for revealing microscopic structures in materials science. However, traditional Rietveld refinement of ND data relies heavily on manual operation of specialized software, which is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and highly dependent on user expertise, severely hindering automated analysis. The automation of Rietveld refinement has long been a long-standing and challenging problem in crystallography. To address this challenge, this paper presents the Dr.Sai-Rongzai agent, an autonomous refinement assistant based on a large language model (LLM), a specialist knowledge base, and the GSAS-II refinement engine, achieving for the first time an intelligent refinement that integrates knowledge-driven decision-making. The agent accomplishes a fully automated workflow from natural language task parsing to autonomous decision-making, execution of refinement strategies, and report generation. Evaluation on five representative samples shows that the Rongzai agent achieves lower Rwp values than human specialists on three samples (2.88% vs. 4.42%, 5.06% vs. 5.40%, 7.60% vs. 9.00%), while on the other two samples its results are very close to those of the specialists. The agent is currently deployed at the China Spallation Neutron Source (CSNS) and is open for external user registration, providing an intelligent and user-friendly analytical tool for materials research. This work fully leverages the cutting-edge advantages of LLM, offers a new path to solve the long-standing problem of automated refinement, takes a key step toward intelligent and fully automated crystallographic analysis, and holds great potential to accelerate AI for Science discoveries in neutron-based materials characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（关键词：大语言模型、知识库、GSAS-II精修引擎、自动化工作流，属于计算与人工智能方法驱动的工具开发，结合实验数据分析）；研究对象：中子衍射数据的Rietveld精修自动化问题，具体应用于材料科学中原子位置（尤其是轻元素）的微观结构解析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的Rongzai智能体首次实现了知识驱动决策的中子衍射Rietveld精修全自动化，在五个代表性样品中，三个样品的Rwp值低于人类专家（如2.88% vs 4.42%），其余两个样品结果与专家非常接近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于大语言模型的Rongzai智能体首次实现了知识驱动决策的中子衍射Rietveld精修全自动化，在五个代表性样品中，三个样品的Rwp值低于人类专家（如2.88% vs 4.42%），其余两个样品结果与专家非常接近。；创新点：首次将大语言模型与专业晶体学精修软件（GSAS-II）及知识库集成，实现端到端的智能自动化Rietveld精修，替代传统高度依赖人工操作和专家经验的繁琐流程。
papers.method_zh: 采用大语言模型（LLM）作为核心推理引擎，结合专家知识库与GSAS-II精修引擎，构建从自然语言任务解析、自主决策、精修策略执行到报告生成的完整自动化流程。

papers.title: Controlled Zeno-Induced Localization of Free Fermions in a Quasiperiodic Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate measurement-induced localization in a continuously monitored one-dimensional Aubry--André--Harper model, focusing on the quantum Zeno regime in which the measurements dominate coherent dynamics. The presence of a quasiperiodic potential renders the problem analytically tractable and enables a controlled study of the interplay between monitoring and disorder. We develop an analytical description based on an instantaneous Schrödinger equation with a measurement-induced effective potential constructed self-consistently from individual quantum trajectories, without relying on postselection. In the quantum Zeno regime, an emergent dominant energy scale reduces the problem to a transfer-matrix formulation of an effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, which allows direct computation of the Lyapunov exponent. Complementarily, we extract the localization length numerically from long-time steady-state quantum state diffusion trajectories by reconstructing the intrinsic localized single-particle wave functions and analyzing their spatial decay. These numerical results show quantitative agreement with the effective theory predictions, with controlled corrections of order $J^2/[λ^2+(γ/2)^2]$ (where $J$ is the hopping amplitude, $γ$ the measurement strength, and $λ$ the quasiperiodic potential). Our results underscore the connection between the effective non-Hermitian description and the stochastic monitored dynamics, showing the interplay between Zeno-like localization, coherent hopping, and quasiperiodic-disorder-induced localization, while also laying the groundwork for understanding and exploiting measurement-induced localization as a tool for quantum control and state preparation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical description、transfer-matrix formulation、numerical simulations、quantum trajectories）；研究对象：连续监测下的一维准周期Aubry–André–Harper模型中的测量诱导局域化现象，特别是量子Zeno regime下的自由费米子局域化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子Zeno regime下，测量主导相干动力学，通过自洽构建的测量诱导有效势，可将问题简化为非厄米哈密顿量的转移矩阵形式，直接计算Lyapunov指数；数值提取的局域长度与有效理论预测定量一致，修正项为$J^2/[\lambda^2+(\gamma/2)^2]$量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子Zeno regime下，测量主导相干动力学，通过自洽构建的测量诱导有效势，可将问题简化为非厄米哈密顿量的转移矩阵形式，直接计算Lyapunov指数；数值提取的局域长度与有效理论预测定量一致，修正项为$J^2/[\lambda^2+(\gamma/2)^2]$量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于瞬时薛定谔方程的分析描述，引入自洽的测量诱导有效势（无需后选择）；采用转移矩阵方法处理有效非厄米哈密顿量；通过长时间稳态量子态扩散轨迹数值重构局域单粒子波函数，提取局域长度。

papers.title: Mixed-State Long-Range Entanglement from Dimensional Constraints
papers.abstract: We present a new mechanism for long-range entanglement (LRE) in strongly symmetric many-body mixed states that does not rely on symmetry anomalies or long-range correlations. Our primary example is the maximally mixed state in the translation-invariant subspace on a one-dimensional ring. This state is LRE because translationally symmetric short-range entangled states span a subspace whose dimension grows only polynomially with system size, whereas the full translation-invariant subspace grows exponentially. We further discuss certain unconventional properties of this state, including logarithmically growing conditional mutual information, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry-breaking, and Rényi-index-dependent operator-space entanglement. We also construct a geometrically non-local Lindbladian to stabilize this state as the steady state. Our results identify dimensional mismatch as a novel route to LRE that is intrinsic to many-body mixed states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提出新机制、构造模型、理论分析。；研究对象：强对称多体混合态中的长程纠缠（LRE），具体以一维环上平移不变子空间中的最大混合态为主要例子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种不依赖对称性反常或长程关联的混合态长程纠缠新机制，其根源在于平移对称短程纠缠态子空间的维度仅多项式增长，而完整平移不变子空间呈指数增长，导致维度失配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种不依赖对称性反常或长程关联的混合态长程纠缠新机制，其根源在于平移对称短程纠缠态子空间的维度仅多项式增长，而完整平移不变子空间呈指数增长，导致维度失配。；创新点：首次提出“维度失配”（dimensional mismatch）作为多体混合态中长程纠缠的内在来源，区别于以往依赖对称性反常或长程关联的机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与数学分析：通过分析子空间维度的标度行为、计算条件互信息、讨论强-弱自发对称性破缺以及Rényi指数依赖的算符空间纠缠，并构造了几何非局域的Lindblad主方程来稳定该稳态。

papers.title: Translation symmetry-enforced long-range entanglement in mixed states
papers.abstract: We show by a counting argument that even though translation symmetry admits symmetric short-range entangled (SRE) eigenstates, there are not enough such SRE eigenstates to span the zero momentum sector. This means that the fixed point strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking state of translation symmetry is long-range entangled: it cannot be written as a mixture of SRE states. This is a subtle form of long-range entanglement in mixed states that cannot be detected by long-range connected correlation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“counting argument”“fixed point”“long-range entanglement”等理论概念，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：混合态中平移对称性所强制的长程纠缠现象，具体关注平移对称性下的强-弱自发对称性破缺（strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking）的固定点态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使平移对称性允许存在对称的短程纠缠（SRE）本征态，这些SRE本征态的数量不足以张满零动量子空间。因此，平移对称性的强-弱自发对称性破缺固定点态是长程纠缠的，无法写成SRE态的混合，且这种长程纠缠无法通过长程连通关联函数检测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使平移对称性允许存在对称的短程纠缠（SRE）本征态，这些SRE本征态的数量不足以张满零动量子空间。因此，平移对称性的强-弱自发对称性破缺固定点态是长程纠缠的，无法写成SRE态的混合，且这种长程纠缠无法通过长程连通关联函数检测。；创新点：揭示了一种混合态中微妙的、无法被传统长程连通关联函数探测的长程纠缠形式，并指出平移对称性本身即可强制这种纠缠存在，即使系统允许SRE本征态。
papers.method_zh: 采用计数论证（counting argument）进行理论分析，通过态空间维度的计数来证明SRE本征态无法覆盖零动量子空间，从而推断混合态中长程纠缠的存在性。

papers.title: Universal quantum resource distillation via composite generalised quantum Stein's lemma
papers.abstract: The performance of quantum resource manipulation protocols, including key examples such as distillation of quantum entanglement, is measured in terms of the rate at which desired target states can be produced from a given noisy state. However, to achieve optimal rates, known protocols require precise tailoring to the quantum state in question, demanding a perfect knowledge of the input and allowing no errors in its preparation. Here we show that distillation of quantum resources in the framework of resource non-generating operations can be performed universally: optimal rates of distillation can be achieved with no knowledge of the input state whatsoever, certifying the robustness of quantum resource distillation. The findings apply in particular to the purification of quantum entanglement under non-entangling maps, where the optimal rates are governed by the regularised relative entropy of entanglement. Our result relies on an extension of the generalised quantum Stein's lemma in quantum hypothesis testing to a composite setting where the null hypothesis is no longer a fixed quantum state, but is rather composed of i.i.d. copies of an unknown state. The solution of this asymptotic problem is made possible through new developments in one-shot quantum information and a refinement of the blurring technique from [Lami, arXiv:2408.06410].
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论量子资源蒸馏的数学框架、量子假设检验引理扩展、以及渐近信息论方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子资源蒸馏协议，特别是纠缠蒸馏，在资源非生成操作（如非纠缠映射）下的通用性。具体体系为未知量子态的i.i.d.副本构成的复合零假设。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在资源非生成操作框架下，量子资源蒸馏可以通用地实现：无需任何输入态知识即可达到最优蒸馏速率，证明了量子资源蒸馏的鲁棒性。该结果尤其适用于非纠缠映射下的纠缠纯化，其最优速率由正则化相对纠缠熵决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在资源非生成操作框架下，量子资源蒸馏可以通用地实现：无需任何输入态知识即可达到最优蒸馏速率，证明了量子资源蒸馏的鲁棒性。该结果尤其适用于非纠缠映射下的纠缠纯化，其最优速率由正则化相对纠缠熵决定。；创新点：将广义量子Stein引理从固定零假设推广到复合零假设（未知态i.i.d.副本），从而实现了无需输入态知识的通用最优蒸馏协议。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于广义量子Stein引理在复合假设检验中的扩展，其中零假设不再是固定量子态，而是未知态的i.i.d.副本。通过单次量子信息理论的新进展，以及来自[Lami, arXiv:2408.06410]的模糊化技术的改进，解决了该渐近问题。

papers.title: Extensive long-range magic in non-Abelian topological orders
papers.abstract: We show that the low-energy states of non-Abelian topological orders possess extensive magic which is long-ranged, and cannot be eliminated by a constant-depth local unitary circuit. This refines conventional notions of complexity beyond the linear circuit depth which is required to prepare any topological phase, and provides a new resource-theoretic characterization of topological orders. A central technical result is a no-go theorem establishing that stabilizer states--even up to constant-depth local unitarie--cannot approximate low-energy states of non-Abelian string-net models which satisfy the entanglement bootstrap axioms. Moreover, we show that stabilizer-realizable Abelian string-net phases have mutual braiding phases quantized by the on-site qudit dimension, and that any violation of this condition necessarily implies extensive long-range magic. Extending to higher spatial dimensions, we argue that any state obeying an entanglement area law and hosting excitations with nontrivial fusion spaces must exhibit extensive long-range magic. This applies, in particular, to ground-states and low-energy states of higher-dimensional quantum double models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, no-go theorem, argue, theoretical characterization。；研究对象：非阿贝尔拓扑序的低能态，特别是满足纠缠自举公理的弦网模型，以及高维量子双模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非阿贝尔拓扑序的低能态具有无法通过常数深度局域幺正电路消除的、长程的“魔法”（magic），这为拓扑序提供了新的资源理论刻画。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非阿贝尔拓扑序的低能态具有无法通过常数深度局域幺正电路消除的、长程的“魔法”（magic），这为拓扑序提供了新的资源理论刻画。；创新点：将“魔法”（magic）这一量子计算资源理论概念引入拓扑序的刻画，并证明非阿贝尔拓扑序中的魔法是长程且不可通过常数深度电路消除的，从而超越了传统上仅用线性电路深度来区分拓扑相位的复杂性概念。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与论证。具体包括：建立了一个“不可行定理”（no-go theorem），证明稳定子态（即使经过常数深度局域幺正操作）无法近似满足纠缠自举公理的非阿贝尔弦网模型的低能态；通过分析阿贝尔弦网相的编织相位与局域qudit维度的量子化关系，论证了违反该条件必然导致长程魔法；并推广到高维，论证任何满足纠缠面积律且具有非平凡融合空间激发态的系统必然具有长程魔法。

papers.title: Mid-infrared Assisted THz Phonon Amplification in a 2D Semiconductor for Room Temperature Detection
papers.abstract: Efficient and selective excitation of lattice vibrations is central to controlling energy flow at the nanoscale, yet remains challenging under conventional optical excitation. Here, we introduce a mid-infrared-assisted phonon amplification approach, termed MIRAPA, that enables efficient energy injection directly into vibrational bonds. Using surface-enhanced resonant Raman scattering in few-layer $\mathrm{MoS_2}$, we exploit strong exciton--phonon coupling to monitor phonon populations. When mid-infrared (MIR) light is introduced, it couples directly to out-of-plane lattice vibrations, leading to room-temperature phonon amplification exceeding $80\%$. Crucially, MIRAPA bypasses electronic excitation pathways, allowing the MIR power density to be nearly $300\times$ lower than that required for visible excitation to achieve comparable enhancement.
