The resulting phonon modulation is robust, persisting over more than $2800$ on/off cycles and exceeding $15$ hours of continuous-wave laser illumination without degradation. Quantitative analysis yields an effective noise-equivalent power of approximately $0.3\,\mathrm{nW}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ for MIR detection, highlighting the sensitivity of the approach. By combining vibrational selectivity, low-power operation, and long-term stability, MIRAPA provides a robust platform for probing and amplifying phonons in two-dimensional semiconductors. These results open new opportunities for nanoscale vibrational sensing, mid-infrared detection, and phonon-based coherent devices, including routes toward phonon lasing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验方法（表面增强共振拉曼散射）、实验条件（室温、连续波激光照明）以及定量测量结果（噪声等效功率、循环次数等）。；研究对象：二维半导体材料少层MoS₂中的晶格振动（声子），具体为面外晶格振动模式，以及通过中红外光辅助实现的声子放大现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种中红外辅助的声子放大方法（MIRAPA），可在室温下实现超过80%的声子放大，且所需中红外功率密度比可见光激发低近300倍，同时具备超过2800次开关循环和15小时以上的长期稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种中红外辅助的声子放大方法（MIRAPA），可在室温下实现超过80%的声子放大，且所需中红外功率密度比可见光激发低近300倍，同时具备超过2800次开关循环和15小时以上的长期稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统方法的系统性对比，但核心创新在于：1）绕过电子激发路径，直接通过中红外光耦合晶格振动实现高效声子放大；2）在极低功率密度下（比可见光低约300倍）实现室温运行；3）兼具振动选择性、低功耗和长期稳定性，为声子激光等相干器件提供新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用表面增强共振拉曼散射技术，利用激子-声子强耦合监测声子布居数；引入中红外光直接耦合面外晶格振动，实现声子放大。定量分析中使用了噪声等效功率（约0.3 nW/√Hz）评估检测灵敏度。

papers.title: Fast contracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor products for equivariant graph neural networks
papers.abstract: We present an $\mathcal{O}(L^3)$ algorithm for evaluating contracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor products in $\mathrm{O}(3)$-equivariant machine learning potentials at fixed Canonical Polyadic (CP) rank. Mapping the angular integral to a structured Gauss--Legendre and Fourier tensor-product grid decouples the radial channel contractions from the angular transforms. The antisymmetric parity-odd Clebsch--Gordan channels, unreachable by the symmetric pointwise product on a scalar $S^2$ grid, are recovered through the surface-curl pairing $\hat r \cdot [\nabla_{S^2} A \times \nabla_{S^2} B]$, the spherical Poisson bracket, which supplies the $L=1$ angular momentum on the grid while preserving rotational equivariance. The construction extends to parity-aware equivariant message passing in atomic-cluster-expansion-style architectures and is verified by direct numerical quadrature. The full uncontracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor product remains subject to the $\mathcal{O}(L^4)$ output-size lower bound. A benchmark shows wall-clock scaling empirically as $L^2$ across the practical $l_{\max}$ range. For the on-site contraction this is pre-asymptotic, giving way to $L^3$ at large $l_{\max}$. For message passing it is structural and the runtime is memory-bandwidth bound on $L^2$-sized grid tensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：algorithm、machine learning potentials、numerical quadrature、benchmark。；研究对象：O(3)等变图神经网络中收缩的Clebsch–Gordan张量积的高效计算方法，具体应用于机器学习原子间势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种O(L³)算法用于评估固定Canonical Polyadic (CP) 秩下的收缩Clebsch–Gordan张量积，并通过球面泊松括号在标量S²网格上恢复反对称奇宇称通道，同时保持旋转等变性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种O(L³)算法用于评估固定Canonical Polyadic (CP) 秩下的收缩Clebsch–Gordan张量积，并通过球面泊松括号在标量S²网格上恢复反对称奇宇称通道，同时保持旋转等变性。；创新点：通过球面泊松括号在标量网格上恢复反对称奇宇称Clebsch–Gordan通道，突破了对称点乘无法达到的通道限制；实现了O(L³)的收缩算法，并在实际l_max范围内观察到墙钟时间按L²标度。
papers.method_zh: 将角度积分映射到结构化Gauss–Legendre和Fourier张量积网格，解耦径向通道收缩与角度变换；利用表面旋量配对（球面泊松括号）在网格上提供L=1角动量；通过直接数值求积验证，并在原子团簇展开风格架构中实现宇称感知的等变消息传递。

papers.title: Multifunctional Barophotonic Control of Resonators and Metasurfaces
papers.abstract: Actively tunable nanophotonic platforms that control light-matter interactions enable reconfigurable optical systems and programmable photonic integrated circuits. Hydrostatic pressure provides a noninvasive and material-agnostic mechanism for modulating the refractive index and resonance conditions without introducing free carriers or structural damage. Here, we demonstrate multiple pressure-dependent functionalities in silicon nitride nanostructures, including resonance tuning, refractive index modulation, and polarization state conversion. Applying a pressure of up to 5 GPa, we observe a Fabry-Pérot resonance shift of up to 30 nm and a relative refractive index decrease of up to 4%. Based on the results, we design and examine, to the best of our knowledge, the first extreme-pressure-tunable, polarization-converting metasurface, which tunes the ellipticity and orientation angle of the output light. These findings establish pressure-controllable silicon nitride as a viable platform for reconfigurable photonics and extreme-environment nanophotonic systems, including deep-ocean exploration, planetary interiors, and space applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、observe、design and examine）；研究对象：氮化硅纳米结构中的谐振器与超表面，具体涉及法布里-珀罗谐振、折射率调制和偏振态转换。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加高达5 GPa的静水压力，实现了氮化硅纳米结构中法布里-珀罗谐振峰30 nm的移动和相对折射率4%的降低，并首次设计了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加高达5 GPa的静水压力，实现了氮化硅纳米结构中法布里-珀罗谐振峰30 nm的移动和相对折射率4%的降低，并首次设计了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面。；创新点：首次展示了基于极端压力调控的偏振转换超表面，并建立了压力可控氮化硅作为可重构光子学和极端环境（如深海、行星内部、太空）纳米光子学平台的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用静水压力调控（最高5 GPa），结合光学测量观察谐振位移和折射率变化；理论上设计并模拟了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面。

papers.title: Hybrid Nanophotonic Scintillators for Enhanced X-ray Absorption, Emission, and Time Resolution
papers.abstract: Scintillators convert ionizing radiation into visible photons, enabling applications from cosmic ray detection to medical imaging. Two independent strategies for improving scintillator performance via nanoscale patterning have recently been demonstrated: engineering material properties to enhance absorption of ionizing radiation and integrating nanophotonic structures to enhance the spontaneous emission rate ("nanophotonic scintillators"). Here, we propose a nanophotonic scintillator that simultaneously enhances both the initial energy conversion and the spontaneous emission rate, by periodically stacking a fast-emitting scintillator and a visible-light-transparent material with strong X-ray attenuation ("stopping layer") to form a one-dimensional (1D) photonic crystal (PhC) scintillator. Photoelectric absorption in the stopping layer increases the number of photoelectrons that deposit energy in neighboring scintillator layers and contribute to scintillation. At the same time, the spontaneous emission rate is enhanced by the nanophotonic structuring itself. We design a 1D PhC comprising an organic scintillator and indium tin oxide (ITO) as the stopping layer and numerically simulate the enhancement in scintillation yield and decay rate. The total detected light output is enhanced by up to a factor of 700 compared to a bulk organic scintillator of equal thickness. We further investigate a 1D PhC structure integrating inorganic and organic scintillators for time-of-flight positron emission tomography (TOF-PET): replacing the non-scintillating stopping layer with an inorganic scintillator further increases the light yield, and the coincidence time resolution (CTR) is enhanced up to 3.5 times compared to a bulk inorganic scintillator of equal thickness. Our work presents a unified approach to improve key scintillation parameters within a single nanophotonic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically simulate、design、propose）；研究对象：一种一维光子晶体（1D PhC）闪烁体，由快速发射闪烁体与强X射线衰减材料（如ITO或无机闪烁体）周期性堆叠而成，用于增强X射线吸收、发射及时间分辨率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时增强初始能量转换（利用“停止层”增加光电吸收）和自发辐射速率（利用纳米光子结构），所设计的混合纳米光子闪烁体可将总探测光输出提升至同等厚度体闪烁体的700倍，并将符合时间分辨率（CTR）提升至3.5倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时增强初始能量转换（利用“停止层”增加光电吸收）和自发辐射速率（利用纳米光子结构），所设计的混合纳米光子闪烁体可将总探测光输出提升至同等厚度体闪烁体的700倍，并将符合时间分辨率（CTR）提升至3.5倍。；创新点：首次在单一纳米光子结构中同时实现X射线吸收增强和自发辐射速率增强，提出将非闪烁停止层替换为无机闪烁体以进一步提升光产额和时间分辨率的统一方案。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟：设计一维光子晶体结构（有机闪烁体+ITO停止层，或有机/无机闪烁体交替堆叠），模拟闪烁产额、衰减速率及符合时间分辨率（CTR）的增强。

papers.title: Analyzing the two-dimensional doped Hubbard model with the Worldvolume HMC method
papers.abstract: We apply the Worldvolume Hybrid Monte Carlo (WV-HMC) method [arXiv:2012.08468] to the two-dimensional Hubbard model, which is known to suffer from a severe sign problem when the system is doped (away from half filling). We show that the method predicts physical observables with controlled statistical errors on an $8 \times 8$ lattice at temperature $T/t = 1/6.4 \approx 0.156$ and interaction strength $U/t = 8.0$ ($t$ is the hopping amplitude), for which the standard determinant quantum Monte Carlo fails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Worldvolume Hybrid Monte Carlo (WV-HMC) method”、“determinant quantum Monte Carlo fails”、“predicts physical observables”。；研究对象：二维掺杂Hubbard模型（two-dimensional doped Hubbard model），具体研究其在远离半填充（doped）时的物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WV-HMC方法能够在标准行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法失效的掺杂区域（8×8晶格，温度T/t=1/6.4，相互作用强度U/t=8.0）以受控的统计误差预测物理可观测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WV-HMC方法能够在标准行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法失效的掺杂区域（8×8晶格，温度T/t=1/6.4，相互作用强度U/t=8.0）以受控的统计误差预测物理可观测量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Worldvolume Hybrid Monte Carlo (WV-HMC) 方法（文献[arXiv:2012.08468]提出），一种改进的量子蒙特卡洛算法，用于处理符号问题（sign problem）。

papers.title: Weakly nonlinear analysis of Hopf bifurcations in the elastohydrodynamics of Cosserat rods
papers.abstract: We study the weakly nonlinear saturation of the flutter instability of a planar Cosserat rod in a viscous fluid driven by a terminal follower force. This instability, established in our preceding work as a Hopf bifurcation of a non-self-adjoint linear operator, produces stable limit-cycle oscillations in the fully nonlinear overdamped dynamics. Here we derive an analytical description of the emergence of this limit cycle near threshold. Working close to the critical follower force, we perform a multiple-scale expansion about the compressed straight base state and systematically remove secular growth at higher orders. Solvability at cubic order, enforced using the adjoint eigenmode of the non-Hermitian operator, yields a Stuart-Landau amplitude equation for the critical oscillatory mode. The Landau coefficients are expressed as explicit inner products involving the critical eigenmode, its adjoint, and quadratic corrections. The resulting reduced theory predicts a supercritical Hopf bifurcation with a steady-state tip oscillation amplitude scaling as the square root of the distance from threshold. These predictions rationalize the near-threshold scaling observed in nonlinear simulations and provide an analytical normal form for the onset of self-sustained beating in pressure-driven soft robotic arms at low Reynolds number.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“multiple-scale expansion”、“Stuart-Landau amplitude equation”、“analytical description”。；研究对象：受末端随动力驱动的平面Cosserat杆在粘性流体中的弹性流体动力学系统，具体研究其颤振失稳后的弱非线性饱和行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界随动力附近，系统通过超临界Hopf分岔产生稳定的极限环振荡，其稳态尖端振荡幅度与距临界点的距离的平方根成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界随动力附近，系统通过超临界Hopf分岔产生稳定的极限环振荡，其稳态尖端振荡幅度与距临界点的距离的平方根成正比。；创新点：首次为粘性流体中Cosserat杆的颤振失稳提供了解析的弱非线性理论，建立了从线性失稳到有限振幅极限环的解析范式，并定量解释了非线性模拟中观察到的近阈值标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用多重尺度展开法，在压缩直基态附近进行摄动分析，利用非厄米算子的伴随本征模消除高阶久期项，推导出描述临界振荡模式的Stuart-Landau振幅方程，并将Landau系数表达为临界本征模、伴随模及二次修正项的内积形式。

papers.title: Generalized Suzuki-Chin Factorization in Bosonic Path Integral Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Modern implementations of path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) simulations of distinguishable particles frequently make use of high order factorization schemes for the Boltzmann operator to expedite convergence of equilibrium averages. Among these methods is the generalized Suzuki-Chin factorization (GSF), which is accurate up to fourth order in the imaginary-time step. In this work, we show that the GSF decomposition of the Boltzmann operator is applicable to bosonic PIMD, and results in an improved convergence of estimators. In particular, we show that the recently developed quadratic scaling bosonic PIMD need not change when using the GSF. The GSF scheme is implemented as a re-weighting factor for observables, without affecting the sampling generated by the standard, second-order, primitive factorization. We study the effect of this factorization for bosons in a harmonic trap and a sinusoidal potential. We also assess the effectiveness of GSF in calculating fermionic expectation values for harmonically-trapped atoms. In all these cases, we find that the GSF speeds up convergence with the Trotter number by a factor of $\sim 2-4$ across a wide temperature range, at only a modest computational cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD)、factorization schemes、Boltzmann operator、re-weighting factor。；研究对象：玻色子系统（bosonic system）的路径积分分子动力学模拟，具体研究了谐振势阱（harmonic trap）和正弦势（sinusoidal potential）中的玻色子，以及谐振势阱中费米子期望值的计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 广义Suzuki-Chin分解（GSF）可应用于玻色子PIMD，在不改变二次缩放玻色子PIMD采样方式的前提下，通过重加权因子加速平衡平均值的收敛，在宽温度范围内将收敛速度提升约2-4倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：广义Suzuki-Chin分解（GSF）可应用于玻色子PIMD，在不改变二次缩放玻色子PIMD采样方式的前提下，通过重加权因子加速平衡平均值的收敛，在宽温度范围内将收敛速度提升约2-4倍。；创新点：首次将GSF分解应用于玻色子PIMD，证明其无需改变已有的二次缩放玻色子PIMD算法，仅通过重加权因子即可实现收敛加速，并系统评估了其在玻色子和费米子体系中的效果。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义Suzuki-Chin分解（GSF）对玻尔兹曼算符进行四阶精度的分解，并将其作为可观测量的重加权因子（re-weighting factor），结合标准二阶原始分解（primitive factorization）生成的采样，进行玻色子路径积分分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking and Goldstone modes for deep information propagation
papers.abstract: In physical systems, whenever a continuous symmetry is spontaneously broken, the system possesses excitations called Goldstone modes, which allow coherent information propagation over long distances and times. In this work, we study deep neural networks whose internal layers are equivariant under a continuous symmetry and may therefore support analogous Goldstone-like degrees of freedom. We demonstrate, both analytically and empirically, that these degrees of freedom enable coherent signal propagation across depth and recurrent iterations, providing a mechanism for stable information flow without relying on architectural stabilizers such as residual connections or normalization. In feedforward networks, this results in improved trainability and representational diversity across layers. In recurrent settings, we demonstrate the same mechanism is valuable for long-term memory by propagating information over recurrent iterations, thereby improving performance of RNNs and GRUs on long-sequence modeling tasks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically and empirically”（解析与实证结合），但未涉及具体实验手段，核心是理论建模与数值验证。；研究对象：深度神经网络中的信息传播机制，具体研究在连续对称性等变（equivariant）的神经网络层中，自发对称性破缺及其产生的类戈德斯通模式如何实现长程相干信号传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有连续对称性的深度神经网络中，自发对称性破缺会产生类似戈德斯通模式的自由度，这些自由度能够在不依赖残差连接或归一化等架构稳定器的情况下，实现跨深度和循环迭代的相干信号传播，从而提升前馈网络的可训练性与表示多样性，以及循环网络的长序列建模性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有连续对称性的深度神经网络中，自发对称性破缺会产生类似戈德斯通模式的自由度，这些自由度能够在不依赖残差连接或归一化等架构稳定器的情况下，实现跨深度和循环迭代的相干信号传播，从而提升前馈网络的可训练性与表示多样性，以及循环网络的长序列建模性能。；创新点：将凝聚态物理中自发对称性破缺与戈德斯通模式的概念引入深度神经网络的信息传播研究，提出一种不依赖传统架构稳定器（如残差连接、归一化）的稳定信息流机制。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（对称性破缺与戈德斯通模式的理论推导）与数值实验（在前馈网络、RNN、GRU等架构上验证信号传播与任务性能）。

papers.title: Entangled Telecom Photon Generation using Twisted Van der Waals Crystals
papers.abstract: Nanoscale quantum light sources are essential building blocks for integrated quantum photonic systems. Here, we report a wavelength-scale entangled-photon source based on van der Waals-engineered NbOBr$_2$, and benchmark its performance for telecom-wavelength quantum light generation. By exploiting the material's second-order nonlinearity, we generate quantum-correlated photon pairs via spontaneous parametric down-conversion. We then use a 90$^{\circ}$ twisted stacking to induce quantum interference in photon-pair generation, yielding polarization-entangled photons. This approach enables tunability of the quantum optical state via control of the excitation laser polarization. We experimentally obtain entanglement fidelities exceeding 95% for Bell states, along with a high coincidence-to-accidental ratio of $\sim$335, and a brightness approximately one order of magnitude higher than recently reported telecom sources based on transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) 2D materials. These results establish twisted van der Waals engineering as a powerful platform for highly tunable, high-brightness quantum light sources at telecom wavelengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report, experimentally obtain, benchmark its performance。；研究对象：基于范德瓦尔斯工程化NbOBr₂的波长尺度纠缠光子源，用于电信波段量子光产生。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过90°扭转堆叠在NbOBr₂中诱导量子干涉，实现了偏振纠缠光子对产生，贝尔态纠缠保真度超过95%，亮度比近期报道的基于过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）二维材料的电信光源高约一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过90°扭转堆叠在NbOBr₂中诱导量子干涉，实现了偏振纠缠光子对产生，贝尔态纠缠保真度超过95%，亮度比近期报道的基于过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）二维材料的电信光源高约一个数量级。；创新点：将扭转范德瓦尔斯工程确立为一种高可调谐、高亮度的电信波段量子光源平台，相较于传统TMD二维材料光源在亮度上实现约一个数量级的提升。
papers.method_zh: 利用NbOBr₂的二阶非线性光学效应，通过自发参量下转换产生量子关联光子对；采用90°扭转堆叠结构诱导光子对产生中的量子干涉，并通过控制激发激光偏振实现量子光学态的可调谐性。

papers.title: Fraxonium: Fractional fluxon states for qudit encoding
papers.abstract: We propose a superconducting circuit hosting $d$ low-lying states, well separated from the rest of the spectrum, that naturally realizes a qudit system protected from leakage errors. The system represents a generalization of the fluxonium and the low-energy states are constituted by fractional fluxon states, that we call {\it fraxons}, localized in the minima of a suitably designed Josephson potential. The latter is tailored through a Fourier engineering approach, that employs multi-harmonic Josephson building block elements composed by a Josephson junction and an inductance connected in series. We present the spectrum of a $d=4$ and a $d=5$ qudit system and study in detail the qutrit case. We analyze the dipole matrix elements for coupling to radiation and propose a non-Abelian, stimulated Raman adiabatic passage (STIRAP) protocol for single-qutrit gates, that is particularly suited for the present system. The proposed platform opens novel perspectives in circuit engineering and quantum computing beyond the qubit paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、spectrum、protocol、theoretical framework。；研究对象：一种超导电路系统，具体为基于分数磁通态（fractional fluxon states，称为fraxons）的广义fluxonium系统，用于实现qudit（多能级量子比特）编码。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种天然具有d个低能态且与高能谱充分分离的超导电路，可构成无泄漏误差的qudit系统；低能态由局域在约瑟夫森势阱中的分数磁通态（fraxons）构成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种天然具有d个低能态且与高能谱充分分离的超导电路，可构成无泄漏误差的qudit系统；低能态由局域在约瑟夫森势阱中的分数磁通态（fraxons）构成。；创新点：将fluxonium推广到多能级qudit系统，利用分数磁通态实现天然防泄漏的量子编码，并引入非阿贝尔STIRAP协议实现单qutrit门操作，为超越qubit范式的量子计算提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用傅里叶工程方法设计多谐约瑟夫森构建块（约瑟夫森结与电感串联），通过调控约瑟夫森势能实现多势阱结构；计算了d=4和d=5 qudit系统的能谱，并详细分析了qutrit（三能级）情况；分析了偶极矩阵元，并提出了用于单qutrit门的非阿贝尔受激拉曼绝热通道（STIRAP）协议。

papers.title: Autonomous Reshaping of Expression Landscapes by DNA Methylation
papers.abstract: DNA methylation is usually treated as an epigenetic memory mark: transcriptional history is written into regulatory DNA and later stabilizes a chosen cell identity. This picture explains persistence, but it makes memory passive. Here we show that the same promoter-level coupling required for methylation memory can instead turn methylation into an internal control variable for regulatory dynamics. Transcription-factor occupancy protects regulatory DNA from methylation, while methylation shifts later transcription-factor binding thresholds. Under time-scale separation, this reciprocal loop separates into fast expression dynamics conditioned on methylation and a slow methylation flow written by expression. Minimal promoter, self-activation, and fate-toggle models show that this feedback does more than preserve a past state: it autonomously reshapes the expression landscape. In a methylation-coupled toggle, the preferred expression state can move continuously through single-well drift, allowing commitment without first entering a multiwell regime. Stochastic simulations further show that evolving methylation reduces fate reversals relative to a frozen landscape, making weak early expression bias more predictive of later fate. These results recast DNA methylation from a downstream stabilizer of cell identity into a slow dynamical coordinate that can help determine how regulatory states are chosen.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：model、dynamics、stochastic simulations）；研究对象：DNA甲基化作为表观遗传调控的动力学机制，具体研究启动子甲基化与转录因子结合之间的耦合反馈对基因表达景观的塑造作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DNA甲基化不仅是被动记录转录历史的记忆标记，还能作为慢速动力学变量，通过反馈环路自主重塑表达景观，使细胞命运选择无需经过多稳态区域即可实现连续漂移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DNA甲基化不仅是被动记录转录历史的记忆标记，还能作为慢速动力学变量，通过反馈环路自主重塑表达景观，使细胞命运选择无需经过多稳态区域即可实现连续漂移。；创新点：将DNA甲基化从传统认知中的下游稳定器重新定义为可主动调控表达景观选择的慢速动力学坐标，揭示了单阱漂移（single-well drift）实现命运承诺的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 构建最小启动子模型、自激活模型和命运切换模型（fate-toggle models），采用时间尺度分离分析（快慢变量分解）和随机模拟（stochastic simulations）研究甲基化与表达耦合的动力学行为。

papers.title: Lang2MLIP: End-to-End Language-to-Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Development with Autonomous Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract: Developing machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for complex materials systems remains challenging because it requires expertise in atomistic simulations, machine learning, and workflow design, as well as iterative active learning procedures. Existing automated pipelines typically assume a fixed sequence of stages or depend on domain experts, which limits their adaptability to heterogeneous materials systems where the optimal curriculum is not known in advance. To lower the barrier to developing MLIPs for non-experts, we propose Lang2MLIP, a multi-agent framework that takes natural-language input and formulates end-to-end MLIP development as a sequential decision-making problem solved by large language models (LLMs). At each step, a decision-making agent observes the current dataset, model, evaluation results, and execution log, and then automatically selects an appropriate action to improve the model. This removes the need for a predefined pipeline and enables the agent to self-correct by revisiting earlier subsystems when new failures arise. We evaluate this approach on a solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) system with multiple components and interfaces. These results suggest that LLM-based multi-agent systems are a promising direction for automating MLIP development and making it more accessible to non-experts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials, large language models, multi-agent framework, sequential decision-making）；研究对象：复杂材料体系，具体以多组分、多界面的固态电解质界面（SEI）体系为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为Lang2MLIP的多智能体框架，该框架利用大语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言输入转化为端到端的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）开发流程，无需预设固定流程，并能通过自我纠错提升模型性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为Lang2MLIP的多智能体框架，该框架利用大语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言输入转化为端到端的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）开发流程，无需预设固定流程，并能通过自我纠错提升模型性能。；创新点：提出了一种无需预设固定流程、可自适应调整的端到端MLIP开发自动化框架。通过将自然语言作为输入，并利用LLM智能体进行自主决策和自我纠错，显著降低了非专家用户开发MLIP的门槛。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于大语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体框架。该框架将MLIP开发建模为一个序列决策问题，由一个决策智能体根据当前数据集、模型、评估结果和执行日志，自动选择并执行合适的操作（如数据生成、模型训练、主动学习等）来迭代改进模型。

papers.title: Power sensitivity of broadband radiofrequency detectors based on quantum diamond spins
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond can be used to detect radiofrequency (RF) signals through coupling of the RF magnetic field with the NV spins, combined with optical readout of the spin state. The sensitivity of such RF detectors has so far been mainly studied in terms of magnetic field sensitivity, which is relevant when the RF signal is generated by a near-field source. However, for applications where the RF input is delivered externally, a more relevant quantity is the sensitivity in terms of the input RF power. Here we theoretically analyse the power sensitivity of NV-based RF detectors as a function of the RF-spin interface geometry. We derive scaling laws of the power sensitivity for both slope-detection and variance-detection RF sensing protocols, and for various noise regimes. We find that, in most scenarios, the power sensitivity scales inversely with the characteristic physical dimension of the RF-spin interface, for instance the width of a coplanar waveguide or the diameter of a loop antenna. In other words, the smaller the structure and the probed NV volume, the better the power sensitivity, which is contrary to the case of magnetic field sensitivity. Lastly, we numerically estimate that photon shot noise limited sensitivities of 10^{-20} W Hz^{-1} (slope) and 10^{-12} W Hz^{-1/2} (variance) are achievable. This work lays the groundwork for further optimisation of NV-based RF detectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically analyse、derive scaling laws、numerically estimate）；研究对象：基于金刚石氮-空位（NV）色心的宽带射频探测器，重点研究其功率灵敏度与射频-自旋界面几何结构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大多数情况下，NV基射频探测器的功率灵敏度与射频-自旋界面的特征物理尺寸成反比（结构越小、探测的NV体积越小，功率灵敏度越高），这与磁场灵敏度的标度律相反。理论估计光子散粒噪声极限下，斜率检测和方差检测的灵敏度分别可达10^{-20} W Hz^{-1}和10^{-12} W Hz^{-1/2}。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大多数情况下，NV基射频探测器的功率灵敏度与射频-自旋界面的特征物理尺寸成反比（结构越小、探测的NV体积越小，功率灵敏度越高），这与磁场灵敏度的标度律相反。理论估计光子散粒噪声极限下，斜率检测和方差检测的灵敏度分别可达10^{-20} W Hz^{-1}和10^{-12} W Hz^{-1/2}。；创新点：首次从输入射频功率的角度（而非传统磁场灵敏度）系统分析NV基射频探测器的灵敏度，并揭示了功率灵敏度与界面几何尺寸的反比标度关系，为优化器件设计提供了理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导了斜率检测和方差检测两种射频传感协议下功率灵敏度的标度律，并考虑了多种噪声机制（如光子散粒噪声等），同时结合数值估算。

papers.title: Monolithic axial InGaAs quantum dot emitters in GaAs-based nanowires via Sb-mediated facet engineering
papers.abstract: GaAs-based nanowires hosting active quantum heterostructures provide a promising route toward monolithic integration of single-photon sources on silicon, a key requirement for scalable quantum photonics. However, ultrathin axial quantum-emitter formation is often hindered by facet-dependent growth dynamics and rotational twins, which induce lateral overgrowth and compromise interface abruptness. Here, we develop InGaAs-based quantum emitters by tailoring facet evolution via dilute Sb incorporation, which efficiently suppresses twins and promotes confined axial insertion at the growth-front facet. This approach significantly enhances the probability of obtaining abrupt, few-nanometer-thin quantum dots at the nanowire tip. Single-nanowire optical spectroscopy reveals intense, spatially localized emission from the active region with lifetimes as short as (0.51 $\pm$ 0.02) ns, and second-order photon-correlation measurements consistently exhibit pronounced antibunching with $g^{(2)}(0)<0.4$, confirming single-photon emission. These results establish a strong correlation between twin density and axial heterostructure formation, identifying defect control as a key factor in realizing monolithically integrated nanowire single-photon sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：optical spectroscopy, photon-correlation measurements, 生长与表征。；研究对象：基于GaAs纳米线的轴向InGaAs量子点单光子发射器。具体体系为通过Sb辅助面工程在GaAs纳米线中嵌入的InGaAs量子点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过掺入少量Sb元素调控纳米线晶面演化，可以有效抑制孪晶缺陷，促进在生长前沿形成陡峭的、仅几纳米厚的轴向InGaAs量子点。这些量子点展现出强烈的、空间局域化的单光子发射特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过掺入少量Sb元素调控纳米线晶面演化，可以有效抑制孪晶缺陷，促进在生长前沿形成陡峭的、仅几纳米厚的轴向InGaAs量子点。这些量子点展现出强烈的、空间局域化的单光子发射特性。；创新点：提出并验证了通过稀Sb掺入进行“面工程”（facet engineering）来抑制孪晶、实现高质量轴向量子点这一新策略，并建立了孪晶密度与轴向异质结构形成之间的强关联性。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长纳米线；单纳米线光学光谱学（single-nanowire optical spectroscopy）表征发光特性；二阶光子关联测量（second-order photon-correlation measurements）验证单光子发射。

papers.title: All-Electric Quantum State Transfer via Spin-Orbit Phase Matching
papers.abstract: Semiconductor hole-spin qubits offer a promising route to quantum computation due to their weak hyperfine interaction, and strong intrinsic spin-orbit coupling enabling electric control of qubits. Scalable architectures, however, require coherent long-distance quantum state transfer, which is hindered in these systems by spin-orbit induced anisotropic exchange. Here we show that this limitation can be overcome by using an all-electric control protocol. By tuning the electric field strength, we identify discrete spin-orbit phase-matching conditions that restore near-perfect state transfer, independent of the rotation axis. Complementarily, controlling the electric field direction aligns the spin-orbit axis, suppressing excitation non-conserving processes and enabling robust transfer without fine tuning. Our results establish that electrical control of spin-orbit phases through either magnitude tuning or axis alignment as a practical route for robust quantum information transport in hole-spin quantum dot arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：all-electric control protocol、identify、establish、show that（理论推导与方案设计）。；研究对象：半导体空穴自旋量子点阵列中的长距离量子态传输，具体涉及自旋-轨道耦合诱导的各向异性交换作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节电场强度或电场方向，可实现自旋-轨道相位匹配条件，从而恢复近乎完美的量子态传输，克服自旋-轨道耦合导致的各向异性交换对长距离传输的阻碍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节电场强度或电场方向，可实现自旋-轨道相位匹配条件，从而恢复近乎完美的量子态传输，克服自旋-轨道耦合导致的各向异性交换对长距离传输的阻碍。；创新点：提出全电学控制协议，利用电场强度调谐或电场方向对齐两种方式实现自旋-轨道相位匹配，无需精细调节即可实现鲁棒的量子态传输。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与方案设计：通过调控电场强度寻找离散的自旋-轨道相位匹配条件，或通过控制电场方向对齐自旋-轨道轴，抑制非激发守恒过程。

papers.title: Universal Spin Squeezing Dynamical Phase Transitions across Lattice Geometries, Dimensions, and Microscopic Couplings
papers.abstract: Recent work has identified a dynamical squeezing phase transition in power-law interacting bilayer XXZ spin models, separating a fully collective phase with Heisenberg-limited squeezing from a partially-collective phase with universal critical scaling. Here we test and establish the universality of this transition along two qualitatively different microscopic axes: lattice geometry, by studying square, triangular, and honeycomb $2\mathrm{D}$ bilayers as well as $1\mathrm{D}$ ladders, and a symmetry-preserving rescaling $λ$ of the interlayer couplings relative to the intralayer ones. Combining a Bogoliubov instability analysis with discrete truncated Wigner simulations, we find that the transition persists across all four lattice geometries and over a wide range of $λ$ with critical exponents consistent within error, providing strong evidence for a genuine non-equilibrium universality class. The Bogoliubov theory recovers the previously identified scaling $a_Z^* \propto L$ in the long-range interacting regime $α< d+2$, and yields an analytical scaling $a_Z^* \propto L^{2/(α-d)}$ for the critical aspect ratio with system size for $α>d+2$, with $α$ the power-law exponent in dimension $d$. This uncovers a previously unrecognized sub-linear regime for short-range interactions. By tuning $λ$ we vary the interlayer coupling strength at fixed layer spacing, demonstrating that the dynamical transition can be driven purely through interaction engineering without modifying the underlying geometry. These findings provide a versatile route toward controlling entanglement generation in Rydberg-array, polar molecule, and trapped-ion platforms with applications in quantum sensing and simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：结合Bogoliubov不稳定性分析与离散截断Wigner模拟（discrete truncated Wigner simulations）。；研究对象：幂律相互作用的双层XXZ自旋模型中的动力学压缩相变（dynamical squeezing phase transition），研究其在不同晶格几何（二维方形、三角、蜂窝晶格及一维梯子）和微观耦合参数下的普适性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该动力学压缩相变在所有研究的晶格几何和广泛的层间耦合重标度参数λ范围内均存在，且临界指数在误差范围内一致，为一种真正的非平衡普适类提供了有力证据。此外，Bogoliubov理论揭示了短程相互作用下此前未被认识的亚线性标度区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该动力学压缩相变在所有研究的晶格几何和广泛的层间耦合重标度参数λ范围内均存在，且临界指数在误差范围内一致，为一种真正的非平衡普适类提供了有力证据。此外，Bogoliubov理论揭示了短程相互作用下此前未被认识的亚线性标度区域。；创新点：系统验证了该动力学相变在晶格几何（从二维到一维）和层间耦合强度（通过参数λ调控）两个微观维度上的普适性，并推导出短程相互作用区域（α>d+2）临界纵横比随系统尺寸的解析标度律a_Z^* ∝ L^{2/(α-d)}，揭示了此前未发现的亚线性标度行为。同时证明可通过纯相互作用工程（不改变几何结构）驱动该动力学相变。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov不稳定性分析（Bogoliubov instability analysis）和离散截断Wigner模拟（discrete truncated Wigner simulations）两种理论方法。

papers.title: A Twist on Scattering from Defect Anomalies
papers.abstract: In the presence of extended defects, familiar incoming particles can scatter into exotic outgoing states created by twist operators. We show that one possible mechanism driving these "categorical scattering" processes is the presence of localized 't Hooft anomalies on the defect's worldvolume. Defect anomalies trap non-trivial charges at junctions between the symmetry lines and the interface, opening new transmission channels that would naively appear to violate selection rules. After outlining the general mechanism, we investigate several concrete examples with defects, interfaces, and boundaries. For models of massless chiral fermions already studied in the literature, we show that the emergence of twist operators can be understood as a consequence of defect anomalies. We then introduce new massive integrable theories in which a similar phenomenon occurs, and we explicitly solve the associated scattering problem, obtaining new integrable solutions. Finally, we construct lattice spin chains with defects where similar physics is expected to arise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, mechanism, investigate, construct, integrable theories, lattice spin chains。；研究对象：存在扩展缺陷的量子场论和凝聚态系统中的散射现象，特别是由缺陷异常（defect anomalies）导致的“范畴散射”（categorical scattering）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩展缺陷上的局域化't Hooft异常是驱动“范畴散射”的一种可能机制，它会在对称线与界面的连接处束缚非平凡荷，从而打开看似违反选择定则的新透射通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩展缺陷上的局域化't Hooft异常是驱动“范畴散射”的一种可能机制，它会在对称线与界面的连接处束缚非平凡荷，从而打开看似违反选择定则的新透射通道。；创新点：将缺陷上的局域化't Hooft异常与“范畴散射”中扭算符（twist operators）的产生机制联系起来，并在有质量可积理论中首次实现了该现象的显式求解。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论分析框架，首先概述一般机制，然后通过具体例子进行验证：包括文献中已有的无质量手征费米子模型、新引入的有质量可积理论（并显式求解散射问题），以及预期出现类似物理的缺陷晶格自旋链模型。

papers.title: Non-Invertible Symmetries and Boundaries for Two-Dimensional Fermions
papers.abstract: We study the relation between boundary conditions and categorical symmetries of two-dimensional fermionic conformal field theories. We determine all anomaly-free invertible global symmetries of two free complex Weyl fermions, which take the form $\mathbb{Z}_k$ for each primitive Pythagorean triple $a^2 + b^2 = k^2$. The theory is self-dual under gauging any of these symmetries, and so to each there is associated a non-invertible topological defect. We study the properties of these lines, and show that any conformal boundary condition of two Dirac fermions that preserves a $U(1)^2$ symmetry can be found by dressing a trivial Dirichlet boundary with one of them. We discuss two microscopic descriptions of these defects: fermions coupled to a quantum-mechanical rotor degree of freedom; and an abelian gauge theory that realises symmetric mass generation in a half-space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论对称性、拓扑缺陷、边界条件等理论概念，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：二维费米子共形场论，具体为两个自由复Weyl费米子（即两个狄拉克费米子）的边界条件与范畴对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了两个自由复Weyl费米子的所有无反常可逆整体对称性，形式为每个本原毕达哥拉斯三元组 \(a^2+b^2=k^2\) 对应的 \(\mathbb{Z}_k\) 群；这些对称性规范后理论自对偶，从而每个对称性关联一个不可逆拓扑缺陷；任何保持 \(U(1)^2\) 对称性的共形边界条件可通过用其中一个缺陷修饰平凡狄利克雷边界得到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了两个自由复Weyl费米子的所有无反常可逆整体对称性，形式为每个本原毕达哥拉斯三元组 \(a^2+b^2=k^2\) 对应的 \(\mathbb{Z}_k\) 群；这些对称性规范后理论自对偶，从而每个对称性关联一个不可逆拓扑缺陷；任何保持 \(U(1)^2\) 对称性的共形边界条件可通过用其中一个缺陷修饰平凡狄利克雷边界得到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用共形场论中的对称性分类、规范对偶、拓扑缺陷构造，以及边界条件的代数描述；给出了两种微观描述：费米子耦合量子力学转子自由度，以及实现半空间对称质量生成的阿贝尔规范理论。

papers.title: Efficiency in a repetitive pulse magnet
papers.abstract: A repetitive-pulse magnet is a promising tool when combined with repetitive excitations, such as pulsed lasers. Technically, the repetition and the magnetic field values in a repetitive-pulse magnet are limited by the Joule heating in the coil. Here, we analytically examine the relationship between the coil's dimensions and its efficiency, assuming negligible heating of the coil, to design an optimized high-repetition, high-magnetic-field coil. We calculated the dependence of the maximum magnetic field, energy loss, pulse duration, form factor, impedance, and maximum current on the coil's geometry. We found that the smaller the coil, the more pulses and the more intense the magnetic fields we can obtain under a given condition. We argue that the obtained trend arises from a complex interplay among various parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“analytically examine”（解析分析）、“calculated the dependence”（计算依赖关系）、“we argue”（理论论证），未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：重复脉冲磁体（repetitive-pulse magnet）的设计优化，具体研究线圈几何尺寸（dimensions）与性能（效率、磁场强度、发热限制等）之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在忽略线圈发热的理想条件下，线圈尺寸越小，在给定条件下可获得越多的脉冲次数和越强的磁场。这一趋势源于多种参数（如最大磁场、能量损耗、脉冲宽度、形状因子、阻抗、最大电流）之间的复杂相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在忽略线圈发热的理想条件下，线圈尺寸越小，在给定条件下可获得越多的脉冲次数和越强的磁场。这一趋势源于多种参数（如最大磁场、能量损耗、脉冲宽度、形状因子、阻抗、最大电流）之间的复杂相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（analytical examination），通过推导线圈几何参数与最大磁场、能量损耗、脉冲持续时间、形状因子、阻抗、最大电流等物理量的函数关系，进行优化设计。

papers.title: Nagaoka supermetal in the particle-doped triangular Hubbard model
papers.abstract: While the interplay of correlations and geometric frustration in doped Mott insulators provides a fertile ground for exotic quantum phases, the nature of the metallic state emerging upon particle doping remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the triangular-lattice Hubbard model with particle doping and provide compelling evidence for an intrinsic, interaction-driven quantum state, which we term the Nagaoka supermetal. This state is characterized by a sublinear temperature dependence in the DC resistivity, along with singular behaviors in the charge compressibility and zero-frequency spectral weight. To understand the origin of these singular properties, we derive an effective low-energy model and demonstrate that a higher-order Van Hove singularity emerges from the reconstructed dispersion. This singularity gives rise to a power-law divergence in the density of states, capturing the anomalous properties observed in the supermetallic regime. Our findings offer a new perspective on non-Fermi liquid states in geometrically frustrated systems and are directly accessible in current ultracold atom experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate, derive an effective low-energy model, demonstrate）；研究对象：三角晶格Hubbard模型在粒子掺杂下的金属态，具体为一种称为“Nagaoka超金属”的量子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粒子掺杂的三角晶格Hubbard模型中，发现了一种由相互作用驱动的内禀量子态——Nagaoka超金属，其直流电阻率呈亚线性温度依赖，并伴随电荷压缩率和零频谱权的奇异行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粒子掺杂的三角晶格Hubbard模型中，发现了一种由相互作用驱动的内禀量子态——Nagaoka超金属，其直流电阻率呈亚线性温度依赖，并伴随电荷压缩率和零频谱权的奇异行为。；创新点：首次在几何阻挫的三角晶格掺杂体系中提出并刻画了“Nagaoka超金属”这一非费米液体态，并揭示了高阶Van Hove奇异性是其微观起源。
papers.method_zh: 通过推导有效低能模型，证明重构的色散中出现了高阶Van Hove奇异性，导致态密度呈幂律发散，从而解释了超金属态的反常性质。

papers.title: Parallel Scan Recurrent Neural Quantum States for Scalable Variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Neural-network quantum states have emerged as a powerful variational framework for quantum many-body systems, with recent progress often driven by massively parallel architectures such as transformers. Recurrent neural network quantum states, however, are frequently regarded as intrinsically sequential and therefore less scalable. Here we revisit this view by showing that modern recurrent architectures can support fast, accurate, and computationally accessible neural quantum state simulations. Using autoregressive recurrent wave functions together with recent advances in parallelizable recurrence, we develop variational ansätze, called parallel scan recurrent neural quantum states (PSR-NQS), which can be trained efficiently within variational Monte Carlo in one and two spatial dimensions. We demonstrate accurate benchmark results and show that, with iterative retraining, our approach reaches two-dimensional spin lattices as large as $52\times52$ while remaining in agreement with available quantum Monte Carlo data. Our results establish recurrent architectures as a practical and promising route toward scalable neural quantum state simulations with modest computational resources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“variational Monte Carlo”、“neural quantum state simulations”、“benchmark results”。；研究对象：量子多体系统，具体为二维自旋晶格（如 $52\times52$ 的二维自旋晶格）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入并行扫描技术，循环神经网络量子态可以实现快速、准确且计算资源需求适中的变分蒙特卡洛模拟，在二维大尺寸自旋晶格上达到与现有量子蒙特卡洛数据一致的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入并行扫描技术，循环神经网络量子态可以实现快速、准确且计算资源需求适中的变分蒙特卡洛模拟，在二维大尺寸自旋晶格上达到与现有量子蒙特卡洛数据一致的结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 变分蒙特卡洛方法（VMC），结合自回归循环波函数与并行化递归（parallelizable recurrence）技术，构建了并行扫描循环神经网络量子态（PSR-NQS）。

papers.title: Chiral molecule-induced contributions to ferromagnetic resonance
papers.abstract: Despite extensive research on chirality-driven spin selectivity, most studies have focused on static magnetic properties, while the influence of chirality on the dynamic magnetic response remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate how chiral molecular interfaces affect magnetization dynamics in thin Co/Ni multilayers with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy using broadband ferromagnetic resonance spectroscopy. A comparison between bare (reference) films and molecule-functionalized (hybrid) samples reveals no measurable changes in either the resonance field or the linewidth that could be attributed to the presence of the chiral environment. Motivated by our findings we develop a macrospin description that distinguishes equilibrium modifications of the magnetic free-energy landscape (MIPAC-type effects) from non-equilibrium, CISS-induced spin torques. Our analysis shows that equilibrium modifications primarily shift the resonance condition via changes to the free energy landscape and thereby the effective field, whereas damping-like non-equilibrium torques provide a distinct channel for varying the effective damping rate. This approach establishes clear criteria for disentangling chiral-interface-induced energy modifications from torque-driven dynamical effects in ferromagnetic resonance experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用宽带铁磁共振谱”进行实验测量，并“发展了一个宏自旋描述”进行理论分析。；研究对象：手性分子界面修饰的Co/Ni多层膜（具有垂直磁各向异性）中的磁化动力学行为，具体研究手性环境对铁磁共振响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验上未观察到手性分子界面导致的可测量的共振场或线宽变化；理论上区分了平衡态自由能修正（MIPAC型效应）与非平衡态CISS诱导自旋力矩对铁磁共振的不同贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验上未观察到手性分子界面导致的可测量的共振场或线宽变化；理论上区分了平衡态自由能修正（MIPAC型效应）与非平衡态CISS诱导自旋力矩对铁磁共振的不同贡献。；创新点：首次系统区分了手性界面引起的平衡态自由能修正（通过改变有效场影响共振条件）与非平衡态阻尼型自旋力矩（通过改变有效阻尼率影响动力学）在铁磁共振实验中的不同可观测效应，并建立了区分这两类贡献的明确判据。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：宽带铁磁共振谱（broadband ferromagnetic resonance spectroscopy）。理论框架：宏自旋描述（macrospin description），用于区分平衡态自由能景观修正与非平衡态自旋力矩。

papers.title: Magnetization-dependent and stacking-tunable Edelstein effect in two-dimensional magnet 2H-VTe2
papers.abstract: The Edelstein effect in magnetic systems enables magnetization switching via the coupling between current-induced spin accumulation and intrinsic magnetic order, and is therefore highly promising for next-generation spintronic devices. Realizing and manipulating the Edelstein effect in two-dimensional (2D) magnetic systems is particularly desirable for achieving high-efficiency and multifunctional spintronic applications. In this work, based on first-principles calculations and symmetry analysis, we demonstrate that the Edelstein effect can intrinsically arise in the 2D in-plane ferromagnetic semiconductor 2H-VTe2, with its behavior strongly dependent on the magnetization orientation. For monolayer 2H-VTe2 with D3h crystal symmetry, under an applied current along the +x direction, only the time-reversal-even z component and the time-reversal-odd y(x) component of the spin accumulation are allowed when the magnetization is aligned along +x (+y). For ferromagnetic bilayer 2H-VTe2 in AB or BA stacking, where the crystal symmetry is reduced to C3v, additional spin components emerge with the presence of in-plane magnetization. Specifically, for magnetization along +x (+y), besides dSz_even and dSy_odd (dSz_even and dSx_odd), extra components such as dSy_even and dSz_odd (dSy_even) become allowed. Notably, these additional components can be reversibly switched by changing the stacking configuration from AB to BA via interlayer sliding. Our results not only deepen the understanding of current-induced spin accumulation in 2D magnetic systems from both symmetry and first-principles perspectives, but also identify 2H-MX2 materials as a promising platform for realizing intrinsic and tunable Edelstein effects in high-efficiency spin-orbit torque devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、symmetry analysis（对称性分析）。；研究对象：二维面内铁磁半导体2H-VTe2（单层及AB/BA堆叠双层）中的Edelstein效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维面内铁磁半导体2H-VTe2中，Edelstein效应可本征地产生，其自旋积累行为强烈依赖于磁化取向，且通过改变双层堆叠方式（AB或BA）可逆地调控额外自旋分量的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维面内铁磁半导体2H-VTe2中，Edelstein效应可本征地产生，其自旋积累行为强烈依赖于磁化取向，且通过改变双层堆叠方式（AB或BA）可逆地调控额外自旋分量的出现。；创新点：揭示了二维磁性体系2H-VTe2中Edelstein效应对磁化取向的依赖性，并首次提出通过层间滑动改变堆叠构型（AB/BA）可逆调控Edelstein效应中的自旋积累分量，为在二维材料中实现可调谐的Edelstein效应提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合对称性分析（symmetry analysis）。

papers.title: Shubnikov-de Haas Characterization of Superconductor-Semiconductor Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-semiconductor nanostructures are a central component for research spanning condensed matter physics and quantum information processing. Continued progress relies critically on the ability to characterize, control, and optimize several intrinsic material properties including spin-orbit coupling, band offsets, and disorder in a device-relevant stack that necessarily couples the electronic states of a superconducting metal film and a semiconductor. Here we report a new method to extract fundamental material parameters utilizing simple Shubnikov-de Haas (SdH) oscillation measurements in heterostructures in which metallic electronic states are coupled to a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) residing in an InAs quantum well beneath an aluminum thin film. Proper analysis of the full magnetoresistance data facilitates extraction of the quantum well carrier density, spin-orbit coupling strength, and both transport and quantum scattering times. Most importantly, the extracted scattering times in the 2DEG are impacted by the metal-semiconductor coupling strength allowing us to quickly gain information on proximity-induced superconducting gap without any fabrication or mK measurements. The wealth of information that is accessed with these simple measurements positions this methodology as an important tool for hybrid materials optimization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“report a new method”、“measurements”、“extraction of...”。；研究对象：超导体-半导体异质结构，具体为铝薄膜下方的InAs量子阱中的二维电子气（2DEG）与金属超导态耦合的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用简单的Shubnikov-de Haas（SdH）振荡测量，可以从全磁阻数据中提取量子阱载流子密度、自旋轨道耦合强度、输运和量子散射时间，并快速获得金属-半导体耦合强度对近邻诱导超导能隙的影响信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用简单的Shubnikov-de Haas（SdH）振荡测量，可以从全磁阻数据中提取量子阱载流子密度、自旋轨道耦合强度、输运和量子散射时间，并快速获得金属-半导体耦合强度对近邻诱导超导能隙的影响信息。；创新点：提出了一种无需复杂器件制备或mK级低温测量，仅通过SdH振荡即可快速获取超导-半导体异质结构中关键材料参数（包括近邻超导能隙相关信息）的新方法。
papers.method_zh: Shubnikov-de Haas（SdH）振荡测量，结合对全磁阻数据的分析，提取载流子密度、自旋轨道耦合强度、输运散射时间和量子散射时间。

papers.title: Do Hopfield Networks Dream of Stored Patterns? A Statistical-Mechanical Theory of Dreaming in Multidirectional Associative Memories
papers.abstract: We introduce the Dreaming $L$-directional Associative Memory (DLAM), a multi-layer Hebbian architecture in which off-line dreaming and supervised heteroassociative coupling coexist within a single energy function, placing our approach within the framework of energy-based models (EBMs). The replica-symmetric free energy, derived via the Guerra interpolation scheme, yields self-consistency equations governing the order parameters across the control-parameter space. The effective local field decomposes into signal, intra-layer dreaming noise, and inter-layer noise. Dreaming improves retrieval by differentially attenuating high-eigenvalue interference modes of the empirical correlation matrix, suppressing inter-pattern crosstalk while preserving the signal. Dreaming and inter-layer coupling prove synergistic, opening retrieval regions unreachable by either mechanism alone, as confirmed by Monte Carlo simulations for $L=3$. Their interplay is most pronounced on pattern disentanglement: given a mixture state as input, the network splits the constituent patterns one-per-layer, recovering each modality-specific pattern from a common cue that simultaneously blends noisy evidence from all sensory channels. Phase diagrams are planar projections of the hyperspace $(α,β,ρ,t)$-where $α$ is the storage load, $β$ the fast-noise inverse temperature, $ρ$ the dataset entropy, and $t$ the sleeping time. In the $(ρ,t)$-plane, the diagrams reveal a data-computation trade-off: off-line consolidation substitutes for additional training data, extending to heteroassociative architectures a phenomenon previously established for autoassociative networks. Enriching the standard Hopfield model with heteroassociativity and dreaming gives rise to EBMs capable of complex tasks beyond classical pattern recognition, contributing to a modern theory of neural information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：statistical-mechanical theory、replica-symmetric free energy、Guerra interpolation scheme、energy-based models (EBMs)。；研究对象：多方向联想记忆（Multidirectional Associative Memories）神经网络，具体为引入“做梦”（Dreaming）机制的多层Hebbian架构（DLAM），研究其存储、检索与模式分离的统计力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: “做梦”机制通过差异化衰减经验相关矩阵的高本征值干扰模式，抑制模式间串扰并保留信号，从而提升检索性能；且“做梦”与层间耦合具有协同效应，能打开单独任一机制无法达到的检索区域，尤其在模式分离（pattern disentanglement）任务中表现显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：“做梦”机制通过差异化衰减经验相关矩阵的高本征值干扰模式，抑制模式间串扰并保留信号，从而提升检索性能；且“做梦”与层间耦合具有协同效应，能打开单独任一机制无法达到的检索区域，尤其在模式分离（pattern disentanglement）任务中表现显著。；创新点：将离线“做梦”（off-line dreaming）与有监督异联想耦合（supervised heteroassociative coupling）统一于单一能量函数中，提出DLAM模型；揭示了数据-计算权衡（data-computation trade-off）：离线巩固可替代额外训练数据，并将此现象从自联想网络推广至异联想架构。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Guerra插值方案推导复制对称自由能，建立序参量自洽方程；数值模拟：对L=3（三层）系统进行蒙特卡洛模拟验证相图。控制参数空间包括存储负载α、快噪声逆温度β、数据集熵ρ和睡眠时间t。

papers.title: Enhanced Near-Field Thermal Radiation Driven by Multiple Corner and Edge Modes in Subwavelength Square Nanowires
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the near-field thermal radiation between subwavelength SiC nanowires with square cross sections is dominated by multiple corner and edge resonances rather than the single surface-phonon-polariton channel of planar surfaces. Fluctuational electrodynamics simulations reveal that these resonances lie within the SiC Reststrahlen band, redshift for thinner nanowires, and yield a four-fold enhancement of thermal conductance. This maximum enhancement occurs when the separation gap nearly matches the nanowire thickness, balancing dimensional confinement and interwire coupling. These findings establish square nanowires as a versatile platform for geometrycontrolled near-field heat transfer in nanoscale heat management and energy conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：fluctuational electrodynamics simulations（涨落电动力学模拟）。；研究对象：亚波长方形截面SiC纳米线之间的近场热辐射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 方形截面SiC纳米线之间的近场热辐射由多个角模式和边缘模式主导，而非平面表面的单一表面声子极化激元通道；当纳米线间距与其厚度接近时，热导可增强四倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：方形截面SiC纳米线之间的近场热辐射由多个角模式和边缘模式主导，而非平面表面的单一表面声子极化激元通道；当纳米线间距与其厚度接近时，热导可增强四倍。；创新点：揭示了方形截面纳米线中多个角模式和边缘模式对近场热辐射的增强作用，建立了通过几何形状（截面形状与尺寸）调控近场热传输的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用涨落电动力学（fluctuational electrodynamics）进行数值模拟，分析纳米线几何形状对近场热辐射模式及热导的影响。

papers.title: Giant optical spin-orbit interactions in ferroelectric van der Waals waveguides
papers.abstract: Optical spin-orbit interactions (SOI) link photonic spin to momentum, offering a route toward on-chip polarization control and beam steering. Nevertheless, achieving sufficient optical SOI and nonlinearities on sub-micrometer scales - a prerequisite for dense photonic integration - remains an outstanding challenge. Here, we show that highly birefringent van der Waals (vdW) waveguides provide an ideal, chip-compatible platform to address this limitation. We focus on the ferroelectric semiconductor NbOI2, which exhibits record optical nonlinearities and dielectric anisotropy. Using femtosecond optical microscopy, we image light propagation and harmonic conversion beyond the total internal reflection barrier over tens of micrometers in NbOI2 slab waveguides. We report giant optical spin-splitting through the optical spin Hall effect, which facilitates spatial separation of optical spin currents on sub-micrometer scales, in quantitative agreement with a microscopic light-matter interaction model. We further leverage optical spin-momentum locking to realize polarization-controlled waveguide steering. We generalize these observations across various vdW waveguides and empirically confirm a scaling law linking dielectric anisotropy to geometric spin-splitting. Our results establish highly anisotropic vdW waveguides as an ideal platform for densely integrated opto-spintronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“femtosecond optical microscopy”（飞秒光学显微镜）、“imaging light propagation”（成像光传播）、“harmonic conversion”（谐波转换）等实验手段。；研究对象：铁电范德瓦尔斯波导中的光学自旋-轨道相互作用（optical spin-orbit interactions），具体材料为铁电半导体NbOI₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高度双折射的范德瓦尔斯波导（如NbOI₂）中，实现了亚微米尺度的巨大光学自旋分裂（光学自旋霍尔效应），并利用光学自旋-动量锁定实现了偏振控制的波导转向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高度双折射的范德瓦尔斯波导（如NbOI₂）中，实现了亚微米尺度的巨大光学自旋分裂（光学自旋霍尔效应），并利用光学自旋-动量锁定实现了偏振控制的波导转向。；创新点：首次在铁电范德瓦尔斯波导中实现亚微米尺度的巨大光学自旋-轨道相互作用，并建立了介电各向异性与几何自旋分裂之间的标度律，为密集集成光自旋电子技术提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒光学显微镜成像技术，用于观测NbOI₂薄片波导中超越全内反射屏障的光传播与谐波转换；结合微观光-物质相互作用模型进行定量分析。

papers.title: Nonlinear dynamic elastic moduli from equilibrium stress fluctuations
papers.abstract: Fluctuation formulas for elastic and viscoelastic moduli allow their computation from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, avoiding explicit nonequilibrium deformation protocols. While such expressions are well established for the quasi-static moduli, and also the linear dynamic moduli, no fluctuation formula exists for the nonlinear time-dependent moduli that govern anharmonic viscoelastic response under finite time-dependent strains. In this work we derive transient-time correlation function expressions for both the linear and the nonlinear dynamic moduli, starting from the DOLLS/SLLOD equations of motion for irrotational motion. The resulting formulas involve equilibrium time correlations of the stress tensor and Born-kinetic terms, and they recover the known quasi-static and linear dynamic results in the appropriate limits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive”（推导）、“fluctuation formulas”（涨落公式）、“equilibrium time correlations”（平衡时间关联）。；研究对象：非线性动态弹性模量（nonlinear time-dependent elastic moduli），具体针对有限时间应变下的非简谐振粘弹性响应（anharmonic viscoelastic response）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从DOLLS/SLLOD运动方程出发，推导出了线性和非线性动态模量的瞬态时间关联函数表达式，该表达式在适当极限下能恢复已知的准静态和线性动态结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从DOLLS/SLLOD运动方程出发，推导出了线性和非线性动态模量的瞬态时间关联函数表达式，该表达式在适当极限下能恢复已知的准静态和线性动态结果。；创新点：首次建立了非线性时间依赖弹性模量的涨落公式，填补了此前仅存在准静态和线性动态模量涨落公式的空白。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。基于平衡分子动力学模拟中的应力张量和Born-kinetic项的平衡时间关联，利用DOLLS/SLLOD运动方程（针对无旋运动）推导瞬态时间关联函数表达式。

papers.title: Theory of fracture initiation and propagation in viscoelastic media
papers.abstract: Crack initiation and propagation are fundamental problems in materials science, often leading to catastrophic failure. While fracture in elastic solids occurs instantaneously above a critical load, viscoelastic materials may sustain high loads for a finite time before cracks start to propagate. This phenomenon, known as delayed fracture, has been widely observed experimentally but is still only partially understood theoretically. In this study, we present a rigorous framework based on the Lagrange--d'Alembert principle of virtual work (PVW) to predict both the viscoelastic delay time and the subsequent crack evolution under arbitrary loading histories. We derive how the delay time depends on the applied remote load and validate the theory through quantitative comparison with experiments, using directly measured delay times together with DMA-based viscoelastic characterization of the material. Very good agreement is obtained over a broad range of loading and delay times. Our results also show that crack propagation starts at finite speed and that load-dependent steady-state conditions are soon established. Finite element analyses further support the proposed framework and clarify the role of finite-ranged adhesion forces at fixed adhesion energy, showing that shorter interaction ranges yield results in quantitative agreement with theory. We also present, for the first time, a rigorous J-integral formulation valid for linear viscoelastic solids under arbitrary, time-varying loading histories. The result restores path independence and yields a generalized Griffith criterion that naturally predicts delayed fracture initiation in non-conservative materials. Remarkably, fracture initiation can be described without specifying the detailed stress distribution within the process zone, as long as it remains small relative to the crack length.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：基于 Lagrange-d’Alembert 虚功原理（PVW）建立理论框架，并通过与实验定量对比验证理论，同时辅以有限元分析（FEA）支持。；研究对象：粘弹性介质中的裂纹萌生与扩展现象，特别是延迟断裂（delayed fracture）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个严格的理论框架，能够预测粘弹性材料在任意加载历史下的延迟时间及后续裂纹演化，并首次建立了适用于线性粘弹性固体的路径无关 J 积分，推广了 Griffith 准则，从而自然解释了非保守材料中的延迟断裂起始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个严格的理论框架，能够预测粘弹性材料在任意加载历史下的延迟时间及后续裂纹演化，并首次建立了适用于线性粘弹性固体的路径无关 J 积分，推广了 Griffith 准则，从而自然解释了非保守材料中的延迟断裂起始。；创新点：首次给出了适用于任意时变加载历史的线性粘弹性固体的严格 J 积分公式，恢复了路径无关性，并由此得到广义 Griffith 准则，能够预测延迟断裂起始，且无需详细描述过程区内的应力分布（只要过程区尺寸远小于裂纹长度）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导基于 Lagrange-d’Alembert 虚功原理；实验验证采用直接测量的延迟时间与基于 DMA（动态力学分析）的粘弹性表征；数值分析采用有限元方法（FEA），并考虑了有限范围粘附力与固定粘附能的作用。

papers.title: High-Pressure XRD Study of Ti-3Al-2.5V Titanium Alloy: Intermediate Transition Pressure and Composition Trends in Ti-Al-V Alloys
papers.abstract: High-pressure X-ray diffraction experiments were performed on Ti-Al-V alloys to investigate the effect of composition on structural stability, focusing on Ti-3Al-2.5V and comparing with pure Titanium and Ti-6Al-4V. Measurements using different pressure-transmitting media show a phase transition in Ti-3Al-2.5V at 17-19 GPa, intermediate between pure Ti (5-10 GPa) and Ti-6Al-4V (~30 GPa). Despite variations arising from the choice of pressure medium, the transition pressure shows a clear and systematic increase with higher Al and V content. Equation-of-state analysis indicates that the bulk modulus remains nearly unchanged across compositions. This suggests a decoupling between elastic properties and phase stability, with alloying primarily affecting the transition pressure rather than compressibility. These results highlight the role of composition in tuning high-pressure phase transformations in Ti-Al-V based alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：High-pressure X-ray diffraction experiments（高压X射线衍射实验）、measurements（测量）。；研究对象：Ti-Al-V合金（具体为Ti-3Al-2.5V、Ti-6Al-4V及纯钛）在高压下的结构稳定性与相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ti-3Al-2.5V的相变压力（17-19 GPa）介于纯钛（5-10 GPa）与Ti-6Al-4V（约30 GPa）之间，且随Al和V含量增加而系统性地升高；但体弹模量几乎不随成分变化，表明弹性性质与相稳定性存在解耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ti-3Al-2.5V的相变压力（17-19 GPa）介于纯钛（5-10 GPa）与Ti-6Al-4V（约30 GPa）之间，且随Al和V含量增加而系统性地升高；但体弹模量几乎不随成分变化，表明弹性性质与相稳定性存在解耦。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高压X射线衍射（XRD）实验，使用不同压力传递介质进行测量，并结合状态方程（Equation-of-State）分析。

papers.title: Nodal Topological Superconductivity Driven by Crystalline Antiunitary Symmetry in Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Topological superconductivity hosts protected quasiparticles and is central to topological quantum computation, yet its realization in intrinsic materials remains challenging and often relies on engineered platforms. Here we uncover a symmetry-constrained mechanism for nodal topological superconductivity in altermagnets. Focusing on fourfold rotational collinear altermagnets, we show that the native crystalline antiunitary symmetry $\mathcal{T}C_{4z}$ generically forbids pure spin-singlet pairing and selects pairing structures that admit Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) Hamiltonians with emergent chiral symmetries. These symmetries further give rise to robust nodal topological phases over broad parameter regimes, including a nodal-point phase hosting Majorana flat bands (MFBs) and two distinct nodal-loop phases with chiral Majorana edge states. Notably, the nodal structure persists even after spontaneous breaking of the antiunitary symmetry, indicating that the topology originates from symmetry-constrained pairing rather than direct symmetry protection. Finally, we propose tunneling signatures that can distinguish these nodal phases and probe symmetry breaking experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we uncover”“we show”“we propose”等理论推导与机制分析表述，未提及实验手段或计算模拟。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中的节点拓扑超导态，具体聚焦于具有四重旋转对称性的共线交变磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁体中的晶体反幺正对称性 \(\mathcal{T}C_{4z}\) 强制禁止纯自旋单态配对，并选择出具有手征对称性的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）哈密顿量，从而在宽参数范围内产生稳健的节点拓扑相，包括具有马约拉纳平带的节点点相和两种具有手征马约拉纳边缘态的节点环相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁体中的晶体反幺正对称性 \(\mathcal{T}C_{4z}\) 强制禁止纯自旋单态配对，并选择出具有手征对称性的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）哈密顿量，从而在宽参数范围内产生稳健的节点拓扑相，包括具有马约拉纳平带的节点点相和两种具有手征马约拉纳边缘态的节点环相。；创新点：揭示了交变磁体中由晶体反幺正对称性驱动的节点拓扑超导机制，指出拓扑源于对称性约束的配对结构而非直接的对称性保护，并提出了通过隧穿谱实验区分不同节点相及探测对称性破缺的方案。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析与拓扑能带理论框架，具体包括：基于晶体反幺正对称性 \(\mathcal{T}C_{4z}\) 的配对结构约束分析、BdG 哈密顿量的手征对称性推导、节点拓扑相的分类与边缘态计算。

papers.title: Layer thickness dependent band gap of MBE grown single- to few-layer MoS$_{2}$
papers.abstract: In light of the rise of transition metal dichalcogenides as 2D semiconductors for device applications, band engineering becomes very important from an application point of view. In many of these materials, such as the canonical example of MoS$_{2}$, the semiconductor band gap depends on the layer number. It changes from indirect to direct as it evolves from a bulk semiconductor to a monolayer. Interestingly, it was predicted and experimentally confirmed that, by thinning the material from bulk to a bilayer, the indirect transition shows a strong blue-shift. Here, we present the results of scanning tunnelling spectroscopy measurements on MoS$_{2}$ that has been grown \textit{in situ} via molecular beam epitaxy on graphene on Ir(111) at thicknesses ranging from 1 to 5 layers. We find a drastic decrease of the band gap with increasing layer number, to values even below the band gap in bulk. We also observe that the pinning of the conduction band vanishes above 4 layers. Comparing our experimental data with density functional theory and \textit{GW} calculations indicates that an additional screening is introduced by the sample growth conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunnelling spectroscopy measurements、molecular beam epitaxy、in situ growth）；研究对象：单层到少层（1-5层）MoS₂的层数依赖带隙变化，具体为分子束外延（MBE）在Ir(111)上石墨烯衬底生长的MoS₂薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着MoS₂层数增加，带隙急剧减小，甚至低于体相MoS₂的带隙；同时，当层数超过4层时，导带钉扎效应消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着MoS₂层数增加，带隙急剧减小，甚至低于体相MoS₂的带隙；同时，当层数超过4层时，导带钉扎效应消失。；创新点：发现MBE生长的MoS₂带隙随层数增加而减小的幅度比预期更大（低于体相带隙），并指出样品生长条件引入了额外的屏蔽效应，这与传统剥离或机械解理样品的层数依赖行为不同。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道谱（STS）测量；样品通过分子束外延（MBE）在Ir(111)上的石墨烯衬底原位生长；实验数据与密度泛函理论（DFT）及GW计算进行对比。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Geometry of two-dimensional square-well fluids
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic geometry of two-dimensional fluids has been investigated using a square-well model as a prototype fluid. A comparison with the three-dimensional case is performed in the subcritical and supercritical domains of thermodynamic space. In the subcritical region, it is found that the R-crossing method has a narrower range of validity for two-dimensional fluids compared to three-dimensional ones. On the other hand, in the supercritical region, an analysis of different Widom lines, including the R Widom line, shows that for two-dimensional fluids these lines extend further into the supercritical region than their three-dimensional counterparts. A similar behavior is observed for the validity of the Clausius--Clapeyron equation in two-dimensional fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic geometry（热力学几何）、square-well model（方阱模型）、analysis（分析）。；研究对象：二维方阱流体（two-dimensional square-well fluids）的热力学几何性质，并与三维方阱流体进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在亚临界区域，二维流体的R-crossing方法适用范围比三维流体更窄；在超临界区域，二维流体的Widom线（包括R Widom线）比三维流体延伸得更远，且Clausius-Clapeyron方程在二维流体中的有效性也表现出类似行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在亚临界区域，二维流体的R-crossing方法适用范围比三维流体更窄；在超临界区域，二维流体的Widom线（包括R Widom线）比三维流体延伸得更远，且Clausius-Clapeyron方程在二维流体中的有效性也表现出类似行为。；创新点：系统比较了二维与三维方阱流体在亚临界和超临界区域的热力学几何行为差异，揭示了二维流体中R-crossing方法适用范围更窄、Widom线延伸更远等新特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用方阱模型作为原型流体，通过热力学几何（thermodynamic geometry）框架进行分析，具体包括R-crossing方法、Widom线分析以及Clausius-Clapeyron方程的有效性检验，并与三维情况进行对比。

papers.title: OpenAaaS: An Open Agent-as-a-Service Framework for Distributed Materials-Informatics Research
papers.abstract: The Materials Genome Initiative catalyzed the proliferation of centralized platforms--SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS--that aggregate computational and experimental resources for accelerated materials discovery. In parallel, breakthroughs in large language models (LLMs) and autonomous agents have created powerful new reasoning capabilities for scientific research. Yet a critical "last mile" problem remains: while we possess world-class models and vast repositories of materials data, we lack the organizational infrastructure to compose these capabilities securely across institutional boundaries. The development of structural and functional materials for harsh service environments--high-temperature alloys, radiation resistant steels, corrosion-resistant coatings--remains characterized by long-term iteration, mechanistic complexity, and high domain expertise--demands that exceed both monolithic agent systems and traditional centralized platforms. To address this gap we propose OpenAaaS, an open-source hierarchical and distributed Agent-as-a-Service framework that enables organized multi-agent collaboration for intelligent materials design. OpenAaaS is built on a single foundational principle: code flows, data stays still. A Master Agent plans and decomposes complex research tasks without requiring direct access to subordinate agents' managed data and computational resources. Sub-agents, deployed as near-data execution nodes, retain full sovereignty over local datasets, proprietary algorithms, and specialized hardware. This architecture guarantees that raw data never leaves its domain of origin while enabling cross-scale, cross-domain secure integration of previously isolated materials intelligence silos. We validate the framework through two representative case studies: (i) AlphaAgent, an evidence-grounded materials literature analysis executor that achieves 4.66/5.0 on deep analytical questions against single-pass RAG baselines; and (ii) an ultra-large-scale hexa-high-entropy alloy descriptor database service that demonstrates secure near-data execution and domain-specific scientific workflows under strict data-sovereignty constraints. OpenAaaS establishes a principled pathway toward "organized research" via agent collectives, offering a scalable foundation for next-generation materials intelligent design platforms. All source code is available at https://github.com/Wolido/OpenAaaS.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（框架设计与案例验证）。关键词：Agent-as-a-Service framework、case studies、literature analysis、descriptor database service。；研究对象：材料信息学中的分布式智能设计框架，具体案例涉及高熵合金描述符数据库服务及材料文献分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出OpenAaaS开源框架，通过“代码流动、数据静止”原则实现跨机构、跨域的材料智能安全集成，在文献分析任务中达到4.66/5.0的深度分析评分，并成功构建超大规模六元高熵合金描述符数据库服务。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出OpenAaaS开源框架，通过“代码流动、数据静止”原则实现跨机构、跨域的材料智能安全集成，在文献分析任务中达到4.66/5.0的深度分析评分，并成功构建超大规模六元高熵合金描述符数据库服务。；创新点：首次提出面向材料信息学的开源分层分布式Agent协作框架，解决“最后一公里”问题——即跨机构安全组合大语言模型与材料数据的能力，并实现数据主权保障下的多智能体协同。
papers.method_zh: 采用分层分布式Agent-as-a-Service架构：Master Agent负责任务分解与规划，Sub-agent作为近数据执行节点保留数据与计算资源主权。验证方法包括：①AlphaAgent文献分析执行器（对比单次RAG基线）；②超大规模高熵合金描述符数据库服务（演示严格数据主权约束下的近数据执行与科学工作流）。

papers.title: Magnetocaloric Effect in Nanostructured $La_{0.6}Sr_{0.4}Fe_{1-x}Co_{x}O_3$
papers.abstract: This work presents a systematic study of the magnetocaloric effect in the nanostructured perovskite series $La_{0.6}Sr_{0.4}Fe_{1-x}Co_{x}O_3$ (x = 0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, and 1.0), synthesized by a pore-wetting method using polymeric membranes with pore diameters of 200 nm and 800 nm. All samples were calcined at 1000°C. Structural characterization was made by X-ray diffraction and confirmed the formation of a single-phase perovskite with distorted rhombohedral symmetry, without detectable secondary phases. We observed significant influence of substitution of Fe by Co on the morphology, as the analysis by scanning electron microscopy revealed a clear evolution from smaller to larger particles and from thin to thicker nanotubes, as the Co content increased. Magnetic measurements showed that the cationic substitution enhances ferromagnetic coupling, increasing both the saturation magnetization (MS) and the Curie temperature (TC). The magnetocaloric properties, determined through the Maxwell relations, exhibit a maximum entropy change of 1.13 J/(kg K) under an applied field of 3 T for the sample with x = 1. These results demonstrate that the combination of Co doping and controlled nanostructuring effectively optimizes the magnetocaloric response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesized by a pore-wetting method”“structural characterization was made by X-ray diffraction”“magnetic measurements”等实验合成与表征手段。；研究对象：纳米结构钙钛矿系列材料 \(La_{0.6}Sr_{0.4}Fe_{1-x}Co_{x}O_3\)（x = 0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0）的磁热效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Co掺杂增强了铁磁耦合，提高了饱和磁化强度和居里温度；在x=1样品、3 T外加磁场下，最大熵变达到1.13 J/(kg K)，表明Co掺杂与纳米结构调控可有效优化磁热响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Co掺杂增强了铁磁耦合，提高了饱和磁化强度和居里温度；在x=1样品、3 T外加磁场下，最大熵变达到1.13 J/(kg K)，表明Co掺杂与纳米结构调控可有效优化磁热响应。；创新点：系统研究了Co掺杂与纳米结构（不同孔径膜及纳米管形貌演变）对 \(La_{0.6}Sr_{0.4}Fe_{1-x}Co_{x}O_3\) 系列材料磁热效应的协同优化作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用孔径为200 nm和800 nm的聚合物膜通过孔润湿法合成样品，1000°C煅烧；使用X射线衍射进行结构表征，扫描电子显微镜观察形貌，通过磁性测量确定饱和磁化强度和居里温度，并利用麦克斯韦关系计算磁热效应（熵变）。

papers.title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis theorem from gauge constraints
papers.abstract: We construct a $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge theory coupled to matter on a one-dimensional chain, aiming to study the ground-state physics in the Gauss law subspace. We show that the theory in the Gauss law subspace has a U$(1)$ symmetry whose generator commutes with lattice translations, but anticommutes with the lattice reflection operator. This leads to a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem that always rules out a trivial gapped ground state in the Gauss law subspace, if the hamiltonian is invariant under translations and reflection. Any point in the parameter space must realize a either a spontaneously symmetry broken (SSB) ground state, or a gapless ground state. Imposing the Gauss law is pivotal for the existence of the U$(1)$ symmetry, and hence of the LSM theorem. We thus demonstrate a novel mechanism to obtain an LSM-type theorem, wherein the symmetry responsible for the theorem originates from the kinematic constraints of a gauge theory. We identify a point in the parameter space at which the system is gapless. At the gapless point, the excitations admit a description in terms of free Dirac fermions with a constraint on the total fermion number. The asymptotic behavior of the two-point correlation function of the simplest local gauge-invariant quantity at the gapless point is found to be $ \propto \cos{(πr)}\,r^{-2/9}$, where $r$ is the lattice separation between the two points. This model is also a natural platform to study phase diagram topological defects residing in families of SSB phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：gauge theory（规范理论）、Gauss law subspace（高斯定律子空间）、LSM theorem（Lieb-Schultz-Mattis定理）。；研究对象：一维链上耦合物质的 $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$ 规范理论，以及该理论在高斯定律子空间中的基态物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高斯定律子空间中，系统存在一个U(1)对称性，该对称性与平移和反射对称性共同导致了一个Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）定理，排除了平凡有能隙基态的存在，系统必须处于自发对称性破缺（SSB）态或无间隙态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高斯定律子空间中，系统存在一个U(1)对称性，该对称性与平移和反射对称性共同导致了一个Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）定理，排除了平凡有能隙基态的存在，系统必须处于自发对称性破缺（SSB）态或无间隙态。；创新点：提出了一种获得LSM型定理的新机制：该定理所依赖的对称性并非来自哈密顿量的显式对称性，而是源于规范理论运动学约束（高斯定律）所诱导的U(1)对称性。摘要未突出说明该机制与已有LSM定理实现方式的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 通过构造一维 $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$ 规范理论，分析高斯定律约束下的对称性结构（U(1)对称性及其与平移、反射算符的对易/反对易关系），推导LSM定理。在无间隙点，利用自由狄拉克费米子描述激发，并计算局域规范不变量的两点关联函数的渐近行为（$\propto \cos(\pi r) r^{-2/9}$）。

papers.title: Anisotropic Dopant and Strain Architectures in WS$_2$ Nanocrystals Driven by Growth Kinetics
papers.abstract: Dopant distribution in two-dimensional semiconductors is typically assumed to be stochastic, limiting deterministic defect engineering. Here, we show that non-equilibrium growth kinetics can be harnessed to define dopant-driven strain architectures in vanadium-doped WS$_2$ monolayers. Using synchrotron X-ray fluorescence, we identify preferential vanadium incorporation, anti-correlated with tungsten content, along crystallographic bisectors. An adsorption-growth-diffusion model with a single kinetic parameter quantitatively captures the dopant segregation arising from preferential corner adsorption and limited diffusion during chemical vapor deposition growth. Hyperspectral Raman imaging demonstrates mechanically induced vibrational responses, revealing localized tensile strain ($\varepsilon \approx0.70\%$) channels associated with the anisotropic dopant distribution. This regime is marked by the depletion of W-site-sensitive in-plane modes and the emergence of a localized $J2$ mode (210~cm$^{-1}$), which our ab-initio calculations attribute to antiphase V$-$V oscillations. These findings establish kinetic segregation as a route to deterministic chemical and strain architectures in 2D semiconductors, enabling programmable defect landscapes and strain engineering during synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“synchrotron X-ray fluorescence”、“hyperspectral Raman imaging”、“ab-initio calculations”。；研究对象：钒掺杂WS₂单层纳米晶体中，由非平衡生长动力学驱动的各向异性掺杂剂分布及其引发的应变结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控化学气相沉积生长动力学，可在二维半导体中实现掺杂剂沿晶向择优分布，并由此产生局域拉伸应变通道（ε≈0.70%），从而突破传统随机掺杂的局限，实现确定性缺陷工程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控化学气相沉积生长动力学，可在二维半导体中实现掺杂剂沿晶向择优分布，并由此产生局域拉伸应变通道（ε≈0.70%），从而突破传统随机掺杂的局限，实现确定性缺陷工程。；创新点：揭示了非平衡生长动力学（而非热力学平衡）可作为在二维半导体中实现确定性化学和应变架构的路径，使合成过程中即可编程缺陷分布与应变工程。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射X射线荧光光谱（确定V与W含量反相关分布）、吸附-生长-扩散模型（单一动力学参数定量描述掺杂偏析）、高光谱拉曼成像（探测机械诱导振动响应）、第一性原理计算（归因于反相V-V振荡的J2模式）。

papers.title: Singular spin fluctuations in the strange-metal phase of La2-xSrxCuO4
papers.abstract: Although spin fluctuations are central to the physics of high-Tc cuprates, their relevance to strange-metal behavior in the overdoped regime remains unclear. Here, we use high magnetic fields to suppress superconductivity and an NMR protocol tailored to electronic inhomogeneity to show that the low-energy limit of the dynamical spin susceptibility χ''(q,omega) at x=0.25 in La2-xSrxCuO4 increases continuously down to our lowest temperatures. This behavior is suggestive of quantum-critical fluctuations, a leading candidate mechanism for strange-metal transport, yet is observed well beyond the spin-stripe critical doping x=0.19. Our data further reveal that the spin dynamics are spatially inhomogeneous, suggesting that nanoscale electronic inhomogeneity may underlie this apparent paradox. These observations provide new insight into the electronic state from which strange-metal behavior emerges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“high magnetic fields”、“NMR protocol”、“data reveal”。；研究对象：过掺杂铜氧化物高温超导体La₂₋ₓSrₓCuO₄（x=0.25）中的奇异金属相及其自旋涨落行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在过掺杂区（x=0.25），低能动态自旋磁化率χ''(q,ω)随温度降低持续增大，表现出量子临界涨落特征，但该行为出现在远高于自旋条纹临界掺杂（x=0.19）的区域；同时自旋动力学在空间上不均匀，暗示纳米尺度电子不均匀性可能是这一表观悖论的原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在过掺杂区（x=0.25），低能动态自旋磁化率χ''(q,ω)随温度降低持续增大，表现出量子临界涨落特征，但该行为出现在远高于自旋条纹临界掺杂（x=0.19）的区域；同时自旋动力学在空间上不均匀，暗示纳米尺度电子不均匀性可能是这一表观悖论的原因。；创新点：首次在过掺杂区（x=0.25）观测到类似量子临界自旋涨落的行为，而该区域传统上被认为远离自旋条纹量子临界点，并揭示空间不均匀性可能是理解这一矛盾的关键。
papers.method_zh: 利用强磁场抑制超导电性，并采用针对电子不均匀性设计的核磁共振（NMR）测量方案，探测低能动态自旋磁化率。

papers.title: Cryogenic microwave frequency combs based on quantum paraelectric superconducting resonators
papers.abstract: A frequency comb, known for its precision as an "optical ruler", features an evenly spaced spectral pattern. While these combs are vital in photonic quantum technologies, their microwave counterparts are now highly sought after for cryogenic quantum technologies, including semiconducting and superconducting qubits and quantum electrical metrology, which mainly operate in the microwave regime. However, microwave combs are still largely underexplored, and typically rely on complex, high-power optical systems incompatible with the low-power, cryogenic on-chip quantum technologies. In this manuscript, we present an all-electrical, on-chip, cryogenic microwave frequency comb on Strontium Titanate (SrTiO$_3$), exploiting its Pockels-like effect in its quantum paraelectric phase. Our device, utilizing a superconducting microwave cavity, generating the frequency comb via cavity phase modulation enabled by the field-induced effective $χ(2)$ of SrTiO$_3$. The ability to continuously vary the dielectric constant of SrTiO$_3$ by the application of electric field, in its quantum paraelectric phase, makes it possible to control the comb's operating frequency range. The exceptionally high dielectric constant of SrTiO$_3$, > 20,000 in its quantum paraelectric state, enables an ultra-miniature design and on-chip integration with cryogenic quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“present an all-electrical, on-chip, cryogenic microwave frequency comb”，并涉及器件制备与测试（如利用超导微波腔、施加电场等）。；研究对象：基于钛酸锶（SrTiO₃）量子顺电相的超导微波谐振器，以及在该体系中实现的微波频率梳。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用SrTiO₃在量子顺电相下的场致有效χ(2)非线性效应，通过超导微波腔的相位调制，首次实现了全电学、片上、低温微波频率梳，且其工作频率范围可通过电场连续调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用SrTiO₃在量子顺电相下的场致有效χ(2)非线性效应，通过超导微波腔的相位调制，首次实现了全电学、片上、低温微波频率梳，且其工作频率范围可通过电场连续调控。；创新点：首次在低温量子顺电材料中实现全电学、片上集成的微波频率梳，避免了传统微波梳依赖复杂高功率光学系统的局限，且利用SrTiO₃的超高介电常数实现了超小型化设计，与低温量子技术（如超导量子比特）兼容。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：制备基于SrTiO₃的超导微波谐振器，利用其Pockels类效应（场致有效χ(2））实现腔相位调制，从而产生频率梳；通过施加电场连续改变SrTiO₃的介电常数（>20,000）来调控梳齿的工作频率范围。

papers.title: Phase Ordering in a few O(n) Symmetric Models: Slow Growth, Mpemba Effect and Experimental Relevance
papers.abstract: We study phase ordering dynamics in the three-dimensional nonconserved XY model, via Monte Carlo simulations, for quenches from paramagnetic phase to certain final temperatures $T_f$ within the ferromagnetic region of the phase diagram. The growth in the system occurs via annihilation of vortex and anti-vortex pairs, cores of which, in the three dimensional system geometry, join from different planes, on which the spins lie, to form line defects. In the long-time limit, the associated characteristic length scale, $\ell(t)$, appears to grow with time $(t)$ approximately as $t^{0.15}$, for $T_f=0$. The exponent is much smaller, like in the zero temperature intermediate time ordering in the three dimensional Ising model, than $1/2$, the expected value, that is realized for quenches to $T_f$ value that is sufficiently larger than zero. We carry out quenches from different starting temperatures, $T_s$, that lie above the critical temperature $T_c$. It is observed that the systems with higher $T_s$ approach the final equilibrium faster. This resembles the puzzling Mpemba effect. We present similar results also from the simulations of the two- and three- dimensional Ising model. In the case of the 2D Ising model, we show that the Mpemba effect is observed only if the starting magnetization is restricted to a value close to zero. In $d=3$, on the other hand, for both the models, the effect appears even if the initial configurations at a given $T_s$ are chosen from the full distribution of magnetization. Thus, our results are of much experimental relevance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、数值模拟）；研究对象：三维非守恒XY模型、二维及三维Ising模型中的相序动力学（phase ordering dynamics），以及Mpemba效应（即高温系统比低温系统更快达到平衡的反常现象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维非守恒XY模型中，淬火至零温时特征长度标度指数约为0.15，远小于预期值1/2；且从更高起始温度淬火时系统更快达到平衡，呈现Mpemba效应。该效应在二维Ising模型中仅当起始磁化接近零时出现，而在三维Ising和XY模型中即使从完整磁化分布中选取初始构型也能观察到。
