papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维非守恒XY模型中，淬火至零温时特征长度标度指数约为0.15，远小于预期值1/2；且从更高起始温度淬火时系统更快达到平衡，呈现Mpemba效应。该效应在二维Ising模型中仅当起始磁化接近零时出现，而在三维Ising和XY模型中即使从完整磁化分布中选取初始构型也能观察到。；创新点：首次在三维非守恒XY模型中系统研究淬火至不同终温时的生长指数，并揭示Mpemba效应在三维Ising和XY模型中的普遍性及其对维度和初始磁化分布的依赖性，指出其实验可观测性。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟，对三维非守恒XY模型从顺磁相淬火至铁磁区内不同终温T_f，并分析涡旋-反涡旋对湮灭导致的畴生长动力学；同时模拟二维和三维Ising模型，比较不同起始温度T_s下的弛豫行为。

papers.title: Probing Floquet topological phases via non-Hermitian skin effect of reflected waves
papers.abstract: Periodically driven systems host topological phases without static analogs, such as the anomalous Floquet phase characterized by trivial bulk bands yet robust boundary modes. In this work, we investigate the scattering problem of a Floquet Chern insulator and reveal the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) of reflected waves. Using a discrete-time scattering formalism, we demonstrate how the non-Hermitian winding number of the reflection matrix is linked to the bulk Floquet invariant via boundary resonances. This reflected-wave NHSE relies on which quasienergy gap the incident wave resides in, leading to a gap-dependent Goos-Hänchen (GH) shift. We further show that the momentum-integrated GH shift quantitatively yields the Floquet topological invariant of the corresponding gap. Our work highlights a frequency-dependent NHSE of reflected waves in driven systems and provides a real-space scattering approach to identify non-equilibrium topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate the scattering problem”“using a discrete-time scattering formalism”“demonstrate how...is linked to...”，属于理论推导与形式化分析。；研究对象：Floquet 拓扑绝缘体中的散射问题，具体为反射波的非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）及其与 Floquet 拓扑相（如反常 Floquet 相）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反射波的非厄米趋肤效应依赖于入射波所处的准能隙，并导致能隙依赖的 Goos-Hänchen 位移；动量积分的 Goos-Hänchen 位移可定量给出对应能隙的 Floquet 拓扑不变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反射波的非厄米趋肤效应依赖于入射波所处的准能隙，并导致能隙依赖的 Goos-Hänchen 位移；动量积分的 Goos-Hänchen 位移可定量给出对应能隙的 Floquet 拓扑不变量。；创新点：揭示了驱动系统中反射波的频率依赖非厄米趋肤效应，并提出了一种基于实空间散射方法（real-space scattering approach）来识别非平衡拓扑相的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用离散时间散射形式（discrete-time scattering formalism），通过分析反射矩阵的非厄米缠绕数（non-Hermitian winding number）与边界共振（boundary resonances）的关系，建立反射波 NHSE 与体 Floquet 不变量的联系。

papers.title: Metastable Hyperuniformity at Discontinuous Absorbing Transitions
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium hyperuniformity can arise either as a steady-state property of driven active fluids or as a critical signature at continuous absorbing transition points in two and three dimensions. Whether analogous structural order exists near discontinuous absorbing transitions, and what mechanism generates it, remains unclear. Here, we show that discontinuous absorbing transitions generically host a metastable hyperuniform regime near the stability limit. Using a facilitated Manna model without center-of-mass conservation, we find anomalous scaling $S(k\to0)\sim k^{1.2}$, which appears only near the metastable regime and disappears both deep in the active phase and in the absorbing phase. This scaling is robust in both two and three dimensions, in contrast to critical hyperuniformity at continuous absorbing transitions. We further formulate a minimal conserved Reggeon field theory that reproduces the same metastable hyperuniform regime and anomalous scaling, demonstrating that the phenomenon does not rely on microscopic update rules but arises from the interplay of nonlinear activation, multiplicative demographic noise, and conserved diffusive fluctuations. These results identify metastable hyperuniformity as a generic pseudo-critical structural signature of discontinuous absorbing transitions coupled to a conserved density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：理论分析、数值模拟（facilitated Manna model）、场论构建（Reggeon field theory）。；研究对象：非平衡超均匀性（hyperuniformity）在不连续吸收相变（discontinuous absorbing transitions）中的表现，特别是与守恒密度耦合的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不连续吸收相变在稳定性极限附近普遍存在一个亚稳态超均匀（metastable hyperuniform）区域，表现出反常标度行为 \( S(k\to0)\sim k^{1.2} \)，该行为在二维和三维中均稳健存在，且不同于连续吸收相变中的临界超均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不连续吸收相变在稳定性极限附近普遍存在一个亚稳态超均匀（metastable hyperuniform）区域，表现出反常标度行为 \( S(k\to0)\sim k^{1.2} \)，该行为在二维和三维中均稳健存在，且不同于连续吸收相变中的临界超均匀性。；创新点：首次揭示不连续吸收相变中普遍存在亚稳态超均匀性，并证明其源于非线性激活、乘性人口噪声与守恒扩散涨落的相互作用，而非微观更新规则，从而将超均匀性从临界现象推广到伪临界（pseudo-critical）结构特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用无质心守恒的促进型Manna模型（facilitated Manna model）进行数值模拟，并构建最小守恒Reggeon场论（minimal conserved Reggeon field theory）进行理论分析，以解释亚稳态超均匀性的起源。

papers.title: Correlation-driven tunability of altermagnetism in RuO$_2$
papers.abstract: RuO$_2$ has been regarded as a prototypical candidate for metallic altermagnet, offering a potential platform for high-speed and high-efficiency spintronics. However, the magnetic ground state of RuO$_2$ remains a topic of active debate due to conflicting experimental reports. In this work, we investigate the effect of electron correlations in RuO$_2$ using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT). In contrast to previous DFT-based studies, DFT+DMFT captures essential dynamical correlation effects, yielding spectral functions and optical conductivities in excellent quantitative agreement with experiments, and further reveals that RuO$_2$ resides in the close vicinity of both the paramagnetic-altermagnetic phase boundary and the itinerant-localized crossover, rendering the magnetic ground state highly susceptible to external perturbations. Indeed, even a minimal compressive strain of $\sim$0.5% is sufficient to drive the system into an altermagnetic phase. These findings elucidate the origin of the conflicting experimental observations and reveal that dynamical correlation effects are the key driving force behind the highly tunable magnetic ground state of RuO$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT+DMFT、密度泛函理论、动力学平均场理论）；研究对象：金属性交变磁体候选材料RuO₂的磁性基态及其可调性
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联效应使RuO₂处于顺磁-交变磁相边界和巡游-局域化交叉区域，导致其磁性基态对外界扰动高度敏感，仅约0.5%的微小压缩应变即可驱动系统进入交变磁相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联效应使RuO₂处于顺磁-交变磁相边界和巡游-局域化交叉区域，导致其磁性基态对外界扰动高度敏感，仅约0.5%的微小压缩应变即可驱动系统进入交变磁相。；创新点：首次通过DFT+DMFT捕获了RuO₂中关键的动力学关联效应，揭示了以往基于DFT的研究未能解释的磁性基态高度可调性，并阐明了实验观测矛盾的原因。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT），并与实验光谱函数和光学电导率进行定量对比。

papers.title: Emergence of information interference in stochastic systems with non-diagonal noise and switching environments
papers.abstract: Stochastic forces in natural systems are rarely isotropic. From hydrodynamically coupled colloids to chemical reaction networks, noise contributions are inherently correlated. Together with internal interactions and changing environments, they shape the dependencies between the degrees of freedom of real-world systems, as quantified by their mutual information. In this work, we focus on linearized stochastic systems with both non-diagonal noise matrices and stochastically switching environments. We study how their presence leads to the emergence of information interference, so that the total mutual information cannot be decomposed as the sum of the contributions from deterministic interactions, noise anisotropy, and environmental switching alone. We identify two distinct sources of information interference: a static term, arising from the simultaneous presence of deterministic coupling and noise anisotropy; and a dynamic term, emerging from the interplay between internal processes and environmental switches. We then apply this framework to different physical systems. In the presence of switching temperatures, the mutual information disentangles exactly into internal and environmental contributions. When the noise anisotropy arises instead from hydrodynamic interactions, we find that the presence of a shared fluid can either mask or enhance the information stemming from a non-conservative force depending on its degree of non-reciprocity. Finally, in a fuel-driven chemical reaction network, we show that information interference is controlled by the non-equilibrium driving. These results establish a general information-theoretic perspective on how anisotropic noise and environmental variability shape statistical dependencies in stochastic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：linearized stochastic systems、mutual information、information-theoretic perspective。；研究对象：具有非对角噪声矩阵和随机切换环境的线性化随机系统，具体应用于流体动力学耦合胶体、非保守力系统、燃料驱动化学反应网络等物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非对角噪声和随机切换环境共同作用下，随机系统的总互信息无法分解为确定性相互作用、噪声各向异性和环境切换各自贡献的简单和，而是产生“信息干涉”现象，其来源包括静态项（确定性耦合与噪声各向异性共存）和动态项（内部过程与环境切换的相互作用）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非对角噪声和随机切换环境共同作用下，随机系统的总互信息无法分解为确定性相互作用、噪声各向异性和环境切换各自贡献的简单和，而是产生“信息干涉”现象，其来源包括静态项（确定性耦合与噪声各向异性共存）和动态项（内部过程与环境切换的相互作用）。；创新点：首次从信息论角度系统揭示非对角噪声与随机切换环境共同导致的信息干涉机制，并区分其静态与动态来源，为理解各向异性噪声和环境变异性如何塑造随机系统的统计依赖性提供了统一视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用信息论框架，通过线性化随机系统的互信息分析，解析推导信息干涉的静态与动态来源，并应用于切换温度系统、流体动力学相互作用系统以及非平衡化学反应网络等具体物理模型。

papers.title: High-temperature behavior of amorphous alumina coatings: Insights from in-situ nanoindentation and X-ray diffraction studies
papers.abstract: Further development of nuclear power plant technology relies heavily on materials durability under operating conditions. Estimating the materials performance in the operando tests is crucial. In this paper, the mechanical behavior of thin amorphous nuclear-dedicated Al2O3 coatings deposited by pulsed laser deposition was investigated by nanoindentation over the temperature range of 25-650C. Experimental nanomechanical analysis was supported by MD simulations. The results indicate that the hardness of the amorphous coating experiences a gradual, constant decrease with temperature, while the Young modulus value remains constant in the whole temperature range. Observed phenomena confirm the increasing plasticity of the material and it is postulated to be related to the bond-switching mechanism that accelerates at high temperatures. The post-mortem transmission electron microscopy characterization confirmed that the loaded material was non-crystalline over the entire range of the indentation temperatures. The thermal stability of the structure was further studied in-situ up to 1050C by X-ray diffraction. The implemented methodology allowed us to follow the dynamic process of phase transitions occurring in the material above 650C. First, thermally activated crystallization was observed at 700C. Intermediate alumina phases were present up to 950C, while above this temperature, exclusively the thermodynamically stable alpha-Al2O3 was observed. The in-situ high-temperature characterization of the evolution of thin films boosts the understanding of the application limits of the coating systems at elevated temperatures. The added value is that the paper demonstrates the potential usefulness of combining high-temperature techniques to characterize the complete behavior of thin films at elevated temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：nanoindentation、X-ray diffraction、in-situ characterization、MD simulations辅助）；研究对象：非晶态Al₂O₃薄膜（通过脉冲激光沉积制备，用于核能领域）在高温下的力学行为与结构演变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶Al₂O₃涂层的硬度随温度升高持续下降，但杨氏模量在25-650°C范围内保持不变；材料在650°C以上发生相变，依次经历700°C热激活结晶、中间相氧化铝（至950°C）以及最终形成热力学稳定的α-Al₂O₃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶Al₂O₃涂层的硬度随温度升高持续下降，但杨氏模量在25-650°C范围内保持不变；材料在650°C以上发生相变，依次经历700°C热激活结晶、中间相氧化铝（至950°C）以及最终形成热力学稳定的α-Al₂O₃。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：变温纳米压痕（25-650°C）、原位X射线衍射（至1050°C）、透射电子显微镜（后分析）；计算辅助：分子动力学（MD）模拟。

papers.title: Beyond Explained Variance: A Cautionary Tale of PCA
papers.abstract: We address shortcomings of principal component analysis (PCA) for visualizing high-dimensional data lying on a nonlinear low-dimensional manifold via two-dimensional scatterplots, focusing on a fossil teeth dataset from the early mammalian insectivore Kuehneotherium. While the PCA scatterplot reported by Jolliffe and Cadima (Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A, 2016) shows clustering in the region where PC2 < 0, our analysis based on t-SNE and persistent homology (PH) reveals a ring-like structure with no evident clustering and intrinsic dimensionality equal to one. We further propose a generative probabilistic-geometric model in which the data are sampled uniformly from a unit circle. Under this model, pairwise cosine distances follow an arcsine distribution, in qualitative agreement with the observed U-shaped distribution, thereby independently supporting the analysis based on tt t-SNE and persistent homology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。关键词：PCA、t-SNE、persistent homology、generative probabilistic-geometric model。；研究对象：早期哺乳类食虫动物Kuehneotherium的化石牙齿数据集，属于高维非线性低维流形数据可视化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统PCA对该数据集的可视化（显示聚类）具有误导性；t-SNE与持续同调分析揭示数据实际呈环状结构且无聚类，本征维度为1。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统PCA对该数据集的可视化（显示聚类）具有误导性；t-SNE与持续同调分析揭示数据实际呈环状结构且无聚类，本征维度为1。；创新点：指出PCA解释方差指标在非线性流形数据可视化中的局限性，并通过独立生成模型验证了t-SNE与持续同调分析结果的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 对比PCA与t-SNE、持续同调（persistent homology）两种非线性降维/拓扑数据分析方法；提出生成式概率-几何模型（数据在单位圆上均匀采样），并推导成对余弦距离服从反正弦分布，与观测到的U形分布定性吻合。

papers.title: Quantifying information flow along a stochastic trajectory
papers.abstract: Stochastic information flow (SIF) quantifies information flow at the trajectory level, overcoming the limitations of conventional symmetric, ensemble-averaged measures. However, computational difficulties have hindered the empirical application of the SIF. In this work, we propose a scalable deep-learning method for estimating the SIF from general time-series data. Its applications to an exactly solvable two-particle model, Kuramoto oscillators, and empirical trajectories of interacting motile cells demonstrate the utility of SIF as a data-driven indicator of cooperative structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：deep-learning method、estimating、time-series data、data-driven indicator。；研究对象：随机轨迹中的信息流（stochastic information flow, SIF），具体应用于两粒子模型、Kuramoto振子以及相互运动的细胞实验轨迹。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种可扩展的深度学习方法，能够从一般时间序列数据中估计随机信息流（SIF），并证明SIF可作为合作结构的数据驱动指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种可扩展的深度学习方法，能够从一般时间序列数据中估计随机信息流（SIF），并证明SIF可作为合作结构的数据驱动指标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用可扩展的深度学习方法来估计SIF，并将其应用于精确可解的两粒子模型、Kuramoto振子模型以及相互运动的细胞实验轨迹。

papers.title: Theory of Rayleigh molecular light scattering by isotropic polar fluids revisited
papers.abstract: The molecular theory of Rayleigh light scattering in dense isotropic polar fluids is reconsidered by suitably adapting local field concepts of electrostatics to propagating electromagnetic waves, hence accounting for both the rotational and dipole-induced dipole (DID) contributions. Simple analytical equations are derived for the various Rayleigh ratios relevant to lateral light scattering in various situations, namely pure DID, pure rotations and mixed contributions. For pure DID, the derived Rayleigh ratios are entirely analytical and very simple, while for pure rotation, the use of rotational mean field approximation is justified, hence allowing the description of Rayleigh ratios in terms of a single orientational correlation parameter that is straightforwardly determined as a positive root of a quadratic algebraic equation. Simple expressions for the Rayleigh ratios are also derived in two mixed situations where DID dominates rotation and when rotation dominates DID. Relation to previous experimental and theoretical work is discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Theory”、“molecular theory”、“analytical equations”、“mean field approximation”。；研究对象：各向同性极性流体中瑞利分子光散射的物理现象，具体涉及旋转贡献和偶极-诱导偶极（DID）贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将静电学中的局域场概念适配到传播电磁波，推导出了纯DID、纯旋转以及混合贡献下各种瑞利比的简单解析表达式；在纯旋转情况下，通过旋转平均场近似，可将瑞利比描述为单个取向关联参数，该参数由二次代数方程的正根直接确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将静电学中的局域场概念适配到传播电磁波，推导出了纯DID、纯旋转以及混合贡献下各种瑞利比的简单解析表达式；在纯旋转情况下，通过旋转平均场近似，可将瑞利比描述为单个取向关联参数，该参数由二次代数方程的正根直接确定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用局域场概念处理传播电磁波，结合旋转平均场近似，推导出不同散射贡献下的瑞利比解析公式。

papers.title: Site-selective preparation of two-dimensional dipolar quantum gases in an optical beat-note lattice
papers.abstract: High-resolution microscopy of two-dimensional dipolar quantum gases requires selecting individual atomic layers, a task complicated for strongly magnetic lanthanide atoms by the limited applicability of standard magnetic-gradient techniques. We present an all-optical method for the deterministic spatial selection of single- and bilayer samples of cold dipolar atoms using spatially selective parametric heating within a beat-note superlattice. By utilizing a high-resolution microscope objective as a common retroreflector for both optical frequency components, the lattice planes are passively stabilized. This renders their positions exceptionally robust against experimental drifts and structure-borne vibrations, even eliminating the need for active laser stabilization over millimeter-scale separations from the reflecting surface. We validate this approach by demonstrating the robust isolation of one or two atomic layers in precise coincidence with the focal plane of our objective. This enables future single-atom-resolved studies of long-range interacting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：optical method, experimental validation, demonstration。；研究对象：二维偶极量子气体（具体为强磁性镧系原子，如镝或铒）的原子层选择与制备。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种全光学方法，利用拍频超晶格中的空间选择性参数加热，实现了对冷偶极原子单层和双层样品的确定性空间选择，且该方法对实验漂移和振动具有极高的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种全光学方法，利用拍频超晶格中的空间选择性参数加热，实现了对冷偶极原子单层和双层样品的确定性空间选择，且该方法对实验漂移和振动具有极高的鲁棒性。；创新点：该方法完全避免了传统磁梯度技术在强磁性镧系原子上应用的局限性，并且通过被动稳定晶格平面位置，消除了对主动激光稳频的需求，使得原子层位置在毫米级尺度上对实验漂移和结构振动具有极高的鲁棒性。摘要未明确说明与已有光学方法（如直接成像或光镊）相比的具体性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 全光学方法：使用高分辨率显微物镜作为两个光学频率分量的公共回射器，构建一个拍频超晶格。通过在该超晶格中施加空间选择性的参数加热，精确地移除不需要的原子层，从而在物镜焦平面处隔离出单层或双层原子。

papers.title: Space-Charge Effects in Silicon Reconfigurable Nonlinear-Processing Units
papers.abstract: Reconfigurable nonlinear-processing units (RNPUs) are multi-terminal electronic devices that act as computational primitives, exploiting intrinsic nonlinear charge transport combined with electrostatic tunability. Silicon-based realizations provide a scalable and technologically relevant platform, yet the physical origin of their room-temperature nonlinearity has remained insufficiently understood. Here, we investigate charge transport using temperature- and length-dependent current-voltage measurements on physical devices, complemented by drift-diffusion simulations, and show that transport is governed by space charge. Interface trap states strongly suppress the equilibrium carrier density, while the functional nonlinearity arises from the voltage-dependent competition between injected mobile carriers and fixed ionized background dopants. The resulting non-equilibrium transport exhibits a transition from an Ohmic regime to a strongly nonlinear regime, and ultimately to a velocity-saturation space-charge-limited current regime, as evidenced by the observed voltage and length scaling. We further show that background doping of opposite polarity to the injected carriers controls the onset and strength of the nonlinearity, leading to behavior exceeding the quadratic dependence of the classical Mott-Gurney law. Agreement between experiment and simulation supports that the spatial distribution of injected carriers and fixed charge governs the internal electric-field profile and device response. These results establish a physical framework for silicon-based RNPUs without requiring disorder or hopping transport, and provide design guidelines for reproducible, scalable, and CMOS-compatible implementations of nonlinear computing hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与模拟混合类型。判断依据：进行了温度依赖和长度依赖的电流-电压测量（实验），并结合了漂移-扩散模拟（计算）。；研究对象：硅基可重构非线性处理单元（RNPUs）中的空间电荷效应及其室温非线性输运机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅基RNPU的室温非线性输运由空间电荷主导，其非线性来源于注入载流子与固定电离背景掺杂之间的电压依赖竞争，而非无序或跳跃输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅基RNPU的室温非线性输运由空间电荷主导，其非线性来源于注入载流子与固定电离背景掺杂之间的电压依赖竞争，而非无序或跳跃输运。；创新点：首次揭示了硅基RNPU中室温非线性的物理起源是空间电荷效应，并指出背景掺杂的极性控制着非线性的起始与强度，可产生超越经典Mott-Gurney平方律的行为，为CMOS兼容的非线性计算硬件提供了设计准则。
papers.method_zh: 温度依赖和长度依赖的电流-电压（I-V）测量；漂移-扩散（drift-diffusion）数值模拟。

papers.title: Multiple Softening Q-vectors Driving a Cascade of CDW Phases in $\mathrm{1T-VSe}_{2}$
papers.abstract: Charge density wave (CDW) formation in two-dimensional materials is governed by complex competing lattice instabilities that remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigate the structural evolution of monolayer $\mathrm{1T-VSe}_{2}$ using first-principles electronic and phonon calculations. The pristine phase exhibits several imaginary-frequency phonon modes associated with dominant instability wave vectors $\mathrm{Q}_{CDW}$, which generate the first-generation CDW phases. Subsequent phonon analyses reveal that several of these intermediate structures remain dynamically unstable and undergo further symmetry-lowering distortions into larger superstructures. Through iterative phonon-driven relaxations, we identify multiple transformation pathways that converge toward the same low-energy $2\sqrt{3}\times4$ CDW configuration. Although these pathways originate from distinct intermediate CDW states, they ultimately reach nearly degenerate energetically stable phases, demonstrating that different phonon-driven routes can lead to the same ground-state configuration. The results establish a unified phonon-driven cascade mechanism for hierarchical CDW formation in monolayer $\mathrm{1T-VSe}_{2}$ and provide a systematic framework for understanding competing ordered phases in low-dimensional quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles electronic and phonon calculations、phonon-driven relaxations。；研究对象：单层1T-VSe₂中的电荷密度波（CDW）相变及其多级结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层1T-VSe₂中存在多个软化的声子模（Q_CDW），通过迭代声子驱动弛豫，揭示了从不同中间CDW相最终收敛到同一低能2√3×4超结构的级联相变机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层1T-VSe₂中存在多个软化的声子模（Q_CDW），通过迭代声子驱动弛豫，揭示了从不同中间CDW相最终收敛到同一低能2√3×4超结构的级联相变机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理电子结构计算与声子计算（first-principles electronic and phonon calculations），以及迭代声子驱动结构弛豫（iterative phonon-driven relaxations）。

papers.title: Magnetic fields in monoclinic $α$-RuCl$_3$ reveal rhombohedral inclusions underlying apparent oscillations
papers.abstract: The majority of research on $α$-RuCl$_3$ has focused on applying in-plane magnetic fields to suppress antiferromagnetic order and induce a quantum spin liquid (QSL). However, this effort has been complicated by the materials temperature-dependent crystal structure and sensitivity to strain-induced stacking disorder, making interpretation of field-induced phenomena contentious. The crystal structure of $α$-RuCl$_3$ has recently been clarified as a function of temperature and sample size, motivating a reassessment of its magnetic properties and connection to proposed spin-liquid signatures. Here, we show that the monoclinic structure can be isolated in nanogram-scale crystals, enabling the study of Kitaev physics in a new regime. We focus on a structurally well-defined monoclinic crystal at low temperature and perform high-resolution magnetotropic susceptibility measurements in several crystal planes. Mapping the AFM phase boundary versus temperature, field, and orientation, we find the monoclinic phase diagram closely resembles rhombohedral crystals but is systematically shifted to higher transition temperatures and critical fields. For $B \parallel a$, we observe a two-step suppression of AFM order, indicating an intermediate ordered phase analogous to the ZZ2 phase reported in rhombohedral samples. Our results show that transitions previously observed beyond the AFM regime under in-plane fields arise from multiple shifted AFM phase boundaries associated with monoclinic inclusions, rather than non-magnetic phases. These findings indicate that features attributed to a QSL are instead due to an incomplete transition from the high-temperature monoclinic to the low-temperature rhombohedral structure. They also highlight the role of structural symmetry and sample homogeneity in interpreting field-induced phenomena in $α$-RuCl$_3$ and related two-dimensional quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：high-resolution magnetotropic susceptibility measurements、mapping phase boundary、实验观测结果。；研究对象：单斜相α-RuCl₃晶体在低温下的磁性质，特别是其反铁磁相边界与量子自旋液体候选特征的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单斜α-RuCl₃的相图与菱方相类似，但相变温度和临界场系统性地更高；先前被认为与量子自旋液体相关的场致振荡现象，实际上源于单斜夹杂物导致的多个偏移反铁磁相边界，而非非磁性相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单斜α-RuCl₃的相图与菱方相类似，但相变温度和临界场系统性地更高；先前被认为与量子自旋液体相关的场致振荡现象，实际上源于单斜夹杂物导致的多个偏移反铁磁相边界，而非非磁性相。；创新点：通过将单斜结构隔离在纳克级晶体中，首次在结构明确单斜相中研究Kitaev物理，并揭示先前归因于量子自旋液体的特征实际上是单斜-菱方结构不完全转变的产物。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率磁致旋磁化率测量（magnetotropic susceptibility measurements），在不同晶面（多个晶体平面）进行，并结合温度、磁场和取向的相边界映射。

papers.title: From Film to Flakes: Electronic Properties and Magnetization Variations in Yttrium Iron Garnet
papers.abstract: Yttrium iron garnet (YIG) is a ferrimagnetic insulator valued for its high Curie temperature, very low magnetic damping, and ability to support long-range spin-wave transport. These qualities have established it as a cornerstone material in the field of spintronics and magnonics. Most studies on YIG so far have been focused on bulk crystals, thin films, and nanoparticles, including variants with substitutions at the yttrium or iron site. New morphologies such as sub-micron flakes have drawn interest recently as their geometry and mechanical flexibility might enable different device architectures. However, detailed investigations combining their electronic structure and magnetic behavior remain scarce. In this work, we present a comparative study of the electronic and magnetic properties of a bulk-like YIG film and a sub-micron-sized YIG flake. Our results highlight the distinct behavior that emerges in sub-micron dimensions and point toward future uses for flake-based YIG in compact spintronics devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提到“present a comparative study”（比较研究），并对比了薄膜与薄片的电子和磁性性质，属于实验测量与表征。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG）的亚微米薄片与块体薄膜，具体研究其电子结构和磁学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 亚微米尺寸的YIG薄片展现出与块体薄膜不同的电子和磁性行为，有望用于紧凑型自旋电子学器件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：亚微米尺寸的YIG薄片展现出与块体薄膜不同的电子和磁性行为，有望用于紧凑型自旋电子学器件。；创新点：首次对亚微米级YIG薄片与块体薄膜的电子结构和磁学性质进行系统比较，揭示了小尺寸下涌现的新行为，填补了该形态YIG详细研究的空白。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如磁光克尔效应、振动样品磁强计、X射线光电子能谱等），仅提及对电子结构和磁学性质进行了比较研究。

papers.title: An Effective Scaling Framework for Non-Adiabatic Mode Dynamics
papers.abstract: This study proposes an effective theoretical framework for non-adiabatic parametric excitation in structured media, incorporating a nonlinear frequency regulator U as a stabilizing mechanism. We introduce the non-adiabaticity parameter as a time-local diagnostic for driven non-stationary systems and analyze its competition with nonlinear spectral detuning through the scaling ratio. The principal physical result is that strongly nonlinear oscillatory systems can exhibit saturation of non-adiabatic parametric amplification: when the nonlinear regulator becomes sufficiently strong, exponential mode growth is dynamically suppressed and the excitation evolves toward a bounded low-occupancy regime. Using numerical verification in an expanded 100-level bosonic Fock basis, we demonstrate a crossover from hyperbolic amplification dynamics toward an effectively bounded response associated with spectral blockade and suppression of higher-order mode occupation. These results suggest that nonlinear spectral stabilization may represent a general mechanism for finite-amplitude non-adiabatic dynamics in driven structured media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算验证）。判断依据：提出理论框架（effective theoretical framework）、引入参数（non-adiabaticity parameter）、数值验证（numerical verification in an expanded 100-level bosonic Fock basis）。；研究对象：非绝热参量激发（non-adiabatic parametric excitation）在结构化介质（structured media）中的动力学行为，具体涉及强非线性振荡系统（strongly nonlinear oscillatory systems）和玻色子Fock空间（bosonic Fock basis）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强非线性振荡系统中，非绝热参量放大可被非线性频率调节器（U）饱和：当非线性调节足够强时，指数模式增长被动态抑制，激发进入有界低占据态（bounded low-occupancy regime），表现为从双曲放大动力学向有界响应的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强非线性振荡系统中，非绝热参量放大可被非线性频率调节器（U）饱和：当非线性调节足够强时，指数模式增长被动态抑制，激发进入有界低占据态（bounded low-occupancy regime），表现为从双曲放大动力学向有界响应的交叉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出包含非线性频率调节器U的有效理论框架；引入非绝热性参数（non-adiabaticity parameter）作为时间局域诊断量；通过标度比（scaling ratio）分析非绝热性与非线性谱失谐的竞争；在扩展的100级玻色子Fock基中进行数值验证。

papers.title: Invertible Symmetry and Spontaneous Duality Breaking in the Transverse-Field Ising Model
papers.abstract: The self-duality of the transverse-field Ising model is an archetype for dualities that, alongside symmetry and topology, are used as an organizing principle throughout modern physics. This duality, however, is not exact. The original and dual models have different symmetries and numbers of ground states, and the duality is implemented by a non-invertible operator giving rise to a non-invertible symmetry at the quantum critical point. Here, we show that by adjusting the model to accommodate open rather than periodic boundary conditions, it allows for an exact duality implemented by a unique invertible operator. In the model with exact duality, the symmetry at the quantum critical point is also exact, and hence invertible. Moreover, we find that the exact duality necessitates the presence of an anomalous edge degree of freedom, thus realizing a duality rather than topology based bulk-boundary correspondence. Finally, the exactness of the duality implies that the spontaneous breakdown of a global symmetry in terms of the original model can equivalently be described as spontaneously breaking a local symmetry in the dual system. We show that this seeming contradiction of Elitzur's theorem can be explained by the original and dual models obtaining different sensitivities to spatially local perturbations in any physical implementation of the Hamiltonian. Although the dual partners are mathematically equivalent, their physical implementations therefore are not. In analogy to the spontaneous breakdown of symmetries, we term this emergent distinction due to arbitrarily small environmental influences spontaneous duality breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论分析、对称性论证、模型调整、数学等价性讨论。；研究对象：横场伊辛模型中的自对偶性及其对称性结构，特别是边界条件对对偶性精确性的影响，以及由此引发的自发对偶性破缺现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将横场伊辛模型从周期性边界条件调整为开放边界条件，可以实现由唯一可逆算符执行的精确对偶性，从而在量子临界点获得精确且可逆的对称性；该精确对偶性必然伴随反常边缘自由度，实现了一种基于对偶性而非拓扑的体-边对应；此外，精确对偶性导致原模型中的全局对称性自发破缺等价于对偶系统中的局域对称性自发破缺，这一看似违反Elitzur定理的矛盾可通过原模型与对偶模型对空间局域扰动的不同敏感性来解释，从而提出“自发对偶性破缺”这一新概念。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将横场伊辛模型从周期性边界条件调整为开放边界条件，可以实现由唯一可逆算符执行的精确对偶性，从而在量子临界点获得精确且可逆的对称性；该精确对偶性必然伴随反常边缘自由度，实现了一种基于对偶性而非拓扑的体-边对应；此外，精确对偶性导致原模型中的全局对称性自发破缺等价于对偶系统中的局域对称性自发破缺，这一看似违反Elitzur定理的矛盾可通过原模型与对偶模型对空间局域扰动的不同敏感性来解释，从而提出“自发对偶性破缺”这一新概念。；创新点：首次证明横场伊辛模型在开放边界条件下可实现精确可逆对偶性，并揭示该对偶性导致反常边缘自由度，从而建立对偶性而非拓扑驱动的体-边对应；提出“自发对偶性破缺”概念，解释原模型与对偶模型在物理实现中对环境扰动的不同敏感性，为理解对偶性在真实物理系统中的表现提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过调整边界条件（开放边界替代周期性边界）构造精确对偶变换；利用对称性分析、可逆算符构造、体-边对应论证以及Elitzur定理的重新审视来建立理论框架。

papers.title: Lamb Shift of Landau Levels in Two-Dimensional Electron Systems in a Multimode Resonator
papers.abstract: The use of resonators to modify the behavior of electromagnetic systems demonstrates its potential for application in a wide range of problems. However, existing theoretical studies often resort to the single-mode approximation, rarely considering a second resonator mode. In this paper, we show that including a large number of resonator modes in the model significantly enhances the softening effect of the cyclotron frequency of a two-dimensional electron system. We address this problem by demonstrating the possibility of reducing the system to a set of coupled harmonic oscillators and finding the eigenfrequencies of the oscillators. This is made possible by applying the self-energy method for modes in one polarization and the method for finding the eigenvalues of matrices that have undergone first-rank updating for modes in the perpendicular polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical studies”、“self-energy method”、“finding the eigenvalues of matrices”。；研究对象：多模谐振腔中的二维电子系统，具体物理现象为朗道能级的兰姆移位（Lamb Shift），即回旋频率的软化效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在模型中包含大量谐振腔模式会显著增强二维电子系统回旋频率的软化效应（即兰姆移位效应增强）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在模型中包含大量谐振腔模式会显著增强二维电子系统回旋频率的软化效应（即兰姆移位效应增强）。；创新点：突破了以往理论研究中常用的单模近似（single-mode approximation），首次在模型中考虑了多个谐振腔模式（包括大量模式）对二维电子系统回旋频率的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值求解。具体方法包括：将系统简化为耦合谐振子集合以求解本征频率；对一种极化模式采用自能方法（self-energy method），对垂直极化模式采用一阶秩更新矩阵（first-rank updating）求特征值的方法。

papers.title: Thermoelectric enhancement from an asymmetric spectral-conductivity cusp in spin-1 chiral fermions
papers.abstract: A recent study showed that, in spin-1 chiral fermion systems composed of two linearly dispersing bands and one trivial band, impurity scattering produces an asymmetric cusp in the spectral conductivity. We demonstrate that this asymmetric cusp markedly enhances the electronic thermoelectric response. Using linear-response theory within the self-consistent Born approximation, we find low-temperature enhancements in both the Seebeck coefficient and the electronic figure of merit. Increasing the curvature of the trivial band further strengthens this cusp-induced enhancement, even though the corresponding density of states becomes smoother. To clarify this mechanism, we introduce a minimal cusp model for the spectral conductivity and show that the enhancement is most pronounced when the cusp is sharp and strongly asymmetric, and when the spectral conductivity at the cusp energy is small.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：linear-response theory、self-consistent Born approximation、minimal cusp model。；研究对象：自旋-1手性费米子体系（由两条线性色散能带和一条平庸能带构成）中的热电输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 杂质散射在自旋-1手性费米子体系中产生的非对称谱电导尖峰，能够显著增强电子热电响应，包括低温下的塞贝克系数和电子品质因子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：杂质散射在自旋-1手性费米子体系中产生的非对称谱电导尖峰，能够显著增强电子热电响应，包括低温下的塞贝克系数和电子品质因子。；创新点：揭示了非对称谱电导尖峰（而非态密度）是热电增强的关键机制，并指出增强效果在尖峰尖锐、高度不对称且尖峰能量处谱电导值很小时最为显著。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽玻恩近似的线性响应理论，并引入一个最小化尖峰模型（minimal cusp model）来分析谱电导尖峰形状对热电增强的影响。

papers.title: Interface controlled spin filtering and nonreciprocal transport in Altermagnet/Ising superconductor junctions
papers.abstract: We investigate theoretically spin-resolved transport, spin filtering, and nonreciprocal effects in an Altermagnet/Ising superconductor (AM/ISC) junction with a spin-active interface. Using a modified Bogoliubov-de Gennes framework within the scattering formalism, we demonstrate that the interplay among intrinsic spin-orbit coupling (ISOC), anisotropic AM spin texture and spin-dependent interfacial scattering gives rise to strongly anisotropic charge and spin conductance. In the weak spin-mixing regime, transport remains predominantly helicity conserving and exhibits pronounced angular dependence governed by the relative orientation between the AM spin texture and interface magnetization. Increasing ISOC enhances spin conductance and leads to spin-selective Andreev reflection resulting in finite spin filtering. In contrast, the strong spin-mixing regime exhibits enhanced angular anisotropy and robust spin-polarized transport over a broad energy range. Conventional Andreev reflection becomes strongly suppressed, accompanied by substantial spectral redistribution. We further show that nonreciprocal transport persists throughout the single-band, intermediate and double-band ISC regime. The spin polarization and spin-filter efficiency exhibit nonmonotonic dependence on system parameters, reaching values up to $\sim 86\%$, with characteristic angular modulation determined by the AM spin texture. Finite-energy analysis reveals enhanced spin selectivity at low energies and suppression near the superconducting gap. Furthermore, strong spin mixing at the AM/ISC junction produces asymmetric conductance patterns, indicating nonreciprocal transport. Our results establish AM/ISC junctions as a versatile platform for tunable superconducting spintronics and directional spin transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We investigate theoretically、scattering formalism、modified Bogoliubov-de Gennes framework。；研究对象：Altermagnet/Ising superconductor (AM/ISC) 异质结中的自旋分辨输运、自旋过滤和非互易输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AM/ISC结中，通过调控自旋活性界面，可以实现高达约86%的自旋极化与自旋过滤效率，并观察到强各向异性的电荷/自旋电导以及非互易输运行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AM/ISC结中，通过调控自旋活性界面，可以实现高达约86%的自旋极化与自旋过滤效率，并观察到强各向异性的电荷/自旋电导以及非互易输运行为。；创新点：揭示了Altermagnet（AM）的各向异性自旋织构、Ising超导体（ISC）的内禀自旋轨道耦合（ISOC）以及自旋依赖的界面散射三者之间的协同作用，如何导致强各向异性和可调的自旋输运特性，从而将AM/ISC结确立为可调谐超导自旋电子学与定向自旋输运的平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用修正的Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 框架和散射形式理论，对AM/ISC结中的输运过程进行理论计算与分析。

papers.title: Reconfigurable chiral superconductivity
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene at high displacement fields hosts superconductivity emerging from a spin valley polarized quarter metal, with transport signatures suggestive of time reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking and chiral superconductivity (CSC). These observations have motivated proposals of topological superconductivity and non-Abelian quasiparticles, yet direct magnetic evidence and microscopic insight into the superconducting state remain lacking, limiting understanding of this unique state. Here we use nanoscale SQUID on tip magnetometry to image isospin-polarized domains in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene and establish CSC via spatially resolved thermodynamic detection of TRS breaking. We find that the density at which domain walls proliferate at elevated temperatures coincides with the onset of CSC, indicating an underlying transition in the parent state that both induces superconductivity and reduces domain wall energy. We further show that the chiral domain structure in the superconducting phase is inherited from the isospin-polarized parent state. Strikingly, the CSC phase exhibits multiple transport regimes governed by configurations of chiral domains separated by highly resistive domain walls. We demonstrate deterministic, ultra low current control of these domains, enabling reversible switching between states of opposite chirality a defining CSC property absent in other superconductors. These results establish rhombohedral graphene as a unique platform for reconfigurable CSC and ultra low power electronic functionality based on controllable isospin textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：nanoscale SQUID on tip magnetometry、transport signatures、thermodynamic detection。；研究对象：菱方五层石墨烯（rhombohedral pentalayer graphene）中的可重构手性超导态（reconfigurable chiral superconductivity），以及与之相关的等自旋极化母态（isospin-polarized parent state）和畴结构（domain structure）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过纳米SQUID磁强计直接成像等自旋极化畴并热力学检测时间反演对称性破缺，证实了菱方五层石墨烯中的手性超导态；该超导态的手性畴结构继承自母态，且可通过超低电流实现可逆切换，从而实现了可重构的手性超导性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过纳米SQUID磁强计直接成像等自旋极化畴并热力学检测时间反演对称性破缺，证实了菱方五层石墨烯中的手性超导态；该超导态的手性畴结构继承自母态，且可通过超低电流实现可逆切换，从而实现了可重构的手性超导性。；创新点：首次通过直接磁成像和热力学检测提供了手性超导态的时间反演对称性破缺证据；揭示了超导相中手性畴结构继承自等自旋极化母态，并实现了基于超低电流的确定性、可逆手性态切换，这是其他超导体中不具备的可重构手性超导特性。
papers.method_zh: 纳米SQUID-on-tip磁强计（nanoscale SQUID on tip magnetometry）进行空间分辨的热力学检测，结合输运测量（transport measurements）表征不同手性畴构型下的输运行为。

papers.title: Electron - acoustic phonons scattering in quantum wells in a tilted quantizing magnetic field
papers.abstract: Electron scattering by longitudinal acoustic phonons in a quantizing magnetic field is considered. Expressions for the scattering rate in a magnetic field tilted to the quantum well layers are derived. By analyzing these expressions, trends in the behavior of the scattering rate are established with changes in the magnetic field strength and orientation, as well as the potential profile of the quantum well.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：considered、derived、analyzing expressions。；研究对象：量子阱中电子与纵向声学声子的散射过程，特别是在倾斜量子化磁场下的散射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了倾斜磁场下量子阱中电子-声学声子散射率的表达式，并揭示了散射率随磁场强度、磁场方向以及量子阱势阱轮廓变化的趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了倾斜磁场下量子阱中电子-声学声子散射率的表达式，并揭示了散射率随磁场强度、磁场方向以及量子阱势阱轮廓变化的趋势。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与分析。具体为：在量子化磁场中考虑电子被纵向声学声子散射，推导出磁场相对于量子阱层倾斜时的散射率表达式，并基于这些表达式进行趋势分析。

papers.title: Reentrant behavior and possible $2/3$ magnetization plateau on the double-trillium langbeinite K$_2$Ni$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$
papers.abstract: K$_2$Ni$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$ is a member of the langbeinite family, consisting of two intertwined $S=1$ trillium lattices, out of which one is strongly coupled (strong-TL) and the other is weakly coupled (weak-TL). Further inter-trillium interactions give rise to a highly-frustrated Heisenberg Hamiltonian. Despite ordering at low temperatures, K$_2$Ni$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$ lies close in parameter space to a spin-liquid region that surrounds the tetratrillium limit, where each triangle belonging to strong-TL turns into a tetrahedron by connecting to a single spin from weak-TL. Here, we compare the experimentally determined magnetization process using pulsed magnetic fields up to $40$ T with classical Monte Carlo calculations, uncovering a series of phase transitions at both low and intermediate fields. Furthermore, we reveal a signature of a $2/3$ magnetization plateau consisting of a $1/3$ phase on strong-TL and a fully polarized phase on weak-TL. Although in the classical limit no plateau is expected, we find a very prominent dome structure reflecting the tendency of the system to stabilize this particular spin configuration. The presence of a dome leads to a reentrant phenomenon in which the system recovers the Hamiltonian symmetries when increasing the magnetic field. Finally, we show that this plateau-like phase is also present in the classical Heisenberg model on the single trillium and tetratrillium lattices, indicating its possible presence in the large family of double-trillium langbeinite compounds. Our findings motivate future studies on the presence of the plateau phase in the quantum limit of both trillium and double-trillium materials within the langbeinite family.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“experimentally determined magnetization process using pulsed magnetic fields”和“classical Monte Carlo calculations”。；研究对象：双三叶草型朗格贝矿化合物K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃，具体研究其在外加磁场下的磁化过程及可能的2/3磁化平台现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃中观测到2/3磁化平台的迹象（由强耦合三叶草子晶格的1/3相和弱耦合三叶草子晶格的全极化相组成），并发现该体系在磁场增加时出现重入行为，恢复哈密顿量的对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃中观测到2/3磁化平台的迹象（由强耦合三叶草子晶格的1/3相和弱耦合三叶草子晶格的全极化相组成），并发现该体系在磁场增加时出现重入行为，恢复哈密顿量的对称性。；创新点：揭示了双三叶草型朗格贝矿体系中2/3磁化平台的存在及其与重入行为的关联，并指出该平台相在单三叶草和四三叶草晶格的经典海森堡模型中同样存在，暗示其可能广泛存在于朗格贝矿家族化合物中。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用脉冲磁场（最高40 T）测量磁化过程；理论上采用经典蒙特卡洛计算进行对比分析。

papers.title: Multiband Superconductivity in the Exactly Solvable Hatsugai-Kohmoto Model
papers.abstract: Multiband superconductivity gives rise to a rich landscape of possible pairing states. Here we study superconductivity in the multiband extension of the Hatsugai-Kohmoto model, an exactly solvable model of correlated electrons with momentum-local interactions, which provides a minimal framework to explore the interplay of strong correlations, orbital structure and pairing symmetry. Focusing on a two-orbital system with point-group symmetry $\rm D_{4h}$, we classify the symmetry-allowed superconducting gap structures, taking into account spin, orbital and momentum degrees of freedom. We further compute the critical temperature and the superconducting order parameter for selected pairing channels as functions of interaction and pairing strength within a mean-field treatment. Our results provide a systematic framework for analyzing superconductivity in the orbital Hatsugai-Kohmoto model and extend symmetry-based approaches to correlated multiband settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“exactly solvable model”（精确可解模型）、“mean-field treatment”（平均场处理）和“symmetry-based approaches”（基于对称性的方法），未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：Hatsugai-Kohmoto (HK) 模型的多轨道扩展版本中的超导电性。具体聚焦于一个具有 $\rm D_{4h}$ 点群对称性的双轨道系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在可精确求解的多轨道HK模型中，通过考虑自旋、轨道和动量自由度，可以对对称性允许的超导能隙结构进行分类，并计算特定配对通道的临界温度和超导序参量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在可精确求解的多轨道HK模型中，通过考虑自旋、轨道和动量自由度，可以对对称性允许的超导能隙结构进行分类，并计算特定配对通道的临界温度和超导序参量。；创新点：将基于对称性的超导配对态分析方法推广到了具有轨道自由度的强关联多带体系（即轨道HK模型），为分析此类模型中的超导电性提供了一个系统性的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：1）利用点群对称性对超导配对态进行分类；2）在平均场框架下计算临界温度和超导序参量作为相互作用和配对强度的函数。

papers.title: Defect annihilation mechanism in the formation of dodecagonal quasicrystals
papers.abstract: Understanding defect evolution is essential to the structural stability of quasicrystals, yet the kinetics of defect repair remain poorly understood. Here, by combining the string method and the spring pair method, we determine the minimum energy path from defective to defect-free dodecagonal quasicrystals using a particle model with the Lennard-Jones-Gauss potential. We find that defect annihilation proceeds via three stages: phason flip, aggregation and decomposition of shield-like defects. These sequential transformations are driven by potential energy gradients and accompanied by an increase in structural symmetry. The three stages act synergistically in promoting defect annihilation, offering new insights into the microscopic repair mechanisms of quasicrystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“string method”、“spring pair method”、“particle model”、“minimum energy path”。；研究对象：十二角准晶中的缺陷湮灭机制。具体体系为采用Lennard-Jones-Gauss势的粒子模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 缺陷湮灭通过三个阶段进行：相位子翻转、盾形缺陷的聚集与分解。这三个阶段由势能梯度驱动，伴随结构对称性提高，协同促进缺陷修复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：缺陷湮灭通过三个阶段进行：相位子翻转、盾形缺陷的聚集与分解。这三个阶段由势能梯度驱动，伴随结构对称性提高，协同促进缺陷修复。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合弦方法（string method）与弹簧对方法（spring pair method），计算从有缺陷到无缺陷十二角准晶的最小能量路径。

papers.title: Fluctuation-Dissipation Framework for Size-Dependent Surface Tension
papers.abstract: The size-dependent liquid-vapor surface tension controls phase change, wetting, and transport at nanoscales, yet its first curvature correction, the Tolman length, remains difficult to determine. We develop a thermodynamic and statistical-mechanical framework that relates this correction to bulk response properties of a one-component liquid near liquid-vapor coexistence. For curved interfaces, the analysis considers two local formulations of the same capillary-chemical balance, in excess pressures and in relative density deviations. For weakly compressible liquids in the regime emphasized here, the adopted asymmetric density-based formulation is the practically relevant one, with finite-curvature effects entering through vapor supersaturation under capillary equilibrium. At coexistence, the planar-limit value of the same Tolman length reduces to a combination of the liquid isothermal compressibility and its pressure derivative and can be recast as a bulk fluctuation-response observable of the homogeneous liquid in the isothermal-isobaric ensemble. In this representation, the planar-limit coefficient is determined by second and third central moments of the volume distribution, equivalently by the pressure response of the relative fluctuation width. For water, homogeneous (N,P,T) simulations of SPC/E and TIP4P/2005 sample the bulk liquid, not an explicit liquid-vapor interface, and yield estimates near -0.7 Angstrom at 300 K. An independent evaluation based on the IAPWS-IF97 industrial formulation gives -0.713 +/- 0.004 Angstrom at the same coexistence state and predicts a weakly nonmonotonic temperature dependence along coexistence. Beyond water, the framework applies to other one-component liquids in regimes where an accurate thermal equation of state or sufficiently converged bulk volume statistics are available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：thermodynamic and statistical-mechanical framework、analysis、representation）；研究对象：液-气界面张力随尺寸变化的修正，特别是Tolman长度（一阶曲率修正），以水（SPC/E和TIP4P/2005模型）为主要示例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在平面极限下，Tolman长度可表示为液体等温压缩率及其压力导数的组合，等价于均相液体在等温等压系综中的体积涨落响应可观测量；对于水，该值在300 K时约为-0.7 Å。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在平面极限下，Tolman长度可表示为液体等温压缩率及其压力导数的组合，等价于均相液体在等温等压系综中的体积涨落响应可观测量；对于水，该值在300 K时约为-0.7 Å。；创新点：将Tolman长度与均相液体的体涨落响应性质直接关联，使其可通过纯体相模拟（无需显式模拟液-气界面）或状态方程计算得到。
papers.method_zh: 发展了热力学与统计力学理论框架，通过两种局域表述（过剩压力和相对密度偏差）分析弯曲界面下的毛细-化学平衡；采用基于密度的不对称公式处理弱可压缩液体；利用等温等压系综中的体积分布二阶和三阶中心矩计算Tolman长度；对水进行了均相（N,P,T）分子动力学模拟（SPC/E和TIP4P/2005），并使用了IAPWS-IF97工业状态方程进行独立评估。

papers.title: Crossover and universality breaking in the dilute Baxter-Wu model
papers.abstract: The critical behavior of the Baxter-Wu model belongs to the universality class of the four-state Potts model. While the introduction of annealed vacancies does not alter the criticality of the four-state Potts model, the dilute Baxter-Wu model has remained the subject of several competing scenarios. Here we investigate the phase diagram of the spin-$1$ Baxter-Wu model in the presence of a crystal field using transfer-matrix calculations and large-scale Monte Carlo simulations. Our results provide strong evidence for continuously varying critical exponents at finite dilution and reveal a crossover to first-order behavior. Along the line of continuous transitions, the central charge remains close to $c=1$, while the scaling dimensions systematically deviate from the spin-$1/2$ limit as the crystal field increases, eventually giving way to a first-order regime at strong fields. These findings resolve previous ambiguities and establish a consistent picture of the critical behavior of the dilute spin-$1$ Baxter-Wu model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：transfer-matrix calculations, large-scale Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：稀释Baxter-Wu模型（spin-1 Baxter-Wu model in the presence of a crystal field）的临界行为与相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限稀释下，临界指数连续变化，并存在向一级相变的交叉行为；连续相变线上中心荷保持接近c=1，但标度维度随晶场增大系统性地偏离自旋-1/2极限，最终在强场下进入一级相变区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限稀释下，临界指数连续变化，并存在向一级相变的交叉行为；连续相变线上中心荷保持接近c=1，但标度维度随晶场增大系统性地偏离自旋-1/2极限，最终在强场下进入一级相变区域。；创新点：解决了此前关于稀释Baxter-Wu模型临界行为的多种竞争性理论分歧，建立了自旋-1 Baxter-Wu模型在晶场作用下临界行为的一致图像。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 转移矩阵计算（transfer-matrix calculations）和大规模蒙特卡洛模拟（large-scale Monte Carlo simulations）。

papers.title: Conditional probability density functional theory for solids
papers.abstract: A recently developed approach, conditional probability density functional theory (CP-DFT), yields direct access to the exchange-correlation hole of a system, an important correlation function that is not available from any standard DFT calculation. We present the first results for extended materials with periodic boundary conditions. We demonstrate that CP-DFT works on weakly correlated materials (Na, Si). When applied to the prototypical Kagome material $CsV_3Sb_5$, we find $d$-orbital correlations that are not captured by standard DFT. Such distribution leads to a positive finding probability between two separated electrons and an enhanced charge density wave signal, suggesting a useful approach for strongly correlated systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：conditional probability density functional theory (CP-DFT)、DFT计算、periodic boundary conditions。；研究对象：扩展固体材料，包括弱关联材料（Na, Si）和强关联Kagome材料CsV₃Sb₅。具体物理现象为交换-关联空穴（exchange-correlation hole）和电荷密度波信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CP-DFT方法成功应用于周期性固体，在弱关联材料中有效，并在Kagome材料CsV₃Sb₅中发现了标准DFT无法捕获的d轨道关联，导致两个分离电子之间的正发现概率以及增强的电荷密度波信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CP-DFT方法成功应用于周期性固体，在弱关联材料中有效，并在Kagome材料CsV₃Sb₅中发现了标准DFT无法捕获的d轨道关联，导致两个分离电子之间的正发现概率以及增强的电荷密度波信号。；创新点：首次将CP-DFT方法应用于具有周期性边界条件的扩展材料，并展示了该方法在强关联体系中揭示标准DFT无法获得的轨道关联信息的能力。
papers.method_zh: 采用条件概率密度泛函理论（CP-DFT），在周期性边界条件下对扩展材料进行第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Highly Efficient Exciton Modulation in MoSe$_2$/PdSe$_2$ Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Controlling exciton recombination in atomically thin semiconductors is central to their optoelectronic functionality, as the competition between radiative and non-radiative decay channels governs emission efficiency. Existing approaches, such as defect passivation, chemical doping, dielectric engineering, and strain tuning, primarily aim to suppress non-radiative losses. Here, we report a pronounced $\sim$6-fold enhancement of room-temperature A-exciton emission in a type-I MoSe$_2$/PdSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure, yielding a photoluminescence quantum yield of 6 %, compared to $\sim$1 % for as-exfoliated monolayer MoSe$_2$. This enhancement is accompanied by strong quenching of the B-exciton, consistent with interlayer electronic coupling that redistributes exciton populations toward the radiative A-exciton channel. Power- and temperature-dependent measurements reveal a suppression of exciton-exciton annihilation and a crossover to quenched emission at low temperature, indicating a redistribution of exciton relaxation pathways. Photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy further reveals a broadband enhancement spanning 450-725 nm, ruling out a resonance-specific mechanism. These results demonstrate that interlayer electronic coupling can be used as an efficient means to redirect exciton populations toward radiative channels, enhancing emission efficiency in two-dimensional semiconductors without chemical modification or strain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：photoluminescence（光致发光）、power- and temperature-dependent measurements（功率与温度依赖测量）、photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy（光致发光激发光谱）。；研究对象：MoSe₂/PdSe₂ 范德华异质结中的激子调控行为，具体为A激子和B激子的辐射复合与发射效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MoSe₂/PdSe₂ 异质结中，通过层间电子耦合将激子布居重新分配至辐射性的A激子通道，实现了室温下A激子发射强度约6倍的增强，光致发光量子产率从单层MoSe₂的~1%提升至6%，同时B激子发射被强烈猝灭。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MoSe₂/PdSe₂ 异质结中，通过层间电子耦合将激子布居重新分配至辐射性的A激子通道，实现了室温下A激子发射强度约6倍的增强，光致发光量子产率从单层MoSe₂的~1%提升至6%，同时B激子发射被强烈猝灭。；创新点：利用层间电子耦合而非传统的缺陷钝化、化学掺杂、介电工程或应变调控等手段，实现了对激子复合通道的高效重定向，从而显著提升二维半导体的发光效率，且无需化学修饰或施加应变。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光（PL）光谱、功率依赖与温度依赖的PL测量、光致发光激发（PLE）光谱。

papers.title: Observation of an aperiodic polariton monotile
papers.abstract: A plethora of unconventional localization phenomena and fractal features of linear spectrum observed in quasiperiodic structures have been accompanied by a long-standing quest for the geometrical elements and structures that permit tilings of the plane, but only in a non-periodic manner. Until 2024, it was believed that such quasiperiodic structures, or quasicrystals, could only be composed of at least two different tiles. Surprisingly, a newly discovered class of quasicrystals requires only one elementary monotile. However, its physical realization and study of propagating coherent excitations in this novel setting remained elusive. Here we optically sculpt aperiodic quasicrystals composed of "einstein" monotiles in an inorganic microcavity and observe nontrivial relative phases of the exciton-polariton condensates nonresonantly excited at the vertices of each monotile. Utilizing energy-resolved tomography in momentum-space, we reveal the formation of distinct Bragg peaks with six-fold symmetry and Dirac-like spectral fingerprints, intrinsic to the underlying graphene-like structure, while interferometric phase reconstruction shows a nontrivial synchronization pattern distinct from both periodic triangular lattices and Penrose quasicrystals. Our work demonstrates that monotiles can be converted into a programmable driven-dissipative artificial material, where long-range coherence coexists with enforced geometric aperiodicity, producing synchronization and spectral responses distinct from both periodic and conventional quasicrystalline tilings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：optically sculpt、observed、revealed、interferometric phase reconstruction。；研究对象：由“爱因斯坦单瓦片”（einstein monotile）构成的非周期准晶结构中的激子-极化激元（exciton-polariton）凝聚体。具体体系为无机微腔中光学雕刻的非周期准晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验上首次实现了由单一“爱因斯坦单瓦片”构成的非周期准晶，并观测到其顶点处激子-极化激元凝聚体之间非平庸的相对相位，以及具有六重对称性的布拉格峰和类狄拉克谱特征，其同步化模式与周期三角晶格和彭罗斯准晶均不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验上首次实现了由单一“爱因斯坦单瓦片”构成的非周期准晶，并观测到其顶点处激子-极化激元凝聚体之间非平庸的相对相位，以及具有六重对称性的布拉格峰和类狄拉克谱特征，其同步化模式与周期三角晶格和彭罗斯准晶均不同。；创新点：首次在物理上实现了并研究了基于单一“爱因斯坦单瓦片”的非周期准晶中的传播性相干激发（激子-极化激元），此前这类结构仅停留在数学和几何构想中。该工作展示了长程相干性与强制几何非周期性共存的驱动-耗散人工材料，其同步化响应和光谱特征区别于周期晶格和传统准晶。
papers.method_zh: 利用非共振光激发在无机微腔中光学雕刻出由单一“爱因斯坦单瓦片”构成的非周期准晶；采用动量空间能量分辨断层扫描（energy-resolved tomography in momentum-space）揭示布拉格峰和能谱特征；使用干涉相位重建（interferometric phase reconstruction）分析凝聚体的同步化模式。

papers.title: Magnesium-graphene interphase boundaries created by high-pressure torsion enhance hydrogen storage kinetics:Mechanisms and significance of activation energy and frequency factor
papers.abstract: A strategy to overcome sluggish hydrogenation/dehydrogenation of magnesium is demonstrated by creating magnesium-graphene interphase boundaries via high-pressure torsion (HPT). HPT reduces the grain size of pure magnesium from 1 mm to 850 nm, with 70% of grain boundaries having high misorientation angles. Graphene addition leads to even finer grain sizes of 10-500 nm with a bimodal morphology. The magnesium-graphene composites exhibit superior kinetics at 623 K while maintaining high air resistance. Kinetic modeling reveals that the rate-controlling mechanism transits from interfacial reaction in coarse-grained magnesium to atomic diffusion in magnesium-graphene nanocomposites. Kissinger analysis shows that the activation energy for hydrogen desorption remains unchanged at 145 +/- 2 kJ/mol, regardless of the presence of grain or interphase boundaries. However, the frequency factor (number of successful attempts to overcome the activation energy) increases with the generation of interfaces, which serve as sites for hydrogen diffusion and heterogeneous metal/hydride nucleation. These findings highlight the impact of interphase boundary engineering via severe plastic deformation for enhancing the kinetics and air resistance of hydrogen storage materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：high-pressure torsion、kinetic modeling、Kissinger analysis）；研究对象：镁-石墨烯复合材料中的界面边界及其对储氢动力学的影响
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高压扭转（HPT）在镁中引入镁-石墨烯相界面，可在不改变氢脱附活化能（145±2 kJ/mol）的情况下，显著提高频率因子（即成功克服活化能的尝试次数），从而大幅提升储氢动力学性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高压扭转（HPT）在镁中引入镁-石墨烯相界面，可在不改变氢脱附活化能（145±2 kJ/mol）的情况下，显著提高频率因子（即成功克服活化能的尝试次数），从而大幅提升储氢动力学性能。；创新点：揭示了通过剧烈塑性变形引入相界面边界，而非改变活化能，通过增加频率因子来增强储氢动力学和空气稳定性的机制。
papers.method_zh: 高压扭转（HPT）制备样品；动力学建模分析速率控制机制；Kissinger分析法测定活化能和频率因子。

papers.title: Structural, electronic, and optical properties of hexagonal GeSn from density functional theory
papers.abstract: Unlike cubic GeSn, which requires a high Sn concentration to undergo an indirect-to-direct bandgap transition, lonsdaleite (2H) germanium is an intrinsic direct-gap semiconductor. We employ first-principles density functional theory to investigate the structural, electronic, and optical properties of 2H-Ge$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$ random alloys in the dilute Sn regime ($x \le 0.10$). The extended alloy disorder is modeled using 48-atom special quasirandom structure (SQS) supercells, and the coherent effective band structure is recovered via spectral band unfolding. We show that 2H-Ge$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$ maintains a direct bandgap at the $Γ$ point across the studied composition range, exhibiting a strong bandgap bowing that shifts the fundamental absorption edge into the mid-infrared. Evaluation of the optical transition matrix elements reveals a giant polarization anisotropy dictated by spin-orbit coupling. The fundamental transition is strongly dipole-allowed for light polarized perpendicular to the crystal $c$-axis, an optical selection rule that is robustly preserved despite the random alloy disorder breaking the symmetry. These results demonstrate that hexagonal GeSn bypasses the compositional threshold limitations of the cubic phase, providing a highly tunable direct-gap system for infrared optoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles density functional theory”、“special quasirandom structure (SQS)”、“spectral band unfolding”。；研究对象：六方相（lonsdaleite，2H结构）Ge₁₋ₓSnₓ稀合金（x ≤ 0.10）的结构、电子和光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 2H-Ge₁₋ₓSnₓ在研究的组分范围内（x ≤ 0.10）始终保持Γ点直接带隙，且带隙弯曲效应显著，可将基本吸收边调至中红外波段；其光学跃迁具有巨大的偏振各向异性，基本跃迁对垂直于c轴偏振的光是强偶极允许的，且该选择定则不受随机合金无序破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：2H-Ge₁₋ₓSnₓ在研究的组分范围内（x ≤ 0.10）始终保持Γ点直接带隙，且带隙弯曲效应显著，可将基本吸收边调至中红外波段；其光学跃迁具有巨大的偏振各向异性，基本跃迁对垂直于c轴偏振的光是强偶极允许的，且该选择定则不受随机合金无序破坏。；创新点：发现六方GeSn无需像立方相GeSn那样需要高Sn浓度才能实现间接-直接带隙转变，在低Sn浓度下即为直接带隙，且其光学选择定则对合金无序具有鲁棒性，从而规避了立方相中组分阈值的限制。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算；使用48原子特殊准随机结构（SQS）超胞模拟扩展的合金无序；通过谱带展开（spectral band unfolding）恢复相干有效能带结构；计算光学跃迁矩阵元。

papers.title: Helium Bubbles in Liquid Lead Lithium Solutions: Pressure Inhomogeneities at Interfaces and Non Ideal Mixture Effects
papers.abstract: The extremely low solubility of helium in liquid metals may lead to rapid supersaturation, promoting spontaneous formation of helium bubbles by nucleation. Once nucleated, the stability of these bubbles is governed by the properties of the helium liquid metal interface. In particular, interfacial tension between the immiscible phases controls bubble interactions and induces local pressure inhomogeneities. This work is motivated by the need of a better understanding of helium bubble formation in liquid Pb Li alloys, which are of particular relevance for the design of breeding blankets in the future nuclear fusion reactors. We employ classical molecular dynamics simulations to investigate helium segregation in a range of lead lithium systems, including the limiting cases of pure lead and pure lithium. Changes in local pressure are evaluated from direct mechanical calculations, enabling the characterization of interfacial properties. Interfacial tension and radius of the bubble are subsequently determined across multiple thermodynamic conditions, spanning temperatures starting near the melting points of the constituent metals up to 1021 K. The impact of curvature and composition of the alloy on the interfacial behaviour are also investigated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：classical molecular dynamics simulations（经典分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：液态铅锂（Pb-Li）合金中氦气泡的形成与界面性质，包括纯铅和纯锂的极限情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过直接力学计算评估了氦在液态铅锂合金中偏析引起的局部压力变化，表征了界面张力与气泡半径随温度（从熔点附近至1021 K）及合金成分的变化，并研究了曲率与成分对界面行为的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过直接力学计算评估了氦在液态铅锂合金中偏析引起的局部压力变化，表征了界面张力与气泡半径随温度（从熔点附近至1021 K）及合金成分的变化，并研究了曲率与成分对界面行为的影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 经典分子动力学模拟（classical molecular dynamics simulations），通过直接力学计算评估局部压力变化，进而确定界面张力与气泡半径。

papers.title: Ultrafast Critical Slowing of Spin Dynamics and Emergent Nonequilibrium Fano Interference in Fe3GeTe2
papers.abstract: Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ is a prototypical metallic van der Waals ferromagnet with itinerant magnetism and a highly tunable Curie temperature, yet how electronic excitations couple to spin and lattice degrees of freedom across its magnetic transition remains largely unexplored. Here, we use two-color pump-probe reflectivity to investigate the coupled electronic, spin, and lattice dynamics. The time-resolved reflectivity exhibits a tri-exponential relaxation, in which the intermediate component shows an anomaly near the Curie temperature due to enhanced interlayer spin-lattice interactions, while the slowest component displays pronounced critical slowing down with an exponent of ~ 0.3, revealing non-universal relaxation dynamics associated with intralayer spin correlations. Furthermore, we observe an emergent nonequilibrium A1g phonon Fano asymmetry that is suppressed in the ferromagnetic phase but anomalously enhanced in the paramagnetic regime, driven by thermally activated anharmonic decay pathways that bridge the kinematic gap to a hot electronic continuum. The pronounced enhancement of the acoustic strain pulse amplitude near T$_c$ further evidences robust magnetoelastic coupling. Overall, our results reveal how magnetic order governs the interplay among critical spin dynamics, electronic continuum excitations, and lattice response in metallic van der Waals ferromagnets
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“two-color pump-probe reflectivity”、“time-resolved reflectivity”、“pump-probe”等明确表明采用了超快光学实验手段。；研究对象：金属性范德华铁磁体Fe₃GeTe₂，具体研究其电子、自旋和晶格动力学在磁相变附近的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe₃GeTe₂中观测到自旋动力学的非普适临界慢化（临界指数约0.3），并发现一种非平衡态A1g声子Fano不对称性，该不对称性在铁磁相被抑制而在顺磁相反常增强，揭示了磁有序如何调控自旋、电子连续谱与晶格响应之间的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe₃GeTe₂中观测到自旋动力学的非普适临界慢化（临界指数约0.3），并发现一种非平衡态A1g声子Fano不对称性，该不对称性在铁磁相被抑制而在顺磁相反常增强，揭示了磁有序如何调控自旋、电子连续谱与晶格响应之间的相互作用。；创新点：首次在Fe₃GeTe₂中揭示了中间弛豫分量在居里温度附近因层间自旋-晶格相互作用增强而出现的异常，以及最慢弛豫分量表现出的非普适临界慢化行为；同时发现了非平衡态A1g声子Fano不对称性在顺磁相中的反常增强，并将其归因于热激活的非简谐衰减通道桥接了与热电子连续谱的运动学间隙。
papers.method_zh: 双色泵浦-探测反射率测量（two-color pump-probe reflectivity），用于研究耦合的电子、自旋和晶格动力学；通过分析时间分辨反射率的三指数弛豫、声子Fano线型以及声学应变脉冲振幅来提取物理信息。

papers.title: Observation of end-to-end pumping in a quasiperiodic Fibonacci-type photonic chain
papers.abstract: Topological pumps offer a promising route to operate as connecting buses, supplying efficient and robust connectivity between non-neighboring elements in a network. Here, we investigate a finite quasiperiodic Fibonacci-type photonic chain and demonstrate its ability for end-to-end pumping, with only small and simple changes to the system. First, we use a tight-binding formalism to numerically show that a localized pumping state can be transferred between opposite ends of the system, with only a small structural change to the chain. Then, we experimentally implement this topological pump in an array of coupled optical waveguides, where light propagation is effectively described by the tight-binding model under the paraxial approximation, enabling direct correspondence between theory and experiment. We numerically simulate and experimentally demonstrate pumping by injecting light into a single waveguide at one end of the setup, which activates a localized pumping state. As the light propagates along the wave guide array, it is also pumped to the other end. We further show that pumping remains robust against structural deformation, such as controlled defects in the waveguide array. Our results establish that quasiperiodic Fibonacci-type photonic lattices are a robust and experimentally viable platform for disorder-resilient state transfer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。关键词：experimentally implement、numerically simulate、tight-binding formalism。；研究对象：准周期Fibonacci型光子链中的端到端拓扑泵浦现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限长度的准周期Fibonacci型光子链中，仅通过微小且简单的结构变化即可实现局域泵浦态从系统一端到另一端的转移，且该泵浦过程对结构缺陷具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限长度的准周期Fibonacci型光子链中，仅通过微小且简单的结构变化即可实现局域泵浦态从系统一端到另一端的转移，且该泵浦过程对结构缺陷具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次在准周期Fibonacci型光子晶格中实验实现并验证了端到端拓扑泵浦，展示了其作为抗无序态转移的稳健实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用耦合光波导阵列，在近轴近似下光传播等效于紧束缚模型；理论上使用紧束缚形式进行数值模拟，并通过注入单波导光激发局域泵浦态，观测光沿波导阵列传播时向另一端的泵浦。

papers.title: Apparent Ferroelectric Polarization Hysteresis and a Simple Method to Observe Piezoelectric Strain Loops with a Microphone
papers.abstract: Extra components in series to non-ferroelectric capacitance can cause apparent ferroelectric D-E hysteresis loops even with the double-wave method (DWM). Characteristics of fake loops are studied withsimple circuit models, and suspicious loops of actual materials are found in some papers using the DWM. Inverse piezoelectric strain also reverses along with the polarization by the electric field, and S-E loops are considered more reliable to prove ferroelectricity than the D-E loops. But measurement of S-E loops usually requires expensive instruments in contrast to D-E loops with a simple circuit. A very simple method is developed to observe S-E loops of bulk samples with an inexpensive small electret microphone and a little expansion to the circuit for D-E loops. S-E loops of a commercial ceramic capacitor by this method reveal that its D-E loops apparent.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：simple method developed、observed with a microphone、measurement of S-E loops）；研究对象：铁电材料的极化滞后现象与压电应变回路的简易观测方法，具体以商业陶瓷电容器为测试对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 串联非铁电电容的额外元件即使采用双波法（DWM）也会产生虚假的铁电D-E滞后回线；开发了一种使用廉价驻极体麦克风观测块体样品压电应变回路的简易方法，可有效识别虚假铁电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：串联非铁电电容的额外元件即使采用双波法（DWM）也会产生虚假的铁电D-E滞后回线；开发了一种使用廉价驻极体麦克风观测块体样品压电应变回路的简易方法，可有效识别虚假铁电性。；创新点：提出一种低成本、无需昂贵仪器的压电应变回路观测方法，可替代传统S-E测量设备，用于区分真实与虚假铁电D-E滞后回线。
papers.method_zh: 采用简单电路模型研究虚假回线特征；在D-E回路电路基础上扩展，使用驻极体麦克风直接测量块体样品的压电应变（S-E）回路。

papers.title: Quantized Transport in Floquet Topological Insulators
papers.abstract: We study quantum transport in a periodically driven (Floquet) topological system coupled to static fermionic reservoirs. Using the Floquet nonequilibrium Green's-function (NEGF) formalism we show, from exact numerics for a strip geometry, that the two-terminal (longitudinal) conductance is quantized as $|W_{\varepsilon}|\,e^2/h$, while the Hall (transverse) conductance is quantized as $W_{\varepsilon}\,e^2/h$, where $W_{\varepsilon}$ is the Floquet winding invariant associated with the quasienergy gap at $\varepsilon = 0$ or $\varepsilon = Ω/2$. Quantization is achieved only after summing over the contribution of all Floquet sidebands. We provide an analytic understanding of this Floquet conductance sum rule, by considering the Hall conductance in the weak coupling limit. In that limit, we show that the Floquet Hall conductance gets contributions from the Floquet sidebands, which includes the signs of the velocities of the edge modes. Their sum yields exact quantization, as predicted by the Floquet sum rule. We find that in a wide range of parameter regime, the convergence is fast, making observation of the sum rule and Floquet winding numbers accessible to experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Floquet nonequilibrium Green's-function formalism、analytic understanding、weak coupling limit）；研究对象：周期驱动（Floquet）拓扑绝缘体与静态费米子库耦合的量子输运体系，具体关注纵向和横向电导的量子化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Floquet拓扑绝缘体中，两端纵向电导量子化为 \(|W_{\varepsilon}| e^2/h\)，霍尔电导量子化为 \(W_{\varepsilon} e^2/h\)，其中 \(W_{\varepsilon}\) 为准能隙（\(\varepsilon=0\) 或 \(\varepsilon=\Omega/2\)）处的Floquet绕数；量子化仅在对所有Floquet边带贡献求和后实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Floquet拓扑绝缘体中，两端纵向电导量子化为 \(|W_{\varepsilon}| e^2/h\)，霍尔电导量子化为 \(W_{\varepsilon} e^2/h\)，其中 \(W_{\varepsilon}\) 为准能隙（\(\varepsilon=0\) 或 \(\varepsilon=\Omega/2\)）处的Floquet绕数；量子化仅在对所有Floquet边带贡献求和后实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式，对条带几何结构进行精确数值计算；在弱耦合极限下对霍尔电导进行解析分析，推导Floquet电导求和规则。

papers.title: Selective Octahedral Accommodation of Cr$^{3+}$ and Weak Magnetic Connectivity in the Sugilite Analogue KNa$_2$Cr$_2$Li$_3$Si$_{12}$O$_{30}$
papers.abstract: We report the synthesis of the Cr analogue of sugilite, KNa$_2$Cr$_2$Li$_3$Si$_{12}$O$_{30}$, in the milarite-type framework. Rietveld refinement of a composition-conserving antisite model gives $x = 0.0024(18)$ in KNa$_2$[Cr$_{2-x}$Li$_x$][Li$_{3-x}$Cr$_x$]Si$_{12}$O$_{30}$, corresponding to a T2-site Cr occupancy of $0.0008(6)$. X-ray MEM analysis shows no detectable Cr-like density at T2. Magnetic susceptibility indicates weak antiferromagnetic interactions with $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = -4.78(7)$ K and no ordering above 1.8 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesis（合成）、Rietveld refinement（Rietveld精修）、X-ray MEM analysis（X射线最大熵方法分析）、Magnetic susceptibility（磁化率测量）。；研究对象：铬（Cr）取代的硅酸盐矿物类似物——KNa₂Cr₂Li₃Si₁₂O₃₀，属于milartite型框架结构，具体为sugilite（杉石）的铬类似物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cr³⁺离子在结构中优先占据八面体配位位置（T2位），且占据率极低（约0.08%），导致磁相互作用非常弱，表现为弱反铁磁耦合（θ_W = -4.78 K），在1.8 K以上未观察到磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cr³⁺离子在结构中优先占据八面体配位位置（T2位），且占据率极低（约0.08%），导致磁相互作用非常弱，表现为弱反铁磁耦合（θ_W = -4.78 K），在1.8 K以上未观察到磁有序。；创新点：首次成功合成了sugilite的铬类似物，并精确量化了Cr³⁺在晶体结构中的选择性占据行为（几乎完全占据八面体位点，而非四面体位点），揭示了该体系中极弱的磁耦合特性。
papers.method_zh: 采用固相合成方法制备样品；使用Rietveld精修对成分守恒的反位缺陷模型进行结构分析；利用X射线最大熵方法（X-ray MEM analysis）分析电子密度分布；通过磁化率测量研究磁性质。

papers.title: Matrix-noise Jacobians in stochastic-calculus inference and optimal paths
papers.abstract: Multiplicative noise makes stochastic dynamics depend on how the white-noise limit is interpreted. In multidimensional systems with matrix-valued noise amplitudes $σ(x)$, this dependence includes a local Jacobian contribution that is absent from the scalar examples most often used to build intuition. We formulate a finite-step path-likelihood framework for $θ$-discretized diffusions and show that its short-time expansion isolates the scalar $J_σ=\partial_jσ_{ik}\partial_iσ_{jk}-(\partial_iσ_{ik})(\partial_lσ_{lk})$. For a specified noise-amplitude representation $σ$, this quantity vanishes in one-dimensional, scalar-isotropic, and strictly diagonal cases, but can survive when state-dependent noise directions mix different components. We then test its consequences using paired comparisons that hold the drift, diffusion matrix, interpolation point, and Gaussian increment term fixed. In Model A, removing only the off-diagonal determinant contribution produces a shift in the fitted stochastic prescription that vanishes when $J_σ=0$. In Model B, removing the corresponding state-dependent action term changes a stable optimized transition path. These results show that a genuinely matrix-noise part of the short-time path measure can survive the scalar cancellations familiar from simpler settings and produce measurable changes in fitted stochastic prescriptions and Onsager--Machlup paths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic-calculus inference（随机微积分推断）、path-likelihood framework（路径似然框架）、short-time expansion（短时展开）。；研究对象：具有矩阵值噪声振幅 σ(x) 的多维随机动力学系统，特别是乘法噪声（multiplicative noise）在随机微积分解释中的依赖性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一个仅存在于多维矩阵噪声系统中的局域雅可比项 J_σ = ∂_j σ_{ik} ∂_i σ_{jk} - (∂_i σ_{ik})(∂_l σ_{lk})，该量在一维、标量各向同性和严格对角情形下为零，但在状态依赖的噪声方向混合不同分量时非零，并能导致可观测的物理效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一个仅存在于多维矩阵噪声系统中的局域雅可比项 J_σ = ∂_j σ_{ik} ∂_i σ_{jk} - (∂_i σ_{ik})(∂_l σ_{lk})，该量在一维、标量各向同性和严格对角情形下为零，但在状态依赖的噪声方向混合不同分量时非零，并能导致可观测的物理效应。；创新点：揭示了在标量噪声情形中常见的抵消效应（scalar cancellations）在多维矩阵噪声中可能不完整，存在一个纯粹的矩阵噪声部分（J_σ）能够存活下来，并导致拟合的随机微积分解释（stochastic prescription）和最优路径（Onsager–Machlup paths）发生可测量的变化。摘要未明确说明与已有工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 构建了 θ-离散化扩散过程的有限步路径似然框架，并通过短时展开（short-time expansion）提取出标量雅可比项 J_σ。采用配对比较方法（paired comparisons）控制漂移、扩散矩阵、插值点和高斯增量项不变，在两种模型（Model A 和 Model B）中测试该雅可比项的后果。

papers.title: Frustrated Magnetism of the $S = 1$ Trillium-Lattice Oxide Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$
papers.abstract: We report magnetization and heat-capacity measurements on the ordered-spinel oxide Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$, where Ni$^{2+}$ ions with $S = 1$ form a single three-dimensional trillium lattice. Powder x-ray diffraction confirms a cubic ordered-spinel structure with space group $P4_{1}32$ or $P4_{3}32$. The inverse susceptibility $H/M$ follows Curie--Weiss behavior above 50 K with an effective magnetic moment $μ_{\mathrm{eff}} = 3.124(4)\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Ni and a Weiss temperature $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = -0.21(1)$ K, but deviates smoothly below about 10 K. The magnetic heat capacity $C_{\mathrm{mag}}/T$ shows a broad maximum near 3 K with a wide tail to about 10 K, and the entropy recovered between 2 and 40 K is about 88% of $R \ln 3$. The broad heat-capacity maximum is compared with Monte Carlo results for the local ferromagnetic Ising model on the trillium lattice using a characteristic scale $J$ of order 7 K, while the inverse susceptibility shows only qualitative similarity to the theoretical curve. These results establish Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$ as a rare $S = 1$ single-trillium oxide with frustrated magnetic correlations. The present data provide an experimental platform for discussing the relation between Heisenberg-like and spin-ice-like regimes on the trillium lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：magnetization and heat-capacity measurements（磁化与热容测量）、powder x-ray diffraction（粉末X射线衍射）。；研究对象：S=1的三角格（trillium lattice）氧化物Li₂NiGe₃O₈，其中Ni²⁺离子形成三维三角格，研究其阻挫磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li₂NiGe₃O₈是一种罕见的S=1单三角格氧化物，表现出阻挫磁关联；其磁热容在约3 K处出现宽峰，与三角格上局域铁磁Ising模型的蒙特卡洛结果定性一致，但逆磁化率仅与理论曲线有定性相似性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li₂NiGe₃O₈是一种罕见的S=1单三角格氧化物，表现出阻挫磁关联；其磁热容在约3 K处出现宽峰，与三角格上局域铁磁Ising模型的蒙特卡洛结果定性一致，但逆磁化率仅与理论曲线有定性相似性。；创新点：首次报道了S=1单三角格氧化物Li₂NiGe₃O₈的磁性表征，为讨论三角格上Heisenberg型与自旋冰型行为之间的关系提供了实验平台。摘要未突出说明与已有S=1三角格材料的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 粉末X射线衍射确定晶体结构；磁化率测量（Curie-Weiss分析）提取有效磁矩和Weiss温度；热容测量提取磁热容C_mag/T，并与三角格上局域铁磁Ising模型的蒙特卡洛模拟结果进行比较。

papers.title: Terahertz detection within charge density wave state
papers.abstract: Terahertz (THz) technology enables multi-Tbps satellite communications, but conventional semiconductor detectors suffer from fundamental performance degradation above 1 THz due to the Drude limit of free electrons. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that charge density wave (CDW) materials offer a paradigm-shifting solution via their collective electronic response. We show that a static bias electric field can continuously tune the THz resonant absorption frequency of CDW states from 0 to cutoff frequency, and enhance the nonlinear rectification current by more than one order of magnitude. This unprecedented electric-field tunability makes CDW materials ideal candidates for next-generation ultrafast THz detectors working at room-temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically demonstrate”“we show”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：电荷密度波（CDW）材料中的太赫兹（THz）探测机制，具体涉及CDW态的集体电子响应及其在太赫兹频段的共振吸收与整流效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 理论证明，通过施加静态偏置电场，可以连续调控CDW态的太赫兹共振吸收频率（从0至截止频率），并将非线性整流电流提升一个数量级以上，使CDW材料成为室温下下一代超快太赫兹探测器的理想候选。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：理论证明，通过施加静态偏置电场，可以连续调控CDW态的太赫兹共振吸收频率（从0至截止频率），并将非线性整流电流提升一个数量级以上，使CDW材料成为室温下下一代超快太赫兹探测器的理想候选。；创新点：提出利用CDW材料的集体电子响应替代传统半导体探测器，突破1 THz以上因自由电子Drude极限导致的性能退化，并首次展示电场对CDW太赫兹共振吸收的连续可调性及整流电流的显著增强。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于CDW材料的集体电子响应模型，研究静态偏置电场对太赫兹共振吸收频率的调谐作用以及对非线性整流电流的增强效应。

papers.title: Grassmann tensor networks
papers.abstract: Developing non-perturbative methods to reveal exotic properties of strongly correlated fermionic systems remains one of the most essential tasks of theoretical physics. Tensor network methods with Grassmann algebra offer powerful numerical tools for fermionic many-body systems in the coherent-state path-integral representation. Despite their vast potential for both condensed-matter and particle-physics communities, Grassmann tensor network methods are somewhat underexploited in practical simulations. In this work, we provide a detailed, self-contained introduction to Grassmann tensor network methods, from the basics of the Grassmann tensor operations to the Grassmannization of typical tensor network algorithms. Furthermore, the resulting Grassmann tensor network methods are validated in several interesting models in both particle physics and condensed matter physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“developing non-perturbative methods”、“tensor network methods”、“provide a detailed, self-contained introduction”，属于理论方法开发与介绍。；研究对象：强关联费米子多体系统，具体包括凝聚态物理和粒子物理中的若干模型（摘要未列出具体模型名称）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文系统性地建立了Grassmann张量网络方法，从基本运算到算法实现，并在多个物理模型中验证了其有效性，展示了该方法在强关联费米子系统非微扰计算中的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文系统性地建立了Grassmann张量网络方法，从基本运算到算法实现，并在多个物理模型中验证了其有效性，展示了该方法在强关联费米子系统非微扰计算中的潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：本文提供了Grassmann张量网络方法从基础到算法的完整、自洽的入门介绍，并首次在多个粒子物理与凝聚态物理模型中系统验证了该方法，弥补了该方法在实际模拟中应用不足的现状。
papers.method_zh: 基于Grassmann代数的张量网络方法，具体包括：Grassmann张量基本运算的定义、典型张量网络算法（如DMRG、TEBD等）的“Grassmann化”，以及在相干态路径积分表示下的数值实现。

papers.title: Topological and morphological signatures of disorder in a self-assembled, soft matter sponge network
papers.abstract: Many soft matter systems exhibit ordered, polycontinuous network morphologies, such as the cubic (double) gyroid or diamond, as well as disordered network morphologies known generically as ``random sponges". While presumed to share similar local packing geometry, the structural relationship between these ordered and disordered network morphologies has remained obscure. We use slice and view scanning electron microscopy to analyze and compare multi-scale morphological features of an ordered double-gyroid morphology to the amorphous sponge morphology formed in the same block copolymer sample. We find that node valence of the minority component network of the sponge is mostly gyroidal (trivalent), with a small fraction of diamond-like (tetravalent) connections. We analyze mesoatoms -- space-filling volumes occupied by chains around each network node -- finding significant differences in shape and size between ordered and amorphous regions. Local block thickness and inter-domain curvature within mesoatomic units of the disordered sponge exhibits a surprisingly similar degree of dispersity to the ordered double-gyroid.
