The resulting ((Ti_{40}Zr_{40}Ni_{20})_{72}Be_{28})_{97}Al_{3} BMGs demonstrate an ultrahigh specific strength of 5.34 \times 10^5 \text{ N}\cdot\text{m}\cdot\text{kg}^{-1}, establishing a new record for Ti-based BMGs, along with a plastic strain of 13\%, breaking through the traditional strength-plasticity limitation of BMGs. Structural analyses show that Al microalloying effectively inherits and modulates the short-range order derived from quasicrystalline structures, thereby achieving an observed synergistic enhancement in both strength and plasticity. This work provides new insights into composition design and lightweight structural applications of Ti-based BMGs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“结构分析”“微合金化”等实验手段，并给出了具体成分和性能数据。；研究对象：钛基块体金属玻璃（Ti-based BMGs），具体成分为((Ti₄₀Zr₄₀Ni₂₀)₇₂Be₂₈)₉₇Al₃，基于准晶结构设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过准晶结构遗传性与微量Al微合金化，实现了钛基金属玻璃比强度与塑性的协同提升，获得了创纪录的比强度（5.34×10⁵ N·m·kg⁻¹）和13%的塑性应变，突破了传统强度-塑性权衡限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过准晶结构遗传性与微量Al微合金化，实现了钛基金属玻璃比强度与塑性的协同提升，获得了创纪录的比强度（5.34×10⁵ N·m·kg⁻¹）和13%的塑性应变，突破了传统强度-塑性权衡限制。；创新点：基于准晶结构衍生的结构遗传性进行成分设计，并通过微量Al微合金化同时提升比强度和塑性，为钛基金属玻璃的成分设计提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 采用准晶结构遗传性设计策略与微量Al微合金化方法，通过结构分析（具体手段摘要未明确说明）研究Al微合金化对短程有序结构的继承与调控作用。

papers.title: Theory and Discovery of Electrides
papers.abstract: Electrides are materials with electrons localized at interstitial regions of the crystal lattice and have been identified as promising candidates for a variety of applications, including catalysis, electron emission, and superconductivity. We present a theoretical framework for the origin of interstitial electrons in electrides. We demonstrate that this theory can explain electride-like behavior in prototypical electrides, and we use it to develop descriptors for the high-throughput discovery of new inorganic electride candidates from first principles. We also show that the same concepts can explain electride-like behavior in other classes of material, including high-pressure electrides and organic electrides and, more broadly, provide an alternative understanding of F-center defects and solvated electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical framework, first principles, descriptors, high-throughput discovery）；研究对象：电化物（electrides），即电子局域于晶格间隙位置的材料，涵盖无机电化物、高压电化物、有机电化物，以及F心缺陷和溶剂化电子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个解释电化物中间隙电子起源的理论框架，并基于该理论开发了用于高通量发现新型无机电化物候选材料的描述符。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个解释电化物中间隙电子起源的理论框架，并基于该理论开发了用于高通量发现新型无机电化物候选材料的描述符。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles）结合高通量筛选（high-throughput discovery），通过理论推导建立描述符（descriptors）。

papers.title: Nanostructure of PEGDA-PEG hydrogel membranes and how it controls their permeability
papers.abstract: The spacial heterogeneity of hydrogels composed of PEGDA and added polymer chains is expected to play a crucial role on their transport properties which can be exploited in filtration or tissue engineering. However little is known about the arrangement of the polymer chains in the matrix and the length scales of these heterogeneities. Here we combine solid-state NMR and Small Angle Neutron Scattering to unravel the structure and dynamics of PEGDA hydrogels containing added PEG chains of various concentrations. Our results show that the samples present heterogeneities in both the PEGDA and PEG concentrations and suggest that the PEG chains entangle with the PEGDA network. When plotting the sample permeability, K, as a function the specific surface of the PEGDA heterogeneities we obtain a master curve, showing that the heterogeneity of the PEGDA matrix controls the permeability of the sample. Moreover the scaling K ___ V/S suggests a structure composed of facetted PEGDA/PEG heterogeneities separated by a network of aqueous thin and flattened films in which the water can permeate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：solid-state NMR、Small Angle Neutron Scattering（实验手段）。；研究对象：PEGDA-PEG水凝胶膜，具体研究其纳米尺度结构以及该结构如何控制膜的渗透性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PEGDA水凝胶膜的渗透性由其内部PEGDA异质性的比表面积（specific surface）控制，且渗透率K与比表面积V/S呈标度关系，表明水渗透通过由薄而扁平的水膜分隔的PEGDA/PEG多面体异质结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PEGDA水凝胶膜的渗透性由其内部PEGDA异质性的比表面积（specific surface）控制，且渗透率K与比表面积V/S呈标度关系，表明水渗透通过由薄而扁平的水膜分隔的PEGDA/PEG多面体异质结构。；创新点：首次通过实验揭示了PEGDA水凝胶中PEGDA和PEG浓度的空间异质性，并建立了渗透率与PEGDA异质性比表面积之间的主曲线（master curve），从而明确了基质异质性对渗透性的控制机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 固态核磁共振（solid-state NMR）和小角中子散射（Small Angle Neutron Scattering）相结合，用于解析水凝胶中聚合物链的结构和动力学。

papers.title: Tensional wrinkling of thin elastic sheets with two circular holes
papers.abstract: A paradigm for the study of wrinkling in elastic sheet is the Lamé configuration, in which azimuthal wrinkles form in an annular sheet subjected to tensile loads at both edges. Since wrinkles are spatially extended, this instability provides a mechanism for stress transmission over long distances. A natural extension of this problem is wrinkling in sheets with multiple holes or broken symmetry. Here, we investigate tension-induced wrinkling in thin elastic sheets containing two circular holes by combining analytical modeling and experiments. The pre-buckled state is solved analytically using bipolar coordinates, enabling identification of the wrinkling threshold as a function of the distance between the two holes. Near-threshold wrinkling and interactions between wrinkles are analyzed, and we validate our theoretical predictions against experimental observations obtained through video imaging of spin-coated polystyrene sheets floating on liquid surfaces with controlled surface tension. Our results demonstrate that geometric symmetry breaking, such as the presence of a second hole, strongly influences wrinkle nucleation, orientation, and spatial extent. Beyond mechanics, these findings might provide a simple mechanism for cellular mechanosensing, where force transmission is amplified by mechanical instabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 实验验证）。关键词：analytical modeling, experiments, video imaging。；研究对象：含两个圆孔的薄弹性片在拉伸载荷下形成的褶皱（wrinkling）现象，具体为双孔弹性片中的张力诱导褶皱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 几何对称性破缺（如引入第二个孔）强烈影响褶皱的成核、取向和空间范围；褶皱阈值随两孔间距变化，且褶皱可作为长距离应力传递的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：几何对称性破缺（如引入第二个孔）强烈影响褶皱的成核、取向和空间范围；褶皱阈值随两孔间距变化，且褶皱可作为长距离应力传递的机制。；创新点：将经典的单孔环形片（Lamé构型）褶皱问题推广到含两个圆孔的非对称体系，揭示了多孔或对称性破缺对褶皱行为的影响，并提供了实验验证。摘要未突出说明与单孔情况的具体定量差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：使用双极坐标（bipolar coordinates）解析求解屈曲前状态，识别褶皱阈值；实验方面：对旋涂聚苯乙烯（polystyrene）薄片进行视频成像，薄片漂浮在具有可控表面张力的液体表面。

papers.title: Barnett effect in rotating spinor dipolar quantum droplets
papers.abstract: We propose releasing the spin degree of freedom to stabilize the vortex state in self-bound droplets of dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates. When a vortex is embedded into the droplet, spontaneous magnetization arises in the axial direction via a mechanism similar to the Barnett effect; that is, the orbital angular momentum is transferred to the spin angular momentum. When an external magnetic field is applied to the spontaneously magnetized droplet, the entire atomic cloud starts to rotate without changing its shape, which can be regarded as mechanical Larmor precession of a macroscopic object. A chirally different pair of droplets can form a stable bound state because of the attractive interaction between the spontaneously magnetized droplets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、mechanism（机制）、regarded as（视为）。；研究对象：旋转自旋极化偶极量子液滴中的Barnett效应，具体为偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates）中自束缚液滴的涡旋态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在偶极量子液滴中嵌入涡旋后，会通过类似Barnett效应的机制自发产生轴向磁化（轨道角动量转化为自旋角动量）；施加外磁场时，整个液滴会像宏观物体一样发生机械拉莫尔进动而不改变形状；不同手性的磁化液滴对可通过吸引相互作用形成稳定束缚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在偶极量子液滴中嵌入涡旋后，会通过类似Barnett效应的机制自发产生轴向磁化（轨道角动量转化为自旋角动量）；施加外磁场时，整个液滴会像宏观物体一样发生机械拉莫尔进动而不改变形状；不同手性的磁化液滴对可通过吸引相互作用形成稳定束缚态。；创新点：首次提出释放自旋自由度来稳定偶极量子液滴中的涡旋态，并揭示了液滴作为宏观物体发生机械拉莫尔进动的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的自束缚液滴模型，引入自旋自由度，类比Barnett效应和拉莫尔进动进行物理机制推导。

papers.title: Altermagnons at the metal-insulator transition
papers.abstract: By means of slave-boson theory for the Hubbard model on the checkerboard lattice, we calculate dynamical altermagnetic spin susceptibilities from the metallic to the Mott-insulating regime. We track magnon dispersion and lifetime renormalization, allowing us to uncover a crossover from a chirality-selective dissipation of magnon modes to coherent yet strongly deformed chiral magnon branches across the metal insulator transition. Our formalism lends itself to a quantitative description of collective spin dynamics in correlated altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：slave-boson theory（奴隶玻色子理论）、计算（calculate）、理论框架（formalism）。；研究对象：棋盘格晶格上的Hubbard模型，以及该体系中从金属态到Mott绝缘态的交替磁（altermagnetic）自旋动力学，具体包括交替磁振子（altermagnons）的色散和寿命重整化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金属-绝缘体转变过程中，交替磁振子模式经历了一个从手性选择性耗散到相干但强烈形变的手性磁振子分支的交叉（crossover）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金属-绝缘体转变过程中，交替磁振子模式经历了一个从手性选择性耗散到相干但强烈形变的手性磁振子分支的交叉（crossover）。；创新点：该工作为关联交替磁体（correlated altermagnets）中的集体自旋动力学提供了定量描述框架，揭示了金属-绝缘体转变对交替磁振子手性特征和耗散行为的调控。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或先前理论工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用奴隶玻色子理论（slave-boson theory）处理棋盘格晶格上的Hubbard模型，计算了从金属态到Mott绝缘态的动力学交替磁自旋磁化率，并追踪了磁振子色散和寿命的重整化。

papers.title: Tracer-free Contactless Acoustic Microrheometry Quantifies Viscoelastic Spectrum of Phase-separated Condensates
papers.abstract: The rheology of phase-separated condensates plays a central role in applications spanning advanced materials design and cellular processes, yet quantitative characterization of their viscoelasticity remains challenging due to the limitations of existing microrheological methods that require tracer particles or mechanical contact. Here, we establish tracer-free and contactless acoustic microrheometry as a versatile platform for quantifying the frequency-dependent complex shear modulus of single microscale condensates over 0.01-10 Hz. Using spatiotemporally controlled acoustic radiation force generated within a micro-acoustic resonator, this method deforms condensates for creep-recovery and oscillatory viscoelastic measurements. Quantitative validation using dextran condensates in a polyethylene-glycol continuous phase successfully captures their size- and frequency-dependent mechanical responses, while application to nucleic-acid condensates reveals salt-dependent internal viscoelastic changes at single-condensate resolution. By enabling quantitative dissection of condensate mechanics without invasive probes, acoustic microrheometry provides a broadly applicable framework for investigating phase-separated condensates across materials science, soft matter physics, biology, and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了建立（establish）一种新方法，并进行了定量验证（quantitative validation）和应用（application）。；研究对象：相分离凝聚体（phase-separated condensates）的流变学特性，具体包括葡聚糖（dextran）凝聚体和核酸（nucleic-acid）凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了一种无示踪粒子、非接触的声学微流变测量方法，能够定量表征单个微米级相分离凝聚体在0.01-10 Hz频率范围内的复剪切模量，并揭示了凝聚体尺寸、频率以及盐浓度对其粘弹性响应的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了一种无示踪粒子、非接触的声学微流变测量方法，能够定量表征单个微米级相分离凝聚体在0.01-10 Hz频率范围内的复剪切模量，并揭示了凝聚体尺寸、频率以及盐浓度对其粘弹性响应的影响。；创新点：实现了对单个微米级相分离凝聚体的无示踪粒子（tracer-free）、非接触（contactless）的定量粘弹性谱测量，克服了现有微流变方法需要引入示踪粒子或机械接触的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 声学微流变测量法（acoustic microrheometry）。具体利用微声学谐振器（micro-acoustic resonator）产生时空可控的声辐射力（acoustic radiation force），对单个凝聚体进行蠕变恢复（creep-recovery）和振荡粘弹性（oscillatory viscoelastic）测量。

papers.title: The Algebra of Free Fermions: Classifying Spaces, Hamiltonians, and Computation
papers.abstract: Research on topological phases of matter is a core field in modern condensed matter physics. Free fermion systems, such as topological insulators and superconductors, have been studied using the "Tenfold Way" and K-theory. Building on Kitaev's idea of $Ω$-spectrum and classifying space, as well as Freed-Moore's K-theory, this work demonstrates that free fermionic systems form a genuine $G$-$Ω$-spectrum and clarifies its connection to several distinct classification schemes appearing in the physical literature. By introducing the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded algebra $A_{\mathrm{sym}}^V$, the classification problem for systems with general symmetries, including antilinear symmetries, antisymmetries, projective representations, and point group symmetries, is turned into an extension problem in representation theory. To solve this, a computational method for the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded Wedderburn-Artin decomposition of $A_{\mathrm{sym}}^V$ is developed. This decomposition not only yields a classification but also enables the explicit construction of the corresponding Dirac Hamiltonian. Furthermore, a GAP programming package has been developed to automate these calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：K-theory、Ω-spectrum、representation theory、algebraic classification。；研究对象：自由费米子体系，包括拓扑绝缘体、拓扑超导体等具有一般对称性（包括反线性对称、反对称、投影表示、点群对称）的拓扑物相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自由费米子系统构成一个真正的G-Ω-谱，并建立了与物理文献中多种分类方案的联系；通过引入Z₂-分次代数A_sym^V，将一般对称性下的分类问题转化为表示论中的扩张问题，并发展了Z₂-分次Wedderburn-Artin分解的计算方法，从而不仅实现分类，还能显式构造对应的Dirac哈密顿量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自由费米子系统构成一个真正的G-Ω-谱，并建立了与物理文献中多种分类方案的联系；通过引入Z₂-分次代数A_sym^V，将一般对称性下的分类问题转化为表示论中的扩张问题，并发展了Z₂-分次Wedderburn-Artin分解的计算方法，从而不仅实现分类，还能显式构造对应的Dirac哈密顿量。；创新点：将自由费米子分类问题统一为表示论中的扩张问题，并提供了可自动计算的代数分解方法，同时实现了从分类到哈密顿量显式构造的完整流程。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kitaev的Ω-谱与分类空间思想以及Freed-Moore的K-理论框架，引入Z₂-分次代数A_sym^V，利用Z₂-分次Wedderburn-Artin分解进行代数分类，并开发了GAP编程包实现自动化计算。

papers.title: Fast and Accurate Prediction of Lattice Thermal Conductivity via Machine Learning Surrogates
papers.abstract: The appearance of generative models has opened vast chemical spaces in the design of functional materials. Although machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have substantially accelerated phonon calculations, high-fidelity prediction of lattice thermal conductivity \k{appa}lat still requires accurate treatment of anharmonic interactions, which remains a key challenge for existing potentials across novel chemical spaces. To address this challenge, we present a comprehensive benchmark of 15 surrogate models for predicting \k{appa}lat using the Phonix database, which contains 6,966 entries with anharmonic phonon properties derived from first-principles calculations. Firstly, We categorize these surrogate models into three distinct groups: Physical-informed feature descriptors combined with ML models, end-to-end deep neural networks, and pre-trained MLIP-embeddings combined with ML models. By evaluating model performance across random, space-group disjoint (testing generalization to unseen crystal symmetries), and Out-Of-Distribution splits (OOD dataset that testing extrapolation to property regimes beyond the training range) based on \k{appa}lat, we probe both interpolation and exploration capabilities. Our results reveal that MLIP-embedded models excel in interpolation within well-sampled regions, deep neural network models especially ALiEGNN demonstrate superior robustness in OOD regimes critical for discovering novel low-\k{appa}lat. Additionally, we find a systematic degradation in performance when the structural representation is reduced. Although surrogate models exhibit lower accuracy than direct simulations using first-principles calculation, they reduce computational costs by orders of magnitude, enabling efficient high-throughput screening of thermoelectric materials with minimal loss in generative design workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning surrogates、first-principles calculations、benchmark。；研究对象：晶格热导率（κlat）的快速准确预测，具体基于Phonix数据库中的6,966个条目（包含来自第一性原理计算的非简谐声子性质）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机器学习代理模型（尤其是MLIP嵌入模型和ALiEGNN深度神经网络）在预测晶格热导率时，能在不同泛化场景下实现高精度与极低计算成本的平衡，其中ALiEGNN在发现新型低κlat材料的分布外（OOD）区域表现出最优鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机器学习代理模型（尤其是MLIP嵌入模型和ALiEGNN深度神经网络）在预测晶格热导率时，能在不同泛化场景下实现高精度与极低计算成本的平衡，其中ALiEGNN在发现新型低κlat材料的分布外（OOD）区域表现出最优鲁棒性。；创新点：首次在包含6,966个非简谐声子性质的大规模数据库上，对三类不同架构的机器学习代理模型进行系统基准测试，并特别关注了模型在分布外（OOD）场景下的外推能力，揭示了不同模型在插值与探索任务中的优劣。
papers.method_zh: 构建并系统比较了15种代理模型，分为三类：物理信息特征描述符结合机器学习模型、端到端深度神经网络、预训练MLIP嵌入结合机器学习模型。通过随机划分、空间群不交划分（测试对未知晶体对称性的泛化）和基于κlat的分布外划分（测试外推能力）来评估模型性能。

papers.title: Interband Berry connection measurement in the optical honeycomb lattice
papers.abstract: The geometry of Bloch bands affects many physical properties of crystalline solids and other spatially periodic systems. Direct experimental determination of such geometry is an active area of research. In this work, we focus on the fundamental connection between optical excitations and the relative geometry of pairs of Bloch bands, as characterized by the interband Berry connection. We simulate the response of electrons in solids to optical excitation by the response of ultracold fermionic atoms in optical lattices to periodic modulation of the lattice position. The strength of resonant excitation between bands, measured at each quasimomentum and for various lattice-shaking polarizations, directly maps out the interband Berry connection. We apply this method to the optical honeycomb lattice, driving excitations between the ground $n=1$ band and the excited $n'=\{2,3,4\}$ bands. We observe transparency lines of quasimomenta at which the response to excitation of specific polarization is zero. Further, the interband Berry connection between bands 1 and 3 shows irreducible Dirac strings connecting the $K$ and $K'$ points in the Brillouin zone, lines along which the interband Berry connection abruptly changes orientation. Our work establishes optical response as a powerful tool for characterizing geometrical and topological properties of band structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We simulate the response...”、“We apply this method...”、“We observe...”，描述了具体的实验测量过程和观测结果。；研究对象：光学蜂窝晶格（optical honeycomb lattice）中的超冷费米子原子（ultracold fermionic atoms），以及其能带间的几何性质，具体为带间贝里连接（interband Berry connection）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量不同准动量下、不同晶格振动偏振方向对带间共振激发的响应强度，可以直接映射出带间贝里连接。实验观测到了特定偏振下响应为零的准动量“透明线”，并发现第1和第3能带之间的带间贝里连接存在不可约的狄拉克弦（Dirac strings），连接布里渊区的K和K’点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量不同准动量下、不同晶格振动偏振方向对带间共振激发的响应强度，可以直接映射出带间贝里连接。实验观测到了特定偏振下响应为零的准动量“透明线”，并发现第1和第3能带之间的带间贝里连接存在不可约的狄拉克弦（Dirac strings），连接布里渊区的K和K’点。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于提出并实验演示了一种通过光学响应（即晶格调制下的带间激发）来直接测量能带几何性质（带间贝里连接）的通用方法，并将其应用于光学蜂窝晶格，揭示了其中与拓扑相关的狄拉克弦结构。
papers.method_zh: 利用超冷费米子原子在光学晶格中的响应来模拟固体中电子对光激发的响应。具体手段是对光学晶格的位置施加周期性调制（lattice-shaking），并测量不同准动量（quasimomentum）和不同调制偏振方向下的带间共振激发强度。

papers.title: Outstanding TC Enhancement in 5d-3d Y2NiIrO6 by Compression
papers.abstract: Understanding and predicting the properties of 5d compounds critically depend on the identification of the superexchange interactions from which their magnetism emerges. The study of pressure effects on double perovskites Y2NiIrO6 (YNIO) provide deep insight toward this goal. At ambient pressure, YNIO is a ferrimagnetic insulator with the Ir4+-5d Jeff = 1/2 Mott-insulating state. Under the physical pressure up to 17 GPa, the compound exhibits concurrent compression on Ni/Ir-O bond lengths and Ni-O-Ir bond angles, leading to increase of the Curie temperature from 192 to 240 K. In contrary, external pressure increases distanced Ir-Ir interaction and in turn induces magnetic frustration in Sr2IrO4/Sr3Ir2O7 due to the extended 5d orbitals. In YNIO, the rock-salt ordered Ni-Ir naturally blocks extended superexchange beyond the nearest neighbor, and in turn suppresses such magnetic frustration. Moreover, the orthogonal Ni eg-Ir t2g pathway in YNIO is robust under lattice distortion, while the superexchange is weakened by bond bending in La2NiMnO6 with a similar half-filed eg-t2g configuration. Our findings establish a framework for elucidating the mechanism of 5d-3d superexchange and guides bond-engineered magnetism in iridate-related systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：physical pressure up to 17 GPa、Curie temperature、bond lengths、bond angles等实验测量参数。；研究对象：双钙钛矿氧化物Y₂NiIrO₆（YNIO）在物理压力下的磁性与结构变化，特别是5d-3d超交换相互作用机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在17 GPa物理压力下，Y₂NiIrO₆的居里温度从192 K显著提升至240 K，且由于岩盐有序的Ni-Ir结构抑制了磁阻挫，其超交换作用在压缩下保持稳健。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在17 GPa物理压力下，Y₂NiIrO₆的居里温度从192 K显著提升至240 K，且由于岩盐有序的Ni-Ir结构抑制了磁阻挫，其超交换作用在压缩下保持稳健。；创新点：揭示了在5d-3d双钙钛矿体系中，岩盐有序的Ni-Ir排列能有效阻断最近邻以外的扩展超交换，从而避免类似Sr₂IrO₄/Sr₃Ir₂O₇中因压力导致的磁阻挫；同时发现正交的Ni e_g-Ir t₂g超交换路径在晶格畸变下保持稳健，与La₂NiMnO₆中因键弯曲而弱化的超交换形成对比。
papers.method_zh: 施加物理压力（最高17 GPa），测量Ni/Ir-O键长、Ni-O-Ir键角随压力的变化，并结合居里温度的变化分析超交换相互作用。摘要未明确提及具体实验技术（如X射线衍射、磁化率测量等），但可推断使用了高压原位结构表征与磁性测量手段。

papers.title: Euler Topology in Superconducting Honeycomb Lattices
papers.abstract: Electronic bands in systems with space-time inversion (IST) symmetry can host nontrivial Euler topology. Here, we investigate the band topology of IST-symmetric superconducting honeycomb lattices and demonstrate that s-wave spin-singlet (SWSS) and f-wave spin-triplet (FWST) superconducting pairings give rise to valley-Euler and Euler superconductors, respectively. We find that Euler topology in both pairing states gives rise to mirror-symmetry-protected helical domain-wall modes. Furthermore, we show that Euler topology in the FWST state induces non-Abelian braiding of Dirac nodes in momentum space when anisotropic hopping is introduced. Our work establishes superconducting electronic instabilities as a natural route to realizing nontrivial Euler band topology in Dirac materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、demonstrate、show、establish（理论分析与推导）。；研究对象：具有时空反演（IST）对称性的超导蜂窝晶格体系，具体研究s波自旋单态（SWSS）和f波自旋三重态（FWST）超导配对下的欧拉拓扑。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在IST对称的超导蜂窝晶格中，s波自旋单态和f波自旋三重态超导配对分别导致谷-欧拉超导体和欧拉超导体；两种配对态的欧拉拓扑均产生镜面对称保护的螺旋畴壁模，且f波三重态中的欧拉拓扑在引入各向异性跳跃时会导致动量空间狄拉克节点的非阿贝尔编织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在IST对称的超导蜂窝晶格中，s波自旋单态和f波自旋三重态超导配对分别导致谷-欧拉超导体和欧拉超导体；两种配对态的欧拉拓扑均产生镜面对称保护的螺旋畴壁模，且f波三重态中的欧拉拓扑在引入各向异性跳跃时会导致动量空间狄拉克节点的非阿贝尔编织。；创新点：首次将超导电子不稳定性（s波和f波配对）确立为实现狄拉克材料中非平凡欧拉能带拓扑的自然途径，并揭示了f波三重态欧拉拓扑中狄拉克节点的非阿贝尔编织现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于能带拓扑理论，研究IST对称超导蜂窝晶格的能带拓扑性质，分析不同超导配对（SWSS和FWST）下的欧拉拓扑结构及其对称性保护边界态，并探讨各向异性跳跃对狄拉克节点编织行为的影响。

papers.title: Experimental Progress in Ambient-Pressure Superconducting Bilayer Nickelate Films
papers.abstract: Bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates display superconductivity near 80 K under high pressure, establishing a new nickelate platform for studying unconventional high-temperature superconductivity. The recent stabilization of superconducting RA3Ni2O7 (RA = rare earth or alkaline earth) films at ambient pressure has changed the experimental landscape: epitaxial strain can reproduce key structural ingredients of the high-pressure phase while making transport, spectroscopy, microscopy, and device-oriented measurements directly accessible. This Review summarizes the experimental progress on ambient-pressure superconducting bilayer nickelate films, with emphasis on synthesis routes, oxygen stoichiometry, substrate-induced strain, normal-state transport, superconducting properties, doping phase diagrams, and momentum-resolved electronic structure. We highlight several issues that remain unsettled, including the reproducibility of phase-pure ultrathin films, the microscopic origin of the two-step superconducting transition, the role of oxygen defects and substrate-derived doping, the position of the Ni 3dz2-derived γ band, and the pairing symmetry. We close by outlining experimental directions that could establish a more quantitative link among crystal structure, orbital reconstruction, and superconductivity in bilayer nickelate films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：实验进展、综述、合成、输运、光谱、显微术）；研究对象：环境压力下超导的双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍氧化物薄膜（RA₃Ni₂O₇，RA=稀土或碱土元素）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过外延应变可在环境压力下稳定双层镍氧化物薄膜的超导态，使其输运、光谱、显微及器件测量成为可能，从而改变了该领域的研究格局。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过外延应变可在环境压力下稳定双层镍氧化物薄膜的超导态，使其输运、光谱、显微及器件测量成为可能，从而改变了该领域的研究格局。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（该文为综述，主要总结已有实验进展，未明确声称自身创新点）。
papers.method_zh: 综述了合成路线、氧化学计量调控、衬底诱导应变、常态输运、超导性质、掺杂相图、动量分辨电子结构（如ARPES）等实验手段。

papers.title: $G^0W^0$ implementation based on the pseudopotential and numerical-atomic-orbital basis-set framework: Algorithms and benchmarks
papers.abstract: The $GW$ method delivers substantially improved accuracy in electronic band structure calculations over conventional Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) by explicitly incorporating the electron self-energy effect beyond mean-field approximations. Despite many existing implementations, a periodic $GW$ implementation within the framework of numerical atomic orbitals (NAO) combined with the pseudopotential (PP) scheme has not been reported. This is urgently needed given the increasing popularity of the NAO-PP framework in KS-DFT calculations and its importance for the development of machine-learning electronic-structure approaches. In this work, we present an efficient NAO-PP-based $G^0W^0$ computational framework by interfacing the first-principles software package ABACUS with LibRPA -- a library for performing low-scaling random-phase approximation and $GW$ calculations based on NAOs. Our approach employs the localized resolution of identity (LRI) technique with a novel compression scheme, significantly improving both computational efficiency and numerical stability. In addition, an analytic treatment of the small-q limit of the microscopic dielectric function reduces the need for dense q-point sampling. Furthermore, we propose a practical strategy to select a suitable KS-DFT pseudopotential prior to $G^0W^0$ calculations by examining the frequency-dependent macroscopic dielectric function. Systematic benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our compression scheme and real-space tensor filtering strategies, demonstrating both high accuracy and significant computational efficiency gains. Comparisons with established $G^0W^0$ implementations show excellent agreement in band structures and band gaps, confirming ABACUS+LibRPA as a reliable and efficient platform for large-scale $G^0W^0$ simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：implementation（实现）、benchmarks（基准测试）、computational framework（计算框架）。；研究对象：基于赝势（PP）和数值原子轨道（NAO）基组框架下的周期性 \(G^0W^0\) 计算方法。摘要未明确说明具体材料体系，而是以方法开发和基准测试为主。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将第一性原理软件ABACUS与低标度RPA/GW计算库LibRPA接口，成功实现了基于NAO-PP框架的高效 \(G^0W^0\) 计算，在保证精度的同时显著提升了计算效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将第一性原理软件ABACUS与低标度RPA/GW计算库LibRPA接口，成功实现了基于NAO-PP框架的高效 \(G^0W^0\) 计算，在保证精度的同时显著提升了计算效率。；创新点：首次在数值原子轨道（NAO）与赝势（PP）结合的框架下实现了周期性 \(G^0W^0\) 计算；提出了针对LRI的压缩方案和实空间张量滤波策略以提升计算效率与数值稳定性；提出了通过介电函数预选赝势的实用策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用局域化分辨率恒等式（LRI）技术并引入新型压缩方案；对小q极限下的微观介电函数进行解析处理；提出通过检查频率依赖的宏观介电函数来预选合适的KS-DFT赝势的策略。软件实现基于ABACUS+LibRPA平台。

papers.title: Defect screening and load transfer in minimal hard-soft double networks
papers.abstract: Double network (DN) materials exhibit anomalous strength and toughness that far exceed the sum of their constituents. While widely exploited, the fundamental physical mechanisms underlying this synergy remain elusive. Here, we show that a minimal three-dimensional model of two coupled, disordered linear-elastic networks is sufficient to capture the essential physics of DN nonlinear mechanics. The model reproduces the full suite of unique mechanical behaviors, including yielding, necking, strain hardening, and the brittle-to-ductile transition. Mechanical contrast between the hard and soft networks drives inter-network load transfer, which screens defects and suppresses stress concentrations in the hard network. By defining a stress-concentration factor, K_sc, we find that the hard-network failure strain scales universally as 1/K_sc, directly bridging microscopic defect screening to macroscopic yielding. We further show that complete defect screening triggers the shift from localized necking to delocalized damage. Furthermore, the stable necking plateau is identified as an energetic selection governed by the balance between potential energy release and irreversible dissipation. These findings reveal that a simple linear-elastic framework can account for the rich nonlinear landscape of DN materials, providing a general principle for designing next-generation tough solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：minimal three-dimensional model、linear-elastic networks、energetic selection。；研究对象：双网络（Double Network, DN）材料，具体为一种由两个耦合的无序线性弹性网络构成的最小三维模型，研究其非线性力学行为（屈服、颈缩、应变硬化、脆韧转变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硬网络与软网络之间的力学对比驱动了网络间载荷传递，从而屏蔽缺陷并抑制硬网络中的应力集中；硬网络的失效应变与应力集中因子K_sc成反比，且完全缺陷屏蔽会触发从局部颈缩向非局部损伤的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硬网络与软网络之间的力学对比驱动了网络间载荷传递，从而屏蔽缺陷并抑制硬网络中的应力集中；硬网络的失效应变与应力集中因子K_sc成反比，且完全缺陷屏蔽会触发从局部颈缩向非局部损伤的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于：仅用两个耦合的线性弹性网络模型即可复现双网络材料丰富的非线性力学行为（如屈服、颈缩、应变硬化、脆韧转变），并建立了缺陷屏蔽与宏观屈服之间的普适标度关系（失效应变∝1/K_sc），揭示了稳定颈缩平台源于势能释放与不可逆耗散之间的能量平衡。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个由两个耦合的无序线性弹性网络组成的最小三维模型，通过数值模拟分析其非线性力学响应，并定义了应力集中因子K_sc来量化缺陷屏蔽效应。

papers.title: Thermoviscoelasticity of polydomain liquid crystal elastomers regulated by soft elasticity
papers.abstract: Liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) are elastomeric networks with rod-like mesogens that reorient under load. In polydomain LCEs, this reorientation drives a polydomain-to-monodomain transition that produces a soft-elastic plateau. Coupling between this soft elasticity and polymer-network viscoelasticity yields a path-dependent thermoviscoelastic response, central to applications in damping, impact protection, and tough adhesives. However, the physics governing this response under complex thermomechanical histories remains insufficiently studied. We present a combined experimental and theoretical study of polydomain LCEs under three uniaxial protocols: single-cycle loading-unloading, stress-free recovery from various pre-stretches, and multi-cycle loading with progressively increasing amplitude. We develop a finite-deformation constitutive model combining two parallel mechanisms: rate-independent, temperature-dependent soft elasticity from mesogen reorientation, and time- and temperature-dependent viscoelasticity. With a single parameter set, the model quantitatively reproduces all three protocols and resolves each mechanism's contribution. A temperature-dependent soft-elastic limit governs the low-rate response and the long-time recovered stretch, while viscoelasticity controls the rate-dependent deviation and the cycle-wise accumulation of residual stretch away from this limit. A thermal recovery test above the nematic-isotropic transition confirms that all hysteresis and residual deformation are reversible, ruling out irreversible damage. The framework provides mechanistic understanding and a predictive basis for designing polydomain LCE components under complex thermomechanical histories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and theoretical study”以及“develop a finite-deformation constitutive model”。；研究对象：多畴液晶弹性体（polydomain liquid crystal elastomers, LCEs）在复杂热力学历史下的热粘弹性行为，特别是由软弹性（soft elasticity）调控的力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多畴LCE的软弹性与聚合物网络粘弹性耦合，导致路径依赖的热粘弹性响应；所有滞后和残余变形在高于向列-各向同性转变温度的热恢复测试中完全可逆，排除了不可逆损伤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多畴LCE的软弹性与聚合物网络粘弹性耦合，导致路径依赖的热粘弹性响应；所有滞后和残余变形在高于向列-各向同性转变温度的热恢复测试中完全可逆，排除了不可逆损伤。；创新点：通过单一参数集定量复现三种不同实验协议，并解析了软弹性和粘弹性各自对响应（如低速率响应、长时间恢复伸长、速率依赖性偏差、残余伸长的循环累积）的贡献。摘要未突出说明与以往模型相比的具体理论改进。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用三种单轴加载协议：单次循环加载-卸载、不同预拉伸后的无应力恢复、以及振幅递增的多循环加载。理论上构建了有限变形本构模型，包含两个并联机制：与速率无关、温度依赖的软弹性（由介晶基元重取向驱动）和与时间及温度依赖的粘弹性。

papers.title: Landau theory applied to antiferroelectric ordering in ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals
papers.abstract: The polarization and density modulation associated with antiferroelectric ordering is studied experimentally as a function of temperature in two ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals, the prototypical single compound (DIO) and a commercial mixture (FNLC919). The modulation wavenumber qA is determined by small angle X-ray diffraction from the weak smectic-like density wave (wavenumber qS = 2qA) that accompanies the polarization modulation. Results for qS and the saturated value of the polarization are analyzed in terms of Landau theory previously developed to describe the para-/antiferro-/feroelectric sequence of phase transitions in solid ferroelectrics. The analysis indicates that the polarization modulation is reasonably well approximated by a simple sinusoid in the antiferroelectric phase of DIO, whereas in FNLC919 the modulation develops a strongly soliton-like profile (with sharply decreasing wavenumber) close to the antiferro- to ferrolectric transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally studied”（实验研究），并使用了小角X射线衍射等实验手段。；研究对象：铁电向列型液晶中的反铁电有序。具体材料为：原型单组分化合物DIO和商业混合物FNLC919。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Landau理论分析，发现DIO化合物中的极化调制在反铁电相中近似为简单正弦波；而FNLC919混合物中，在接近反铁电-铁电相变时，极化调制发展出强孤子状轮廓（波数急剧减小）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Landau理论分析，发现DIO化合物中的极化调制在反铁电相中近似为简单正弦波；而FNLC919混合物中，在接近反铁电-铁电相变时，极化调制发展出强孤子状轮廓（波数急剧减小）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用小角X射线衍射测量伴随极化调制的弱近晶型密度波（波数qS = 2qA），从而确定调制波数qA。理论上，利用先前为固体铁电体中顺电/反铁电/铁电相变序列开发的Landau理论，分析qS和极化饱和值的实验结果。

papers.title: Superconductivity Reinforces Charge-Density-Wave Phase Coherence across Cuprates
papers.abstract: For decades, superconductivity in high-Tc cuprates has been viewed as a competitor that suppresses charge-density-wave (CDW) order by reducing its amplitude and spatial extent. Here, we show that this picture is incomplete, as superconductivity is accompanied by a systematic enhancement of CDW phase coherence across multiple cuprate families. Using resonant soft x-ray scattering combined with a coherence-sensitive momentum-profile analysis, we uncover a BCS-like growth of phase coherence below Tc, which phenomenologically manifests as the absence of CDW peak broadening and near-perfect wave-vector locking. This enhancement remains visible even in a disorder-dominated regime created by long-term crystal aging and follows a common trend when compared with published data on Bi-, Hg-, Y-, and Nd-based cuprates. These results indicate that superconductivity reshapes CDW order in two distinct ways, suppressing its amplitude while strengthening its phase coherence, and reveal an additional phase-level interplay with lattice coupling in high-Tc cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“resonant soft x-ray scattering combined with a coherence-sensitive momentum-profile analysis”（共振软X射线散射结合相干敏感动量轮廓分析）。；研究对象：高温铜氧化物超导体（cuprates）中的电荷密度波（CDW）与超导电性之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导电性并非单纯抑制CDW，而是以两种不同方式重塑CDW：一方面抑制其振幅，另一方面增强其相位相干性。这种相位相干性的增强在超导转变温度以下表现出类似BCS理论的增长行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导电性并非单纯抑制CDW，而是以两种不同方式重塑CDW：一方面抑制其振幅，另一方面增强其相位相干性。这种相位相干性的增强在超导转变温度以下表现出类似BCS理论的增长行为。；创新点：颠覆了传统认为超导电性仅作为CDW竞争者的观点，首次揭示超导电性能够系统性地增强CDW的相位相干性，并指出这种增强在无序主导的晶体老化样品中仍然可见，表明存在超导与CDW之间额外的相位级相互作用以及晶格耦合效应。
papers.method_zh: 共振软X射线散射（resonant soft x-ray scattering）结合相干敏感动量轮廓分析（coherence-sensitive momentum-profile analysis），并对比了Bi基、Hg基、Y基和Nd基铜氧化物的已发表数据。

papers.title: Discovery of a nonsymmorphic superconductor with spontaneous rotational symmetry breaking and nontrivial zero modes
papers.abstract: Topological superconductivity has attracted great interest due to its fundamental significance for realizing Majorana quasiparticles and fault-tolerant quantum computation. Nonsymmorphic superconductors, with symmetry-protected nontrivial electronic structures, offer a promising route to exotic topological superconducting states, yet experimental realizations remain scarce. Here we identify nonsymmorphic compound PtPb4 as a robust platform hosting superconductivity with spontaneous rotational symmetry breaking and nontrivial zero-energy modes. PtPb4 crystallizes in a frustrated Shastry-Sutherland lattice and exhibits nontrivial band topology. By combining in-plane and out-of-plane resistivity measurements, pronounced twofold anisotropy is observed in both the superconducting state and the upper critical field, evidencing spontaneous rotational symmetry breaking. Scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy further reveal twofold-symmetric magnetic vortices, providing direct real-space evidence for the symmetry-broken superconducting state. Notably, a robust zero-energy vortex bound state emerges and persists without spatial splitting over extended distances, consistent with the characteristics expected for Majorana bound state. These findings uncover an exotic superconducting state in PtPb4 and establish a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity and superconducting quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了通过电阻率测量（in-plane and out-of-plane resistivity measurements）和扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/STS）进行实验观测。；研究对象：非对称性超导体PtPb₄，以及其中自发旋转对称性破缺的超导态和非平庸零能模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非对称性化合物PtPb₄中发现了具有自发旋转对称性破缺的超导态，并观测到与马约拉纳束缚态特征一致的、鲁棒的零能涡旋束缚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非对称性化合物PtPb₄中发现了具有自发旋转对称性破缺的超导态，并观测到与马约拉纳束缚态特征一致的、鲁棒的零能涡旋束缚态。；创新点：首次在实验上发现并证实了非对称性超导体PtPb₄同时具备自发旋转对称性破缺和非平庸零能模，为研究拓扑超导和实现马约拉纳准粒子提供了新的、有前景的实验平台。摘要未突出说明与具体理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 面内与面外电阻率测量（用于观测超导态和上临界场的二重各向异性）；扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/STS，用于直接实空间观测二重对称磁涡旋及零能束缚态）。

papers.title: Mechanics of heterogeneous fiber networks
papers.abstract: Internally generated active stresses drive soft materials into architectures inaccessible to thermal self-assembly. We use a microtubule-based active fluid to assemble and irreversibly restructure actin-fascin networks. Subsequently, we probe the mesoscale mechanics of such networks by combining active microrheology with fluorescence imaging of the strain field around the probe. Increasing motor concentration broadens the pore-size distribution and thickens load-bearing bundles, raising the mean local elastic modulus and its spatial variability. Displacement fields of actively-processed networks propagate over longer range when compared to unprocessed networks. At large strains, both networks strain soften and plastically restructure. The combined microrheology and strain-imaging approach show that tunable active stresses reprogram the structure and viscoelastic response of fiber networks at the scale of their structural heterogeneity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（“We use...”、“subsequently, we probe...”）和具体实验手段（“active microrheology”、“fluorescence imaging”）。；研究对象：由微管活性流体驱动的肌动蛋白-肌束蛋白纤维网络。具体研究这种生物聚合物网络在内部活性应力作用下的结构重组及其介观尺度的力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节活性流体中马达蛋白的浓度，可以主动调控纤维网络的孔隙率、承重束的厚度以及局部弹性模量的平均值和空间变异性，从而改变网络的整体粘弹性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节活性流体中马达蛋白的浓度，可以主动调控纤维网络的孔隙率、承重束的厚度以及局部弹性模量的平均值和空间变异性，从而改变网络的整体粘弹性响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于将主动微流变学与高分辨率应变场成像相结合，直接关联了纤维网络的结构异质性与局域力学响应，并展示了利用可调活性应力来“编程”网络结构-力学性能关系的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，首先利用基于微管的活性流体产生内部活性应力，对肌动蛋白-肌束蛋白网络进行组装和不可逆的结构重组。随后，结合主动微流变学（active microrheology）和荧光成像技术，对探针周围的应变场进行实时观测，以表征网络的介观力学性质。

papers.title: Existent condition of partially wet state in capillary tubes
papers.abstract: We develop a theory that predicts the equilibrium states of a fluid contained in a capillary which has corners. Each section of the tube can take three states: completely wet state where the tube section is completely occupied by the fluid, partially wet state where only the corners are occupied by the fluid known as corner film or finger, and completely dry state. We calculate the phase diagram of these states for a square tube with rounded corners. It is shown that the partially wet state can exist only in a certain region in the parameter space spanned by the equilibrium contact angle and the corner curvature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a theory”、“calculate the phase diagram”。；研究对象：毛细管中流体的平衡态，特别是具有角落的毛细管中部分润湿状态（corner film/finger）的存在条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 部分润湿状态（仅角落被流体占据）仅在由平衡接触角和角落曲率张成的参数空间中的特定区域内存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：部分润湿状态（仅角落被流体占据）仅在由平衡接触角和角落曲率张成的参数空间中的特定区域内存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与相图计算。具体为：针对具有圆角方形截面的毛细管，通过理论推导计算完全润湿、部分润湿和完全干燥三种状态的相图。

papers.title: Random-h Fractional-Dimensional Lattices Reveal Endpoint-Compressed Percolation Activation between Two and Three Dimensions
papers.abstract: Non-integer dimensionality is central to fractal and complex systems, yet it is rarely represented as an explicit lattice on which classical statistical-mechanical models can be directly simulated. Here we introduce random-h fractional dimension (RhFD), a constructive lattice framework in which fractional-dimensional environments are generated by stochastic activation of local connectivity, h. In the 2D-to-3D interval, RhFD lattices are formed by recursively growing out-of-plane sites from a square base with probability \r{ho}h. Using quenched site-percolation simulations, we show that the construction recovers the integer-dimensional endpoints and yields a robust crossover in which the percolation threshold decreases from the 2D regime toward the 3D regime. The crossover is not a uniform interpolation: high-resolution scans reveal endpoint-compressed activation, with -dpc/d\r{ho}h increasing toward \r{ho}h = 1. Mass dimension increases with \r{ho}h, whereas the coordination descriptor first decreases as sparse protrusions form and then rises sharply when a dense 3D backbone emerges. RhFD provides an explicit lattice substrate for fractional-dimensional statistical mechanics and shows that geometric mass, local coordination, and critical connectivity can decouple during dimensional crossover.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quenched site-percolation simulations（淬火位点逾渗模拟）、constructive lattice framework（构造性晶格框架）。；研究对象：论文研究了一种新提出的“随机-h 分数维晶格”（RhFD），该晶格在二维到三维区间内通过随机激活局域连接性（h）生成分数维环境，并研究其上的逾渗相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RhFD 晶格上的逾渗阈值从二维区间向三维区间下降，但并非均匀插值，而是呈现“端点压缩激活”行为（即 -dpc/dρh 在 ρh=1 处增大）；质量维度随 ρh 增加而增加，而配位数描述符先下降后急剧上升，表明几何质量、局域配位和临界连通性在维度交叉过程中可以解耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RhFD 晶格上的逾渗阈值从二维区间向三维区间下降，但并非均匀插值，而是呈现“端点压缩激活”行为（即 -dpc/dρh 在 ρh=1 处增大）；质量维度随 ρh 增加而增加，而配位数描述符先下降后急剧上升，表明几何质量、局域配位和临界连通性在维度交叉过程中可以解耦。；创新点：首次提出一种可显式构造的分数维晶格框架（RhFD），使得经典统计力学模型能够直接在非整数维晶格上进行模拟，并揭示了维度交叉过程中几何质量、局域配位与临界连通性的解耦行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用淬火位点逾渗模拟（quenched site-percolation simulations），在由方形基底以概率 ρh 递归生长面外位点构建的 RhFD 晶格上进行计算分析。

papers.title: Unbiased large-$N$ approach to competing vestigial orders of density-wave and superconducting instabilities
papers.abstract: When a primary order breaks multiple symmetries, partially ordered phases that only break a subset of those symmetries, known as vestigial phases, may onset at a higher temperature. This concept has been applied to a wide range of systems, including iron pnictides, cuprates, van der Waals antiferromagnets, doped topological insulators, and twisted bilayer graphene. In general, a multi-component primary order parameter (OP) supports multiple vestigial channels, each described by a quadratic (or higher-order) composite OP. However, the standard large-$N$ approach to the Ginzburg-Landau action of the primary OP has an intrinsic ambiguity in how one decouples the composite OPs, leading to situations in which one can seemingly enhance or eliminate altogether any vestigial instability. Here, we show that this ambiguity is a direct consequence of redundancy relations, such as Fierz identities, that relate different composite OPs, reflecting the fact that different vestigial channels interfere with each other and thus cannot be treated separately. To resolve this ambiguity, we propose an unbiased large-$N$ approach that respects both the redundancy relations and the underlying symmetry-group structure, and that gives unique values for the effective interactions of all vestigial channels. Our analysis reveals the generic existence of regions in the parameter space of quartic Landau coefficients where no vestigial order is stable, in contrast to the standard large-$N$ approach, but in agreement with weak-coupling and variational approaches. We illustrate our results by analyzing the vestigial orders of charge-density waves, spin-density waves, and multi-component superconductors in tetragonal, hexagonal, and cubic systems, respectively, revealing the presence of exotic vestigial phases describing spin-quadrupolar, charge-$4e$ superconducting, and altermagnetic orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：large-\(N\) approach、Ginzburg-Landau action、对称性分析、弱耦合方法。；研究对象：密度波（电荷密度波、自旋密度波）与多分量超导体的残余有序相（vestigial orders），以及这些有序相在四方、六方、立方体系中的竞争与稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无偏的 large-\(N\) 方法，解决了标准 large-\(N\) 方法中因复合序参量之间的冗余关系（如Fierz恒等式）导致的歧义，揭示了在朗道四次项参数空间中存在残余有序相不稳定的区域，并预言了自旋四极矩、电荷-\(4e\) 超导和交变磁性等奇异残余相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无偏的 large-\(N\) 方法，解决了标准 large-\(N\) 方法中因复合序参量之间的冗余关系（如Fierz恒等式）导致的歧义，揭示了在朗道四次项参数空间中存在残余有序相不稳定的区域，并预言了自旋四极矩、电荷-\(4e\) 超导和交变磁性等奇异残余相。；创新点：首次指出标准 large-\(N\) 方法在处理多分量初级序参量的残余有序通道时存在内在歧义（可人为增强或消除残余不稳定性），并通过引入冗余关系约束给出了唯一有效的有效相互作用，从而修正了此前对残余有序相稳定性的判断。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Ginzburg-Landau 作用量，采用无偏 large-\(N\) 展开方法，严格尊重复合序参量之间的冗余关系（Fierz恒等式）及底层对称群结构，并与弱耦合方法和变分方法进行对比验证。

papers.title: Optical signatures of antiferromagnetic correlations in a strongly interacting quantum Hall MoSe2 monolayer
papers.abstract: Strong magnetic fields quench the kinetic energy of electrons, leading to the formation of flat energy bands, known as Landau levels (LLs). In this situation, even weak interactions can drive the emergence of various ordered phases. The simplest of such phases is a quantum Hall ferromagnet, where a spontaneous spin polarization emerges when LLs with opposite spins cross. The presence of strong electron-electron interaction at zero field changes this picture and makes the resulting states much harder to predict. Here we use magneto-optical spectroscopy to reveal quantum Hall states with unconventional correlations favouring an unpolarized state in the strongly correlated electron liquid in a MoSe2 monolayer. The oscillations of the exciton polaron energies as a function of perpendicular magnetic field and electron density demonstrate the emergence of LLs in a correlated electron liquid and density-dependent crossings between LLs of opposite valleys. On lowering the LL filling factor, where interactions within LLs are stronger, the crossings systematically broaden, indicating an increase in the Zeeman energy required to fully polarize the valley-degenerate LLs. These observations are shown to be consistent with antiferromagnetic interactions between LL electrons, favouring a ground state with zero valley polarization, and are therefore inconsistent with conventional quantum Hall ferromagnetism. This discovery demonstrates a qualitatively distinct form of quantum Hall magnetism in a strongly correlated electron liquid, establishing an anchoring point for understanding spin-unpolarized fractional and ordered states of correlated electrons driven by magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：magneto-optical spectroscopy（磁光光谱）、observations（观测）、demonstrate（展示）。；研究对象：强相互作用量子霍尔MoSe₂单层中的反铁磁关联态，具体为强关联电子液体中谷简并朗道能级（LLs）的量子霍尔态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强相互作用的MoSe₂单层电子液体中，观测到朗道能级交叉处出现系统性的展宽，表明需要更大的塞曼能才能完全极化谷简并的朗道能级，这与朗道能级电子间的反铁磁相互作用一致，从而形成零谷极化的基态，而非传统的量子霍尔铁磁态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强相互作用的MoSe₂单层电子液体中，观测到朗道能级交叉处出现系统性的展宽，表明需要更大的塞曼能才能完全极化谷简并的朗道能级，这与朗道能级电子间的反铁磁相互作用一致，从而形成零谷极化的基态，而非传统的量子霍尔铁磁态。；创新点：首次在强关联电子液体中揭示了一种与常规量子霍尔铁磁态截然不同的量子霍尔磁性形式——反铁磁关联驱动的零谷极化基态，为理解磁场驱动下自旋非极化的分数量子霍尔态及有序态提供了关键锚点。
papers.method_zh: 磁光光谱学（magneto-optical spectroscopy），通过测量激子极化子能量随垂直磁场和电子密度的振荡，分析朗道能级的形成与谷间交叉行为。

papers.title: Giant critical response in a driven-dissipative quantum gas
papers.abstract: Systems close to a phase transition turn weak perturbations into large responses. At equilibrium, this amplification is closely linked to criticality: fluctuations grow, dynamics slow, and a common soft mode controls the response. Whether this correspondence survives in driven-dissipative quantum systems, sustained by continuous pumping and loss away from thermal equilibrium, remains an open question. Here we show experimentally that it does. In a room-temperature semiconductor photon Bose-Einstein condensate, the critical slowing of spontaneous intensity fluctuations and the amplification of weak pump perturbations are measured independently. Both peak at the same condensate population, $\bar{n}_c = 1250$, where the dimensionless slowing factor and susceptibility reach the same value, $\bar{n}_c/2 = 625$. A single weakly damped collective photon-reservoir mode governs both effects. This fluctuation-response correspondence in a finite open quantum gas establishes critical susceptibility as a measurable dynamical signature of condensation, with peak gain set by system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here we show experimentally that it does”，并描述了在室温半导体光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的具体测量。；研究对象：驱动-耗散量子气体中的临界响应现象。具体体系为室温半导体光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（photon Bose-Einstein condensate）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远离热平衡的驱动-耗散量子系统中，临界涨落与响应之间的对应关系依然成立。实验发现，自发强度涨落的临界慢化与弱泵浦扰动的放大效应在相同的凝聚体粒子数（$\bar{n}_c = 1250$）处达到峰值，且两者由同一个弱阻尼的集体光子-库模式控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远离热平衡的驱动-耗散量子系统中，临界涨落与响应之间的对应关系依然成立。实验发现，自发强度涨落的临界慢化与弱泵浦扰动的放大效应在相同的凝聚体粒子数（$\bar{n}_c = 1250$）处达到峰值，且两者由同一个弱阻尼的集体光子-库模式控制。；创新点：首次在实验上证明了驱动-耗散量子系统中涨落-响应对应关系的存在，表明即使在远离热平衡的稳态下，临界现象的基本特征（如慢化与放大）依然由同一个软模控制。该工作将临界磁化率确立为凝聚体可测量的动力学特征，并指出其峰值增益由系统尺寸决定。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了室温半导体光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的两种独立物理量：1）自发强度涨落的临界慢化（critical slowing down）；2）弱泵浦扰动的放大效应（即响应函数或磁化率）。通过对比两者的峰值位置和数值，建立了涨落-响应对应关系。

papers.title: First-principles real-space embedding theory of the superconducting proximity effect
papers.abstract: When a superconductor is placed in contact with a normal material, Cooper pairs penetrate the latter and induce superconductivity via the proximity effect. Despite its central role in quantum materials, superconducting devices and topological platforms, a predictive first-principles description of the proximity effect at realistic interfaces has remained computationally prohibitive so far. Here, we fill this gap by developing a Green's-function framework based on real-space dynamical embedding that enables first-principles simulations of superconducting proximity in mesoscopic systems. We show that the proximity effect admits a transparent diagrammatic formulation in terms of normal and anomalous embedding self-energies, which disentangle and quantify the distinct renormalization mechanisms generated by coupling to a superconducting bath. By combining this formalism with recursive schemes, we compute local spectral functions and proximity lengths extending over hundreds of nanometers into the bulk without resorting to thick interface slabs. We deploy the approach on tight-binding models (Qi-Hughes-Zhang and Fu-Kane-Mele), where we analyze mixed-parity superconductivity in topological insulators proximitized by $s$-wave superconductors, and on first-principles simulations of NbSe$_2$/CrBr$_3$ heterostructures based on density-functional theory and maximally-localized Wannier functions, the latter enabling direct comparison with scanning tunneling spectroscopy experiments. Our work provides a scalable and conceptually unified framework that bridges microscopic electronic structure and mesoscale proximity physics, enabling predictive atomistic simulations of superconducting interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles simulations”、“Green's-function framework”、“dynamical embedding”、“density-functional theory”。；研究对象：超导邻近效应（superconducting proximity effect）在真实界面中的第一性原理描述，具体材料体系包括拓扑绝缘体（Qi-Hughes-Zhang和Fu-Kane-Mele模型）以及NbSe₂/CrBr₃异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发展了一套基于实空间动力学嵌入的格林函数框架，能够对介观体系中的超导邻近效应进行第一性原理模拟，并揭示了邻近效应可通过正常和反常嵌入自能进行清晰的图解表述，从而分离并量化超导浴耦合产生的不同重整化机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发展了一套基于实空间动力学嵌入的格林函数框架，能够对介观体系中的超导邻近效应进行第一性原理模拟，并揭示了邻近效应可通过正常和反常嵌入自能进行清晰的图解表述，从而分离并量化超导浴耦合产生的不同重整化机制。；创新点：首次实现了对介观尺度超导邻近效应的可预测性第一性原理模拟，避免了传统厚界面板层计算，并建立了从微观电子结构到介观邻近物理的统一计算框架，可直接与扫描隧道谱实验对比。
papers.method_zh: 实空间动力学嵌入格林函数方法（real-space dynamical embedding Green's-function framework），结合递归方案（recursive schemes）计算局域谱函数和邻近长度；在紧束缚模型（Qi-Hughes-Zhang和Fu-Kane-Mele）上分析混合宇称超导；在NbSe₂/CrBr₃异质结中采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）和最大局域化Wannier函数（MLWFs）的第一性原理模拟。

papers.title: Magnetic-field-tunable cyclotron hyperbolic polaritons
papers.abstract: Hyperbolic polaritons are conventionally associated with structural anisotropy or phononic Reststrahlen bands. Here, we predict a new class of hyperbolic polaritons arising from magnetic-field-induced cyclotron motion of charge carriers. When a perpendicular magnetic field is applied to high-mobility semimetals, the cyclotron response drives the in-plane dielectric function from metallic- to insulating-like below the cyclotron resonance frequency, while the out-of-plane response remains metallic. This anisotropy creates a hyperbolic dielectric environment that supports field-tunable hyperbolic polaritons. We develop a comprehensive theoretical framework incorporating coupling to other collective excitations and show that these modes can be directly visualized in real space via terahertz near-field nanoscopy. Our work identifies cyclotron motion as a new route to hyperbolic polaritons and establishes a versatile platform for magnetically programmable nanophotonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“predict”、“develop a comprehensive theoretical framework”、“show that these modes can be directly visualized”。；研究对象：磁场诱导的回旋运动产生的双曲极化激元（cyclotron hyperbolic polaritons），具体体系为高迁移率半金属（high-mobility semimetals）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在垂直于高迁移率半金属施加磁场时，载流子的回旋共振响应会使面内介电函数在回旋共振频率以下从类金属转变为类绝缘体，而面外响应仍保持金属性，从而形成可调谐的双曲极化激元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在垂直于高迁移率半金属施加磁场时，载流子的回旋共振响应会使面内介电函数在回旋共振频率以下从类金属转变为类绝缘体，而面外响应仍保持金属性，从而形成可调谐的双曲极化激元。；创新点：首次提出回旋运动（cyclotron motion）作为产生双曲极化激元的新机制，区别于传统依赖结构各向异性或声子Reststrahlen带的方法，并建立了磁场可编程纳米光子学的通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建，包括将回旋运动响应与其它集体激发（collective excitations）耦合的完整理论模型，并预言可通过太赫兹近场纳米显微镜（terahertz near-field nanoscopy）在实空间直接观测这些模式。

papers.title: Symmetry Guided Band-Gap Opening via Periodic Topological Defects in Graphene
papers.abstract: Graphene lacks an intrinsic band-gap, which limits its use in electronic applications. Here we demonstrate that periodic arrays of topological defects can open and control a band-gap in a predictable manner governed by defect spacing and lattice symmetry. Using first-principles density functional theory calculations supported by tight-binding models, we investigate graphene superlattices containing Stone-Wales and flower-like defects over a range of $N \times N$ periodicities, where $N$ determines the defect separation. We show that band-gap opening occurs only when translation symmetry is reduced in a specific way: for supercells with $N$ a multiple of three, Brillouin-zone folding brings the Dirac cones at $K$ and $K'$ to the same momentum in the reduced Brillouin zone. In particular, flower-like defect superlattices produce larger and tunable band-gaps, whose magnitude decreases systematically with increasing defect separation and approaches zero in the dilute-defect limit. These results establish a predictive framework for band-gap engineering in defect-patterned graphene and clarify the microscopic mechanism underlying gap formation in periodically reconstructed lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles density functional theory calculations、tight-binding models）；研究对象：石墨烯中周期性拓扑缺陷（Stone-Wales缺陷和花状缺陷）构成的超晶格体系，以及其能带结构调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过周期性排列拓扑缺陷，可在石墨烯中打开并调控带隙，且带隙大小由缺陷间距和晶格对称性决定；仅当超胞周期N为3的倍数时，布里渊区折叠使K和K'点狄拉克锥重合，才能打开带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过周期性排列拓扑缺陷，可在石墨烯中打开并调控带隙，且带隙大小由缺陷间距和晶格对称性决定；仅当超胞周期N为3的倍数时，布里渊区折叠使K和K'点狄拉克锥重合，才能打开带隙。；创新点：建立了基于缺陷间距和晶格对称性预测带隙的框架，并揭示了周期性重构晶格中带隙形成的微观机制（布里渊区折叠导致狄拉克锥重合）。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，辅以紧束缚模型（tight-binding models）分析。

papers.title: Synergistic doping of the grain interior and grain boundary alters deformation mechanisms and enables extreme strength in nanocrystalline Ni-Cr-Y alloys
papers.abstract: Solid solution addition and grain boundary segregation have been independently shown to enhance the strength of nanocrystalline alloys. In the present study, the synergy between these two effects is investigated in nanocrystalline Ni-Cr-Y sputtered films through systematic variation of alloying element contents with grain size kept constant. Cr is introduced into a solid solution and serves to strengthen the lattice, while Y segregates to the grain boundaries to stabilize these features. Nanoindentation is used to probe hardness, with unexpected trends and very high values observed. Cr additions led to nanocrystalline solid solution strengthening, yet saturation was observed at higher concentrations due to the emergence of grain boundary dominated processes, as evidenced by pile-up morphologies containing slip steps and grain rotation. Y segregated to the grain boundaries, enhancing boundary-mediated strengthening by pinning the dislocations and suppressing dislocation emission, grain boundary sliding, and grain rotation processes. With increasing Y concentration, the nanocrystalline solid solution strengthening effect induced by Cr addition becomes weaker. This phenomenon can be attributed to a reduced dislocation bowing distance caused by dopant pinning. Most notably, the strongest ternary Ni-Cr-Y alloy exhibited a hardness of 11.0 GPa, among the highest hardness values reported for single-phase Ni-based alloys. These findings highlight how tuning grain and grain boundary chemistry offers a viable strategy to control dislocation mechanics and improve the strength of nanocrystalline metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：sputtered films（溅射薄膜）、nanoindentation（纳米压痕）、hardness（硬度）等实验测量手段。；研究对象：纳米晶Ni-Cr-Y合金薄膜，具体研究Cr固溶强化与Y晶界偏析的协同效应对变形机制和强度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Cr固溶强化与Y晶界偏析的协同掺杂，实现了纳米晶Ni-Cr-Y合金的极端硬度（最高达11.0 GPa），为单相镍基合金中最高硬度值之一；同时发现Y的晶界偏析会抑制Cr的固溶强化效果，其机制与掺杂钉扎导致的位错弓出距离减小有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Cr固溶强化与Y晶界偏析的协同掺杂，实现了纳米晶Ni-Cr-Y合金的极端硬度（最高达11.0 GPa），为单相镍基合金中最高硬度值之一；同时发现Y的晶界偏析会抑制Cr的固溶强化效果，其机制与掺杂钉扎导致的位错弓出距离减小有关。；创新点：首次系统研究了晶内固溶强化（Cr）与晶界偏析（Y）的协同效应，揭示了Y掺杂会削弱Cr固溶强化效果的新机制，并提出了通过同时调控晶粒内部和晶界化学组成来优化位错力学、提升纳米晶金属强度的策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控溅射制备纳米晶Ni-Cr-Y薄膜，通过系统改变Cr和Y含量（保持晶粒尺寸恒定），利用纳米压痕测试硬度，并结合压痕堆积形貌（pile-up morphologies）中的滑移台阶和晶粒旋转等特征分析变形机制。

papers.title: Bound States in Second-order Topological Graphitic Structures
papers.abstract: Quadrupole insulators are a class of second-order topological insulators (SOTIs) that host zero-dimensional corner states within a two-dimensional bulk. Despite their unique properties, their realization in electronic systems on realistic material platforms remains rare. In this work, we present a general design principle to obtain quadrupole insulators based on two-dimensional graphitic structures. By engineering the positions and connections of zigzag edges, we identify four topological classes of graphitic structures. We show that topologically protected massless corner state emerge at the intersection of domains belonging to different topological classes. Crucially, by tuning the smoothness of the domain wall, we further demonstrate the appearance of additional massive localized states with non-zero angular momentum. Our results provide a practical framework for realizing experimentally accessible SOTIs and uncover the coexistence of both massless and massive bound states in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“present a general design principle”“identify four topological classes”“we show”“we further demonstrate”等表述，属于理论设计与分析，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：基于二维石墨烯类（graphitic）结构的二阶拓扑绝缘体（SOTIs），具体为四极绝缘体（quadrupole insulators）及其边界态（corner states）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控锯齿形边缘的位置与连接方式，可在石墨烯类结构中实现四极绝缘体，并在不同拓扑类畴壁处出现受拓扑保护的无质量角态；进一步通过调节畴壁平滑度，可产生具有非零角动量的有质量局域态，实现无质量与有质量束缚态在二维体系中的共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控锯齿形边缘的位置与连接方式，可在石墨烯类结构中实现四极绝缘体，并在不同拓扑类畴壁处出现受拓扑保护的无质量角态；进一步通过调节畴壁平滑度，可产生具有非零角动量的有质量局域态，实现无质量与有质量束缚态在二维体系中的共存。；创新点：提出了在真实电子材料（石墨烯类结构）中实现二阶拓扑绝缘体（四极绝缘体）的通用设计原则，并首次揭示了二维体系中无质量与有质量束缚态（massless and massive bound states）的共存现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与拓扑分类。具体包括：基于锯齿形边缘工程（engineering the positions and connections of zigzag edges）的拓扑类划分，以及通过调节畴壁平滑度（smoothness of the domain wall）来调控束缚态性质。

papers.title: BCS-BEC crossover in trapped one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard chains: entanglement and correlation signatures from DMRG and effective-pairing theory
papers.abstract: Confined ultracold atoms in optical lattices provide a versatile platform for simulating lattice models of strongly correlated quantum systems, where pairing phenomena and superfluid phases can be explored under controlled conditions. While the crossover between the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) phase and the Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) is well understood in homogeneous systems, spatial confinement breaks translational symmetry and reshapes correlation patterns, making the BCS-BEC identification in trapped geometries challenging and allowing unconventional phases to emerge with no direct analog in homogeneous systems. Here we present a characterization of the BCS-BEC crossover in harmonically confined one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard chains. Our analysis combines Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) simulations and entanglement-based diagnostics with effective models describing the formation of tightly bound fermion pairs. This combined approach enables a detailed understanding of how the interplay between interactions and confinement reshapes the crossover, leading to insulating regions coexisting with persistent superfluid correlations. Within this framework, we further introduce conditioned correlation functions whose power-law decay allows a clear distinction between BCS-like and BEC-like regimes. The consistency between the effective descriptions and the numerical DMRG results yields a unified picture of the crossover in harmonically confined geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：DMRG（密度矩阵重正化群）模拟、有效配对理论、纠缠诊断。；研究对象：一维费米-哈伯德链中的BCS-BEC渡越，特别是谐波囚禁势下的配对现象与超流关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在囚禁一维费米-哈伯德链中，相互作用与空间囚禁的协同作用重塑了BCS-BEC渡越，导致绝缘区域与持续超流关联共存；通过条件关联函数的幂律衰减可清晰区分BCS-like与BEC-like区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在囚禁一维费米-哈伯德链中，相互作用与空间囚禁的协同作用重塑了BCS-BEC渡越，导致绝缘区域与持续超流关联共存；通过条件关联函数的幂律衰减可清晰区分BCS-like与BEC-like区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）数值模拟与基于纠缠的诊断工具，并结合描述紧束缚费米子对形成的有效模型。

papers.title: Field Theory of Data: Anomaly Detection via the Functional Renormalization Group. The 2D Ising Model as a Benchmark
papers.abstract: We establish a correspondence between anomaly detection in high-noise regimes and the renormalization group flow of non-equilibrium field theories. We provide a physical grounding for this framework by proving that the detection of phase transitions in interacting non-equilibrium systems maps to the study of an effective equilibrium field theory near its Gaussian fixed point, which we identify with the universal Marchenko-Pastur distribution. Applying the Functional Renormalization Group to the two-dimensional Model A, we demonstrate that the noise-to-signal ratio acts as a physical temperature, where the signal emerges as ordered domains within a thermalized background of fluctuations. Using the exact Onsager solution as a benchmark, we show that this approach identifies critical thresholds with an error below 4%, significantly outperforming standard information-theoretic metrics such as the Kullback-Leibler divergence. Our results provide a universal strategy for resolving structures in complex datasets near criticality, bridging the gap between statistical mechanics and statistical inference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Functional Renormalization Group、field theory、mapping、benchmark。；研究对象：高噪声环境下的异常检测问题，以及二维Ising模型（Model A）中的相变检测。具体物理现象为噪声-信号比作为物理温度时，信号在热化涨落背景中形成有序畴的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将高噪声下的异常检测映射到非平衡场论的重整化群流，并利用二维Ising模型的精确Onsager解作为基准，证明该方法能以低于4%的误差识别临界阈值，显著优于Kullback-Leibler散度等标准信息论指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将高噪声下的异常检测映射到非平衡场论的重整化群流，并利用二维Ising模型的精确Onsager解作为基准，证明该方法能以低于4%的误差识别临界阈值，显著优于Kullback-Leibler散度等标准信息论指标。；创新点：建立了异常检测与重整化群流之间的严格对应关系，并首次将噪声-信号比解释为物理温度，为从统计力学角度解决复杂数据集中的临界结构识别提供了普适策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡场论与功能重整化群（Functional Renormalization Group, FRG）框架，将检测问题转化为有效平衡场论在Gaussian固定点（对应Marchenko-Pastur分布）附近的行为分析。基准测试基于二维Model A的精确Onsager解。

papers.title: Photon Momentum Enabled Symmetry Breaking and Nonlinear Photocurrents in the Centrosymmetric Dirac Semimetal PdTe
papers.abstract: In centrosymmetric Dirac semimetals, second order nonlinear photocurrents are forbidden by the coexistence of time-reversal and inversion symmetries. Here, we demonstrate that finite photon momentum transfer acts as a dynamic symmetry breaking mechanism in PdTe, enabling nonlinear optical responses that are nominally forbidden in the centrosymmetric bulk. Through polarization sensitive measurements, we resolve distinct contributions from the circular photogalvanic effect (CPGE), geometric shift currents, and photon drag mediated processes. We show that the helicity dependent current vanishes at normal incidence and reverses sign with the angle of incidence, reflecting the coupling between photons and spin polarized surface states. Crucially, thickness dependent analysis reveals that the helicity dependent photocurrent component C scales with film thickness, establishing a robust bulk contribution enabled by momentum transfer. This confirms that incident photons provide the directional axis required to probe interband quantum geometry, rather than the response originating solely from surface states or strain. Our results demonstrate that optical excitation can dynamically reduce the effective symmetry of the system, enabling access to quantum geometric tensors and establishing PdTe as a promising platform for exploring nonequilibrium dynamics governed by photon momentum in high symmetry topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“偏振敏感测量”、“厚度依赖分析”等实验手段。；研究对象：中心对称狄拉克半金属PdTe中的非线性光电流现象，特别是光子动量诱导的对称性破缺及其对量子几何张量的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称狄拉克半金属PdTe中，有限的光子动量转移可作为动态对称性破缺机制，使原本被禁止的二阶非线性光电流（如圆光致电流效应、几何移位电流、光子拖曳效应）得以产生，且螺旋度依赖的光电流分量随薄膜厚度线性增长，证实了体态贡献而非仅来自表面态或应变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称狄拉克半金属PdTe中，有限的光子动量转移可作为动态对称性破缺机制，使原本被禁止的二阶非线性光电流（如圆光致电流效应、几何移位电流、光子拖曳效应）得以产生，且螺旋度依赖的光电流分量随薄膜厚度线性增长，证实了体态贡献而非仅来自表面态或应变。；创新点：首次在中心对称狄拉克半金属中利用光子动量作为动态对称性破缺手段，实现了对体态量子几何张量的光学探测，而非依赖表面态或应变等静态对称性破缺机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 偏振敏感的光电流测量（区分圆光致电流效应、几何移位电流、光子拖曳效应）、入射角依赖测量、厚度依赖分析。

papers.title: Contrasting structural reversibility and magnetic correlations in isostructural honeycomb magnets CrCl$_3$ and $α$-RuCl$_3$
papers.abstract: We report a comparative neutron single crystal diffraction study of the structural and magnetic properties of layered halides CrCl$_3$ and $α$-RuCl$_3$, which host a honeycomb arrangement of transition metal ions with distinct electronic configurations and undergo a first-order structural transition between high-temperature \textit{C}2/\textit{m} and low-temperature \textit{R}$\bar{3}$. Both compounds show a step-like change in the $c$-lattice, consistent with an expected stacking rearrangement. In contrast, the in-plane lattice response is quite different: $α$-RuCl$_3$ exhibits an abrupt hysteretic change across the transition accompanied by progressive crystalline degradation upon thermal cycling, whereas CrCl$_3$ shows a smooth in-plane lattice evolution and remains structurally robust. Magnetically, CrCl$_3$ orders into an A-type antiferromagnetic structure at T$_N$=14\,K and exhibits pronounced diffuse magnetic scattering extending up to about 40\,K. $α$-RuCl$_3$ shows no observable magnetic diffuse scattering above its zig-zag antiferromagnetic ordering temperature T$_N$=7.6\,K. These results suggest that the contrasting structural and magnetic behaviors arise from an interplay between interlayer sliding energetics and the fundamentally different electronic configurations of the two compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：neutron single crystal diffraction study（中子单晶衍射研究）、comparative study（对比研究）。；研究对象：两种具有蜂窝状过渡金属离子排列的层状卤化物单晶：CrCl₃ 和 α-RuCl₃，它们具有不同的电子构型，并经历一级结构相变（高温 C2/m 相 → 低温 R3̅ 相）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrCl₃ 和 α-RuCl₃ 在结构相变中表现出截然不同的面内晶格响应和磁关联行为：α-RuCl₃ 在相变处出现突变的滞后变化并伴随热循环下的晶格退化，而 CrCl₃ 则呈现平滑的面内晶格演化且结构稳定；磁学上，CrCl₃ 在奈尔温度以上存在显著的弥散磁散射（~40 K），而 α-RuCl₃ 在其反铁磁有序温度以上未观察到弥散磁散射。这些差异源于层间滑移动力学与两种化合物电子构型的不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrCl₃ 和 α-RuCl₃ 在结构相变中表现出截然不同的面内晶格响应和磁关联行为：α-RuCl₃ 在相变处出现突变的滞后变化并伴随热循环下的晶格退化，而 CrCl₃ 则呈现平滑的面内晶格演化且结构稳定；磁学上，CrCl₃ 在奈尔温度以上存在显著的弥散磁散射（~40 K），而 α-RuCl₃ 在其反铁磁有序温度以上未观察到弥散磁散射。这些差异源于层间滑移动力学与两种化合物电子构型的不同。；创新点：通过直接对比具有相同晶体结构但不同电子构型的两种蜂窝状磁体，揭示了结构可逆性与磁关联行为的显著差异，并指出其根源在于层间滑移能量学与电子构型的耦合。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 中子单晶衍射（neutron single crystal diffraction），对比研究两种化合物的结构相变和磁有序行为。

papers.title: Application of the exact-factorization density-functional perturbation approach to pentacene crystal and monolayer MoS2
papers.abstract: Non-adiabatic effects arising from electron-phonon interactions are often neglected within the Born-Oppenheimer (BO) approximation, which assumes that electronic states adjust instantaneously to nuclear motion. The exact factorization (EF) formalism provides a rigorous framework for treating such effects beyond the adiabatic regime and has recently been adapted to density functional theory (DFT) in the harmonic limit. Building on these foundations, we previously introduced an EF-based perturbative scheme, the EF density-functional perturbation theory (EF-DFPT), that enables the computation of phonon-driven non-adiabatic (NA) corrections to Kohn-Sham (KS) electronic states, up to second order in nuclear displacements. Here, we present the first implementation and application of EF-DFPT to extended periodic materials, focusing on its impact on experimentally relevant observables. Using the pentacene molecular crystal and monolayer MoS2 as representative soft- and stiff-mode systems, respectively, we demonstrate how NA electron-phonon interactions modify the static dielectric response. We show that these modifications originate from the combined effect of NA phonon-dressed electronic wavefunctions and second-order NA energy renormalizations. The resulting behavior is strongly material dependent: NA effects are negligible in monolayer MoS2, whereas in pentacene they lead to pronounced long-range screening effects associated with soft vibrational modes and enhanced electron-phonon coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional perturbation theory”、“first implementation and application”、“computing phonon-driven non-adiabatic corrections”。；研究对象：五并苯分子晶体（pentacene molecular crystal）和单层二硫化钼（monolayer MoS₂），分别作为软模和硬模体系的代表。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非绝热电子-声子相互作用对静态介电响应的修正具有强烈的材料依赖性：在单层MoS₂中可忽略，而在五并苯晶体中则导致显著的长程屏蔽效应，该效应与软振动模和增强的电子-声子耦合相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非绝热电子-声子相互作用对静态介电响应的修正具有强烈的材料依赖性：在单层MoS₂中可忽略，而在五并苯晶体中则导致显著的长程屏蔽效应，该效应与软振动模和增强的电子-声子耦合相关。；创新点：首次将EF-DFPT方法应用于扩展周期材料体系，并展示了该方法对实验可观测物理量（静态介电响应）的影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于精确因子化（exact factorization, EF）框架的密度泛函微扰理论（EF-DFPT），在简谐极限下计算核位移二阶的Kohn-Sham电子态的非绝热修正。

papers.title: Valley-Controlled Viscosity of Two-Dimensional Dirac Fluids
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent experiments in weakly hybridized small-angle twisted bilayer graphene, we investigate how valley imbalance affects the viscosity of two-dimensional Dirac fluids. We show that shifting the two low-energy Dirac cones relative to one another provides a direct knob to control the viscosity of the electron fluid. As the splitting is increased, the system passes through distinct transport regimes associated with valley depletion, charge-neutrality crossover, and the onset of electron-hole scattering, producing a pronounced nonmonotonic response. To place this result in context, we also analyze the viscosity in monolayer graphene (MLG) and two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG). We show that, due to the strong dependence of its inertial mass density on temperature, the kinematic viscosity of MLG is a monotonically decreasing function of temperature. Our results identify valley control as a route to tuning hydrodynamic transport in Dirac materials and clarify the interplay between band structure, scattering phase space, and screening in setting the viscous response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we investigate”、“we show”、“we analyze”等理论推导和计算分析词汇，未提及任何实验手段或计算模拟软件。；研究对象：二维狄拉克流体的粘性，具体包括弱杂化的小角度扭曲双层石墨烯、单层石墨烯（MLG）和二维电子气（2DEG）中的电子流体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控两个低能狄拉克锥的相对能量偏移（即谷极化），可以有效地控制二维狄拉克流体的粘度，并产生非单调的输运响应。此外，单层石墨烯的运动粘度随温度单调递减，这源于其惯性质量密度对温度的强依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控两个低能狄拉克锥的相对能量偏移（即谷极化），可以有效地控制二维狄拉克流体的粘度，并产生非单调的输运响应。此外，单层石墨烯的运动粘度随温度单调递减，这源于其惯性质量密度对温度的强依赖性。；创新点：提出了“谷控制”作为调控狄拉克材料中流体动力学输运的新途径，并阐明了能带结构、散射相空间和屏蔽效应在决定粘性响应中的相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：基于流体动力学理论分析谷极化对粘度的调控机制；通过分析能带结构、散射相空间和屏蔽效应来理解粘性响应的物理根源。

papers.title: Strain-controlled crossover between Majorana and Andreev bound states in disordered superconductor-semiconductor heterostructures
papers.abstract: The unambiguous identification of topological Majorana-bound states (MBSs) in superconducting hybrid systems is hindered by trivial low-energy excitations, especially partially separated Andreev bound states (psABSs), which can mimic Majorana signatures. Here we show that spatially nonuniform strain offers a systematic route to control and interconvert these low-energy states. Using tight-binding Bogoliubov--de Gennes simulations, we study one-dimensional semiconductor nanowires and graphene nanoribbons with superconductivity, Rashba spin-orbit coupling, Zeeman fields, and disorder. We find that even weak strain can qualitatively reshape the low-energy spectrum by modifying effective band parameters and redistributing wavefunction weight. In nanowires, strain tunes the spatial overlap of Majorana components and shifts the topological phase boundary, enabling controlled crossovers between trivial states, psABSs, and topological MBSs. In graphene nanoribbons, where multiband effects and edge states produce a dense, hybridized low-energy spectrum, strain suppresses subband mixing, lifts degeneracies, and stabilizes boundary-localized modes. In both platforms, we identify regimes where disorder-induced psABSs are converted into well-separated and robust MBSs through strain-enhanced nonlocality. We further develop an analytical framework based on a position-dependent topological mass and strain-driven domain-wall motion, which captures the physical mechanism of these crossovers and yields a real-space criterion for the emergence and stability of Majorana modes. Our results establish strain as an effective tuning parameter for distinguishing and stabilizing topological MBSs in realistic disordered systems, and suggest an experimentally relevant pathway toward improved control and identification of Majorana modes in complex hybrid structures relevant to topological quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用紧束缚Bogoliubov–de Gennes模拟（tight-binding Bogoliubov--de Gennes simulations）进行理论研究。；研究对象：超导体-半导体异质结构中的低能束缚态，具体包括一维半导体纳米线（nanowires）和石墨烯纳米带（graphene nanoribbons）中的马约拉纳束缚态（MBSs）与部分分离的安德烈夫束缚态（psABSs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间非均匀的应变可以作为一种系统性的调控手段，在无序的超导混合体系中控制并相互转换拓扑马约拉纳束缚态与平庸的安德烈夫束缚态，甚至能将无序诱导的psABSs转化为稳定且空间分离的MBSs。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间非均匀的应变可以作为一种系统性的调控手段，在无序的超导混合体系中控制并相互转换拓扑马约拉纳束缚态与平庸的安德烈夫束缚态，甚至能将无序诱导的psABSs转化为稳定且空间分离的MBSs。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算与建模。具体采用了紧束缚Bogoliubov–de Gennes（BdG）模拟方法，并发展了一个基于位置依赖的拓扑质量和应变驱动的畴壁运动的分析框架。

papers.title: Adamantane plasma polymers: fluorine-free vacuum-processable triboelectric thin films for all-triboelectric nanogenerator configurations
papers.abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) are major drivers in on-site power generation for smart devices, enable self-powered sensors, and introduce novel catalytic processes. Here, we present the advantages of adamantane plasma layers as bivalently triboelectric surfaces capable of exhibiting both tribopositive and tribonegative character through simple modification of the synthesis conditions without the need for additives or functionalization. Fabrication facing or backfacing the plasma yields thin film polymers with different dielectric constants, Young's moduli, and secondary electron emission. The conformality, stability, and processability of the polymers enable direct implementation across solid-solid, solid-liquid, and hybrid piezo-triboelectric configurations. Additional texturization by buckling is shown to provide voltage and current outputs as high as 90 V cm2 and 0.6 uA for a 2.8 um (tribonegative) vs. 400 nm (tribopositive) combination. A maximum power density of 2.1 uW cm-2 is generated from salty droplets in a switch-electrode drop-TENG configuration employing a 500 nm-thick tribopositive adamantane polymer as the triboelectric surface. These layers have demonstrated outstanding durability, enabling more than 10^5 cycles in solid-solid nanogenerators and 10^4 droplet impacts in solid-liquid configurations. The synthetic method is environmentally friendly and industrially scalable, making the adamantane plasma polymer a reliable and competitive solution for thin film triboelectric materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了薄膜制备（plasma polymers）、器件测试（voltage/current outputs, power density）和耐久性测试（10^5 cycles）等实验内容。；研究对象：金刚烷等离子体聚合物薄膜，用作摩擦电纳米发电机（TENG）的双极性摩擦电表面，适用于固-固、固-液及混合压电-摩擦电构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过简单改变等离子体合成条件（面向或背向等离子体），无需添加剂或功能化，即可使金刚烷聚合物薄膜分别表现出正摩擦电或负摩擦电特性，并实现高电压（90 V cm²）、电流（0.6 μA）输出及优异耐久性（>10^5次循环）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过简单改变等离子体合成条件（面向或背向等离子体），无需添加剂或功能化，即可使金刚烷聚合物薄膜分别表现出正摩擦电或负摩擦电特性，并实现高电压（90 V cm²）、电流（0.6 μA）输出及优异耐久性（>10^5次循环）。；创新点：首次提出金刚烷等离子体聚合物作为双极性摩擦电薄膜，无需添加剂或后功能化即可通过合成条件调控摩擦电极性，且方法环保、可工业规模化。
papers.method_zh: 等离子体聚合沉积（plasma polymerization）制备薄膜；通过改变沉积方向（facing/backfacing plasma）调控介电常数、杨氏模量和二次电子发射；采用屈曲（buckling）技术实现表面织构化；构建固-固、固-液及开关电极液滴TENG构型进行电输出和功率密度测试。

papers.title: Inverse Design of Metainterfaces for Static Friction Control: Beyond the Hertzian Limit
papers.abstract: Programming the static friction of mechanical interfaces is critical for soft robotics, haptics, and precision gripping. Static friction is governed by the real contact area, and standard rough surfaces exhibit a linear area-load scaling inherent to classical Archard and Greenwood-Williamson models, severely restricting their functional range. Here, we propose a framework for the inverse design of tribological metainterfaces engineered for programmable contact behaviors. By utilizing general axisymmetric asperities, we unlock nonlinear macroscopic responses unattainable by standard Hertzian contacts. To solve the inverse problem, we embed a fully differentiable contact mechanics engine within a neural network and a quadratic optimizer. We leverage regularized physical gradients to automatically discover non-standard topographies that reproduce complex target friction laws, with only a few asperities in unit cells. The predicted designs are strictly validated against high-fidelity Boundary Element Method (BEM) simulations. This framework bridges data-driven optimization and rigorous physics, offering a scale-invariant pathway for discovering functional tribological surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了一个“框架”（framework），并使用了“嵌入神经网络和二次优化器”（embed a fully differentiable contact mechanics engine within a neural network and a quadratic optimizer）、“逆设计”（inverse design）等计算和理论方法。；研究对象：摩擦学超界面（tribological metainterfaces）的静态摩擦控制。具体物理现象是粗糙表面接触中的静态摩擦力，以及其与真实接触面积和载荷之间的标度关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过逆设计具有非标准形貌的轴对称微凸体（asperities），可以打破经典赫兹接触理论（Hertzian limit）所固有的线性面积-载荷关系，从而实现可编程的非线性宏观摩擦响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过逆设计具有非标准形貌的轴对称微凸体（asperities），可以打破经典赫兹接触理论（Hertzian limit）所固有的线性面积-载荷关系，从而实现可编程的非线性宏观摩擦响应。；创新点：提出了一个超越经典Archard和Greenwood-Williamson模型线性标度限制的逆设计框架，能够通过仅包含少量微凸体的单胞自动发现并复现复杂的目标摩擦定律，为功能化摩擦表面的发现提供了一条尺度无关的路径。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种结合数据驱动优化与严格物理的逆设计框架。具体包括：1）利用一个完全可微分的接触力学引擎（fully differentiable contact mechanics engine）；2）将其嵌入神经网络和二次优化器中；3）通过正则化的物理梯度（regularized physical gradients）自动发现非标准形貌；4）使用高保真边界元法（Boundary Element Method, BEM）模拟对设计结果进行严格验证。

papers.title: Nano-Clay-Stabilized Water-in-Oil Colloidal Pickering Emulsions as Thixotropic Lubricant
